第一部分：分析模式

Part 1. Analysis Patterns

本书的这一部分介绍了来自多个商业领域的模式。第二章首先探讨了用于描述各方之间责任关系的模式，包括正式的组织关系和合同关系，以及较为非正式的关系。第三章和第四章着重探讨观察和测量，介绍了用于记录世界事实的模式。第三章的案例源于医疗保健领域。第四章则提供了一些来自公司财务分析领域的模式。

This portion of the book presents patterns from a number of business domains. We start in Chapter 2 by looking at patterns for describing relationships that define responsibilities between parties. These include formal organizational and contractual relationships, as well as more informal relationships. Chapters 3 and 4 consider observation and measurement, presenting patterns for recording facts about the world. The origins for Chapter 3 are in health care. Chapter 4 provides a number of patterns from the realm of corporate financial analysis.

第五章探讨我们如何指称对象，并非语言的寻址和内存管理，而是我们在工作生活中精确指称对象时所需的索引。第六章和第七章考察会计的基本模式，阐述账户网络和记账规则如何构成一个有效的会计系统。第八章的主题是计划，我们将探讨标准计划和一次性计划之间的关系，以及如何计划和记录资源的使用情况。

Chapter 5 looks at how we refer to objects, not the addressing and memory management of languages, but the indexing we need when referring exactly to objects in our working life. Chapters 6 and 7 examine basic patterns for accounting, describing how a network of accounts and posting rules can form an active accounting system. Planning is the subject of Chapter 8, where we examine the relationship between standard plans and one-off plans, and how to plan and record the use of resources.

第九章探讨了价格波动情况下的交易，以及我们需要了解的价格变化如何影响交易利润。第十章则着眼于衍生品交易这一更为专业的领域，并关注那些导致我们构建业务对象继承层级结构的问题。衍生品就是这类常见问题的一个例子。最后，第十一章我们将目光从单个对象转向对象包，并探讨如何组织这些对象包以提高其可维护性和灵活性。

Chapter 9 examines trading in situations where prices are fluid and we need to understand how these price changes affect the profits of our trades. Chapter 10 then looks at the more specialized area of derivative trading, but with an eye at the problems of situations which lead us to build inheritance hierarchies of business objects. Derivatives are one example of more common problems. Finally in Chapter 11 we look beyond objects, to packages of objects, and visit some of the problems of organizing them in a way that improves their maintainability and flexibility.

第二章 问责制

Chapter 2. Accountability

问责制的概念适用于个人或组织对他人负有责任的情况。它是一个抽象的概念，可以涵盖许多具体问题，包括组织结构、合同和雇佣关系。

The concept of accountability applies when a person or organization is responsible to another. It is an abstract notion that can represent many specific issues, including organization structures, contracts, and employment.

本章首先介绍重要的参与方模式（2.1）——即个人和组织的超类型。然后，利用组织结构问题来展示问责模型的构建过程。简单的组织结构可以用组织层级（2.2）来建模。当层级众多时，模型变得过于复杂，此时就需要组织结构模式（2.3）。参与方模式和组织结构模式的结合产生了问责机制（2.4）。问责机制可以处理参与方之间的多种关系：组织结构、患者知情同意、服务合同、雇佣关系以及在专业机构的注册等。

This chapter begins by introducing the important pattern of party (2.1)— the supertype of person and organization. The organization structure problem is then used to show the development of the accountability model. Simple organization structures can be modeled with organization hierarchies (2.2). When many hierarchies develop the model becomes too complex, and the organization structure (2.3) pattern is required. The combination of the party and organization structure patterns produces accountability (2.4). Accountabilities can handle many relationships between parties: organization structures, patient consent, contracts for services, employment, and registration with professional bodies.

在使用问责机制时，描述可以形成哪些类型的问责机制以及约束这些问责机制的规则至关重要。这些规则可以通过问责知识层级（2.5）的类型实例来描述。该层级包含参与方类型，允许在不改变模型的情况下，使用参与方类型概括（2.6）对参与方进行分类和子类型划分。层级问责（2.7）代表那些需要严格层级结构的参与方关系。通过这种方式，问责机制既可以用于层级关系网络，也可以用于更复杂的关系网络。

When accountabilities are used it is valuable to describe what kinds of accountabilities can be formed and the rules that constrain these accountabilities. These rules can be described by instances of types at the accountability knowledge level (2.5). This level includes the party type, which allows parties to be classified and subtyped with party type generalizations (2.6) without changing the model. Hierarchic accountability (2.7) represents those interparty relationships that do require a strict hierarchy. In this way accountabilities can be used for both hierarchic and more complex networks of relationships.

问责制界定了各方的责任。这些责任可以通过操作范围（2.8）来界定。操作范围是问责制合同中的条款，类似于持续订单中的明细项目。随着这些责任的累积，将它们与岗位（2.9）而非岗位负责人关联起来可能更为有效。

Accountabilities define responsibilities for parties. These responsibilities can be defined through operating scopes (2.8). Operating scopes are the clauses of the accountability's contract, rather like line items on an ongoing order. As these responsibilities accumulate it can be useful to attach them to a post (2.9) rather than to the person who occupies it.

本章基于多个项目：问责制是贯穿始终的主题。最初的理念源于为一家公用事业公司开展的客户服务项目和为一家电话公司开展的会计项目。问责制模型则是在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的 Cosmos 项目中开发的[2]。

This chapter is based on many projects: Accountabilities are a common theme. Original ideas developed with a customer service project for a utility and an accounting project for a telephone company. The accountability model was developed in the Cosmos project for the UK National Health Service [2].

关键概念：政党、问责制

Key Concepts Party, Accountability

2.1 党

2.1 Party

翻翻你的通讯录，你看到了什么？如果跟我的一样，你会看到很多地址、电话号码，偶尔还有电子邮件地址……所有这些都与某些东西相关联。通常，这个“东西”指的是某个人，但偶尔也会出现公司。我经常打电话给Town Taxi，但我并不想跟某个特定的人说话——我只是想打车。图2.1或许可以作为通讯录建模的初步尝试，但它存在一些重复，让我看着很不舒服。我本能地会寻找一种将人和公司概括起来的方法。这种类型是典型的未命名概念——每个人都知道并使用它，但却没有人给它起个名字。我在无数的数据模型中都见过这种情况，它们被赋予了各种各样的名称：人/组织、参与者、法人实体等等。

Take a look through your address book, and what do you see? If it's anything like mine, you will see a lot of addresses, telephone numbers, the odd e-mail address... all linked to something. Often that something is a person, but once in awhile a company shows up. I call Town Taxi frequently, but there's no particular person I want to speak to there—I just want to get a cab. A first attempt at modeling the address book might be Figure 2.1, but it has a duplication that is painful to my eye. Instinctively I look for a generalization of person and company. This type is a classic case of an unnamed concept—one that everybody knows and uses but nobody has a name for. I have seen it on countless data models on various names: person/organization, player, legal entity, and so on.

图 2.1 地址簿的初始模型。

Figure 2.1 Initial model of an address book.

该模型展现了个人和组织相似的责任。

This model shows the similar responsibilities of person and organization.

我更倾向于使用“方”这个词。在图 2.2 中，我将“方”定义为个人或组织的超类型。这样，我就可以拥有公司内部各部门，甚至是非正式团队的地址和电话号码。

The term I prefer is party. In Figure 2.2 I define a party as the supertype of a person or organization. This allows me to have addresses and phone numbers for departments within companies, or even informal teams.

图 2.2 图 2.1 使用政党进行概括。

Figure 2.2 Figure 2.1 generalized using party.

在许多情况下，如果使用“个人”或“组织”，则应使用“一方”。

Party should be used in many situations where person or organization is used.

令人惊讶的是，很多事情都与政党而非个人或组织相关。你会收发信件给个人和组织；我会向个人和组织付款；组织和个人都会开展活动、拥有银行账户、缴纳税款。我认为，这些例子足以证明这种抽象概念的价值。

It is surprising how many things relate to party rather than to person or organization. You receive and send letters to both people and organizational units; I make payments to people and organizations; both organizations and people carry out actions, have bank accounts, file taxes. These examples are enough, I think, to make the abstraction worthwhile.

例如，在英国国家医疗服务体系中，相关方包括：汤姆·凯恩斯医生、圣玛丽医院肾脏科团队、圣玛丽医院、帕克赛德地区卫生局和皇家内科医师学会。

Example In the UK National Health Service, the following would be parties: Dr. Tom Cairns, the renal unit team at St. Mary's Hospital, St. Mary's Hospital, Parkside District Health Authority, and the Royal College of Physicians.

2.2 组织层级

2.2 Organization Hierarchies

我们考虑一家典型的跨国公司：Aroma Coffee Makers, Inc. (ACM)。它由多个运营单元组成，这些运营单元又分为若干区域，区域再分为若干事业部，事业部又分为若干销售办事处。我们可以用图 2.3 来模拟这种简单的组织结构。然而，我并不完全满意这个模型。如果组织结构发生变化，例如为了形成更扁平化的结构而取消区域划分，那么我们就必须修改模型。图 2.4 提供了一个更简单的模型，也更容易修改。图 2.4 中所示的递归关系存在一个问题，那就是它允许事业部成为销售办事处的一部分。我们可以通过定义与层级对应的子类型，并对这些子类型施加约束来解决这个问题。如果组织层级发生变化，我们将修改这些子类型和规则。通常，修改规则比修改模型结构更容易，所以我更倾向于图 2.4 而不是图 2.3。

Let us consider a generic multinational: Aroma Coffee Makers, Inc. (ACM). It has operating units, which are divided into regions, which are divided into divisions which are divided into sales offices. We can model this simple structure using Figure 2.3. This is not a model that I would feel content with, however. If the organization changes, say regions are taken out to provide a flatter structure, then we must alter the model. Figure 2.4 provides a simpler model—one that is easier to change. The danger with the recursive relationship shown in Figure 2.4 is that it allows a division to be part of a sales office. We can deal with this by defining subtypes to correspond with the levels and by putting constraints on these subtypes. Should the organizational hierarchy change, we would alter these subtypes and rules. Usually it is easier to change a rule than to change the model structure, so I prefer Figure 2.4 over Figure 2.3.

图 2.4 具有层级关系的组织超类型。

Figure 2.4 Organization supertype with hierarchic relationship.

层级关联提供了最大的灵活性。由于层级关系而产生的约束必须 作为子类型的规则添加。

The hierarchic association provides the most flexibility. Constraints due to levels have to be added as rules on the subtypes.

层级结构提供了一定的通用性，但也存在一些局限性，例如它仅支持单一的组织层级。假设ACM公司将其主要咖啡机产品线的售后服务团队与销售办事处关联起来。这些团队采用双重汇报结构：他们既向销售团队汇报，也向各产品系列的售后服务部门汇报，而售后服务部门又向产品类型支持部门汇报。因此，位于波士顿的2176型高容量卡布奇诺咖啡机（每分钟50杯）的售后服务团队，既向波士顿销售办事处汇报，也向2170系列售后服务中心汇报，而2170系列售后服务中心又向高容量意大利咖啡部门汇报，高容量意大利咖啡部门向高容量咖啡产品售后服务部门汇报，高容量咖啡产品售后服务部门最终向咖啡产品售后服务部门汇报。（以上并非虚构！）面对这种情况，我们可以添加第二个层级结构，如图2.5所示。 （还需要更多规则，类似于图 2.4 中的规则，但我将这些规则的添加留给读者作为练习。）目前这种方法效果很好，但随着层级结构的增多，结构将变得笨拙。

The hierarchic structure provides a certain amount of generality but has some limitations, including the fact that it only supports a single organizational hierarchy. Assume that ACM attaches service teams for its major lines of coffee makers to its sales offices. These teams have a dual reporting structure: They report to the sales team as well as the service departments for each product family, which in turn report to product type support units. Thus the service team for the 2176 high-volume cappuccino maker in Boston (50 cappuccinos a minute) reports to the Boston sales office but also to the 2170 family service center, which reports to the high-volume Italian coffee division, which reports to the high-volume coffee products service division, which reports to coffee products service division. (I'm not making this up entirely!) Faced with this situation we can add a second hierarchy, as shown in Figure 2.5. (More rules would be required, similar to those in Figure 2.4, but I will leave the addition of those as an exercise for the reader.) As it stands this approach works well, but as more hierarchies appear the structure will become unwieldy.

图 2.5 两种组织层级。

Figure 2.5 Two organizational hierarchies.

组织结构的子类型未显示。如果层级过多，很快就会 变得难以管理。

Subtypes of the organization are not shown. If there are many hierarchies, this will soon get out of hand.

2.3 组织结构

2.3 Organization Structure

如果模型看起来包含多个层级，我们可以使用类型化关系，如图 2.6 所示。我们将层级关联转换为类型，并通过使用组织结构类型的不同实例来区分不同的层级。这可以处理上述场景，其中包含组织结构类型的两个实例：销售组织和服务组织。只需添加更多组织结构类型即可添加其他层级。同样，这种抽象方法在适度增加复杂性的情况下为我们提供了更大的灵活性。如果只有两个层级，则不值得这样做，但如果有多个层级，则非常值得。另请注意，组织结构具有时间段；这使我们能够记录组织结构随时间的变化。此外，请注意，我没有将组织结构类型建模为属性——正如我们稍后将看到的，这对于类型属性来说是一个非常重要的因素。

If it looks like the model will have several hierarchies, we can use a typed relationship, as shown in Figure 2.6. We turn the hierarchic associations into a type and differentiate the hierarchies by using varied instances of the organization structure type. This would handle the above scenario with two instances of the organization structure type: sales organization and service organization. Additional hierarchies could be added merely by adding more organization structure types. Again, this abstraction gives us more flexibility for a modest increase in complexity. For just two hierarchies it would not be worth the effort, but for several it would be. Note also that the organization structure has a time period; this allows us to record changes in the organization structure over time. Note further that I have not modeled the organization structure type as an attribute—a very important factor with type attributes, as we will see later.

例如，位于波士顿的2176型大容量卡布奇诺咖啡机服务团队向波士顿销售办事处汇报工作。我们可以将其建模为一个组织结构模型，其中上级是波士顿销售办事处，下级是波士顿2176型服务团队，组织结构类型为直线管理。

Example The service team for the 2176 high-volume cappuccino maker in Boston reports to the Boston sales office. We would model this as an organization structure whose parent is the Boston sales office, subsidiary is the Boston 2176 service team, and organization structure type is line management.

例如，位于波士顿的 2176 型大容量卡布奇诺咖啡机服务团队也隶属于产品支持架构中的 2170 型系列服务中心。我们可以将其建模为一个独立的组织结构，其上级为 2170 型系列服务中心，下级为波士顿 2176 型服务团队，组织结构类型为产品支持。

Example The service team for the 2176 high-volume cappuccino maker in Boston also reports to the 2170 family service center in the product support structure. We would model this as a separate organization structure whose parent is the 2170 family service center, subsidiary is the Boston 2176 service team, and organization structure type is product support.

简化对象结构会更加强调规则。这些规则的形式为：“如果我们有一个组织结构，其类型为销售组织，其子组织为事业部，那么其父组织必定是区域。” 请注意，这些规则是通过引用组织的属性来表达的。

Simplifying the object structure puts more emphasis on the rules. The rules are of the form, "If we have an organization structure whose type is sales organization and whose child is a division, then the parent must be a region." Note that the rules are expressed by referring to properties of the organization

图 2.6 使用类型化关系。

Figure 2.6 Using a typed relationship.

组织间的每种关系都由组织结构类型定义。 如果关系众多，这种方式比显式关联更有效。

Each relationship between organizations is defined by an organization structure type. It is better than explicit associations if there are many relationships.

这意味着规则应该基于组织结构制定。然而，这也意味着，如果通过添加新的组织结构类型来扩展系统，就需要修改组织结构中的规则。此外，随着组织结构类型数量的增加，规则会变得非常繁琐。

structure, which implies that the rules should be on the organization structure. However, this means that extending the system by adding a new organization structure type would require changing the rules in the organization structure. Furthermore, the rules would get very unwieldy as the number of organization structure types increases.

规则可以放在组织结构类型上，如图 2.7 所示。特定组织结构类型的所有规则都保存在一个地方，并且很容易添加新的组织结构类型。

The rules can be placed instead on the organization structure type, as shown in Figure 2.7. All the rules for a particular organization structure type are held in one place, and it is easy to add new organization structure types.

然而，如果我们很少更改组织结构类型，却频繁添加新的组织子类型，那么图 2.7 就无法很好地发挥作用。在这种情况下，每次添加组织子类型都会导致规则变更。更好的做法是将规则放在组织子类型上。这里的要点是尽量减少模型变更。因此，我们应该将规则放置在最易变动的区域，并确保这些规则不会影响模型的其他部分。

Figure 2.7 does not work well, however, if we change the organization structure types rarely but add new subtypes of organization frequently. In that case each addition of a subtype of organization would cause rule changes. It is better to place the rules on the subtypes of the organization. The general point here is to minimize the model changes that occur. Thus we should place the rules in the most volatile area in such a way that need not touch other parts of the model.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
设计一个模型，使得模型最频繁的修改只会导致最少类型的数据发生变化。
Design a model so that the most frequent modification of the model causes changes to the least number of types.

2.4 问责制

2.4 Accountability

图 2.7 本质上展示了一个组织根据既定规则在一段时间内与另一个组织建立关系。每当对组织做出任何陈述时，都值得考虑以下问题：

Essentially Figure 2.7 shows one organization having a relationship with another for a period of time according to a defined rule. Whenever any statement is made about organizations, it is always worth considering whether the

图 2.7 向图 2.6 添加规则。

Figure 2.7 Adding a rule to Figure 2.6.

该规则强制执行一些限制，例如销售办事处必须向分公司汇报。

The rule enforces constraints such as sales offices reporting to divisions.

同样的道理也适用于人。在这种情况下，我会问：“人们能否根据既定规则，在一段时间内与组织或其他人员建立关系？”答案当然是肯定的，因此我可以而且应该将图 2.7 中的概念抽象化，应用于某个主体。我将这种新的抽象概念命名为“责任”，如图 2.8 所示。

same statement can also apply to people. In this case I ask, "Can people have relationships to organizations or other people for a period of time according to a defined rule?" This is certainly true, and thus I can, and should, abstract Figure 2.7 to apply to a party. As I do this I name the new abstraction an accountability, as shown in Figure 2.8.

图 2.8 问责制。

Figure 2.8 Accountability.

使用第三方机构可以确保问责制涵盖广泛的各方责任， 包括管理、雇佣和合同。

Using a party allows accountability to cover a wide range of interparty responsibilities, including management, employment, and contracts.

例如，约翰·史密斯在ACM公司工作。这可以通过建立问责制模型来体现，其中ACM公司是委托人，约翰·史密斯是责任方，问责类型是雇佣关系。

Example John Smith works for ACM. This can be modeled by an accountability whose commissioner is ACM, responsible party is John Smith, and accountability type is employment.

例如，约翰·史密斯是波士顿 2176 服务团队的经理。这可以建模为一种问责制，其类型为经理，约翰·史密斯对波士顿 2176 服务团队负责。

Example John Smith is the manager of the Boston 2176 service team. This can be modeled as an accountability whose type is manager, with John Smith responsible to the Boston 2176 service team.

例如，马克·瑟兹是皇家内科医师学会的成员。这可以建模为一种问责制，其类型为专业注册，马克·瑟兹对皇家内科医师学会负责。

Example Mark Thursz is a member of the Royal College of Physicians. This can be modeled as an accountability whose type is professional registration, with Mark Thursz responsible to the Royal College of Physicians.

例如，约翰·史密斯同意马克·瑟兹为其进行内窥镜检查。这可以建模为一种问责制，其类型为患者同意，马克·瑟兹对约翰·史密斯负责。

Example John Smith gives his consent to Mark Thursz to perform an endoscopy. This can be modeled as an accountability whose type is patient consent, with Mark Thursz responsible to John Smith.

例如，圣玛丽医院与帕克赛德地区卫生局签订了一份合同，在1996/97年度开展内窥镜检查。这可以建模为一项责任，其类型为内窥镜服务，圣玛丽医院对帕克赛德负责。责任期限为1996年1月1日至1997年12月31日。责任的子类型可以提供更多信息，例如合同涵盖哪些手术以及在合同期内应完成多少例手术。

Example St. Mary's Hospital has a contract with Parkside District Health Authority to perform endoscopies in 1996/97. This can be modeled as an accountability whose type is endoscopy services, with St. Mary's Hospital responsible to Parkside. The time period on the accountability would be January 1, 1996, to December 31, 1997. A subtype of accountability could provide additional information, such as which operations were covered and how many should be performed during the contract's duration.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
在为具有超类型的类型定义特性时，请考虑将特性放在超类型上是否有意义。
Whenever defining features for a type that has a supertype, consider whether placing the features on the supertype makes sense.

正如示例所示，从组织结构抽象到问责制，可以引入一系列其他情况，这些情况都可以被该模型捕捉。然而，模型的复杂性并未增加。基本模型的结构与图 2.7 相同；唯一的区别在于用“参与方”代替了“组织”。

As the examples indicate, abstracting from organization structure to accountability introduces a wide range of additional situations that can be captured by the model. The complexity of the model has not increased, however. The basic model has the same structure as Figure 2.7; the only change is that of using party instead of organization.

2.5 问责知识水平

2.5 Accountability Knowledge Level

然而，问题在于，问责类型远多于组织结构类型，这增加了复杂性。因此，定义问责类型的规则也会变得更加复杂。

Complexity has been introduced, however, in that there are many more accountability types than there would be organization structure types. The rules for defining accountability types would thus become more complex.

引入知识层可以管理这种复杂性。知识层将模型分为两个部分：操作层和知识层。操作层包括责任主体、参与方及其相互关系。知识层包括责任类型、参与方类型及其相互关系，如图 2.9 所示。

This complexity can be managed by introducing a knowledge level. Using a knowledge level splits the model into two sections: the operational and knowledge levels. The operational level consists of accountability, party, and their interrelationships. The knowledge level consists of accountability type, party type, and their interrelationships, as shown in Figure 2.9.

在操作层面，模型记录领域内的日常事件。在知识层面，模型记录支配该结构的通用规则。知识层面的实例控制着操作层面实例的配置。在本例中，实例

At the operational level the model records the day to day events of the domain. At the knowledge level the model records the general rules that govern this structure. Instances in the knowledge level govern the configuration of instances in the operational level. In this example instances of

图 2.9 知识和操作层面的问责制。

Figure 2.9 Knowledge and operational levels of accountability.

知识层对象定义了操作层 对象的法律配置。责任关系只能在符合相应责任类型和参与方类型的各方之间建立。

The knowledge level objects define the legal configurations of operational level objects. Accountabilities can only be created between parties according to corresponding accountability types and party types.

问责制（实际参与方之间的联系）受到问责类型和参与方类型之间联系的制约。

accountability (links between actual parties) are constrained by the links between accountability type and party type.

例如，区域会被细分为若干部门。这种划分是通过一种问责制的区域结构来实现的，其中专员是区域，负责人是部门。

Example Regions are subdivided into divisions. This is handled by an accountability type of regional structure whose commissioners are regions and responsibles are divisions.

例如，患者同意被定义为一种问责类型，其委托人是患者，责任人是医生。

Example Patient consent is defined as an accountability type whose commissioners are patients and responsibles are doctors.

注意，映射到政党类型取代了对政党的子类型化。这是 Odell [3] 所说的“强类型”的一个例子，当映射定义了子类型时就会出现强类型。政党类型与其子类型紧密相关，因为子类型区域的类型必须与政党类型区域相同。从概念上讲，您可以将政党类型的实例视为与政党的子类型相同的对象，尽管这在主流编程语言中无法直接实现。因此，政党类型是政党的强类型。通常，我们只需要映射或子类型化中的一个即可。

Note how mapping to the party type replaces subtyping of the party. This is an example of what Odell [3] refers to as a power type, which occurs when a mapping defines subtypes. The party type is closely linked to the subtypes of party in that the subtype region must have its type as the party type region. Conceptually you can consider the instance of the party type to be the same object as the subtype of party, although this cannot be directly implemented in mainstream programming languages. The party type is then a power type of party. Often we need only one of either the mapping or the subtyping.

然而，如果子类型具有特定行为，且幂类型具有自身特征，则既需要子类型，也需要到幂类型的映射。（Odell 对此情况有特殊的符号表示法[3]。）

However, if the subtypes have specific behavior and the power type has its own features, then both subtypes and mapping to the power type are needed. (Odell has a special notation for this case [3].)

知识层和运营层之间的这种对应关系虽然相似但不完全相同，因为母公司和子公司之间的映射在知识层是多值的，而在运营层则是单值的。这是因为运营层记录的是实际的责任主体，而知识层记录的是责任类型的允许主体类型。这种利用多值知识映射来表示单值运营映射的允许类型的模式很常见。

This reflection between the knowledge and operational levels is similar but not identical, in that the parent and subsidiary mappings are multivalued at the knowledge level but single-valued at the operational level. This is because the operational level records the actual party for the accountability, while the knowledge level records the permissible party types for the accountability type. This use of a multivalued knowledge mapping to show permissible types for a single-valued operational mapping is a common pattern.

知识层和操作层是模型中常见的特征，尽管两者之间的区别通常并未明确指出。我之所以明确区分这两个层级，是因为我发现这有助于我在建模时理清思路。本书中有很多关于操作层和知识层的示例，尤其是在第三章。

Knowledge and operational levels are a common feature of models, although the difference between the levels is often not made explicitly. I make the divisions explicit because I find this helps to clarify my thinking when modeling. There are lots of examples of operational and knowledge levels in this book, particularly in Chapter 3.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
将模型明确划分为操作层和知识层。
Explicitly divide a model into operational and knowledge levels.

许多数据建模人员使用“元模型”一词来描述知识层。我对这种术语并不完全认同。元模型也可以定义建模技术。因此，元模型包含类型、关联、子类型和操作等概念（例如 Rational Software 的统一方法 [ I ] 的元模型）。知识层实际上并不属于这一范畴，因为它没有描述操作层的符号。因此，我仅使用“元模型”一词来描述描述模型语言（符号语义）的模型。

A lot of data modelers use the term meta-model to describe the knowledge level. I am not entirely comfortable with this terminology. Meta-model can also define the modeling technique. Thus a meta-model includes concepts such as type, association, subtyping, and operation (such as the meta-models of Rational Software's Unified Method [ I ] ) . The knowledge level does not really fall into that category because it does not describe the notation for the operational level. I thus only use the term meta-model to describe a model that describes the language (semantics of notation) for a model.1

问责制代表着相当深奥的抽象概念，就像攀登高峰一样，我们应该在出现高原反应之前停下来评估自身状况。尽管对象模型结构非常简单，但大量知识却隐藏在知识层实例中。因此，要使其有效运作，仅仅实现对象模型是不够的；知识层也必须实例化。实例化知识层实际上就是配置系统，这是一种受限的、因而也更简单的编程形式。然而，它仍然是编程，所以您应该考虑如何对其进行测试。

Accountability represents some pretty heady abstraction and as in any climb we should stop and take stock before altitude sickness sets in. Although we have a very simple structure in the object model, a lot of knowledge is buried in the instances of the knowledge level. Thus to make this work it is not enough to implement the object model; the knowledge level must also be instantiated. Instantiating the knowledge level is effectively configuring the system, which is a constrained, and thus simpler, form of programming. It is still programming, however, so you should consider how you are going to test it.

丰富的知识层次也会影响系统间的通信。如果两个系统要进行通信，它们不仅必须共享对象模型，还必须拥有相同的知识对象（或者至少知识层次之间存在某种等价性，如第 5.4 节所述）。最终，一切都归结于此。

Rich knowledge levels also affect communication between systems. If two systems are to communicate, they must not only share the object model but also have identical knowledge objects (or at least some equivalence between knowledge levels, as discussed in Section 5.4). In the end it comes

当然，如果我定义了一个图表，展示了责任类型和参与方类型的实例，那么知识层级就充当了该图表的元模型。当责任类型错综复杂时，这种图表会非常有用。

Of course, if I defined a diagram that showed instances of accountability type and party type, then the knowledge level would act as the meta-model for that diagram. This kind of diagram can be useful if there is a com plicated web of accountability types.

归根结底，如果问责类型数量众多，是使用图 2.9 的结构更简便，还是在图 2.5 的基础上，为每种问责类型添加一个关联关系更简便？问题的复杂性无法避免；我们只能思考，在兼顾类型结构和知识对象的前提下，哪种模型更为简洁。

down to the question, If the number of accountability types is large, is it easier to use the structure of Figure 2.9 or to extend Figure 2.5 with one association for each accountability type? The complexity of the problem cannot be avoided; we can only ask ourselves which is the simpler model, taking both type structure and knowledge objects into account.

与其他任何关系类型一样，我们需要谨慎，避免将其视为涵盖双方之间所有关系的万能灵药。例如，亲生父母就不适合作为责任类型的一个例子，因为双方都不对彼此负责，也没有固有的时间期限；但法定监护人则符合这一条件。

We need to be careful, as with any typed relationship, that this does not become a catch-all for every relationship between two parties. For example, biological parent would not fit as an instance of an accountability type because neither party is responsible to the other, nor is there an inherent time period; legal guardian would fit, however.

2.6 政党类型概括

2.6 Party Type Generalizations

该模型目前的功能已经相当强大，但一些有用的变体可以进一步增强其灵活性。这些变体适用于任何采用知识/操作分离的模型。

The model as it stands is quite powerful, but some useful variations will add even more flexibility. These variations are useful with any model that uses a knowledge/operational split.

以全科医生（GP）爱德华兹医生为例。根据图 2.9 所示的模型，我们可以将他视为全科医生或医生，但不能同时是两者。任何针对医生定义的、也适用于全科医生的责任类型都必须复制过来。我们可以使用多种技术来缓解这个问题。一种方法是允许参与方类型具有子类型和上类型关系，如图 2.10 所示。这本质上引入了……

Consider a general practitioner (GP), Dr. Edwards. Using the model shown in Figure 2.9, we can consider him to be a GP or a doctor but not both. Any accountability types that are defined on doctor that would apply also to GP would have to be copied over. We can use various techniques to alleviate this problem. One approach is to allow party types to have sub- and super-types relationships, as shown in Figure 2.10. This essentially introduces

图 2.10 允许政党类型拥有子类型和超类型。

Figure 2.10 Allowing party types to have sub- and supertypes.

对政党类型进行概括，可以更容易地定义知识水平。

Adding generalization to party types makes it easier to define the knowledge level.

对参与方类型的泛化方式与对类型的泛化方式类似。泛化会导致对问责类型的约束发生变化，从而同时考虑参与方的类型（来自类型映射）和超类型（来自所有类型映射）。

generalization to party types in a similar way that generalization works on types. Generalizations cause a change in the constraint on accountability type, so that both the party's type (from the type mapping) and the supertypes (from the all types mapping] are taken into account.

图 2.10 展示了参与方类型的单一继承层次结构。通过允许超类型映射为多值，可以支持多重继承。此外，图 2.10 仅支持单一分类。这意味着，如果 Edwards 医生既是全科医生又是儿科医生，我们只能通过创建一个特殊的“全科医生/儿科医生”参与方类型来记录这一点，并将全科医生和儿科医生都作为其超类型。多重分类允许在参与方类型的泛化结构之外，为参与方赋予多个参与方类型。这可以通过允许参与方的类型映射为多值来实现。

Figure 2.10 provides a single inheritance hierarchy on party type. Multiple inheritance can be supported by allowing the supertype mapping to be multivalued. In addition, Figure 2.10 only supports single classification. This means that if Dr. Edwards is both a GP and a pediatrician, we can record that only by creating a special GP/pediatrician party type, with both GP and pediatrician as supertypes. Multiple classification allows party to be given multiple party types outside of the generalization structure of party type. This can be done by allowing the type mapping on party to be multivalued.

关于知识层面和操作层面之间相互关系的许多讨论，与建模元模型中对象和类型之间的关系类似。

Much of the discussion about the interrelationships between the knowledge level and operational level is similar to the relationships between object and type in a modeling meta-model.

2.7 层级问责制

2.7 Hierarchic Accountability

问责制所提供的灵活结构，需要付出更多努力来强制执行某些类型的问责制约束。例如，图 2.3 所示的组织结构定义了一系列严格的层级：运营单元划分为区域，区域划分为事业部，事业部划分为销售办事处。虽然可以定义区域结构的问责制类型，但我们如何才能强制执行图 2.3 中所示的严格规则呢？

The flexible structure that accountabilities provide requires more effort to enforce the constraints of some accountability types. For example, the organization structure shown in Figure 2.3 defines a strict series of levels: operating units are divided into regions, that are divided into divisions that are divided into sales offices. It is possible to define an accountability type of regional structure, but how can we enforce the strict rules of Figure 2.3?

第一个问题是，图 2.3 描述的是一个层级结构。然而，现有的问责模型并没有强制执行这种层级结构的规则。这个问题可以通过提供一个带有附加约束的问责类型子类型来解决，如图 2.11 所示。该约束与问责类型的常规约束共同作用，以强制执行操作层级结构的层级性。类似的问责类型子类型也可用于强制执行有向无环图结构。

The first issue is that Figure 2.3 describes a hierarchic structure. The accountability models do not have a rule to enforce such a hierarchy. This can be addressed by providing a subtype of accountability type with an additional constraint, as shown in Figure 2.11. This constraint acts with the usual constraint on accountability types to enforce the hierarchic nature of the operational level structure. A similar accountability type subtype can be used to enforce a directed acyclic graph structure.

利用图 2.11，我们可以通过一系列责任类型来支持图 2.3 所示的案例。例如，责任类型“区域结构级别 1”包含对运营单位负责的区域，“区域结构级别 2”包含对区域负责的部门，依此类推。这种方法虽然可行，但略显笨拙。另一种方法是使用分级责任类型，如图 2.12 所示。在这种情况下，只有一个区域结构责任类型。级别映射将对应于参与方类型列表——运营单位、区域、部门和销售办事处。该模型使得添加新的分级责任类型以及修改需要的级别结构更加容易。层级责任类型捕捉了构成层级结构的各方的责任。

Using Figure 2.11, we can support the case shown in Figure 2.3 by a series of accountability types. An accountability type regional structure level \ would have regions responsible to operating units, regional structure level 2 would have divisions responsible to regions, and so on. This approach works but would be somewhat clumsy. An alternative is to use a leveled accountability type, as shown in Figure 2.12. In this case there would only be a single regional structure accountability type. The levels mapping would map to the list of party types—operating unit, region, division, and sales office. This model makes it easier to add new leveled accountability types and to modify the levels in those structures that need it. The hierarchic accountabil ity type captures the responsibility of the parties forming a hierarchy, the

图 2.11 层级责任类型。

Figure 2.11 Hierarchic accountability type.

新增的限制意味着，受此类问责制约束的各方必须 形成一个层级结构。

The added constraint means that the parties linked by accountabilities of this type must form a hierarchy.

层级式问责制体现了固定顺序的各方类型的责任。区域结构问责制则兼具层级性和层次性。

leveled accountability type captures the responsibility of a fixed sequence of party types. The regional structure accountability type would be both leveled and hierarchic.

图 2.12 分级问责制类型。

Figure 2.12 Leveled accountability type.

分级责任制支持固定层级，例如销售办事处、部门、区域。

Leveled accountabilities supports fixed levels such as sales office, division, region.

子类型上的约束与责任类型上定义的约束共同作用，遵循契约式设计原则[4]。对于分级责任类型，该约束包含了超类型的约束，实际上使得委托人和负责人之间的映射变得多余。这种思路引出了如图 2.13 所示的模型。值得注意的是，图 2.12 并没有错。分级责任类型是责任类型的一个完全合适的子类型，因为责任类型的约束对分级责任类型仍然有效。委托人和负责人之间的映射也仍然有效，尽管它们源自于层级映射。我倾向于采用图 2.12。分级责任类型并非总是必需的，而且可以很容易地添加而不会违反模型。图 2.12 的另一个优点是使知识/运营关系更加明确。

The constraints applied on the subtypes act with the constraint defined on accountability type, following the principles of design by contract [4]. In the case of the leveled accountability type, the constraint subsumes that of the supertype, and indeed makes the commissioners and responsibles mappings superfluous. This thinking leads to a model along the lines of Figure 2.13. It is important to note that Figure 2.12 is not incorrect. Leveled accountability type is a perfectly good subtype of accountability type because the constraint on accountability type will still hold for leveled accountability type. The commissioners and responsibles mappings will also continue to hold, although they would be derived from the levels mapping. I would be inclined to stick with Figure 2.12. The leveled accountability type is not always needed, and can easily be added without violating the model. Figure 2.12 also has the advantage of making the knowledge/operational relationship more explicit.

图 2.13 重新平衡问责类型的子类型。

Figure 2.13 Rebalancing the subtypes of accountability type. A

更好的组织问责层级结构的方式。

better way of organizing the accountability type hierarchy.

2.8 操作范围

2.8 Operating Scopes

问责制本身提供了一种描述各方之间关系的有效方式。问责制的类型描述了他们之间的关系。然而，通常还有其他细节可以更深入地阐释问责制的含义。例如，一位医生可能受雇于伦敦东南部，担任肝脏外科医生，并在1997年实施了20例肝移植手术。又如，一家医院的糖尿病护理团队可能受红盾健康管理组织（Red Shield HMD）委托，为马萨诸塞州西部地区的胰岛素依赖型糖尿病患者提供护理服务。

Accountability, as it stands, provides a valuable way of describing how parties relate to each other. The type of accountability describes what kind of relationship they have. There are usually other details, however, that describe more of the meaning of accountability. Consider a doctor who might be employed as a liver surgeon to carry out 20 liver transplants for southeast London in 1997. A diabetic care team at a hospital might be asked to care for insulin-dependent diabetes patients in western Massachusetts for the Red Shield HMD (Health Management Organization).

如图 2.14 所示，这些细节构成了问责的运作范围。每个运作范围都界定了责任方承担的部分责任后果。抽象地列举运作范围的所有属性是困难的。因此，我们可以看到，问责具有若干运作范围，每个运作范围都是描述其具体特征的子类型。

Such details are the operating scopes of accountability, as shown in Figure 2.14. Each operating scope defines some part of consequences of accountability on the responsible party. It is difficult to enumerate the attributes of an operating scope in the abstract. Thus we see that accountability has a number of operating scopes, each of which is some subtype that describes the actual characteristics.

图 2.14 操作范围。

Figure 2.14 Operating scope.

运营范围界定了在建立责任时所承担的职责 。它们可以用于职位描述。

Operating scopes define the responsibilities that are taken on when an accountability is created. They can be used for job descriptions.

例如，一位负责每年在伦敦东南部进行 20 例肝移植手术的肝脏外科医生，其雇佣责任范围协议包含 20 例手术、肝移植手术协议以及伦敦东南部地区。

Example A liver surgeon who is responsible for 20 liver transplants a year in southeast London has a protocol scope on employment accountability with amount of 20, protocol of liver transplant, and location of southeast London.

例如，一个糖尿病护理团队对红盾保险公司负有责任。该责任涵盖的临床护理范围是针对胰岛素依赖型糖尿病，服务地点位于马萨诸塞州西部。

Example A diabetic care team has accountability with Red Shield. This accountability would have a clinical care scope whose observation concept is insulin-dependent diabetes and location is western Massachusetts.

例如， ACM与印尼咖啡出口商（ICE）签订了一份合同，约定在一年内向其出口3000吨爪哇咖啡和2000吨苏门答腊咖啡。该合同规定了ACM和ICE之间的责任，期限为一年，并包含两项资源条款：每年3000吨爪哇咖啡和每年2000吨苏门答腊咖啡。

Example ACM has a contract with Indonesian Coffee Exporters (ICE) for 3000 tons of Java and 2000 tons of Sumatra over the course of a year. This is described by accountability between ACM and ICE with a year's time period and two resource provisions: 3000 tons/ year of Java and 2000 tons/year of Sumatra.

例如，约翰·史密斯是ACM公司1100和2170系列大容量咖啡机的销售商。他​​在新英格兰地区销售1100和2170两种型号，在纽约地区销售2170型号。他受雇于ACM公司，负责新英格兰地区1100型号、新英格兰地区2170型号和纽约地区2170型号的销售工作。

Example John Smith sells the 1100 and 2170 families of high-volume coffee maker for ACM. He sells both the 1100 and 2170 in New England and sells the 2170 in New York. He has employment accountability to ACM with sales territories for 1100 in New England, 2170 in New England, and 2170 in New York.

在为特定组织使用操作范围时，您需要识别现有的操作范围类型及其属性。虽然很难抽象地概括操作范围，但位置是一个常见因素。如果操作范围的子类型很多，它们可能会形成自己的继承层次结构。在特别复杂的情况下，您可能会看到在知识层级放置操作范围类型 2，以表明哪些问责类型可以拥有哪些操作范围类型。

When using operating scopes for a particular organization, you need to identify the kinds of operating scopes that exist and the properties for them. It is very difficult to generalize about operating scopes in the abstract, but location is a common factor. The subtypes of operating scope may form an inheritance hierarchy of their own if there are many of them. In particularly complex cases you might see an operating scope type2 placed on the knowledge level to show which accountability types can have which operating scope types.

2.9 帖子

2.9 Post

通常情况下，一个人的工作范围——包括其职责和许多责任——会事先在岗位描述中明确界定。当一个人离职时，接替者可能会继承全部职责。这些职责与岗位挂钩，而非与个人挂钩。

Often the operating scopes of a person—their responsibilities, including many of their accountabilities—are defined in advance as that person's job description. When a person leaves a job, the replacement may inherit a full set of responsibilities. These responsibilities are tied to the job rather than the person.

我们可以通过引入“岗位”这一第三方子类型来处理这种情况，如图 2.15 所示。任何与工作本身相关的、无论由谁担任的职责都与岗位相关联。一个人担任岗位，就意味着他/她对岗位负有责任。也就是说，一个人在其任职期间内，必须履行岗位的各项职责。

We can deal with this situation by introducing the post as a third subtype of party, as shown in Figure 2.15. Any responsibilities that are constant to the job, whoever occupies it, are attached to the post. A person fills a post by having an accountability to the post. The notion is that a person is responsible for the responsibilities of the post for the period of time that they are appointed to the post.

例如，保罗·史密斯是高产量产品开发团队的负责人。我们可以将其描述为设立一个高产量产品开发团队负责人的职位。该职位对高产量产品开发团队（一方）负有管理责任。保罗·史密斯对该职位负有单独的责任（任命类型）。

Example Paul Smith is the head of the high-volume product development team. We can describe this by having a post for the head of the high-volume product development team. This has a management accountability with the high-volume product development team (a party). Paul Smith has a separate accountability (of type appointment) to this post.

例如，某医院的移植外科医生岗位职责要求每年完成50例肾移植和20例肝移植手术。该岗位需对医院和相关规程负责，完成50例肾移植和20例肝移植手术。

Example The transplant surgeon post at a hospital has in its job description the requirement to do 50 renal and 20 liver transplants in a year. This post has an accountability with the hospital and protocol scopes for 50 renal transplants and 20 liver transplants.

不应频繁使用帖子。帖子会增加操作层面的复杂性，因为它引入了额外的间接层级。仅在必要时才使用帖子。

Posts should not be used all the time. They add significant complexity to the operational level with their extra level of indirection. Only use posts

2 在这种情况下，操作范围类型的实例必须与操作范围的子类型相匹配。因此，操作范围类型是操作范围的幂类型[3]。

2 In this case the instances of operating scope type must match the subtypes of operating scope. Operating scope type is thus a power type [3] of operating scope.

图 2.15 后。

Figure 2.15 Post.

当职责和范围由职位本身界定，且不 随职位持有者变更而改变时， 便使用职位这一概念。职位任命本身就是一种职责。

Posts are used when accountabilities and scopes are defined by the post and do not change when the holder of the post changes. Appointments to posts are accountabilities.

当岗位职责较为固定且人员更迭频繁时，岗位就显得尤为重要。而如果所有职责都能由一人承担，那么岗位就不是必需的。

when there are significant responsibilities that are static in a post and people change between posts reasonably often. Posts are not necessary in models in which all responsibilities can be attached to a person.
