第三章 观察与测量

Chapter 3. Observations and Measurements

许多计算机系统会记录现实世界中物体的信息。这些信息以记录、属性、对象以及其他各种表示形式进入计算机系统。通常的做法是将信息记录为对象的属性。例如，我的体重是185磅，这一事实会被记录在“人”这一类型的属性中。本章将探讨这种方法的不足之处，并提出更完善的方法。

Many computer systems record information about objects in the real world. This information finds its way into computer systems as records, attributes, objects, and various other representations. The typical route is to record a piece of information as an attribute to an object. For example, the fact that I weigh 185 pounds would be recorded in an attribute of a person type. This chapter examines how this approach fails and suggests more sophisticated approaches.

我们首先讨论数量（3.1）——一种将数字与其关联的单位结合起来的类型。通过结合数字和单位，我们可以更精确地对世界进行建模。将数量及其单位建模为对象后，我们还可以使用转换比率（3.2）来描述如何转换数量。数量模式可以通过使用复合单位（3.3）来扩展，复合单位用其组成部分显式地表示复杂的单位。几乎所有计算机系统都需要数量；货币值应始终使用这种模式来表示。

We begin by discussing quantity (3.1)—a type that combines a number with the unit that is associated with it. By combining numbers and units, we are able to model the world more exactly. With quantities and their units modeled as objects, we can also describe how to convert quantities with a conversion ratio (3.2). The quantity pattern can be extended by using compound units (3.3), which represent complex units explicitly in terms of their components. Quantities are required for almost all computer systems; monetary values should always be represented using this pattern.

数量可以用作对象的属性，用于记录有关对象的信息。然而，当属性数量非常庞大，导致类型过于臃肿时，这种方法就会失效。在这种情况下，可以使用测量（3.4）将测量值视为独立的对象。当需要保存有关单个测量值的信息时，这种模式也很有用。本章将开始介绍操作层和知识层（参见2.5节）的应用。

Quantities can be used as attributes of objects to record information about them. This approach begins to break down, however, when there is a very large number of attributes that can bloat the type with attributes and operations. In these situations measurement (3.4) can be used to treat measurements as objects in their own right. This pattern is also useful when you need to keep information about individual measurements. Here we begin to see the use of operational and knowledge levels (see Section 2.5) in this chapter.

测量使我们能够记录定量信息。观察（3.5）将这种模式扩展到定性信息，从而允许在知识层面上对观察概念（3.6）进行细分。记录观察方案（3.7）通常也至关重要，以便临床医生更好地解读观察结果，并确定观察的准确性和敏感性。

Measurements allow us to record quantitative information. Observation (3.5) extends this pattern to deal with qualitative information and thus allows subtyping observation concepts (3.6) in the knowledge level. It is also often essential to record the protocol (3.7) for an observation so that clinicians can better interpret the observation as well as determine the accuracy and sensitivity of the observation.

一些小的模式可以扩展观察范围。观察发生的时间与记录时间之间的差异可以通过双重时间记录法（3.8）来捕捉。通常，记录已被证明不正确的观察结果非常重要；这就需要对观察结果进行舍弃（3.9）。观察中最棘手的问题在于如何处理确定性，因为记录关于对象的假设通常很重要。主动观察、假设和预测的细分（3.10）是解决这个问题的一种方法。

A number of small patterns extend observation. The difference between the time an observation occurred and when it is recorded can be captured with a dual time record (3.8). Often it is important to keep a record of observations that have been found to be incorrect; this requires a rejected observation (3.9). The biggest headache with observation is dealing with certainty, for it is often important to record hypotheses about objects. The subtyping of active observation, hypothesis, and projection (3.10) is one way of dealing with this problem.

许多关于观察结果的陈述都是通过诊断过程得出的。我们根据其他观察结果推断出新的观察结果。关联观察（3.11）可用于记录证据观察结果，以及用于诊断的知识。

Many statements about observations are made using a process of diagnosis. We infer observations based on other observations. Associated observation (3.11) can be used to record the evidence observations, plus the knowledge that was used for the diagnosis.

上述模式是结构性的，用于记录我们的观察结果。为了理解它们的工作原理，有必要考虑观察过程（3.12），该过程可以用基于事件的技术进行建模。

The preceding patterns are structural and are used to make records of our observations. To understand how they work, it is useful to consider the process of observation (3.12), which can be modeled with an event-based technique.

很少有哪个行业像医学一样对测量和观察有着如此复杂的要求。本章的模型源自英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的“宇宙”（Cosmos）项目[3]，该项目旨在从临床角度对医疗保健进行建模。在这个项目中，由医生、护士和分析师组成的联合团队共同致力于解决一个出了名的难题。我们在此不赘述“宇宙”模型的具体细节，感兴趣的读者可以参考完整的模型[1]。本文中的理念可以移植到其他领域：第四章将探讨如何将其应用于公司金融领域。

Few professions have such complex demands on measurements and observations as medicine. The models in this chapter come from an intense effort in modeling health care from a clinical perspective—the Cosmos project [3] of the UK National Health Service. In this project a joint team of doctors, nurses, and analysts worked together on a notoriously difficult domain. We do not include a pure description of the Cosmos model here. Those interested should refer to the complete model [1]. The ideas here can be transplanted to other areas: Chapter 4 discusses how this was done for corporate finance.

关键概念：数量、单位、测量、观察、观察概念、现象类型、关联函数、被拒绝的观察、假设。

Key Concepts Quantity, Unit, Measurement, Observation, Observation Concept, Phenomenon Type, Associative Function, Rejected Observation, Hypothesis.

3.1 数量

3.1 Quantity

在当前的计算机系统中，记录测量值最简单、最常用的方法是在专门设计的测量字段中记录一个数字，例如图 3.1 所示的格式。这种方法的一个问题是，用数字来表示人的身高并不合适。说我的身高是 6，或者我的体重是 185，这到底是什么意思？为了理解这些数字的含义，我们需要单位。一种方法是在关联名称中引入单位（例如，体重单位为磅）。单位可以明确数字的含义，但这种表示方式仍然显得笨拙。这种方法的另一个问题是，记录者必须使用正确的单位。如果有人告诉我他们的体重是 80 公斤，我应该记录什么？理想情况下，一份好的记录，尤其是在医学领域，应该准确地记录测量值——不多也不少。然而，即使是确定性的单位转换，也无法完全做到这一点。

The simplest and most common way of recording measurements in current computer systems is to record a number in a field designed for a particular measurement, such as the arrangement shown in Figure 3.1. One problem with this method is that using a number to represent a person's height is not very appropriate. What does it mean to say that my height is 6, or that my weight is 185? To make sense of the number, we need units. One way of doing this is to introduce a unit into the name of the association (for example, weight in pounds). The unit clarifies the meaning of the number, but the representation remains awkward. Another problem with this technique is that the recorder must use the correct units for the information. If someone tells me their weight is 80 kilograms, what am I to record? Ideally a good record, especially in medicine, records exactly what was measured—no more, no less. A conversion, however deterministic, does not follow that faithfully.

图 3.1 数字属性。

Figure 3.1 Number attribute.

这种方法没有指定单位。

This approach does not specify the units.

在此背景下，数量是一个非常有用的概念。图 3.2 展示了一种结合了数字和单位的对象类型，例如 6 英尺或 180 磅。数量包含相应的算术和比较运算。例如，加法运算允许像加数字一样轻松地将数量相加，但会检查单位，以避免将 34 英寸加到 68 公斤上。数量是一个“完整值”[2]，用户界面可以解释并显示它（简单的打印操作即可显示数字和单位）。这样，数量很快就能像整数或日期一样，成为一种实用且应用广泛的属性。

In this context a very useful concept is that of quantity. Figure 3.2 shows an object type that combines number and units, for example, 6 feet or 180 pounds. Quantity includes appropriate arithmetical and comparative operations. For example, an addition operation allows quantities to be added together as easily as numbers but checks the units so that 34 inches are not added to 68 kilograms. Quantity is a "whole value" [2] that the user interface can interpret and display (a simple print operation can show the number and the unit). In this way quantity soon becomes as useful and as widely used an attribute as integer or date.

图 3.2 使用数量作为属性的测量。

Figure 3.2 Measurements as attributes using quantity.

凡需使用单位的地方，都应使用数量。

Quantity should always be used where units are required.

例如，我们可以将 185 磅的重量表示为数量 185，单位为磅。

Example We can represent a weight of 185 pounds as a quantity with amount of 185 and unit of pounds.

货币价值也应该以数量的形式表示（本书中我使用“货币”一词），并以某种货币作为单位。使用数量，您可以轻松处理多种货币，而不是局限于单一货币（要是我的个人理财程序也能做到这一点就好了！）。货币对象还可以控制金额的表示方式。如果使用浮点数来表示货币价值，金融系统中经常会出现舍入问题；货币数量可以强制使用定点数来表示金额属性。

Monetary values should also be represented as quantities (I use the term money in this book), using a currency as the unit. With quantities you can easily deal with multiple currencies, rather than being tied to a single currency (if only my personal finance program did that!). Money objects can also control the representation of the amount. Often rounding problems occur in financial systems if floating point numbers are used to represent monetary values; monetary quantities can enforce the use of fixed point numbers for the amount attribute.

例如， 80 美元可以用数量 80 和单位美元来表示。

Example $80 would be represented as a quantity with amount of 80 and units of US dollars.

数量的使用是面向对象分析的一个重要特征。许多建模方法区分属性和关联。关联将模型中的类型连接起来，而属性则根据某种属性类型包含特定的值。问题是，是什么使某个东西成为属性而不是关联？通常，属性是大多数软件环境中典型的内置类型（例如整数、实数、字符串、日期等等）。像数量这样的类型并不符合这种在属性和关联之间进行选择的方式。一些建模者认为应该用关联来建模数量（因为它不是典型的内置类型），而另一些建模者则建议使用属性（因为它是一个自包含的、广泛使用的类型）。在概念建模中，具体采用哪种方式并不重要，重要的是要寻找并使用像数量这样的类型。由于我不区分属性和映射，所以我不参与这场争论。（我之所以强调这一点，是因为我发现像数量这样的类型在我看到的大多数模型中都明显缺失。）

The use of quantity is an important feature of object-oriented analysis. Many modeling approaches make a distinction between attributes and associations. Associations link types in the model, and attributes contain some value according to some attribute type. The question is, what makes something an attribute rather than an association? Usually attributes are the typical built-in types of most software environments (integer, real, string, date, and so on). Types such as quantity do not fit into this way of choosing between attribute and association. Some modelers say quantity should be modeled with an association (because it is not a typical built-in type), while other modelers recommend an attribute (because it is a self-contained, widely used type). In conceptual modeling it doesn't really matter which way you do it, the important thing is that you look for and use types such as quantity. Since I don't distinguish between attributes and mappings, I don't get into this argument. (I'm laboring this point because I find types such as quantity conspicuously absent from most of the models I see.)

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当多个属性与可能在多种类型中使用的行为相互作用时，将这些属性合并成一个新的基本类型。
When multiple attributes interact with behavior that might be used in several types, combine the attributes into a new fundamental type.

3.2 转化率

3.2 Conversion Ratio

我们可以充分利用模型中显式表示的单位。单位的首要作用是允许我们将数量从一种单位转换为另一种单位。如图 3.3 所示，我们可以使用单位之间的转换比率对象，然后为数量赋予一个操作 `convertTo(Unit)`，该操作可以返回给定单位下的新数量。此操作会检查转换比率，以确定是否可以从接收对象的数量推导出目标数量。

We can make good use of units represented explicitly in the model. The first service that units can perform is to allow us to convert quantities from one unit to another. As shown in Figure 3.3 we can use conversion ratio objects between units and then give quantity an operation, convertTo (Unit), which can return a new quantity in the given unit. This operation looks at the conversion ratios to see if a path can be traced from the receiving object's quantity to the desired quantity.

例如，我们可以通过定义英尺到英寸的转换比率（数字为 12）来在英寸和英尺之间进行转换。

Example We can convert between inches and feet by defining a conversion ratio from feet to inches with the number 12.

图 3.3 将换算比率添加到单位中。

Figure 3.3 Adding conversion ratios to units.

例如，我们可以通过定义英寸到毫米的转换比率 25.4 来实现英寸和毫米之间的转换。然后，我们可以将此比率与英尺到英寸的转换比率结合起来，从而实现英尺到毫米的转换。

Example We can convert between inches and millimeters by defining a conversion ratio from inches to millimeters with the number 25.4. We can then combine this ratio with the conversion ratio from feet to inches to convert from feet to millimeters.

转换比率可以处理大多数转换，但并非所有转换。例如，摄氏度到华氏度的转换需要比简单的乘法运算更复杂的计算。在这种情况下，需要使用针对特定实例的方法（参见 6.6 节）。

Conversion ratios can handle most but not all kinds of conversion. A conversion from Celsius to Fahrenheit requires a little more than simple multiplication. In this case an individual instance method (see Section 6.6) is required.

如果有很多不同的单位需要转换，我们可以考虑记录单位的量纲。例如，力的量纲是 [MLT2]，对于非国际单位制 (SI) 单位，我们也需要一个标量。有了量纲和标量，我们就可以自动计算转换比率，虽然设置起来需要一些工作。

If we have a lot of different units to convert, we can consider holding the dimensions of a unit. For example, force has dimensions of [MLT2], and we also need a scalar for units that are not S.I. units. With the dimensions and the scalar, we can compute conversion ratios automatically, although it is a bit of work to set it up.

请注意，由于一个月的天数不是恒定的，因此日期和月份之间的时间转换并不准确。

Be aware that time does not convert properly between days and months because the number of days in a month is not constant.

如果转化过程中有多个备选路径，我们可以在测试用例中利用它们。测试应该检查转化在两个方向上是否都能正常工作。

If we have several alternative paths in conversion, we can make use of them in our test cases. The tests should check that the conversions work in both directions.

对于以货币为单位的货币价值而言，其兑换比率并非随时间保持不变。我们可以通过赋予兑换比率属性来指示其适用时间，从而解决这个问题。

For monetary values, whose units are currencies, the conversion ratios are not constant over time. We can deal with this problem by giving the conversion ratios attributes to indicate their time of applicability.

在单位换算时，我们可以使用换算比率（如本文所述）或场景法（如第 9.4 节所述）。如果换算频繁变化，且我需要了解多组一致的换算结果，我会使用场景法。否则，更简单的换算比率模型更为合适。

When converting between units, we can use either conversion ratios, as described here, or scenarios, as described in Section 9.4. I use scenarios if the conversions change frequently and I need to know about many sets of consistent conversions. Otherwise, the simpler conversion ratio is the better model.

3.3 复合单元

3.3 Compound Units

单位可以是原子单位或复合单位。复合单位是由原子单位组合而成的，例如平方英尺或米每秒。复杂的单位换算运算可以利用原子单位的换算比率来转换复合单位。复合单位需要记住所使用的原子单位及其幂。图 3.4 是一个简单的复合单位转换模型示例。请记住，幂可以是正数也可以是负数。

Units can be atomic or compound. A compound unit is a combination of atomic units, such as feet2 or meters per second. A sophisticated conversion operation can use conversion ratios on atomic units to convert compound units. The compound units need to remember which atomic units are used and their powers. Figure 3.4 is an example of a straightforward model that can convert compound units. Remember that the power can be positive or negative.

例如，我们可以用一个数量为 150 的量来表示 150 平方码的面积，该量的单位是一个复合单位，其中一个单位参考英尺，其幂为 2。

Example We can represent an area of 150 square yards by a quantity whose number is 150 and whose unit is a compound unit with one unit reference to feet with power 2.

该模型的一个变体利用包来表示映射关系。与通常的集合不同，包允许我们在映射中多次使用同一个对象，如图 3.5 所示。当关系只有一个数值属性时，包尤其有用。

A variation on this model takes advantage of representing mappings with bags. Unlike the usual sets, bags allow us to use an object more than once in a mapping, as shown in Figure 3.5. Bags are particularly useful when we have a relationship that has a single numeric attribute.

图 3.4 复合单元。

Figure 3.4 Compound units.

该模型可用于研究加速度及类似现象。

This model can be used for acceleration and similar phenomena.

图 3.5 使用包装袋的复合单元。

Figure 3.5 Compound units using bags. This

该模型比图 3.4 更紧凑。

model is more compact than Figure 3.4.

例如，重力加速度可以用一个数值为 9.81 的量来表示，该量是一个复合单位，其直接单位为米，反单位为秒和秒。

Example The acceleration due to gravity can be expressed as a quantity with number 9.81 and a compound unit with direct units of meter and inverse units of seconds and seconds.

图 3.4 和图 3.5 之间的差异并不大。我略微偏爱图 3.5，因为它避免了单位引用——这种引用方式用途不大。对于复合单元的大多数用户来说，选择哪种模型并不重要。只有那些需要将复合单元分解为原子单元的用户才会用到这些模型，而大多数用户只需要一些打印表示。显然，如果我们的方法不允许在映射中使用包，我们就必须使用图 3.4。

The difference between Figures 3.4 and 3.5 is not great. I have a mild preference for Figure 3.5 because it avoids unit reference—a type that does not do much. The choice between these models does not matter to most clients of a compound unit. Only clients that need to break the compound unit down into atomic units are involved, and most of the type's clients would only need some printing representation. Obviously we must use Figure 3.4 if our method does not allow bags in mappings.

3.4 测量

3.4 Measurement

将数量建模为属性可能适用于单个医院科室，该科室每次住院就诊仅收集几十项测量数据。然而，当我们放眼整个医学领域时，会发现一个人可能需要进行数千项测量。如果为每项测量都定义一个属性，则意味着一个人可能需要进行数千次操作——这将导致界面过于复杂，难以处理。一种解决方案是将所有可测量的指标（身高、体重、血糖水平等）视为对象，并引入对象类型“现象类型”，如图 3.6 所示。这样，一个人将拥有多项测量数据，每项测量数据都将一个数量值分配给一个特定的现象类型。现在，每个人只需一个属性即可记录所有测量数据，而处理测量数据的复杂性将转移到查询数千个测量值和现象类型的实例上。我们还可以向测量数据添加更多属性，以记录诸如测量者、测量时间、测量地点等信息。

Modeling quantities as attributes may be useful for a single hospital department that collects a couple of dozen measurements for each in-patient visit. However, when we look across all areas of medicine, we find thousands of potential measurements that could be made on one person. Denning an attribute for each measurement would mean that one person could have thousands of operations—an untenably complex interface. One solution is to consider all the various things that can be measured (height, weight, blood glucose level, and so on) as objects and to introduce the object type phenomenon type, as shown in Figure 3.6. A person would then have many measurements, each assigning a quantity to a specific phenomenon type. The person would now have only one attribute for all measurements, and the complexity of dealing with the measurements would be shifted to querying thousands of instances of measurement and phenomenon type. We could now add further attributes to the measurement to record such things as who did it, when it was done, where it was done, and so on.

图 3.6 介绍测量和现象类型。

Figure 3.6 Introducing measurement and phenomenon type.

如果大量的测量选项会使模型过于 复杂，那么这种模型就很有用。现象类型是我们已知可以测量的事物。这种知识属于 模型的知识层级。

This model is useful if a large number of possible measurements would make person too complex. The phenomenon types are things we know we can measure. Such knowledge is at the knowledge level of the model.

例如，约翰·史密斯身高 6 英尺，这可以用一个测量来表示，其中人是约翰·史密斯，现象类型是身高，数量是 6 英尺。

Example John Smith is 6 feet tall, which can be represented by a measurement whose person is John Smith, phenomenon type is height, and quantity is 6 feet.

例如，约翰·史密斯的峰值呼气流速（肺部呼出的空气量和速度）为每分钟 180 升。这可以表示为一个测量值，测量对象为约翰·史密斯，现象类型为峰值呼气流速，数值为每分钟 180 升。

Example John Smith has a peak expiratory flow rate (how much air can be blown out of the lungs, how fast) of 180 liters per minute. This can be represented as a measurement whose person is John Smith, phenomenon type is peak expiratory flow rate, and quantity is 180 liters per minute.

例如，一块混凝土样品的强度用每平方英寸4000磅的力表示。这里，人被替换成一块混凝土样品，其测量结果的现象类型是强度，数量是每平方英寸4000磅。

Example A sample of concrete has a strength indicated by a force of 4000 pounds per square inch. Here the person is replaced by a concrete sample with a measurement whose phenomenon type is strength and quantity is 4000 pounds per square inch.

该模型具有一个简单的划分，在后续分析中被证明非常有用。基于此模型，测量是在系统日常运行过程中产生的。然而，现象类型的创建频率要低得多，因为它们代表了关于要测量什么的知识。因此，我们构思了双层模型：操作层由测量组成，知识层由现象类型组成（另见第 2.5 节）。虽然在这个简单的例子中，这两个层级似乎并不重要，但随着我们更深入地探索建模，我们将看到思考这两个层级非常有用。（尽管图 3.6 显示了划分线，但我们在后续的大多数图中都省略了它；不过，我们有一个惯例，即把知识概念绘制在图的顶部。）

This model has a simple division that was found to be very useful in later analysis. Measurements are created as part of the day-to-day operation of a system based on this model. Phenomenon types, however, are created on a much more infrequent basis because they represent the knowledge of what things to measure. The two-level model was thus conceived: the operational level consists of the measurement, and the knowledge level consists of the phenomenon type (see also Section 2.5). Although it does not seem important in this simple example, we will see that thinking about these two levels is useful as we explore modeling more deeply. (Although Figure 3.6 shows the dividing line, we have left it out of most of the following figures; however, we have a convention of drawing knowledge concepts toward the top of the figure.)

建模原理
Modeling Principle
操作层面包含那些每天都在变化的概念。它们的配置受到变化频率低得多的知识层面的制约。
The operational level has those concepts that change on a day-to-day basis. Their configuration is constrained by a knowledge level that changes much less frequently.
建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果一个类型有许多非常相似的关联/属性/连接，则将所有这些关联都创建为一个新类型的对象。创建一个知识级别类型来区分它们。
If a type has many, manysimilar assoc/at/ons, make all of these associations objects of a new type. Create a knowledge level type to differentiate between them.

我们可以选择将计量单位添加到现象类型中，并使用数字而非数量进行测量。但我更倾向于在测量中保留数量，这样我可以轻松地支持同一现象类型下的多个单位。现象类型中的一组单位可用于检查输入测量值的单位，并为用户提供单位列表以供选择。

We could choose to add the unit of measurement to the phenomenon type and use numbers instead of quantities for the measurement. I prefer to keep quantities on the measurement so that I can easily support multiple units for a phenomenon type. A set of units on a phenomenon type can be used to check the unit of an entered measurement and to provide a list for users to choose from.

3.5 观察

3.5 Observation

正如我们可以对患者做出许多定量描述一样，也有许多重要的定性描述，例如性别、血型以及是否患有糖尿病。由于可能性范围太广，我们不能用属性来描述这些定性信息，因此，类似于测量概念的结构就很有用。

Just as there are many quantitative statements we can make about a patient, there are also many important qualitative statements, such as gender, blood group, and whether or not they have diabetes. We cannot use attributes for these statements because there is such a large range of possibilities, so a construct similar to that for measurement is useful.

考虑记录一个人的性别这一问题，性别只有两个可能的值：男性和女性。我们可以把性别看作是我们正在测量的对象，而男性和女性则是它的两个值，就像任何正数都是一个人身高的有效值一样。由此，我们可以设计一种新的观察类型——类别观察，它类似于测量，但关注的是类别而非数量，如图 3.7 所示。我们还可以设计另一种新的观察类型，作为测量和定性观察的超类型。

Consider the problem of recording a person's gender, which has two possible values: male and female. We can think of gender as being what we are measuring, and male and female are two values for it, just as any positive number is a meaningful value for the height of a person. We can then devise a new type, category observation, which is similar to measurement but has a category instead of quantity, as shown in Figure 3.7. We can also devise another new type of observation that acts as a supertype to a measurement and a qualitative observation.

图 3.7 观察结果和类别观察结果。

Figure 3.7 Observations and category observations.

该模型支持定性测量，例如 A 型血。

This model supports qualitative measurements, such as blood group A.

根据图 3.7，我们可以说性别是现象类型的一个实例，而男性和女性是类别的实例。要记录某人是男性，我们创建一个观察记录，其类别为男性，现象类型为性别。

Using Figure 3.7, we can say that gender is the instance of phenomenon type, and male and female are instances of category. To record that a person is male, we create an observation with a category of male and a phenomenon type of gender.

现在我们需要考虑如何记录某些类别只能用于特定的现象类型。例如，“高”、“中等”和“矮”可能是身高这一现象类型的类别，而 A、B、A/B 和 O 可能是血型这一现象类型的类别。这可以通过建立类别与现象类型之间的关系来实现。那么，有趣的问题是类别到现象类型的映射的基数。我们可以问，血型中使用的对象 A 是否可能与多个现象类型相关联？答案当然是肯定的：我们使用 Child-Pugh 评分来评估肝功能，该评分分为 A（良好）、B（中等）和 C（差）三个等级。这就引出了一个问题：我们所说的 A 究竟是什么意思？如果我们仅仅是指由字符“A”组成的字符串，那么这种映射就是多值的，类别与现象类型无关。只有通过定性观察引入某种现象类型时，类别的含义才能明确。另一种方法是将映射设为单值映射，其中类别仅在现象类型的上下文中定义；也就是说，它不是 A，而是血型 A。

We now have to consider how we can record that certain categories can be used only for certain phenomenon types. Tall, Average, and Short might be categories for the phenomenon type height, while A, B, A/B, and O might be categories for the phenomenon type blood group. This could be done by providing a relationship between category and phenomenon type. The interesting question then is the cardinality of the mapping from category to phenomenon type. We might ask, does the object A used in blood group potentially link to more than one phenomenon type? One answer is, of course it does: We grade liver function on the Childs-Pugh scale, which has values A (reasonable), B (moderate), and C (poor). This raises the question of what we mean by A. If we mean merely the string consisting of the character 'A,' then the mapping is multivalued and the category is independent of the phenomenon type. The category's meaning is only clear when a phenomenon type is brought in through a qualitative observation. The alternative is to make the mapping single-valued, where the category is only defined within the context of the phenomenon type; that is, it is not A but blood group A.

这和我们有什么区别呢？单值情况允许我们记录关于类别的有用信息，例如A在肝功能方面优于B，而血型则不存在这种排序。

What difference is this to us? The single-valued case allows us to record useful information about the categories, such as A is better than B with respect to liver function, while no such ordering exists for blood groups.

我对临床流程的初步调查揭示了一个常见的步骤：患者前来就诊，收集患者病情的相关证据，然后由临床医生进行评估。例如，患者可能主诉口渴、体重减轻和尿频（多尿）。这可能导致临床医生诊断为糖尿病。记录这一诊断时，有两点需要注意。首先，仅仅记录患者患有糖尿病是不够的；临床医生还必须明确记录做出此诊断所依据的证据。其次，临床医生并非凭空做出这种推断。随机的证据不能随意组合，推断也并非随意进行。临床医生必须依靠临床知识。

My initial investigations of the clinical process revealed a common sequence: The patient comes to the facility, evidence is collected about the patient's condition, and a clinician makes an assessment. For example, a patient might come in complaining of excessive thirst, weight loss, and frequent urination (polyuria). This would lead a clinician to diagnose diabetes. A couple of things are important about recording this diagnosis. First, it is not sufficient simply to note that the patient has diabetes; the clinician must also explicitly record the evidence used to come up with this diagnosis. Second, the clinician does not make this kind of deduction out of thin air. Random evidence is not assembled into random deductions. The clinician must rely on clinical knowledge.

考虑将此过程融入我们目前已有的模型中。假设患者体重下降。我们可以将其描述为一种“体重变化”现象，并关联了“增加”、“减少”和“稳定”三个类别。类似地，糖尿病也是一种现象，并关联了“存在”和“不存在”两个类别。显然，我们可以通过在观察结果上建立合适的递归关系来记录观察结果之间的联系，如图 3.8 所示。这样，我们就可以记录糖尿病的观察结果与其证据之间的联系。我们还需要记录体重下降与糖尿病之间联系的临床知识。使用图 3.7 所示的模型，我们将难以记录这种联系。“体重变化”现象和“减少”类别只有在进行观察时才会关联。我们需要一种方法来表达即使没有任何观察结果也可能存在的体重下降，并将其置于知识层面。将类别到现象类型的映射设为单值映射即可实现这一点。（3.11 节将对此进行更深入的讨论。）

Consider placing this process in the model we have so far. The patient is suffering from weight loss. We can capture this by saying that there is a phenomenon type of change in weight, with linked categories of gain, loss, and steady. Similarly there is a phenomenon type of diabetes with categories of present and absent. Clearly we can record the link between the observations by placing a suitable recursive relationship on observation, as shown in Figure 3.8. We can thus record the link between the observation of diabetes and its evidence. We also need to record the clinical knowledge of the link between weight loss and diabetes. Using the model shown in Figure 3.7, we would have difficulty recording this link. The phenomenon type of change in weight and the category of loss are only linked when an observation is made. We need a way to say that weight loss, which can exist without any observations, is at the knowledge level. Making the mapping from category to phenomenon type single-valued provides the way. (Section 3.11 discusses this further.)

图 3.8 记录证据和评估的递归关系。

Figure 3.8 Recursive relationship to record evidence and assessment.

这是将类别到现象类型的映射改为单值映射的有力证据。它将类别提升到知识层级，并将其更名为现象，如图 3.9 所示。现象定义了某些现象类型的可能值。

This was the compelling evidence for making the mapping from category to phenomenon type single-valued. It moved category to the knowledge level and renamed it phenomenon, as shown in Figure 3.9. Phenomena define the possible values for some phenomenon type.

图 3.9 知识水平中的现象（以前称为类别）。

Figure 3.9 Phenomenon (formerly category) in the knowledge level.

将定性陈述（例如血型 A）置于知识层面，就可以 在规则中使用它们。

Placing qualitative statements (such as blood group A) in the knowledge level allows them to be used in rules.

例如，一个人的血型是A型这一事实，可以通过对具有A型血特征的人进行类别观察来表明。A型血特征与血型类型这一特征相关联。

Example The fact that a person is blood group A is indicated by a category observation of a person whose phenomenon is blood group A. The blood group A phenomenon is linked to the phenomenon type of blood group.

例如，我们可以将汽车机油油位过低建模为汽车的一个类别观测值。现象类型为机油油位，可能的状态包括过满、正常和过低。该观测值将汽车与机油油位过低这一现象联系起来。

Example We can model a low oil level in a car as a category observation of the car. The phenomenon type is oil level with possible phenomena of over-full, OK, and low. The observation links the car to the low phenomenon.

图 3.9 中的模型适用于具有多个现象类型的类别观察。但许多观察仅涉及存在或不存在的陈述，而非一系列值。疾病就是很好的例子：糖尿病要么存在，要么不存在。我们可以使用图 3.9 来描述“糖尿病不存在”和“糖尿病存在”这两种现象。明确记录糖尿病不存在的情况固然重要，但记录体重没有减轻的情况也可能很有意义。（如果患者出现糖尿病症状但体重没有减轻，则表明并非患有糖尿病。这并不意味着体重正在增加或保持稳定，仅仅意味着体重没有减轻。）实际上，我们可以记录任何现象的不存在情况，尤其可以排除假设性诊断。因此，图 3.10 所示的模型允许任何类别观察具有存在和不存在两种状态。观察概念被添加为现象的超类型。这样做是为了允许糖尿病作为一个观察概念，而无需将其附加到任何现象类型。

The model in Figure 3.9 works well for category observations with several values for a phenomenon type. But many observations involve merely a statement of absence or presence rather than a range of values. Diseases are good examples of these: Diabetes is either present or absent. We could use Figure 3.9 with the phenomena diabetes absent and diabetes present. This ability to explicitly record the absence of diabetes is important, but it may also be sensible to record absence of weight loss. (If a patient comes in with symptoms of diabetes but has not been losing weight, then that would contra-indicate diabetes. This does not imply that the weight is increasing or steady, merely that it is not decreasing.) Indeed we can record the absence of any phenomenon, particularly to eliminate hypothetical diagnoses. Thus the model shown in Figure 3.10 allows any category observation to have presence and absence. Observation concept is added as a supertype of phenomenon. This is done to allow diabetes to be an observation concept without attaching it to some phenomenon type.

例如，我们记录了约翰·史密斯患有糖尿病的事实，方法是将约翰·史密斯的存在观察与糖尿病观察概念联系起来。

Example We record the fact that John Smith has diabetes by a presence observation of John Smith linked to the observation concept diabetes.

例如，我们用隧道本身（而非人）作为观察对象，并定义一个“混凝土剥落”的观察概念，来表示隧道中混凝土的剥落（劣化）。此外，我们还需要在观察结果中添加一个特征，以指示剥落发生在隧道的哪个位置。（对于某些观察概念，医学观察可能还需要解剖学位置信息。）

Example We represent spalling (deteriorating) concrete in a tunnel by an observation with the tunnel instead of the person, and an observation concept of spalling concrete. We also need a feature on the observation to indicate where in the tunnel the spalling occurs. (Medical observations may also need an anatomical location for some observation concepts.)

3.6 亚型观察概念

3.6 Subtyping Observation Concepts

图 3.10 引入了一种超类型关系，它允许对观察概念进行概括。这在医学领域非常常见，并且很有价值，因为观察可以在任何概括程度上进行。如果观察到某个亚型的存在，则所有超类型也都被认为存在。然而，如果观察到某个亚型的缺失，则既不意味着超类型的存在，也不意味着超类型的缺失。观察到缺失并不意味着所有亚型也都缺失。因此，存在性沿着超类型层级向上传播，而缺失性则向下传播。

Figure 3.10 introduces a supertype relationship that allows generalization of observation concepts. This is quite common in medicine and is valuable because observations can be made at any level of generality. If an observation is made of the presence of the subtype, then all supertypes are also considered to be present. However, if an observation is made of the absence of a subtype, then that implies neither presence nor absence of supertypes. Observation of absence does imply all subtypes are also absent. Thus presence is propagated up the supertype hierarchy, while absence is propagated downward.

例如，糖尿病是一个观察概念，分为两种亚型：I 型糖尿病和 II 型糖尿病。观察到约翰·史密斯患有 I 型糖尿病，意味着约翰·史密斯也患有糖尿病。

Example Diabetes is an observation concept with two subtypes: type I diabetes and type II diabetes. An observation that type I diabetes is present for John Smith implies that diabetes is also present for John Smith.

例如， A型血被称为多态性血型，因为它可以细分为A1和A2亚型。其他血型则不具有多态性。

Example Blood group A is called polymorphic because it can be subtyped to A1 and A2. The other blood groups are not polymorphic.

3.7 协议

3.7 Protocol

记录观察结果的一个重要知识概念是操作规程——即进行观察的方法。我们可以通过将体温计放入口腔、腋窝或直肠来测量人体的体温。通常，这些方法得到的温度读数可以认为是相同的；然而，记录我们使用的方法至关重要。了解获得异常观察结果的技术往往可以解释该结果。因此，在医疗保健领域，记录用于记录观察结果的测试方法是一种公认​​的做法。

An important knowledge concept for recording observations is the protocol— the method by which the observations were made. We can measure a person's body temperature by placing a thermometer in the mouth, armpit, or rectum. Usually the temperature readings these techniques yield can be considered the same; nonetheless, it is vital to record which approach we used. A strange observation can often be explained by understanding the technique that was used to reach it. Thus in health care it is accepted practice to always record what tests are used to record observations.

协议的价值之一在于它可以用来确定测量的准确性和灵敏度。这些信息可以被记录下来。

One of the values of a protocol is that it can be used to determine the accuracy and sensitivity of a measurement. This information could be recorded

图 3.10 观察概念的缺失与存在。

Figure 3.10 Absence and presence of observation concepts.

某种现象的缺失与它的存在同样重要。

The absence of a phenomenon can be as valuable as finding a presence.

测量本身固然重要，但通常情况下，测量结果取决于观测所采用的协议。严格遵守协议能更方便地获取这些信息。

on the measurement itself, but usually it is based on the protocol that is used for the observation. Holding it at the protocol makes it easier to capture this information.

3.8 双人计时赛记录

3.8 Dual Time Record

观测结果通常具有一定的有效期限。有效期限的结束标志着该观测结果不再适用。该有效期限与进行观测的时间不同。因此，每个观测结果都有两条时间记录（可以是时间段，也可以是单个时间点）：一条记录​​观测结果的适用时间，另一条记录观测结果的记录时间，如图 3.11 所示。

Observations often have a limited time period during which they can be applied. The end of the time period indicates when the observation is no longer applicable. This time period is different than the time at which the observation is made. Thus there are two time records (which may be periods or single time points) for each observation: one to record when the observation is applicable and the second when it is recorded, as shown in Figure 3.11.

例如，在1997年5月1日的一次就诊中，约翰·史密斯告诉他的医生，他六个月前曾出现胸痛，持续了一周。医生将此记录为对“胸痛”这一观察概念的观察结果。适用时间记录的时间段为1996年11月1日至1996年11月。记录时间为1997年5月1日。（请注意，此处若能以某种方式记录大致时间点将很有帮助。）

Example At a consultation on May 1, 1997, John Smith tells his doctor that he had chest pain six months ago that lasted for a week. The doctor records this as an observation of the presence of the observation concept chest pain. The applicability time record is a time period starting at November 1, 1996 and ending at Novembers, 1996. The recording time is the timepoint May 1,1997. (Note that some way of recording approximate timepoints would be valuable here.)

图 3.11 双时间记录观测。

Figure 3.11 Dual time record for observation.

时间记录既可以记录时间段，也可以记录单个时间点。大多数事件的 发生时间和记录时间是分开的。

A time record allows both periods and single points to be recorded. Most events have a separate occurring and recording time.

3.9 被拒绝的观测值

3.9 Rejected Observation

我们在进行观察时难免会犯错。然而，对于医疗记录而言，我们不能随意删除错误信息。治疗方案可能基于这些错误，而且通常存在法律限制。为了应对这种情况，我们可以将已被证实为不实的观察结果归类为“已驳回的观察结果”，如图 3.12 所示。（请注意，这与曾经正确但现在不再正确的观察结果有所不同，例如已愈合的骨折。已愈合的骨折永远不会被驳回，但其适用时间记录会被赋予一个结束日期。）被驳回的观察结果必须与其驳回的原始观察结果关联起来。

Inevitably we make mistakes when making observations. In the case of medical records, however, we cannot just erase them. Treatments may have been based on these mistakes, and there are usually legal restrictions. To handle this consideration, we can classify observations as rejected observations when it is found that they were and are untrue, as shown in Figure 3.12. (Note the difference between this and an observation that was true but is no longer true, such as a healed broken arm. A healed broken arm is never rejected, but its applicability time record is given an end date.) Rejected observations must be linked to the observation that rejects them.

图 3.12 被拒绝的观测值。

Figure 3.12 Rejected observations.

如果需要完整的审计跟踪，则不能删除观察记录。

Observations cannot be deleted if a full audit trail is needed.

例如，约翰·史密斯的血液检查结果显示平均红细胞体积较大。这可能是由恶性贫血或酗酒引起的。约翰·史密斯告诉医生他很少喝酒。这表明他可能患有恶性贫血，因此需要进行进一步的检查和治疗。六个月后，发现约翰·史密斯酗酒严重。这一信息表明，应该用酗酒的发现来否定恶性贫血的诊断。必须保留之前否定的恶性贫血的诊断，以解释随后进行的治疗。

Example John Smith has a blood test that indicates a large mean corpuscular volume. This can be due to either pernicious anemia or alcohol abuse. John Smith informs the doctor that he drinks very little alcohol. This indicates the presence of pernicious anemia, which leads to further tests and treatment. Six months later it is discovered that John Smith drinks heavily. This information indicates that the observation of pernicious anemia should be rejected by an observation of alcohol abuse. The rejected observation of pernicious anemia must be retained to explain the treatment that ensued.

3.10 主动观察、假设和预测

3.10 Active Observation, Hypothesis, and Projection

在记录观察结果时，会给出不同程度的置信度。例如，临床医生可能会遇到一位表现出所有典型糖尿病症状的患者。医生记录说她认为该患者可能患有糖尿病，但在进行检测之前无法确定，而且在许多疾病中，即使进行检测也无法提供百分之百的确定性。记录这类信息的一种方法是为观察结果赋予概率，但这种方法不够清晰，也不够自然。另一种方法是使用两种分类：主动观察和假设，如图 3.13 所示。二者的区别很微妙：主动观察是指临床医生“积极采纳”的观察结果，并可能以此作为治疗依据。而假设则更有可能导致进一步的检查。

As observations are recorded, many levels of assurance are given. A clinician might be faced with a patient showing all the classic symptoms of diabetes. The clinician records that she thinks the patient probably has diabetes, but she cannot be certain until a test is done, and in many diseases even a test does not provide 100 percent certainty. One approach to recording this kind of information is to assign probabilities to observations, but this method is unclear and does not seem natural. The alternative is to use two classifications: active observation and hypothesis, as shown in Figure 3.13. The distinction is subtle: An active observation is one that the clinician "runs with," probably using it as a basis for treatment. A hypothesis more likely leads to further tests.

图 3.13 主动观察、假设和预测。

Figure 3.13 Active observation, hypothesis, and projection.

例如，一位患者出现口渴、体重减轻和多尿等症状，提示可能患有糖尿病。然而，仅凭这些症状，临床医生会假设患者患有糖尿病，并要求进行空腹血糖检测。该检测结果将决定是否证实或排除糖尿病的假设。

Example A patient with observations of the presence of thirst, weight loss, and poly-uria indicates diabetes. With just these symptoms, however, a clinician makes a hypothesis of diabetes and orders a measurement of the fasting blood glucose. The result of this test indicates whether to confirm the hypothesis or reject it.

主动观察和假设这两种亚型都代表对患者当前状态的观察。预测则是临床医生认为未来可能发生的情况。临床医生通常会根据未来可能出现的情况来制定治疗方案。如果预测正确，则会记录下来，并附上一次主动观察。

Both subtypes, active observation and hypothesis, represent observations of the current state of the patient. Projections are observations that the clinician thinks might occur in the future. Often clinicians decide on treatments by considering future conditions that may occur. If the prediction is true, it is recorded with an additional active observation.

例如，如果患者患有风湿热或继发性风湿性瓣膜病，则存在发生心内膜炎的风险。此风险会被记录为心内膜炎预测值。治疗方案将基于此预测值制定。

Example If a patient has rheumatic fever, or consequent rheumatic valve disease, there is a risk of endocarditis. This risk is recorded as a projection of endocarditis. Treatments will then be based on this projection.

在“宇宙”项目中，观察结果的确定性是讨论最多的领域之一。团队和质量保证小组在这个领域投入的时间和精力，比模型的其他任何部分都多。最终模型反映了临床医生对最自然情况的看法。传统的概率赋值方法或许对科幻爱好者来说合情合理，但显然对临床医生来说却难以理解（他们可能会问诸如“0.8 和 0.7 之间的差异意味着什么？”之类的问题）。通过积极观察和假设，最终的概念更加清晰，尽管选择使用哪种分类方法也更具挑战性。最终，只有参与该项目的经验丰富的临床医生团队才能几乎凭直觉就此做出有效的决策。团队中的专业分析师只能指出一些形式上的推论。

The certainty of observations was one area of much discussion in the Cosmos project. More changes were made in this area and more time was spent by both the team and quality assurance panel than any other part of the model. The final model reflects the clinicians' views of what was the most natural. The classic approach of assigning probabilities might make sense to science fiction aficionados, but it clearly did not to clinicians (who could predict asking questions such as "What am I to make of the difference between 0.8 and 0.7?"). With active observation and hypothesis, the final concept is more clear, although the choice of which classification to use is more problematic. In the end only the group of experienced clinicians connected with the project could make a useful decision on this area in an almost instinctive way. The professional analyst in the team could only point out some formal consequences.

3.11 相关观察

3.11 Associated Observation

此时，我们可以探讨如何记录诊断背后的证据链。基本思路是允许观察结果彼此关联（例如，患者的口渴表明患者患有糖尿病），也允许观察概念彼此关联（例如，口渴表明患有糖尿病）。由此可见，知识层面和操作层面互为反映，如图 3.14 所示。这些反映通过关联关系连接起来，这些关联关系展示了知识概念如何应用于操作层面。在本例中，关联关系不仅存在于观察结果和观察概念之间，也存在于证据结论的关联关系之间。因此，当我们说患者的口渴表明患者患有糖尿病时，我们利用了口渴和糖尿病之间的普遍关联，并且应该明确记录我们正在利用这种关联。图 3.14 展示了我们如何创建类型，不仅用于存储观察结果和观察概念，还用于存储操作层面（关联观察）和知识层面（关联函数）的关联类型。

At this point we can look at ways to record the chain of evidence behind a diagnosis. The basic idea is to allow observations to be linked to each other (the patient's thirst indicated the patient's diabetes) and observation concepts to be so linked (thirst indicates diabetes). Thus we see that the knowledge and operational levels are reflections of each other, as shown in Figure 3.14. These reflections are linked by associations that show how knowledge concepts are applied to the operational level. In this case the links occur not only between the observation and the observation concept but also between the evidence conclusion links. Thus when we say the patient's thirst indicates that the patient has diabetes, we are making use of, and should explicitly record that we are making use of, the general connection between thirst and diabetes. Figure 3.14 shows how we make types to hold not just observations and observation concepts but also types for the links at the operational (associated observation) and the knowledge (associative function) level.

论点

arguments

图 3.14 观测结果之间的联系。

Figure 3.14 Links between observations.

患者的实际证据链在操作层面进行记录。知识 层面则描述可能存在的证据链。

Actual evidence chains for a patient are recorded at the operational level. The knowledge level describes what chains are possible.

例如，一位临床医生观察到患者出现体重减轻、口渴和多尿症状，并基于这些观察结果，做出关于糖尿病的相关观察（和假设）。该相关观察与一个关联函数相关联，该函数的自变量是观察概念——体重减轻、口渴和多尿——其乘积是糖尿病。

Example A clinician observes weight loss, thirst, and polyuria in a patient and makes an associated observation (and hypothesis) of diabetes based on the evidence observations. The associated observation is linked to an associative function whose arguments are the observation concepts—weight loss, thirst, and polyuria—and whose product is diabetes.

例如，如果我的车无法启动且车灯不亮，那么这两个现象都表明电池没电了。汽车无法启动、车灯不亮和电池没电都是通过关联函数联系在一起的观察概念。

Example If my car does not start and the lights do not work, then both of these observations are evidence for the associated observation of a dead battery. Car not starting, lights not working, and dead battery are all observation concepts linked by an associative function.

需要注意的是，知识层面和操作层面并非完全互为镜像。关联观察是观察的一种子类型，但关联函数并非观察概念的子类型。将关联观察视为观察的一种子类型似乎很自然，因为在操作层面，会进行一次特定的观察并辅以证据支持。而在知识层面，则会记录包含论证和结论的规则。一个观察概念可能对应多个关联函数，而它本身就是这些关联函数的结果，但一次特定的观察却只有一组观察作为证据。

Note that the knowledge and operational levels are not complete mirror images of each other. Associated observation is a subtype of observation, but associative function is not a subtype of observation concept. It seemed natural to make associated observation a subtype of observation since, at the operational level, one particular observation is made with supporting evidence. At the knowledge level, the rule with arguments and conclusion is recorded. One observation concept may have several associative functions for which it is the result, but a particular observation has only one set of observations as evidence.

3.12 观察过程

3.12 Process of Observation

本章重点讨论了观察的静态要素：什么是观察或测量，以及如何以通用方式记录观察结果，以支持临床医生进行分析。值得注意的是，在建模过程中，我们发现可以构建一个通用的静态模型，但行为部分则更多地依赖于各个科室。当然，静态模型蕴含着大量的行为。行为的存在是为了产生观察结果，并提供各种方法来理解这些观察结果与其他观察结果之间的关联。然而，我们无法推断的是典型科室进行的观察顺序。临床医生通常会遵循一定的观察路径。科室政策可能是根据更高级别的流程记录这一路径（参见第8章）。设计一个所有临床医生都能使用的通用流程是困难的，几乎是不可能的。

This chapter has concentrated on the static elements of observation: what an observation or measurement is and how we can record it in a generic way to support the analysis that clinicians need to perform on it. It is significant that in modeling we found that we could conceive of a general static model, but the behavioral part was much more dependent on individual departments. Of course, a static model implies a great deal of behavior. Behaviors exist to create observations and to provide various ways of navigating associations to understand how those observations fit with other observations. The behavior we cannot imply, however, is the sequence of observations that a typical department makes. Often a clinician has some path of observations that can be taken. Departmental policy may be to record this path in terms of higher-level protocols (see Chapter 8). It is difficult, and almost certainly impossible, to design a general process that all clinicians could use.

然而，我们可以大致概述一下观察过程。首先，如图 3.15 所示，我们来看一下新的观察结果如何引发进一步的观察。临床医生在进行观察时，会考虑其他相关观察的可能性。他们运用已知的关联函数，列出可能与触发观察相关的观察概念。然后，他们可以根据需要提出进一步的观察。

It is possible, however, to sketch an outline of the process involved in making observations. I begin by looking at how making a new observation can trigger further observations, as shown in Figure 3.15. Whenever clinicians make observations, they consider the possibility of other associated observations. They use the associative functions they know to come up with a list of possible observation concepts that might be associated with the triggering observations. They can then propose further observations as needed.

图 3.15 进行观察会引发进一步的观察。

Figure 3.15 Making an observation triggers further observations.

根据知识水平，可以提出进一步的观察意见。

Further observations are suggested by the knowledge level.

在图 3.15 中，并发触发规则被标记为“关联观察概念”。在事件图中，触发规则有两个用途。首先，它们表示因果关系。当我们考虑业务流程时，这通常就足够了，但随着我们深入研究，我们会发现第二个用途。任何操作都有输入和输出。连接两个操作的触发器必须描述如何从触发操作的输出到达被触发操作的输入。在许多情况下，这很简单，因为它们是同一个对象（例如图 3.15 中从“提出观察”到“执行观察”的触发器）。然而，它们也可能变得相当复杂，例如在查找关联观察概念时。

In Figure 3.15 the concurrent trigger rule is labeled "associated observation concepts." In event diagrams, trigger rules have two purposes. First, they show cause and effect. When we are considering business processes, this is usually enough, but as we delve deeper we see a second purpose. Any operation has input and output. The trigger that connects two operations must describe how to get from the output of the triggering operation to the input of the triggered operation. In many cases this is trivial, as they are the same object (as in the trigger from propose observation to make observation shown in Figure 3.15). However they can get quite complex, as in finding associated observation concepts.

当触发规则更复杂时，我们可以用另一个事件图来表示它。图 3.16 和 3.17 展示了关联观察概念触发的实现方式。首先，我们找到所有输入包含初始观察的观察概念的关联函数。然后，我们计算每个关联函数的值。对于每个结果为真的关联函数，我们计算其乘积并将其加到结果中。由于这些事件图描述的是触发规则查询，因此所有操作都必须是访问器操作，从而不能改变任何对象的可观察状态。

When we have a more complex trigger rule, we can represent the trigger rule with another event diagram. Figures 3.16 and 3.17 do this for the associated observation concepts trigger. We begin by finding all the associative functions whose input includes the initial observation's observation concept. We then evaluate each of these associative functions. For each one that evaluates to true, we find the product and add it to the answer. Since these event diagrams describe a trigger rule query, all the operations must be accessors and hence must not change the observable state of any object.

图 3.16 事件图，用于描述查找关联观测值的查询。

Figure 3.16 Event diagram to describe the query for finding associated observations.

这位于图 3.15 的并发触发或图 3.18 的操作中。

This lies on the concurrent trigger of Figure 3.15 or in the operation of Figure 3. 18.

当触发规则查询很复杂时，也可以将查询表示为一个独立的操作，如图 3.18 所示。两种方法都是正确的。

When the trigger rule query is complex, you can also represent the query as an operation in its own right, as shown in Figure 3.18. Either method is correct.

图 3.17 用于查找观察所隐含的可能观察概念的交互图。

Figure 3.17 An interaction diagram for finding the possible observation concepts implied by an observation.

该交互图支持图 3.16。

This interaction diagram supports Figure 3.16.

图 3.18 将查询显式地表示为一个操作。

Figure 3.18 Notating the query explicitly as an operation.

这与图 3.15 等效。您可以将查询显示为操作，也可以将 其视为触发器的一部分，以简洁性换取紧凑性。

This is equivalent to Figure 3.15. You can either show queries as operations or consider them part of the trigger, trading simplicity for compactness.

即使在查询之后，在提出观察方案之前，仍然存在一个控制条件（评估提议）。查询会根据关联函数提出可能的观察概念。这一步骤很容易由决策支持系统中的软件完成。控制条件代表了额外的步骤，即判断所建议的观察概念是否值得检验。我们认为无法对这一过程进行正式建模，这意味着这一步骤超出了软件的处理范围，只能由临床医生自行判断。

Even after the query, there is a control condition (evaluate proposal) before an observation is proposed. The query suggests possible observation concepts to look for based on the associative functions. This step could easily be done by software in a decision support system. The control condition represents the extra step of deciding whether the suggested observation concept is worth testing for. We did not feel we could formally model this process, implying that this step is beyond software and can only be done in the clinician's head.

图 3.19 包含了由预测和主动观察产生的其他触发因素。这些触发因素用于提出干预建议，其工作方式与前文所述类似。我们建议的干预措施在提出前会由临床医生进行评估。这进一步强调了这样一个事实：虽然任何观察都可能导致进一步的观察，但只有主动观察或预测（而非假设）才能最终促成干预。（干预是指旨在或可能导致患者状态改变的行为。）触发查询的工作方式与知识层级类似，但涉及启动函数，这些函数将在 8.7 节中简要讨论。

Figure 3.19 includes additional triggers that arise from projections and active observations. The triggers to propose intervention work in a similar way to the previous case. We suggest interventions that are eval uated by the clinician before they are proposed. This reinforces the fact that although any observation can lead to further observations being made, only active observations or projections (not hypotheses) lead to interventions. (An intervention is an action which either intends or risks a change in state of the patient.) The trigger queries work in a similar way with the knowledge level but involve start functions, which are discussed briefly in Section 8.7.

图3.19 观测数据处理过程的事件图。

Figure 3.19 Event diagram for the process of working with observations. This

图 3.15 扩展了干预和拒绝的类似触发因素。

extends Figure 3.15 with similar triggers for interventions and rejections.

图 3.19 中的最后一个触发条件展示了活跃观测结果的出现如何与其他观测结果相矛盾，从而导致这些观测结果被拒绝。这同样可能涉及关联函数，但这次我们寻找的是矛盾。一旦某个观测结果（可能是假设）被拒绝，那么之前受该观测结果支持的后续观测结果就必须重新考虑。

The final trigger on Figure 3.19 shows how the appearance of an active observation can contradict other observations and thus lead to those observations being rejected. Again this can involve associative functions, but this time we are looking for a contradiction. Once an observation (which may be a hypothesis) is rejected, further observations which were supported by this observation must be reconsidered.

这些模式的产生过程，其有趣之处在于抽象概念的发现方式。尽管本文讨论的最终结果通常是结构性的，但行为建模在理解这些概念的运作机制中发挥了核心作用。临床医生亲自进行建模这一事实也至关重要。观察的抽象是这些模式的核心；它将体征、症状和诊断联系起来，而临床医生长期以来一直认为这三者截然不同。只有通过建模过程，临床医生才能提取出这种抽象概念。如果软件工程师提出这样的抽象概念，我怀疑他们是否能够说服临床医生相信其有效性。这种怀疑不无道理，因为软件工程师永远不可能拥有如此深厚的医学知识。最佳的概念模型是由领域专家构建的，而他们往往也是最佳的概念建模者。

One of the interesting things about the work that produced these patterns is the way the abstractions were found. Although the final results discussed here are usually structural, behavioral modeling played a central role in understanding how the concepts worked. The fact that clinicians did the modeling themselves was also crucial. The abstraction of observation is central to these patterns; it ties together signs, symptoms, and diagnoses, which clinicians have long considered to be very different. It was only by going through the modeling process that clinicians could pull out the abstraction. If software engineers had come up with such an abstraction, I doubt if they could ever convince clinicians that it was valid. And there would be good reason to be doubtful, since software engineers can never have that deep knowledge of medicine. The best conceptual models are built by domain experts, and they are often the best conceptual modelers.
