第四章 公司财务观察

Chapter 4. Observations for Corporate Finance

要充分理解本章内容，您需要先阅读第3章。

To fully understand this chapter, you will need to read Chapter 3 first.

在大型企业中，识别高层问题很容易，但找出这些问题的根本原因却更加棘手。这类企业会产生海量信息，任何试图分析这些信息的人都可能被淹没其中。

In large corporations it is easy to identify high-level problems, but finding out the root causes of these problems is more tricky. Such corporations generate a deluge of information that can quickly drown anyone trying to analyze it.

例如，衡量公司业绩的主要指标之一是其最终收入。如果收入出现显著下滑，则需要进行分析以找出原因。对 Aroma Coffee Makers (ACM) 的分析表明，尽管其成本仍然合理，但设备销售收入却有所下降。这种情况在其东北地区尤为明显。进一步分析发现，其 1100 款高销量咖啡机系列的实际收入远低于预期，尤其是在政府部门。以上分析主要基于数字，但更深入的分析可能更侧重于定性而非定量。业绩不佳的原因可能是销售薪酬方案不合理、政府预算削减、夏季高温，或是该地区竞争对手实力强劲。

For example, one of the principal measures of a company's performance is its final revenue. If the revenue shows a notable dip, then some analysis needs to be done to find out why. Such an analysis for Aroma Coffee Makers (ACM) showed that their equipment sales income was reduced, although their costs were still reasonable. This was most noticeable in their Northeast region. Looking further showed that their 1100 high-volume coffee maker family was well below its planned income, particularly in the government sector. Much of this is analysis of numbers, but further analysis may be more qualitative than quantitative. Perhaps this poor performance is due to a weak sales compensation plan, or government budget cuts, or a very hot summer, or strong competitor presence in the area.

这一切与临床医生在调查患者症状时所进行的诊断过程非常相似。我们从明显的症状出发，根据我们在该领域的知识，追溯可能的原因。我们希望找到根本原因，然后进行治疗。基于对类似过程的这种宏观理解，我们或许可以假设，可以将临床模型应用于公司金融领域。

All of this is much the same diagnostic process that is done by clinicians when investigating a patient's symptoms. From the obvious symptom we track back through likely causes, guided by our knowledge of the field. We hope to identify the root causes and then treat them. From this broad view of similar processes, we might hypothesize that we can apply the clinical models to corporate finance.

第三章描述了如何在医疗保健领域对患者进行定性和定量描述。在该章结尾，我简要提及该模型可以应用于其他领域，例如分析公司财务。本章将探讨如何将其应用于其他领域。

Chapter 3 gives a description of how qualitative and quantitative statements can be made about patients in a health care context. At the end of that chapter, I briefly mentioned that that model can be applied to other contexts, such as analyzing corporate finances. This chapter looks at how this can be

57 已完成。该模型运行良好，但需要进行一些修改。幸运的是，描述这些修改的模式都是对现有模型的扩展，而不是对其的更改。

57 done. The model works very well, but some modifications are required. Fortunately the patterns that describe these modifications are all extensions of the existing model rather than changes to it.

第一种模式用描述所分析企业细分领域的某种方式来代替人。该企业细分领域（4.1）描述了企业中沿一系列维度定义的部分。每个维度代表一种对企业进行层级划分的方式，例如地理位置、产品范围或市场。企业细分领域是这些维度的组合，这是多维数据库广泛采用的一种技术。

The first pattern replaces the person with some way of describing the segment of the enterprise under analysis. This enterprise segment (4.1) describes a part of the enterprise defined along a series of dimensions. Each dimension represents some way of hierarchically breaking down the enterprise, such as location, product range, or market. The enterprise segment is a combination of these dimensions, a technique widely used by multidimensional databases.

测量协议 (4.2) 模式描述了如何使用模型类型的实例公式，从其他测量值计算出测量值。第 3 章讨论了每种测量值如何衡量一种现象类型；本章将讨论测量协议如何定义为特定现象类型创建测量值的方法。我们涵盖三种测量协议：因果测量协议 (4.2.2) 描述了如何将不同的现象类型组合起来计算另一种现象类型（例如，销售收入是销售量与平均价格的乘积）。比较测量协议 (4.2.2) 描述了单个现象类型如何在不同的状态类型 (4.2.3) 之间变化（例如，实际销售收入与计划销售收入的偏差）。维度组合 (4.2.5) 使用企业细分模式中定义的维度来计算汇总值（例如，通过将各个州的数值相加来计算东北地区的销售收入）。每种测量协议子类型都使用多态性来确定其值。

The measurement protocol (4.2) pattern describes how measurements can be calculated from other measurements using formulas that are instances of model types. Chapter 3 discusses how each measurement measures a phenomenon type; here we discuss how the measurement protocol defines ways of creating measurements for a particular phenomenon type. We cover three varieties of measurement protocols: Causal measurement protocols (4.2.2) describe how different phenomenon types are combined to calculate another (sales revenue is the product of units sold and average price). Comparative measurement protocols (4.2.2) describe how a single phenomenon type can vary between status types (4.2.3) (actual versus plan deviation of sales revenue). Dimension combinations (4.2.5) use the dimensions defined in the enterprise segment pattern to calculate summary values (calculate northeast sales revenue by totaling the values for individual states). Each of these subtypes of measurement protocol uses polymorphism to determine its value.

我们常常用定性现象来描述定量现象类型。在这种情况下，我们可以通过将现象与该现象类型的值范围关联起来来定义它们。首先，我们需要一个范围（4.3），它允许我们描述两个量之间的范围以及我们希望对该范围进行的各种操作。然后，我们可以通过两种方式定义具有范围的现象（4.4）：一是使用具有范围属性的现象（4.4.1）向现象添加范围；二是使用范围函数（4.4.2）。

Often we use qualitative phenomena to describe quantitative phenomenon types. In this case we can define the phenomena by linking them to a range of values for the phenomenon type. First we need a range (4.3), which allows us to describe a range between two quantities and various operations we want to do with the range. We can then define a phenomenon with range (4.4) either by adding a range to the phenomenon using a phenomenon with range attribute (4.4.1) or by using a range function (4.4.2).

我们可以将本章探讨的模式与第三章的模式结合起来，分析企业的财务数据。4.5节展示了如何利用这些模式来识别大型企业问题的根源。

We can combine the patterns examined in this chapter with those of Chapter 3 to analyze a business' financial data. Section 4.5 shows how we can use these patterns to identify the causes of problems in large corporations.

本章中的模型基于一家大型制造公司团队的研究成果。该团队探索了将医疗保健模型应用于公司财务，并发现它是一个非常有用的基础。本章中的模型原型是用 C++ 编写的。

The models in this chapter are based on work done by a team from a large manufacturing company. This team explored using a health care model for corporate finance and found it to be a very useful foundation. The models in this chapter were prototyped using C++.

关键概念：企业细分、维度、测量协议、状态类型

Key Concepts Enterprise Segment, Dimension, Measurement Protocol, Status Type

4.1 企业部门

4.1 Enterprise Segment

本章探讨的问题与第三章讨论的问题最显著的区别在于，本章并非观察单个患者。在某些情况下，我们会考察整个公司，但在其他情况下，我们只观察公司的一部分，例如东北地区政府的10-11杯浓缩咖啡销售情况。我们可以将公司的各个部分以及整个公司视为独立的主体来处理这种情况。然而，重要的是要确保理解这些公司组成部分之间的关​​系。

The most noticeable difference between the problem we examine in this chapter and the one discussed in Chapter 3 is that here not a single patient is being observed. In some cases we look at the whole company, but in other cases we observe only part of the company, such as 10-11 espresso sales to the government in the Northeast region. This could be handled by treating each part of the company, and the whole, as separate parties. However, i t is important to ensure that the relationships between these corporate parts is understood.

因此，我们需要修改从程序到患者的映射关系，使其指向其他类型。我在第三章关于映射关系的讨论中略微提及了这个问题，所以实际上它并不像乍看起来那么棘手。第三章所依据的原始 Cosmos 模型[1]实际上并没有将观察结果与个体联系起来。实际上，这种联系指向的是一种称为“护理对象”的类型。“护理对象”本身是对患者和人群的概括。人群是指一群人，用于对人群进行观察，这对于公共卫生尤为重要。

Thus we have to alter the mapping from procedure to patient to point to some other type. This is an issue that I skimmed over in the discussion of mapping in Chapter 3, so actually it is not such a problem as it may first appear. The original Cosmos model [1], on which Chapter 3 is based, does not actually link from observation to person. In reality the link is to a type called object of care. Object of care is itself a generalization of patient and population. A population is a group of people and is used to allow observations to be made of groups of people, which is particularly important for public health.

对于公司财务，我们需要一种新的关注对象子类型，我们称之为企业部门，如图 4.1 所示。企业部门是公司的一部分，是以非常特殊的方式定义的部分。

For corporate finance we need a new subtype of object of care, which we call enterprise segment, as shown in Figure 4.1. An enterprise segment is a part of a company, a part defined in a very particular way.

图 4.1 护理对象及其亚型。

Figure 4.1 Object of care and its subtypes.

第三章中的病人是可以观察的一种护理对象。

The patient of Chapter 3 is one kind of object of care that can be observed.

当我们观察一个企业时，可以根据多种标准将其划分为不同的部分。例如，可以根据组织单元、地理位置、产品、产品销售的行业等进行划分。每种划分方法都可以相对独立地进行，并且都可以用层级结构来表示。例如，一家跨国公司可以先按市场（美国）划分，然后按地区（东北部）划分，最后按区域（新罕布什尔州）划分。这些独立的层级结构都是企业的一个维度。新罕布什尔州和东北部是地理维度中不同层级的元素。企业的一个组成部分是各个维度元素的组合，每个维度对应一个元素。因此，ACM 的东北部、11-10 区和政府部门可以定义为一个企业组成部分，其地理维度包含东北部，产品维度包含 11-10 区，行业维度包含政府部门，如图 4.2 所示。这种分析方法通常被称为星型模式[4]，常用于多维数据库[2]。

When we look at an enterprise, we can see that we can divide it into parts according to several criteria. It may be divided due to organizational unit, to geographical location, by product, by the industry sector that the product is being sold into, and so on. Each of these methods of division can be carried out more or less independently. Each can also be expressed as a hierarchy. For example, a multinational company can be divided first by market (USA), then by region (Northeast), then by area (New Hampshire). Each of these independent hierarchies is a dimension of the enterprise. New Hampshire and Northeast are elements at different levels in the geographical dimension. An enterprise segment is a combination of dimension elements, one for each dimension of the enterprise. Thus the part of ACM that is northeast, 11-10, government can be defined as the enterprise segment with dimension elements of northeast on the geographical dimension, 11-10 on the product dimension, and government on the industry dimension, as shown in Figure 4.2. This approach to analysis, often referred to as a star schema [4], is com monly used in multidimensional databases [2].

定义了企业细分之后，我们可以构建各种类型之间关系的模型，如图 4.3 所示。我们可以将维度元素链接成层次结构。可以定义多个维度元素层次结构。请注意，父级关联的层次结构约束是必要的，因为仅凭基数无法强制建立层次结构（尽管基数可能允许循环）。企业细分必须包含来自每个层次结构的元素，如企业细分中的三个关联所示。维度元素的约束确保所有层次结构都属于同一维度。该模型能够很好地处理这种情况，但它也存在一些缺点。首先，维度和维度级别的概念没有得到正确定义，尽管它们可以推导出来。其次，添加新维度会导致模型发生变化。

With this enterprise segment defined, we can form a model of the relationships between the various types, as shown in Figure 4.3. We can link dimension elements together into hierarchies. Many hierarchies of dimension elements can be defined. Note how the hierarchies constraint on the parent association is necessary because the cardinalities alone do not enforce a hierarchy (although they might allow cycles). The enterprise segment must have one element from each of these hierarchies, as indicated by the three associations from the enterprise segment. The constraint on the dimension element ensures that the hierarchies are all within the same dimension. The model will handle the situation quite well, but it has a couple of disadvantages. First, the concepts of dimension and dimension level are not properly defined, although they can be derived. Second, adding a new dimension will cause a model change.

图 4.4 所示的模型使用显式维度类型。每个维度都包含一个维度元素层次结构。企业段需要与每个维度中的一个维度元素建立链接。我们可以使用键值映射（参见 15.2 节）来实现这一点。结合基数，该映射表明，对于每个键（维度）实例，都存在且仅存在一个维度元素。

The model shown in Figure 4.4 uses an explicit dimension type. Each dimension holds a hierarchy of dimension elements. The enterprise segment then needs to have one link to a dimension element in each dimension. We can do this by using the keyed mapping (see Section 15.2). When combined with cardinality this mapping states that for each instance of the key (dimension) there is one and only one dimension element.

例如，我们可以定义“11-10，东北政府企业”细分市场，并将其与维度元素“11-10”、“东北”和“政府”关联起来。“11-10”属于产品维度，“东北”属于地域维度，“政府”属于行业维度。

Example We can define the 11-10, Northeast government enterprise segment, linking it to the dimension elements 11-10, Northeast, and government. 11-10 is in the product dimension. Northeast is in the location dimension, and government is in the industry dimension.

请注意，每个层级结构都需要一个顶层，但这并不一定代表一个已命名的元素。一种常见的约定是将顶层标记为“全部”，表示任何引用它的段在该维度上都没有细分。另一种约定是允许与维度元素的映射是可选的；在这种情况下，“nil”表示树的顶层。尽管顶层元素略显人为，但前一种方法更加一致。

Note that each hierarchy needs a top, and this does not necessarily show a named thing. A common convention is to label the top "all," showing that any segment that references it does not have any breakdowns along that dimension. Another convention would be to let the mapping to the dimension element be optional; then "nil" would indicate the top of the tree. The former approach is more consistent, despite this slightly artificial top element.

图 4.2 企业细分如何与维度中的要素相联系。

Figure 4.2 How enterprise segments link to elements in dimensions.

一个企业部门是由各个维度中的要素组合而成的。

One enterprise segment is a combination of elements from each dimension.

例如，如果我们添加一个渠道维度，那么企业细分市场“11-10 东北政府”就会链接到渠道层级结构的顶层维度元素。我们将这个维度元素称为“全部”。

Example If we add a channel dimension, then the enterprise segment 11-10 Northeast government has a link to the top dimension element of the channel hierarchy. We call this dimension element all.

图 4.3 用维度元素定义企业细分。

Figure 4.3 Defining enterprise segments with dimension elements.

使用此模型时，每当添加一个维度时，都需要添加一个新的子类型。

Using this model requires adding a new subtype whenever a dimension is added.

图 4.4 使用维度和维度 元素定义企业细分。

Figure 4.4 Defining enterprise segments by using dimensions and dimension elements.

这种模型允许我们在不改变模型本身的情况下增加新的尺寸，而且 体积也更小。

This model allows us to add new dimensions without changing the model. It is also more compact.

图 4.5 向图 4.4 添加维度级别。维度级别

Figure 4.5 Adding dimension levels to Figure 4.4. Dimension levels

允许我们给维度的每个层级命名。

allow us to name each level of a dimension.

添加维度级别类型并非完全显而易见。当然，每个维度元素都具有维度级别。然而，级别取决于它在维度层次结构中的位置。图 4.5 所示的模型通过为每个维度分配一个列表来定义其维度元素，从而解决了这个问题。维度元素使用其在层次结构中的位置和维度级别列表来确定自身的维度级别。

Adding a type for dimension level is not entirely obvious. Naturally every dimension element has a dimension level. However, the level is determined by its position in the dimension's hierarchy. The model shown in Figure 4.5 deals with this by assigning each dimension a list to define its dimension elements. The dimension element uses its level in the hierarchy and the list of dimension levels to determine its dimension level.

例如，在 ACM 示例中，“位置”维度包含一系列维度级别：市场、区域和地区。新罕布什尔州在层级结构中定义，其父级为“东北地区”，“东北地区”的父级为“美国”，“美国”的父级为“全部”。由于新罕布什尔州位于三级之下，因此其维度级别为列表中的第三个级别：地区。

Example In the ACM example the location dimension has a list of dimension levels: market, region, and area. New Hampshire is defined in the hierarchy with parent Northeast, whose parent is USA, whose parent is all. Since it is three levels down. New Hampshire's dimension level is the third in the list: area.

4.1.1 定义尺寸

我们如何定义维度？最简单的定义是，维度是指大型组织可以通过某种组织结构进行划分的方式。然而，这通常并非最令人满意的定义。根据具体情况，组织的划分方式有很多种。此外，某些维度未必适用于特定的组织系统。图 4.2 中的模型包含了 ACM 销售所在行业的划分，但这并不一定代表 ACM 内部的组织结构。

How can we define dimensions? The simplest definition is that they are the ways in which a large organization can be broken down via some organizational structure. However, that is not generally the most satisfactory definition. An organization can be broken down in many ways, depending on the situation. In addition, some dimensions are not necessarily appropriate to an organization system. The model in Figure 4.2 includes a breakdown by industry to which ACM sells, but this need not represent an organization structure within ACM.

我们可以通过查看层次结构的底层，并探究底层维度所分类的内容，来找到更好的维度定义方法。例如，ACM 专注于咖啡机的销售或租赁。我们可以根据售出的咖啡机型号、销售区域以及销售行业来对这一维度进行分类。这些维度来源于对这一核心事件的分类，即星型模式的事实表 [4]。

We can find a better way to define dimensions by looking at the bottom of the hierarchy and asking what is being classified by the dimensions there. In the example we can see that ACM is focusing on the sale or rental of a coffee machine. We can classify this dimension according to which machine was sold, which sales area sold it, and which industry it was sold into. The dimensions come from the classification of this focal event, which is the fact table of a star schema [4].

在确定此类分析中使用的维度时，首先需要了解核心事件是什么。然后，我们可以考察如何对该核心事件进行分类。从图 4.2 可以看出，核心事件涉及一个产品，该产品包含一个产品系列，该产品系列又包含一个产品组，该产品组又包含一种饮料。在销售维度上，我们可以看到区域、地区和市场。

In determining the dimensions to use in this kind of analysis, first we need to understand what the focal event is. We can then look at the ways in which this focal event can be classified. From Figure 4.2 we see the focal event involves a product that has a product family, which has a product group, which has a beverage. On the sales dimension we see area, region, and market.

这些维度和层级应由业务分析师定义；图 4.6 展示了一种有效的定义方法。如图 4.6 所示，这种结构可能会变得相当复杂。各个维度并非完全独立。例如，请注意价格范围维度与产品维度的交叉点。这表明，任何产品在产品维度和价格范围维度上都对应一个特定的父级。图 4.5 的模型需要进行修改以正确考虑这一点，但这样做是否值得值得商榷，因为它确实会使模型变得复杂一些。这个问题可以通过维度创建过程来解决。

These dimensions and levels should be defined by business analysts; Figure 4.6 shows a good way to do this. As Figure 4.6 indicates this structure can become quite complex. The dimensions are not necessarily completely independent. For example, note how the price range dimension intersects the product dimension. This indicates that any product will have one particular parent along the product and price range dimensions. The model of Figure 4.5 would need to be modified to take this into account properly, although it is questionable whether it is worth undertaking this since it does complicate the model somewhat. This issue could be handled by the dimension creation process.

图 4.6 蒂拉克图显示了一组典型的维度和级别。

Figure 4.6 A Tilak chart showing a typical set of dimensions and levels.

如果任何层级的分支不超过六个，那么这张图就很有用。但 实际上，这种情况很少发生。

This is a useful diagram providing we do not have more than six branches from any level. In practice we rarely do.

这些维度无需细化到最低层级。在这种情况下，分析到单个销售人员的区域或单个客户可能既无意义，甚至不可能。此时，维度只需细化到底层事件即可。了解较低层级仍然很有用，这既有利于未来的发展，也有助于理解较高层级的基础。

The dimensions need not be measurable to the lowest level. In this case it might not be worthwhile, or even possible, to analyze down to an individual salesperson's territory or to an individual customer. In this case the dimensions are elaborated part of the way down to the underlying event. It is still useful to understand what the lower levels are, both for future development and to see the foundations of the higher levels.

对客户领域进行全面分析需要为该客户领域构建业务模型。这包括一个结构模型，用于严格定义各个维度。每个维度都应代表结构模型中的一条层级路径。此过程的细节超出了本章的范围。为了便于讨论，我们假设维度已经确定。

A full analysis of the customer's domain would involve producing a business model for the customer's area. This would include a structural model, which would be used to rigorously define the dimensions. Each dimension should represent a hierarchical path along the structural model. The details of this process are beyond the scope of this chapter. For the sake of discussion we will assume the dimensions have been determined.

分析系统的用户可以显式定义维度，也可以从企业数据库中获取。对于后者，每个维度都需要一个构建器操作来告知系统如何查询企业数据库。这样，系统就可以随着时间的推移向维度中添加节点。

The dimensions can be defined explicitly by the user of the analysis system. Otherwise, they can be determined from corporate databases. For the latter, each dimension needs a builder operation to tell it how to query corporate databases. This allows the system to add nodes to the dimension over time.

4.1.2 维度和企业细分的属性

关于维度的一个重要规则是，较低层级维度的测量值可以正确地合并到较高层级。因此，如果我们想查看东北地区的销售收入，我们可以将东北地区所有子区域的销售额相加。

An important rule about dimensions is that the measurements for dimensions at lower levels can be properly combined into the higher level. Thus if we want to look at sales revenue for the Northeast, we can do this by adding together the values for sales for all subregions of the Northeast region.

任何已定义的尺寸都必须支持此属性。通常尺寸通过相加的方式组合，但也存在一些例外情况（参见 4.2.5 节）。

Any dimensions that are defined must support this property. Usually dimensions are combined through addition, but there are some exceptions (see Section 4.2.5).

除了通过业务结构定义的维度之外，时间也是一个常见的维度。时间维度通过将底层事件分类到特定的时间段来体现。如果这些时间段是月份，那么我们可以讨论诸如“1994 年 3 月（11-10，东北地区）的收入”之类的数据。这意味着存在一个 1994 年 3 月的维度元素，它是 1994 年维度元素的子元素。只要数据仅包含当月的数据（而非年初至今的数据），时间维度就满足上述的组合性属性。我们可以轻松地根据当月数据计算年初至今的数据，但通常无法通过沿维度进行组合来实现。

Along with dimensions defined through business structures, another common dimension is time. Time is treated as a dimension by classifying the underlying event into a time period. If these periods are months then we can talk about such figures as revenue for (11-10, Northeast, March 1994). This implies a dimension element for March 1994 that would be a child of the dimension element for 1994. The time dimension satisfies the combinability property discussed above, providing the figures are only for that month (and not year-to-date figures). We can easily calculate year-to-dates from month-only figures but typically not by combining along a dimension.

企业段与更基础的类型有一个共同的有趣特性：所有企业段在概念上都存在。我们无法在概念上“创造”数字 5、数量 5 美元或日期 1/1/2314。这些概念都存在于我们的思维中，但可能需要在计算机中创建为对象。企业段也具有这一特性。一旦所有维度及其维度元素都已指定，那么所有企业段在概念上就存在，即使它们可能并未被创建为软件对象。

Enterprise segments share an interesting property with more fundamental types: All enterprise segments conceptually exist. There is no notion of conceptually creating the number 5, the quantity $5, or the date 1/1/2314. These things all exist in our minds but may need to be created as objects in the computer. Enterprise segments share this property. Once all dimensions have been specified with their dimension elements, then all enterprise segments conceptually exist, although they may not be created as software objects.

这一共同属性引出了一个问题：企业细分是否应被视为基本类型（参见A.1.5节）。如果是，则它不应映射到任何非基本对象。维度元素和观察（继承自护理对象）均为非基本类型。虽然后者可以排除，但前者是企业细分定义的一部分，因此不能排除。保留企业细分到观察的映射也很有意义，因为一个非常常见的需求是查找给定企业细分的所有观察。综上所述，尽管企业细分具有普遍的概念存在性，但它们似乎并非基本类型。

This shared property raises the question of whether an enterprise segment should be treated as a fundamental type (see Section A.1.5). If so, it should not have any mappings to nonfundamental objects. A dimension element and an observation (inherited from an object of care) are both non -fundamental. Although the latter could be excluded, the former is part of the definition of enterprise segment and thus cannot be excluded. There is also a lot of sense in holding the mapping from an enterprise segment to an observation since a very common request is to find all observations for a given enterprise segment. In balance it seems that enterprise segments are not fundamental, despite this property of universal conceptual existence.

将企业段视为非基础组件确实会对接口产生影响。创建操作实际上是一个查找或创建操作。它首先检查所需的企业段实例是否存在；如果存在，则返回该实例；如果不存在，则创建该实例。（或者您可以将其理解为没有创建操作，而只有查找操作，该操作会在需要时静默创建实例。）

Treating enterprise segments as nonfundamental does have an effect on the interface. The create operation is really a find-or-create. It first looks to see if the required instance of the enterprise segment exists; if so it returns it, if not it creates it. (Or you can think of it as not having a create operation but only a find operation, which creates silently when it needs to.)

4.2 测量方案

4.2 Measurement Protocol

我们一直在讨论的企业分析会用到大量的测量数据。这些数据并非手动输入；通常情况下，它们要么是从众多数据库之一中加载，要么是根据其他测量数据计算得出。我们需要记住如何进行这些测量，也就是我们用来创建测量的协议。图 4.7 展示了测量和协议的总体框架，其中大部分内容与第三章类似。

The corporate analysis we have been discussing uses a lot of measurements. These measurements are not entered by hand; usually they are either loaded from one of many databases or calculated from other measurements. We need to remember how we can make these measurements, that is, the protocol we use to create the measurement. Figure 4.7 shows a general outline of measurement and protocols, much of it similar to that of Chapter 3.

图 4.7 展示了两种测量协议。源测量协议指的是对某个企业数据库的查询。通常情况下，对象在逻辑上知道它正在访问哪个数据库，尽管实际的命令位于另一个层。用户需要决定访问哪个数据库。计算测量协议则表示对域中已有的测量数据进行计算。

Two kinds of measurement protocol are shown in Figure 4.7. Source measurement protocols refer to queries against some corporate database. Typically an object knows logically which database it is accessing, although the actual commands are in another layer. The user should decide which data base is accessed. A calculated measurement protocol represents a calculation done on measurements already present in this domain.

图 4.7 测量和测量协议。

Figure 4.7 Measurement and measurement protocols.

源测量数据来自数据库，计算测量数据使用 公式。

Source measurements are from a database, and calculated measurements use formulas.

该模型的一个重要特点——也反映了其临床背景——是任何现象类型都可以有多种测量方案来确定其数值。这一点可能会让一些读者感到奇怪。如果一种测量方法可以用多种方式计算，那它的意义何在？如果存在多个公式，那它肯定属于不同的现象类型。首先也是最显而易见的一点是，同一现象类型可以同时拥有计算方法和原始测量方案。我们可以在不同的时间使用不同的方案。此外，也可以存在多个原始测量方案；具体使用哪一个取决于系统的可用性。有些数据库比其他数据库更可靠，但可用性永远无法做到完美。

An important point about this model—a reflection of its clinical background—is that any phenomenon type can have several measurement protocols to determine its value. This point may strike some readers as odd. What is the point of a measurement that we can calculate in more than one way? If there is more than one formula, surely it is a different phenomenon type. The first and most obvious point is that the phenomenon type can have both calculations and source protocols. We can use different protocols at different times. There can also be multiple source protocols; which one we use depends on system availability. Some databases are more reliable than others, but availability can never be perfect.

同样，用户可以考虑使用不同的计算方法来得出同一种现象。用户选择哪种计算方法可能取决于可用的数据来源，或者取决于用户对计算中某些细微之处的理解。库存价值就是一个很好的例子。通常，库存只在年末进行实物盘点，但其价值需要在其他时间进行估算。无论哪种情况，该价值都将以相同的方式用于后续的财务信息。

Similarly the user could consider using different calculations to produce the same phenomenon type. Which calculation the user chooses can depend on which sources are available or on the user's opinion about subtle points within the calculation. A good example of this is the value of inventory. Usually inventory is physically counted only at the end of the year, but its value needs to be estimated at other times. In either case the value is used in the same way for further financial information.

该模型的一些用户可能会选择指定用于计算数值的测量协议。然而，另一些用户可能只需要一种现象类型，而让系统自动确定如何获取该值。在后一种情况下，需要某种方法来对特定现象类型的测量协议进行优先级排序。这可以通过将现象类型到测量协议的映射关系构建成一个列表来实现。列表的首项定义了首选协议，依此类推。

Some users of this model may choose to specify which measurement protocol to use to come up with a value. Others, however, may just want a phenomenon type and leave it to the system to come up with how it gets it. In the latter case some way is needed to prioritize the measurement protocols for a phenomenon type. This can be done by making the mapping from phenomenon type to measurement protocol a list. The front of the list defines the preferred protocol and so on.

请注意计算测量值的存在，以及它与其源测量值的关联。这遵循一般规则：当计算结果被视为一个对象时，它应该知道是什么计算导致了它（协议），以及该协议的输入是什么（源）。

Note the presence of calculated measurement, with its link back to its source measurements. This follows the general rule that the result of a computation, when treated as an object, should know what computation caused it (the protocol) and what the inputs to this protocol were (the sources).

4.2.1 保留计算

计算得到的测量协议包含其计算公式，如图 4.8 所示。这是一个单个实例方法的示例（参见第 6.6 节）。计算得到的测量协议的公式通常非常简单，因此我们可以使用一个简单的解释器 [3]，并将公式以电子表格的形式保存。

The calculated measurement protocols include the formulas by which they are calculated, as shown in Figure 4.8. This is an example of an individual instance method (see Section 6.6). The formulas for calculated measurement protocols are often very simple, so we can use a simple interpreter [3] and hold the formulas as spreadsheet-style formulas.

该模型的一个重要特征是参数的呈现方式。每个计算测量协议都有一个参数列表。该列表代表公式中组合的各种现象类型。请注意，映射关系是一个列表。为了使公式有意义，映射关系中的元素必须是可识别的。列表是实现这一点的有效方法。或者，也可以使用字符串作为键。

An important feature of the model is the way the arguments are presented. Each calculated measurement protocol has a list of arguments. This list represents those phenomenon types that are combined in the formula. Note that the mapping is a list. For the formula to make sense, the elements in the mapping must be identifiable. A list is a good way to do this. Alternatively they can be keyed by a string.

图 4.8 计算测量方案的方法。

Figure 4.8 Methods for calculated measurement protocols.

例如，销售收入是一种现象类型，其测量协议为因果计算。因果计算的参数是两个现象类型的列表——销售数量和平均价格。计算方法是公式 arg[1]*arg[2]。

Example Sales revenue is a phenomenon type with a causal calculation as its measurement protocol. The arguments to the causal calculation are a list of two phenomenon types—number of sales and average price. The method is the formula arg[1]*arg[2].

例如，身体质量指数（BMI）是医学上的一种现象类型。它通过体重和身高这两个参数进行因果计算。计算方法为：体重/身高²。

Example Body mass index is a phenomenon type in medicine. It has a causal calculation with arguments of weight and height. The method is the formula weight/height2.

4.2.2 比较和因果测量方案

在企业财务应用中，衡量指标并非绝对值。用户通常不太关心收入是 x 美元这样的具体数字，他们更关心实际收入与计划收入之间的差异，或者今年的收入与去年的收入相比如何。

In a corporate finance application the measurements are not absolute values. The users are usually not too interested in a figure that says revenues are $x, rather they are interested in the difference between the actual and a planned figure or this year's revenues compared to last year's.

为了考虑这些比较性测量，我们需要描述可能出现的各种测量类型。典型的比较是实际值与先前值或计划值之间的比较。先前值可以通过查看适用时间参考（参见第 3.8 节）或查找具有先前时间维度的企业细分测量值来考虑。计划测量要求我们区分实际值和计划值，这对应于第 3.10 节中讨论的主动观测值和预测观测值。此外，预测观测值必须记录预测的来源计划，以便我们能够区分年度计划、季度预测等，如图 4.9 所示。

To consider these comparative measurements, we need to describe the various kinds of measurements that can appear. Typical comparisons are between an actual value and either a prior or a planned value. Prior values can be considered by either looking at the applicability time reference (see Section 3.8) or by looking for a measurement for the enterprise segment that has a prior time dimension. Planned measurements require us to make a distinction between actual or planned values, which correspond to the ac tive and projected observations discussed in Section 3.10. In addition, the projected observation must record what plan was the source for the projection, so that we can distinguish between annual plans, quarterly forecasts, and the like, as shown in Figure 4.9.

至此，两种计算方式之间的根本区别应该显而易见。一种是基于其他现象类型的值来确定某一现象类型的值。例如，我们可以通过将销售数量乘以平均价格来计算销售收入。这种计算方式被称为因果计算，因为它遵循原因。

At this point a fundamental distinction between two types of calculation should be apparent. One kind is determining a value for a phenomenon type based on values of other phenomenon types. For example, we can calculate sales revenue by multiplying the number of sales by the average price. This type of calculation is called a causal calculation because it follows the cause

图 4.9 支持计划值和实际值的观测类型。

Figure 4.9 Kinds of observations to support planned and actual values.

以及效应分析。因果计算可以包含任意数量和任意关系的输入现象类型，并且计算公式可以是任意表达式。

and effect analysis. Causal calculations can have any number and any relationship of input phenomenon types, and the formulas by which they are computed can be any expression.

另一方面，比较计算则更具结构性。它们总是包含两个输入测量值，且这两个测量值必须属于同一现象类型。输出测量值的现象类型总是由计算公式和输入现象类型决定的。因此，如果我们考察的是销售数量的偏差，那么输入值就是销售数量这一现象类型，而输出值就是销售数量的偏差这一现象类型。这些计算的公式通常比较有限，例如绝对偏差 (xy) 或百分比偏差 ((xy)/y)。

Comparative calculations, on the other hand, are more structured. They always have two input measurements, which must be of the same phenomenon type. The output measurement's phenomenon type is always derived from the form of the calculation and the input phenomenon type. Thus if we are looking at the deviation of number of sales, then the inputs will be the phenomenon type number of sales and the output phenomenon type will be deviation for number of sales. The formulas for these calculations will generally be of a fairly limited set: such things as absolute deviation (x-y) or percentage deviation ((x-y)/y).

这两种计算类型之间的差异可以通过对计算测量协议进行子类型化来形式化，如图 4.10 所示。计算测量协议包含结构的关键元素。每个计算测量协议都有一个结果类型和若干输入类型。对于比较计算，它们仅限于两个参数，且这两个参数必须是同一现象类型。所有计算测量协议都有一个方法，该方法包含根据输入计算新值的公式。两个协议可以共享同一个方法，例如，所有用于确定所有现象类型绝对偏差的协议都共享方法 argl-arg2。事实上，这种情况非常常见，因此值得为此创建一个特殊的子类型，将方法与类型绑定。

The differences between these two types of calculations can be formalized by subtyping the calculated measurement protocol, as shown in Figure 4.10. The calculated measurement protocol carries the key elements of the structure. Each calculated measurement protocol has a single result type and a number of input types. For comparative calculations they are limited to two arguments, which must be the same phenomenon type. All calculated measurement protocols have a method that contains the formula by which a new value is calculated from the inputs. Two protocols can share a single method, for example the method argl-arg2 is shared between all the protocols that determine absolute deviation for all the phenomenon types. Indeed, this case is so common it is worth making a special subtype for it that fixes the method to the type.

4.2.3 状态类型：定义计划状态和实际状态

由源测量协议或计算测量协议确定的测量值始终通过其测量协议进行计算。测量协议为测量提供了一种出厂方法[3].1 客户要求

Measurements determined by source or calculated measurement protocols are always calculated through their measurement protocol. The measurement protocol provides a factory method for the measurement [3].1 A client asks the

请注意，造成这种情况的原因是创建方法不同，而不是最终结果的类型不同。这是除了 Gamma eta/ [3J. 指出的原因之外，使用工厂方法的另一个原因。

Note that the reason for this is that the method of creation varies, rather than the type of the final result. This is another reason to use the factory method in addition to those indicated by Gamma eta/ [3J.

图 4.10 计算类型，如计算测量协议所示。

Figure 4.10 Types of calculation as shown by calculated measurement protocols.

因果计算将不同现象类型联系起来，比较计算则显示 同一现象类型在不同状态类型之间的差异。

Causal calculations link different phenomenon types, and comparative calculations show the difference in one phenomenon type between status types.

测量方案用于创建测量结果。客户需要告知测量方案其参考的护理对象。客户还需要告知方案该值是实际值还是计划值：计划值对应哪个计划，实际值对应哪个日期。

measurement protocol to create a measurement. The client needs to tell the measurement protocol what object of care it needs to reference. The client also needs to tell the protocol whether it is an actual or planned value: which plan for the planned value or which date for the actual value.

此时，图 4.9 所示的模型暴露出一个缺陷。我们无法以简单的方式提供协议所需的信息。图 4.9 确实提供了一种从现有测量中确定此信息的有效方法，但它没有提供一种便捷的单一方法来请求该信息。图 4.11 所示的模型可以克服这一缺陷，该模型将这些属性整合到一个状态类型中。抽象状态类型包含两个子类型。实际状态类型可能具有时间偏移。对于当前值，将没有偏移（或偏移量为零）。六个月前或一年前将具有相应的偏移量。计划状态类型具有相应的计划，就像预测一样。

At this point the model shown in Figure 4.9 shows a weakness. There is no simple way we can provide the information needed for the protocol. Figure 4.9 does provide a good way to determine this information from an exist ing measurement, but it does not provide a convenient single way to ask for the information. This can be overcome by the model shown in Figure 4.11, which puts these properties together into a single status type. Two subtypes exist of the abstract status type. Actual status types may have a time offset. For current values there will be no offset (or it can be zero). Six months or one year ago will have the appropriate offset. Planned status types have the appropriate plan, just like projections.

例如，一家公司评估四种财务数据：实际值、上年值、年度计划和最新季度预测。实际值属于“实际”状态类型，时间偏移量为零。上年值属于“实际”状态类型，时间偏移量为一年。年度计划属于“计划”状态类型，与年度计划关联。季度预测也属于“计划”状态类型，与最新季度预测关联。所有季度预测都是计划的实例。

Example A corporation assesses four kinds of financials: actual value, prior year, the annual plan, and the latest quarterly forecast. The actual would be an actual status type with time offset of zero. The prior year is an actual with time offset of one year. The annual plan is a planned status type linked to the annual plan. The quarterly forecast is also a planned status type linked to the latest quarterly forecast. All the quarterly forecasts are instances of the plan.

实际上，我们已经将我们所观察到的观察类型的信息从观察本身转移到了一个单独的类型中。这种类型可以枚举

Effectively we have moved the knowledge of what kind of observation we have from the observation itself to a separate type. This type can enumerate

图 4.11 状态类型，作为图 4.9 的替代方案。

Figure 4.11 Status types as an alternative to Figure 4.9.

这种替代方法更容易指定所需的比较测量类型 （见图 4.12）。

This alternative makes it easier to specify the kind of comparative measurement required (see Figure 4.12).

所有可能的变异都独立于现有观测结果。类型存在于知识层面，因此我们可以计算新的测量值，但它并非必须存在于知识层面。我们应该注意到，这与图 4.9 中的模型并不矛盾。两种表达方式略有不同，但意思相同，而且两者都可以同时成立。

all possible variations independently of existing observations. The type resides at the knowledge level so we can calculate new measurements, but it need not be at the knowledge level. We should note that this is not inconsistent with the model in Figure 4.9. Both expressions say the same thing, in slightly different ways, and both could be supported at the same time.

现在，客户端只需指定测量协议的状态类型，即可获得创建测量所需的足够信息（假设该协议是因果协议）。比较计算需要两种状态类型，每个输入对应一种。一种解决方法是修改创建测量操作，使其对因果测量需要一种状态类型，对比较测量需要两种状态类型。另一种方法是允许使用比较状态类型，如图 4.12 所示。我更倾向于后一种方法，因为比较本身就是一个独立的对象，而且创建所有测量的接口都相同。

Now the client needs only to specify the status type for the measurement protocol to have enough information to create the measurement, assuming the protocol is a causal protocol. Comparative calculations need two status types, one for each input. One way of dealing with this is to vary the create measurement operation so that it requires one status type for causals and two for comparative measurements. Another method is to allow comparative status types, as shown in Figure 4.12. I prefer the latter method because the comparison is now an object in its own right, and the interface for creating all measurements is the same.

例如， ACM 管理层希望查看实际销售收入与计划销售收入的偏差。为了满足此需求，模型必须包含销售收入现象类型和销售收入偏差现象类型。销售收入偏差是通过比较计算得出的，计算方法为 arg[1] - arg[2]。该请求会创建一个销售收入偏差的观测值，其状态类型为比较型。该状态类型的数据项为计划数据，比较对象为实际数据。

Example ACM management wants to see the actual vs. planned deviation for sales revenue. To satisfy this request, the model must include a phenomenon type for sales revenue and a phenomenon type for sales revenue deviation. The sales revenue deviation is a comparative calculation with a method of arg[l] -arg[2].The request creates an observation of sales revenue deviation with a comparative status type. The status type will have datum of planned and comparator of actual.

4.2.4 创建测量

现在我们知道了如何请求新的测量值，我们可以看看创建测量值的过程，如图 4.13 和 4.14 所示。该过程分为三个步骤：查找参数、执行公式以及使用结果值创建新的测量对象。

Now that we know how to ask for a new measurement, we can look at the process for creating a measurement, which is illustrated in Figures 4.13 and 4.14. The process has three steps: finding the arguments, executing a formula, and creating a new measurement object with the resulting value.

参数查找操作是多态的，取决于我们采用的是因果测量协议还是比较测量协议。如图 4.15 所示，因果协议需要找到所有相同状态类型的测量值。

The argument-finding operation is polymorphic depending on whether we have a causal or comparative measurement protocol. The causal protocol, shown in Figure 4.15, needs to find all measurements of the same status type

图 4.12 使用比较状态类型来简化比较 测量的规范。

Figure 4.12 Using comparative status types to ease the specification of comparative measurements.

图 4.13 创建测量的交互图。

Figure 4.13 Interaction diagram for creating a measurement.

以及观察对象的现象类型与协议的输入类型相匹配。如图 4.16 所示，比较公式寻找两个测量值，它们的现象类型与输入类型相同，观察对象相同，并且它们的状态类型分别是协议的数据和比较对象。

and object of care whose phenomenon types match the input types of the protocol. The comparative formula, shown in Figure 4.16, looks for two measurements whose phenomenon type is that of the input type, who have the same object of care, and whose status types are the datum and comparator for the protocol.

图 4.14 事件图，描述了创建测量的过程。

Figure 4.14 Event diagram that describes the process for creating a measurement.

图 4.15 因果计算的查找参数操作。

Figure 4.15 The find arguments operation for a causal calculation.

此操作会找到每种参数类型的度量值，其他所有因素都保持 不变。

This operation finds a measurement for each argument type with all other factors the same.

找到参数后，我们可以将它们传递给公式，然后用结果值创建一个度量值。

When we have found the arguments, we can pass them on to the formula and then create a measurement with the resulting value.

4.2.5 尺寸组合

第三种计算方法是对某一维度上的值进行组合。例如，上面提到的东北地区的销售收入计算方法是将东北地区所有子区域的销售额相加。更准确地说，对于指向东北地区的某个企业细分，其现象类型的度量值是通过查找所有指向东北维度元素子区域但其他维度元素相同的企业细分所对应的该现象类型的度量值来计算的。将这些值相加即可得到新的值。

A third kind of calculation is the combination of values along a dimension. The example mentioned above was that of calculating sales revenue for the Northeast by adding together the values for sales for all child regions of the Northeast region. More precisely, the measurement of a phenomenon type for an enterprise segment that refers to Northeast is calculated by finding all measurements of that phenomenon type attached to enterprise segments that refer to child regions of the Northeast dimension element but have the same dimension elements along the other dimensions. These values are added together for the new value.

图 4.16 查找参数操作用于比较计算。

Figure 4.16 The find arguments operation for comparative calculations. This

该操作为比较状态类型的每个分支找到一个参数。

operation finds one argument for each leg of the comparative status type.

因此，我们可以添加如图 4.17 所示的维度组合协议。我们必须指定要组合的维度。该计算不需要任何输入类型（因为它始终与输出类型相同）。我们可以考虑将输入类型映射的基数降低到零，但我认为通过保持映射的强制性并添加约束，我们可以更好地保持逻辑清晰。创建度量遵循如图 4.14 所示的常规步骤，其中查找参数的操作再次进行了修改，如图 4.18 所示。计算方法的作用非常简单：它获取所有参数并将它们相加。通常使用加法进行组合，但并非总是如此。例如，平均价格这种现象类型不会在维度组合中相加；而是计算平均值。这些变化取决于现象类型，因此每种现象类型都需要一个组合方法。计算方法将组合方法应用于参数以确定结果。

We can thus add a dimension combination protocol as shown in Figure 4.17. We must specify the dimension that is being combined. The calculation does not need any input types (since it is always the same phenomenon type as the output type). We could consider reducing the input type mapping's cardinality to zero, but I think we can preserve the sense better by keeping the mapping mandatory and adding a constraint. Creating the measurement follows the usual steps shown in Figure 4.14, with the find arguments operation again being altered as in Figure 4.18. The role of the calculation method is very simple: It takes all the arguments and adds them together. Usually addition is used for combining, but not always. For example, the phenomenon type average price is not added in dimension combination; instead a mean is found. These variations depend on the phenomenon type, so each phenomenon type needs to have a combi nation method. The calculation method applies the combination method to the arguments to determine the result.

请注意，比较和维度组合协议可以自动生成。对于维度组合，可以为每种现象类型和维度的组合定义一个协议。对于比较计算，可以为每种现象类型和比较计算类型的组合定义一个协议。

Note that the comparative and dimension combination protocols can be automatically generated. For dimension combination, one protocol can be defined for each combination of phenomenon type and dimension. For comparative calculations, one protocol can be defined for each combination of phenomenon type and kind of comparative calculation.

图 4.17 将维度组合添加到计算测量协议中。

Figure 4.17 Adding dimension combination to the calculated measurement protocols.

图 4.18 维度组合计算的查找参数操作。

Figure 4.18 The find arguments operation for dimension combination calculations.

此操作会找到每个子企业细分市场沿指定 维度的度量值。

This operation finds a measurement for each child enterprise segment along the indicated dimension.

计算测量在医疗保健领域同样有用。我们之所以在本章而非第三章讨论计算测量，主要是因为它们在我们公司金融领域的研究中被广泛应用。因此，它们可以说明将模型应用于不同领域会引发更多思考，而这些思考很可能会反过来应用于原领域。

Calculated measurements are just as useful in health care. We discuss cal culated measurements in this chapter, rather than in Chapter 3, primarily because they were used extensively in our work on corporate finance. Thus they are an illustration of how taking a model to a different domain causes more thought that may well feed back into the original domain.

4.3 射程

4.3 Range

到目前为止，我们已经探讨了如何利用计算得出和来源明确的指标来分析公司的财务业绩。指标衡量标准为我们提供了一种定量分析这些信息的方法。然而，为了理解海量数据，将指标分组通常很有帮助。例如，我们可以将绝对收入划分为若干区间，或者将所有低于基准值10%的比较指标标记为问题。

So far we have looked at how we can use measurements, both calculated and sourced, to investigate a company's financial performance. The measurement protocol pattern gives us a way of looking at this information quantitatively. To make sense of a forest of numbers, however, it is often useful to group measurements into categories. We might want to divide the absolute revenues into a number of bands, or we could highlight as problems all comparative measurements that are 10 percent below the datum.

第一步是描述测量范围，这也是本模式的主题。第二步是将这些范围与更广泛的观测系统联系起来，我们将在4.4节中讨论。

Our first step is to describe ranges of measurements, which is the subject of this pattern. The second step is to link these ranges into the broader system of observations, as we will discuss in Section 4.4.

我们经常需要存储一系列值。这些值可以是数字（例如 1..10）、日期（例如 1995 年 1 月 1 日.. 1995 年 5 月 5 日）、数量（例如 10..20 千克）甚至是字符串（例如 AAA..AGZ）。通常，我们会将范围定义在使用该范围的数据类型上，并为该数据类型分别设置上限值和下限值，如图 4.19 所示。

We often come across the need to hold a range of some values. The range can consist of numbers (such as 1..10), dates (such as 1/1/95..5/5/95), quantities (such as 10..20kg) or even strings (such as AAA..AGZ). Usually a range is placed on the type that is using it by giving that type separate mapping for an upper and lower value, as shown in Figure 4.19.

图 4.19 表示使用该类型的范围及其上限和下限。

Figure 4.19 Representing a range with upper and lower bounds on the type that uses it.

不建议对范围采用这种方法；请改用范围类型。

/ do not recommend this approach to ranges; use a range type instead.

这种方法的缺点在于，范围的概念远不止于上限值和下限值。我们可能想知道某个特定值是否在某个范围内，两个范围是否重叠，两个范围是否相邻，或者一组范围是否构成一个连续范围。这种行为需要为每个具有上限值和下限值的类型重复实现。解决方案是将范围本身作为一个对象，如图 4.20 所示。在这种情况下，所有与范围相关的功能都包含在范围对象内部，无需在其他使用范围的类型中重复实现。

The problem with this approach is that there is rather more to ranges than just an upper and lower value. We might want to know whether a particular value is within a range, whether two ranges overlap, whether two ranges abut, or whether a set of ranges form a continuous range. Such behavior would have to be copied for every type that has upper and lower values. The solution is to make the range an object in its own right, as shown in Figure 4.20. In this situation all responsibilities which are essentially about ranges are contained within the range, and do not need to be duplicated in those types that use ranges.

一般来说，任意两个量之间都可以形成一个范围。量本质上是一种定义了比较运算符（>、<、=、>、<）的类型。

In general a range can be formed between any two magnitudes. A magnitude, in essence, is a type that defines the comparative operators (>, <, =, >, <).

图 4.20 使用显式范围对象。

Figure 4.20 Using an explicit range object.

当需要设置上限值和下限值时，必须这样做。上限值和下限值的 映射是可选的，因此允许使用开放式范围，例如小于 6 个月。 布尔值用于区分小于 6 个月和小于等于 6 个 月的情况。

This should always be done when an upper and lower value are needed. Upper and lower mappings are optional, thus allowing open-ended ranges, such as less than 6 months. The Booleans are needed to differentiate less than 6 months from less than or equal to 6 months.

范围只需要定义其关键操作：包含、重叠和相邻。使用范围时，使用类型通常会指示其范围所需的量级类型。有几种方法可以对所需的量级类型进行建模。一种方法是声明子类型，例如我使用时间段（量级为时间点的范围）的方式。另一种方法是使用约束，如图 4.20 所示。第三种方法是使用类似参数化类的方法，其中整数范围由名为 range<Integer> 的类型定义。从概念上讲，所有这些建模技术都是等价的，因此我们可以选择任何我们认为最简单的方法。在实现中，我们需要更谨慎地选择，并且权衡取舍会因实现环境而异。概念模型的选择并不意味着对实现方式有任何影响。

The range needs only these operations to define its own key operations: includes, overlaps, and abuts. When a range is used, the using type usually indicates what kind of magnitudes it wants in its range. There are several ways of modeling which kind of magnitude is required. One way is to declare a subtype, such as I do with time period (a range whose magnitudes are time-points). Another way is to use a constraint, as in Figure 4.20. A third way is to use something along the lines of parameterized classes, where a range of integers is defined by a type called range<Integer>. Conceptually all of these modeling techniques are equivalent, so we can use whatever we find the easiest. In implementation we need to choose more carefully, and the trade-offs vary depending on the implementation environment. The choice of conceptual model does not imply anything about the implementation.

4.4 具有范围的现象

4.4 Phenomenon with Range

范围为我们提供了一种定义测量类别的方法。现在我们需要将它们与更广泛的观测和测量模型联系起来。为此，我们可以构建特定现象类型的现象。如果我们的现象类型是收入百分比偏差，那么我们可以构建收入问题现象，当收入百分比偏差小于-10%时，该现象就存在。这意味着，-12%的收入百分比偏差测量值也意味着存在收入问题这一类别的观测值（参见3.5节）。

Ranges give us a way to define categories of measurements. We now need to link them into the broader model of observation and measurement. To do this, we can form phenomena of certain phenomenon types. If our phenomenon type is revenue percentage deviation, we can form a phenomenon of revenue problem, which exists when our revenue percentage deviation is less than -10 percent. This implies that a measurement of-12 percent of revenue percentage deviation also implies a category observation (see Section 3.5) of revenue problem.

我们首先需要回答的问题是，这里存在一个还是两个观测值。根据图 3.9 所示的模型，观测值要么是测量值，要么是类别观测值，二者不可兼得。我们可以使用图 4.21 所示的模型，允许单个观测值同时具备这两种属性。模型的选择取决于我们是将概念过程视为首先进行测量，然后再单独观察收益问题（这意味着使用图 3.9），还是将测量和观察视为一个过程。对于此类简单情况，我合作过的领域专家更倾向于后者。

The first question we need to answer is whether there are one or two observations. According to the model shown in Figure 3.9, observations are either measurements or category observations, they cannot be both. We can allow a single observation to be both by using the model shown in Figure 4.21. The choice between the models depends on whether we consider the conceptual process as being first a measurement and then a separate step of observing the revenue problem (which implies using Figure 3.9), or whether we see the measurement and observation as one process. For simple cases such as these, the domain experts I have worked with preferred the latter.

图 4.21 允许一个观察结果既是测量结果又是类别观察结果。

Figure 4.21 Allowing an observation to be both a measurement and a category observation.

该[摘要]声明暗示，一个观察结果必须至少是其子类型之一。

The [abstract] statement implies that an observation must be at least one of its subtypes.

既然我们已经有了明确的范围，那么让计算机自动将任何此类测量结果与相关现象联系起来似乎就顺理成章了。为此，我们需要一种方法来定义知识层级内的范围。

Since we have a well-defined range, it seems natural to let the computer automatically link any such measurement to the relevant phenomenon. To do this we need a way of defining the range within the knowledge level.

4.4.1 具有范围属性的现象

最简单的方法是为现象添加一个范围，如图 4.22 和 4.23 所示。这样，当我们创建一个测量值时，就可以检查它是否落在该测量值所属现象类型的任何现象的范围内。我们需要考虑是否希望现象类型的范围互不重叠或完整。这两种情况都表明需要添加约束。

The simplest approach is to add a range to a phenomenon, as shown in Figures 4.22 and 4.23. Then when we create a measurement we can look to see if it falls in the range for any phenomenon of that measurement's phenomenon types. We do have to consider whether we want the range for a phenomenon type not to overlap or to be complete. Either of these conditions indicate the need for a constraint.

图 4.22 为现象添加范围。

Figure 4.22 Adding a range to a phenomenon.

测量协议会生成测量结果。

The measurement protocol creates a measurement.

它询问其现象的类型。

It asks its phenomenon type for its phenomena.

它会询问每一种现象是否包含新的测量方法。

It asks each phenomenon if it includes the new measurement.

如果是这样，则将该测量结果归类为血压的类别观察。

If so, it classifies the measurement as a category observation of the BP.

图 4.23 创建测量和检查现象的交互 图 。

Figure 4.23 Interaction diagram for creating a measurement and checking the phenomena.

检验现象的责任 完全可以由测量对象承担。我 更倾向于协议，因为我认为协议更容易被修改。

The responsibility for checking the phenomena could be done equally well by the measurement object. I prefer the protocol, as I think that is a more likely place for overriding.

例如，收入百分比偏差分为四类：大于 5% 为良好，5% 至 -5% 为尚可，-5% 至 -10% 为警告，小于 -10% 为问题。这可以表示为收入百分比偏差 (RPD) 现象类型的四种情况。良好 RPD 现象的范围没有上限，下限为 5；尚可 RPD 现象的范围上限为 5，下限为 -5；警告 RPD 现象的范围上限为 -5，下限为 -10；问题 RPD 现象的范围上限为 -10，没有下限。重要的是要准确检查边界值，并将此信息包含在范围内；因此，我们需要问：5% 正好是良好 RPD 还是尚可 RPD？

Example Revenue percentage deviation is divided into four categories: greater than 5% is good, 5% to -5% is OK, -5% to -10% is warning, and less than -10% is a problem. This can be represented as four phenomena for the phenomenon type revenue percentage deviation (RPD). The phenomenon good RPD has a range with no upper bound and 5 lower bound, the phenomenon OK RPD has a range with upper bound 5 and lower bound -5, the phenomenon warning RPD has a range with upper bound -5 and lower bound -10, the phenomenon problem RPD has a range with upper bound -10 and no lower bound. It is important to check exactly what the boundaries are and include this information in the ranges; so we ask if exactly 5% is good RPD or OK RPD?

例如，体重指数（BMI）用于定义四个群体：正常（20-25 kg/m²）、超重（25-30 kg/m²）、肥胖（30-40 kg/m²）和病态肥胖（>40 kg/m²）。对于BMI这一现象类型，这可以表示为四种现象。超重现象的范围下限为25 kg/m²，上限为30 kg/m²。其他每种现象的范围也类似。

Example Body mass index is used to define four groups: normal 20-25 kg/m2, overweight 25-30 kg/m2, obese 30-40 kg/m2, morbid obese >40 kg/m2. This would be represented as four phenomena for the phenomenon type body mass index. The overweight phenomenon would have a range with lower bound 25 kg/m2 and upper bound 30 kg/m2. Each of the other phenomena would have similar ranges.

4.4.2 范围函数

另一种方法是创建一个单独的范围函数作为关联函数的子类型，如图 4.24 和 4.25 所示。当不同的范围取决于观测概念所描述的上下文时，这种方法非常有用。该模型允许存在多个范围序列，具体取决于适用的观测概念。范围函数会像关联函数一样评估参数的某种表达式，但还会检查测量值是否落在某个现象类型的范围内。如果两者都为真，

An alternative approach is to create a separate range function as a subtype of associative function, as shown in Figures 4.24 and 4.25. This is useful when different ranges apply, depending on the context described by an observation concept. This model allows several series of ranges to be present, depending on which observation concepts apply. The range function evaluates some expression of the arguments, as in an associative function, but also checks whether the measurement falls in the range over a phenomenon type. If both are true,

图 4.24 范围函数。

Figure 4.24 Range function.

测量协议会生成测量结果。

The measurement protocol creates a measurement.

它询问其现象类型以确定其范围函数。

It asks its phenomenon type for its range functions.

它使用新的测量值评估每个范围函数。

It evaluates each range function with the new measurement.

如果评估结果为真，则找到范围函数的乘积，并将测量结果分类为该乘积的类别观测值。

If the evaluation returns true, it finds the range function's product and classifies the measurement as a category observation of that product.

图 4.25 创建 测量 和检查 范围功能。

Figure 4.25 Creating a measurement and checking range functions.

那么，产品观测概念就适用了。建立约束条件以确保对于任何给定的测量值只有一个量程函数成立，比直接将量程应用于现象要困难得多。

then the product observation concept applies. Developing constraints to ensure that only one range function will be true for any given measurement is considerably more difficult than when ranges are applied directly to phenomena.

例如，某些企业细分市场被定义为关键细分市场。对于这些细分市场，问题收入百分比偏差 (RPD) 定义为 -5% 而不是 -10%。为了处理这种情况，我们将定义一个关键细分市场观察概念。这些关键细分市场将应用相应的观察值。（这还使我们能够随时间更改关键状态。）我们将定义一个范围函数，其参数为：{关键细分市场}、问题 RPD 的乘积、小于 5% 的范围以及 RPD 现象类型。

Example Certain enterprise segments are defined as key. For these segments the problem revenue percentage deviation (RPD) is defined at -5% instead of -10%.To handle this we would define an observation concept of key segment. Those segments that were key segments would have an appropriate observation applied to them. (This would also give us the ability to change key status over time.) We would define a range function with arguments of {key segment}, product of problem RPD, a range of <5% and a phenomenon type of RPD.

例如，正常人β-HCG值范围会随着怀孕而升高。为了表示这一点，我们可以用两个范围函数来表示正常β-HCG值。一个函数的参数为​​怀孕状态，另一个函数的参数为​​非怀孕状态。这两个范围函数的现象类型均为β-HCG。

Example The normal range of a person's beta HCG increases with pregnancy. To represent this, we would have two range functions with the product normal beta HCG. One would have arguments of pregnancy and the other arguments of nonpregnancy. The phenomenon type on the range functions would be beta HCG.

这两种方法各有优点，也可以结合使用。直接关联现象无疑是最简便的方法，如果这种方法能够准确描述情况，就应该使用它。范围函数虽然更复杂，但可以表示更复杂的情况。因此，尽可能使用直接关联现象的方法，而只有在必须使用范围函数时才应该使用。如果情况比这里描述的模型所能处理的更加复杂，则应该向范围函数添加特征，可以直接添加，也可以通过子类型添加。

Both of these approaches have their merits, and it can be plausible to use them both together. Linking directly to the phenomenon is certainly the easiest way of doing it, and that is the one to use if it correctly describes the situation. Range functions are more complex but can represent more complicated situations. So you should use the direct link to phenomenon when you can and range functions when you must. If the situation gets more complex than the models described here can handle, you should add features to range function, either directly or by way of a subtype.

4.5 使用所得框架

4.5 Using the Resulting Framework

到目前为止，本章描述的模式都是对第三章介绍的模式的扩展。现在我们可以看看如何使用这些模型。

So far this chapter has described patterns that represented expansions of those introduced in Chapter 3. Now we can look at how we can use these models.

我们首先来看一下ACM的总收入。这项指标的企业级划分涵盖整个公司；也就是说，企业级划分的所有维度元素都位于维度层级的顶端。该指标通常不是绝对值，而是与某个计划或先前时间段的比较值。此外，如果存在问题，可以通过根据一系列现象进行突出显示来表明。分析师接下来会着手寻找由这些现象定义的问题观察结果。

We begin by looking for the total revenue for ACM. This would be a measurement whose enterprise segment is the whole company; that is, the enterprise segment's dimension elements are all at the top of the dimension hierarchies. The measurement normally would not be an absolute value; rather it would be a comparative value with some plan or prior time period. Furthermore, the fact that it is a problem might be indicated by highlighting it according to a ranged phenomenon. The analyst would then begin by looking for problem observations defined by phenomena.

为了确定问题出在设备销售收入上，我们需要回溯总收入的因果关系计算，即销售收入减去销售成本。请注意，因果关系计算仅指明了一种可能的分析路径，无论该指标是否以此方式确定。最终数据可能实际上来源于数据库。（由于数据质量不佳，其结果可能与公式计算结果不完全吻合。）

To identify that the problem is with equipment sales income, we need to roll back the causal calculation of total revenue as sales income minus sales cost. Note that the causal calculation indicates a possible path of analysis, whether or not the measurement was determined that way. It may be that this final figure was actually sourced from a database. (Due to dirty data, it may be that it doesn't exactly fit the result of the formula.)

下一步是使用维度组合协议。沿着位置维度观察，可以发现东北地区的偏差明显较高。现在我们可以重点关注在位置维度上指向东北维度元素，并且在所有其他维度上都位于顶部的企业细分。重复此过程两次，即可找到位置为东北、产品属于1100系列、行业为政府的企业细分。

The next step is to use dimension combination protocols. Looking along the location dimension shows that the Northeast segment had a noticeably higher deviation. We can now focus on the enterprise segment that points to the Northeast dimension element on the location dimension, and at the top for all other dimensions. Repeating this process two more times would lead us to the enterprise segment with location of Northeast, product of 1100 family, and industry sector of government.

这里存在一定的间接性。当涉及比较计算时，路径可能并非直接。总收入偏差可能并非通过销售收入偏差减去销售成本偏差来计算。更可能的情况是，分别计算实际销售收入和计划销售收入，然后将它们用于因果分析。对于绝对偏差，两种方法都适用，但对于百分比偏差则不然。是否存在相关规范将决定哪些计算方法适用，哪些不适用。

There is a certain amount of indirection here. When comparative calculations are involved, the route may not be direct. It may not be that the deviation in total revenue is calculated by subtracting the deviation in sales cost from the deviation in sales income. A more likely scenario is that the separate actual and planned sales revenues are calculated, and then these are used in the causal. With absolute deviation, either route will work, but this is not true for percentage deviation. The presence or absence of protocols will indicate what will and will not be appropriate calculations.

我们可以使用其他方法。与其先进行因果分析，再进行维度组合，不如先分解位置维度，然后进行因果分析，再分解其他维度。分析方法有很多种，这些方法不必与计算数据时所用的方法相同。

We can use alternative routes. Instead of first doing the causal, and then dimension combinations, we could break down on the location dimension, then use a causal, and then other dimension breakdowns. There are many possible paths for analysis, and these need not be the same as those used for calculating the figures.

我们可以使用第 3.11 节中描述的关联函数来描述定性陈述，例如“强大的竞争对手可能会导致销售额下降”。定性和定量观察通过分配范围现象联系起来。

We can describe qualitative statements, such as "a strong competitor may cause a decrease in sales," using the associative functions described in Section 3.11. Qualitative and quantitative observations are linked by assigning ranged phenomena.

应用程序可以使用多种技术来探索这种结构。当前的多维数据库倾向于用户进行即席探索，从而提供最大的灵活性。另一种方法是固定一条分解路径，该路径由一系列协议层级定义。这种技术已被证明能够快速有效地找到问题的根源。这些层级分析器可以很容易地基于此框架构建。其他方法则会使用代理深入结构内部，以突出显示有趣的测量结果。

Applications can use several techniques to explore this structure. Current multidimensional databases lean toward ad-hoc exploration by the user, which provides the maximum flexibility. Another alternative is to fix a decomposition path, defined by a hierarchy of protocols. This technique has been found to be effective in getting to the root of problems quickly. These hierarchical analyzers can easily be built on top of this framework. Other approaches would use agents to burrow in the structure to highlight interesting measurements.

本章体现了将医疗保健模型应用于公司金融的实际尝试。对医疗保健模型所做的扩展可以反过来应用到公司金融模型中。测量方案当然适用；企业细分模式可能对流行病学有用，尽管这方面尚待分析。我希望通过允许模式以这种方式迁移，能够涌现出越来越多有用的模式，如果我们更倾向于将模式封闭起来，这些模式可能永远不会出现。

This chapter reflects an actual attempt to take a model from health care and apply it to corporate finance. The extensions made to the health care model can be fed back into that model. Measurement protocols are certainly applicable; the enterprise segment pattern may be useful in epidemiology, although that is yet to be analyzed. By allowing patterns to migrate like this, I hope that more and more useful patterns will emerge, patterns that would never have appeared had we been more inclined to keep patterns shut up inside their home.

第五章 指称对象

Chapter 5. Referring to Objects

面向对象编程的核心在于对象标识的概念。在面向对象计算机系统中，每个对象都有一个唯一的ID，用于保证任何对象都可以被直接访问。这种概念也影响着我们的概念思维。很少有对象方法使用主键和辅助键，而主键和辅助键在传统数据建模中扮演着重要角色。我们仍然需要某种方式来引用特定的对象：例如，我可能需要找到某个特定的人来寄送账单，或者医生可能需要将某个病人标记为患有糖尿病。对象系统为我们提供了强大的浏览功能，利用了概念对象之间的自然关系，但有时我们需要更明确的标识符。

Much of object orientation focuses on the idea of object identity. Within an OO computer system, each object has a unique ID, which is used as a guarantee that any object can be directly accessed. This notion affects our conceptual thinking, too. Few object methods use primary and secondary keys, which play a major role in traditional data modeling. We still need some way to refer to a particular object: For example, I might need to find a particular person to whom I need to send a bill, and a doctor may need to mark a patient as suffering from diabetes. Object systems provide us with powerful browsing capabilities that exploit the natural relationships between conceptual objects, but sometimes a more explicit identifier is required.

对象最简单的标识符是名称（5.1），它通常是一串字符，用于标识一个对象。但问题在于，名称并非在所有情况下都能保证指向特定的对象。因此，有时需要一种更为人为的标识符：在标识方案（5.2）的上下文中定义的标识符。

The simplest identifier for an object is a name (5.1), a sequence of characters that usually identifies an object. The problem is that names are not guaranteed to refer to a specific object in all circumstances. A more artificial creation may be required: an identifier within the context of an identification scheme (5.2).

当我们意识到对象并非总是像我们想象的那样定义明确且静止不动时，情况就变得更加复杂了。在计算机之外的现实世界中，我们很容易发现，我们原本认为是两个对象，实际上却是一个对象。对于这种情况，我们需要进行对象合并（5.3）。我们之后可能还需要再次拆分它们，因为我们也可能错误地进行合并。我们可以通过复制替换、取代或本质/外观合并来实现合并。有时，我们会遇到一些看似应该相同的独立对象，但我们无法完全确定，或者无法与其他相关人员达成一致。此时，我们只能说它们之间存在对象等价性（5.4）。

Matters are further complicated when we realize that objects are not always as well defined and static as we think they are. In the world outside computers, it is easy to find situations where what we thought was two objects is actually one. For such situations we need to do an object merge (5.3). We may also need to split them again later, since we can merge in error, too. We can do the merge by copy and replace, superseding, or essence/ appearance. Sometimes we have separate objects that perhaps ought to be the same, but we cannot be entirely sure, or we cannot reach an agreement with other people involved. At this point we can only say that there is an object equivalence (5.4).

请记住，本章讨论的是概念上的对象指称——也就是人类使用的指称。除了软件使用的任何对象标识方案之外，这些指称还会出现在模型中。本章不讨论任何软件标识技术，但我假设任何面向对象实现中都存在这些技术。我还假设这些技术对用户是隐藏的。

Remember that this chapter is about conceptual references to objects— references that humans use. These references appear in a model in addition to any object identity schemes used by software. I don't discuss any software identity techniques in this chapter, but I would assume they exist in any OO implementation. I would also assume they would be hidden from the users.

关键概念：标识符、标识方案、被取代的对象、对象本质、等价性。

Key Concepts Identifier, Identification Scheme, Superseded Object, Object Essence, Equivalence.

5.1 名称

5.1 Name

我在教授面向对象设计课程时会用到一个练习，要求记录一个人的出生信息。这个练习需要记录出生医院和出生城市。我通常会指出，如果我们知道某人出生的医院，那么我们应该自然而然地知道出生城市，因为每家医院都只位于一个城市。但总会有人指出并非如此，因为世界上很多城市都有一家名为“圣玛丽医院”的医院。

An exercise I use in an OO design class I teach involves recording details of a person's birth. Part of this problem requires us to record the hospital and city of someone's birth. As guidance I point out that if the we know the hospital someone is born in, we should automatically know the city, since every hospital lies in only one city. Inevitably someone points out that this is not the case because many cities of the world have a St. Mary's Hospital.

这里的错误是逻辑和哲学中最古老的错误之一——混淆了事物的名称和事物本身。医院远不止是一串字母：它是建筑物、组织、人员、法律实体，以及许多使怀特岛圣玛丽医院与伦敦圣玛丽医院截然不同的因素。显然，如果人们真的遇到医院，就不会把它们混淆。关键在于，可能有很多医院名称相同，但名称仅仅是与医院相关的一串字母，而不是医院本身。我们建模的对象是事物，而不是名称，因此完全可以说每家医院都只位于一个城市。

The error here is one of the oldest in logic and philosophy—the confusion between the name of a thing and the thing itself. A hospital is much more than a sequence of letters: It is buildings, an organization, people, a legal entity, many things that make St. Mary's Hospital on the Isle of Wight different from St. Mary's Hospital in London. Clearly nobody would actually mistake one for the other if they actually ran into the object. The point is that there may be many hospital objects that share the same name, but the name is merely a sequence of letters associated with the hospital, not the hospital itself. We model objects, not names, thus it is perfectly reasonable to say that every hospital lies in only one city.

什么是名字？名字是一种非正式的识别方式。我强调“非正式”二字，因为名字更多地依赖于使用的便利性，而非其他任何特征。字符串“Martin”是一个有用的标识符，在很多情况下足以指代我。但我曾经和另一个也叫Martin的人合租过房子。我们两个住户都使用这个字符串，因此它作为标识符的价值就降低了。在我们朋友圈里，“Martin”仍然是我们俩最常用的标识符，但偶尔也会出现混淆。在许多应用场景中，我们认为给一个人一个名字是合理的，如图5.1所示，尽管这个名字可能是结构化的。更复杂的例子可能会给一个人多个名字，以便使用别名，如图5.2所示。例如，我可以用字符串“Martin F”来指代，以区别于另一个Martin。

What is a name? It is an informal way of identifying an object. I stress the word informal, for names rely more on convenience of use than any other feature. The string "Martin" is a useful identifier that in many contexts is enough to identify me. But I once shared a house with someone else named Martin. Both occupants shared that character string, so its value as an identifier was reduced. Among our circle of friends, "Martin" was still the most commonly used identifier for both of us, but occasional confusions did occur. In many applications we consider it reasonable to give a person a single name, as shown in Figure 5.1, although that name might be structured. More sophisticated examples might give a person many names to allow for aliases, as shown in Figure 5.2. For example, I could be referred to by the string "Martin F" to distinguish me from the other Martin.

名称通常是识别物体的一种有效方式，但任何认真构建人员记录系统的人都不会将名称用作……

Names are often a valuable way to identify objects, but no one serious about building a system that records people would ever use a name as a

图 5.1 只有一个名称的对象。

Figure 5.1 Object with one name.

该模型暗示并非所有对象都必须有名称。有人可能会认为，没有 名称意味着指向一个空字符串，因此这种映射是强制性的。无论如何， 该模型表明一个字符串可以用作多个对象的名称。 从概念上讲，所有相同的字符串都是同一个字符串；也就是说，不存在完全相同的副本。

The model implies that not all objects have to have a name. You could argue that not having a name implies a link to an empty string, hence the mapping is mandatory. In either case this model indicates that a string can be used as a name for many objects. Conceptually all equal strings are the same string; that is, you don't have identical copies.

图 5.2 具有多个名称的对象。

Figure 5.2 Object with many names.

这模拟了一个带有别名的对象。一种变体是拥有一个（常用）名称和 多个别名。

This models an object with aliases. A variation may be to have one (usual) name and several aliases.

姓名并非个人的唯一身份标识。人们往往有很多名字，同一个名字也可能被不同的人使用，而且人们还会改名。所有这些因素都使得姓名不再是可靠的身份标识，尽管它仍然是迄今为止最常用的身份标识。

person's sole identifier. People have many names, the same name is used by different people, and people change names. All of these factors make names unreliable identifiers, although still by far the most common one.

名称和标识符还有另一个重要方面需要记住：名称是一种简洁的方式来向他人描述某个对象。它可以描述对象的某些属性。例如，将一款汽车型号命名为 16GL，可以告诉人们它的发动机排量和舒适度。虽然这个名称简洁地描述了该车型，但它并非标识符，因为很多车型都可以称为 16GL。

There is another aspect to names and identifiers that is important to remember: A name is a compact way of telling someone about an object. It can describe some of the properties of an object. Naming a car model 16GL tells someone about the engine size and the level of comfort. Although this name is a compact report on the model, it is not an identifier because many models could be called 16GL.

一个真正的标识符具有以下几个特性：它必须可靠地将用户引导至唯一一个对象，并且每次使用都必须指向同一个对象。图 5.3 展示了一个常见的标识符模型。与基本对象的情况不同，该标识符与对象的映射是单值的。

A true identifier has several properties: It must reliably lead the user to one and only one object and it must always lead to the same object whenever it is used. Figure 5.3 shows a common model of an identifier. Unlike the usual case with fundamental objects, the mapping back to the object is single-valued.

图 5.3 对象的标识符。

Figure 5.3 An identifier for an object.

这种模型意味着并非所有对象都有标识符，这在概念上是正确的， 即使在软件系统中并非如此。由于 ID 是字符串，并非所有字符串都能标识一个 对象，但要成为真正的标识符，它应该只标识一个对象。如果使用标识符类型 （通常情况下这是更可取的），那么它必须与某个对象进行强制映射 。

This model implies that not all objects have an identifier, which can be true conceptually even if it is not true in software systems. Since the id is a string, not all strings identify an object, but to be a true identifier, it should identify only one. If an identifier type were used, and that would usually be preferable, then that would have a mandatory mapping to an object.

5.2 识别方案

5.2 Identification Scheme

在简单的系统中，每个对象通常只有一个标识符；但更复杂的系统中，一个对象可能拥有多个标识符。医疗保健行业有多种患者识别方案：每家医院分配一个病例编号，各个科室也有各自的编号。银行业使用多种方案来识别银行：SWIFT、排序代码、CHAPS 等。这种更通用的方法可以用类似于图 5.4 的模型来支持。

In simple systems a single identifier for each object is typical, but more complex systems have many identifiers for one object. The health care industry has many schemes for identifying patients: Each hospital assigns a case number, and departments have individual numbers. Banking uses several schemes to identify banks: SWIFT, sort codes, CHAPS, and so on. This more general approach can be supported by a model along the lines of Figure 5.4.

图 5.4 识别方案。

Figure 5.4 Identification schemes.

例如，世界卫生组织的《国际疾病分类》使用代码 E10 表示 I 型糖尿病。这可以表示为一个标识符，其字符串为“E10”，标识方案为 ICD-10，对象为疾病“I 型糖尿病”。

Example The World Health Organization's International Classification of Diseases uses the code E10 for type I diabetes. This can be represented as an identifier with string 'E10,' identification scheme ICD-10, and object the disease diabetes mellitus type I.

例如，假设我的护照号码是 123456。这表示为一个标识符，其字符串为“123456”，识别方案为“英国护照”，对象为“我自己”。但根据具体情况，对象也可以是我的护照。

Example Suppose I have a passport number of 123456. This is represented as an identifier with string '123456,' identification scheme UK passport, and object myself. Depending on the situation, however, the object could be my passport.

识别方案代表了用于识别对象的上下文。同一个账户可能拥有不同的SWIFT号码和CHAPS号码。相同的字符序列在SWIFT和CHAPS中可能代表两家不同的银行，但如果这些字符串采用不同的识别方案，则不会出现问题。

Identification schemes represent the context used to identify an object. A single account will have separate SWIFT and CHAPS numbers. The same character sequence can indicate two different banks in SWIFT and CHAPS, but this is not a problem if these strings are in different schemes.

图 5.4 中的模型虽然是一个起点，但并不完整。其粗糙的形式并未阻止同一个字符串在同一方案中代表多个对象。这里一个有用的概念是唯一性约束 [1]，它用于表明特定的映射组合对于某个对象类型必须具有唯一的值。

The model in Figure 5.4, although a start, is not the whole story. Its crude form includes nothing to stop one string from being used to represent more than one object within the same scheme. A useful concept here is the uniqueness constraint [1], which is used to indicate that a particular combination of mappings must have unique values for an object type.

考虑对标识方案和字符串之间的映射施加唯一性约束。这样的约束意味着任何两个标识符都不能拥有相同的标识方案和相同的字符串。由于从标识符到对象的映射是单值的，标识方案和字符串的组合可以标识一个对象——这正是我们所需要的。其他可能性也值得考虑。例如，对对象和字符串施加唯一性约束如何？这种约束意味着特定的对象和特定的字符串唯一地引用一个标识方案；换句话说，一个对象不能在两个不同的标识方案中使用相同的字符串。这种类型的唯一性约束不仅无法强制执行，而且很不方便。人们通常喜欢对不同的方案使用相同的字符串，这样就不用记住太多标识符。银行卡密码和社保号码就是两个例子。

Consider a uniqueness constraint on the mappings identification scheme and string. Such a constraint would say that no two identifiers can have the same identification scheme and the same string. Since the mapping from identifier to object is single-valued, the combination of identification scheme and string identifies a single object—exactly what we need. The other possibilities are also worth considering. How about a uniqueness constraint on object and string? This constraint would say that a particular object and a particular string uniquely reference an identification scheme; in other words, an object cannot have the same string in two different identification schemes. This type of uniqueness constraint is not only unenforceable but also inconvenient. People often like to use the same string for different schemes so they don't have to remember too many identifiers. Bank card PINs and social security numbers are two examples.

对标识方案和对象施加唯一性约束意味着，在同一个方案中，一个对象只能由一个字符串标识。这将禁止在标识方案中使用别名。别名虽然有用，但并非必不可少；它们可能带来不便，尤其是在人们将标识符与对象混淆的情况下，但并非一定会造成灾难性后果。对所有三个映射施加约束可以防止标识符的无用重复，但不会从根本上改变现状。

A uniqueness constraint on identification scheme and object would mean that within one scheme only one string can identify an object. This would disallow aliases within an identification scheme. Aliases can be useful but are not essential; they can be inconvenient, especially if people confuse the identifier with the object, but are not necessarily disastrous. A constraint for all three mappings would stop useless duplication of identifiers but would not materially alter the picture.

唯一性约束的第二部分规定对象的标识符不可更改。这意味着，在同一个方案中，同一个字符串不能从一个对象转移到另一个对象。这可以通过确保标识符不可删除以及标识符到对象的映射关系不可变来实现——也就是说，映射关系在创建时就被赋予，并且不能更改。一旦标识符被赋予，它就永久有效。实际上，有些方案确实会循环利用标识符，但只有从未被使用过的标识符才能被循环利用。

The second part of a uniqueness constraint states that an objects's identifier cannot be changed. This implies that, within a scheme, the same string cannot be switched from one object to another. This can be enforced by ensuring that identifiers cannot be deleted and that the mappings from the identifier are immutable—that is, they are assigned at creation and cannot change. Once an identifier is assigned, it is assigned for good. In reality some schemes do recycle identifiers, but only identifiers that have never been used can be recycled.

在典型的面向对象语言中，唯一性约束是如何实现的？标识符的不可变性对此大有帮助。由于不可变性不允许在软件内部更新映射关系，因此不存在公共的修改器操作。映射关系必须在创建操作中通过传递参数来设置。在创建操作期间，需要检查是否存在其他标识符具有相同映射组合的唯一性约束。

How are uniqueness constraints implemented in a typical object-oriented language? The immutability of the identifiers is a considerable help. Immutability allows no update of the mapping within software, so there is no public modifier operation. The mappings must be set in the creation operation by passing the values as arguments. During the creation operation a check needs to be made that no other identifier exists with the same combination of mappings that make up the uniqueness constraint.

通常，标识方案会负责检查其标识符所用字符串的格式。这项检查会在创建标识符时进行。如果字符串中包含任何关于被引用对象的重要信息，那么这些信息也应该被检查。例如，我的标识符可能是 U123，其中 U 表示我居住在美国。如果我返回英国，这个标识符就会造成问题。一般来说，将对象特征信息嵌入到标识字符串中是一种不好的做法，因为这种做法意味着当对象特征发生变化时，字符串也应该随之改变。更好的做法是生成一个单独的字符串来提供这类简洁的信息。

Usually the identification scheme would be responsible for checking the format of the strings used by its identifiers. This check would be made when the identifiers are created. If the string embeds any meaningful information about the referenced object, then this information should also be checked. I might have an identifier U123, where the U indicates I live in United States. This identifier would cause a problem should I return to England. In general it is bad practice to embed information about features of an object into an identification string, because such practice implies that the string should change when the features change. It is better to generate a separate string that provides this kind of compact information.

5.3 对象合并

5.3 Object Merge

我们喜欢把事物想象成某种完整的存在：一旦被识别，它就永远被识别了。然而，现实生活远比这复杂。想象一下，一位病人来到医院接受治疗。几天后，他们发现这位病人同时也是医院另一个科室的门诊病人。但是，医院的电脑系统里却为这位病人创建了两条独立的记录。这种情况并不少见，而且可能需要数周甚至数月才能发现重复记录。

We like to think of objects as somehow complete: Once identified, an object is so identified forever. Alas, the vagaries of real life are not so simple. Imagine a patient arriving and being treated at a hospital. After several days they realize that this patient is also an out-patient at another department. However, they have created a separate record for the patient on the hospital computer system. This situation is not uncommon, and it may be weeks or months before the duplication is spotted.

这种重复不仅影响计算机系统，也影响医院工作人员的认知。意识到你目前正在治疗的左心室衰竭患者与一年前因甲状腺毒症（甲亢）入院的同一患者是同一人，这对整个临床流程至关重要，而不仅仅是对计算机系统而言。我们需要一种概念机制将这两个对象联系起来。

This duplication affects not only the computer system but also the perception of the people who work in the hospital. Realizing that a patient you are currently treating for left ventricular failure is the same patient who was in for thyrotoxicosis (overactive thyroid) a year ago is important for the whole clinical process, not just the computer system. We need a conceptual mechanism to tie the two objects together.

我将概述三种策略：复制和替换、取代和本质/外观。

I will outline three strategies for this: copy and replace, superseding, and essence/appearance.

5.3.1 复制和替换

我们通常首先想到的策略是将一个对象的所有属性复制到另一个对象，然后删除被复制的对象（复制并替换）。这样一来，旧对象的标识符就会被修改，使其映射到新对象，从而违反了对象不可变性规则。当允许使用别名标识符时，这种策略是有效的，但问题在于如何处理软件中对已删除对象的引用。除非能够捕获所有此类引用，否则就会出现悬空引用，而悬空引用往往会带来严重的后果。

Usually the first strategy we think of is to copy all the properties of one object over to the other and delete the copied object (copy and replace). The identifier to the old deleted object would be altered so that it mapped to the object that remained, thus breaking the immutability rule. This strategy works when alias identifiers are allowed, but a problem remains in dealing with any references within the software to the deleted object. Unless you can catch all such references, there is the risk of a dangling reference, which often has painful consequences.

例如，约翰·史密斯因某种治疗进入急诊室，并被分配了医院编号JS777。之后，医院发现他之前已在该医院登记，编号为JS123。此时，必须将JS777对象的信息添加到JS123对象的记录中，将所有对JS777对象的引用切换到JS123对象，并删除JS777对象。

Example John Smith enters the emergency room for some treatment and is given the hospital number JS777. Later the hospital discovers that he was previously registered in the hospital under the number JS123. The information from the JS777 object must be added to the record of the JS123 object, all references to the JS777 object switched to the JS123 object, and the JS777 object deleted.

5.3.2 取代

第二种策略是替换对象，如图 5.5 所示。一个对象被标记为已替换，并链接到另一个活动对象。未来所有工作都将在活动对象上进行，而已替换对象则出于历史原因保留。无需替换对已替换对象的引用。要么将已替换对象中的当前数据复制到活动对象，要么发送到活动对象的任何消息都必须检查接收方已替换的所有对象的数据。所有发送到已替换对象的消息

The second strategy is to supersede the object, as shown in Figure 5.5. One object is classified as superseded and linked to the other active object. In the future all work will be done to the active object, and the superseded object is held for historical reasons. There is no need to replace the references to the superseded object. Either the data currently in the superseded object is copied to the active object, or any messages to the active object must check data on all objects that the receiver supersedes. All messages to the superseded object are

图 5.5 对象被另一个对象取代。

Figure 5.5 Object superseded by another.

委托给活动对象。如果所有数据都被复制，则活动对象可以安全地忽略已被取代的对象。

delegated to the active object. If all data is copied, then the active object can safely ignore the presence of superseded objects.

例如，采用替代策略时，JS777 对象会被标记为已替代，而 JS123 则成为活动对象。发送到 JS777 的任何消息都会被委托给 JS123。

Example With the superseding strategy the JS777 object is marked as superseded and the JS123 as the active object. Any messages sent to JS777 are delegated to JS123.

例如，研究人员发现了两种肝炎：输血后肝炎和非甲非乙型肝炎。后来，人们认为这两种肝炎是同一种，统称为丙型肝炎。这可以通过将输血后肝炎和非甲非乙型肝炎都归类到丙型肝炎对象来表示。

Example Researchers discovered two varieties of hepatitis: post-transfusion hepatitis and non-A non-B hepatitis. In time these were considered the same and called hepatitis C. This can be represented by superseding both the post-transfusion and non-A non-B hepatitis, linking them to the active hepatitis C object.

从概念上讲，复制替换策略和替代策略非常相似。唯一的区别在于，替代策略可以查看被替代对象最初附加的内容。这一点至关重要：如果医院在未意识到两位患者是同一人的情况下对史密斯先生进行了治疗，那么只有替代策略才能准确反映实际情况。

Conceptually the copy and replace strategy and the superseding strategies are much the same. The only difference is that you can look to see what was originally attached to the superseded object. This can be important: If a hospital performed treatment on Mr. Smith without realizing the two patients were the same, only the superseding strategy would give an accurate reflection of what happened.

5.3.3 本质/外观

最后要考虑的策略是本质/表象模型，如图 5.6 所示。对象本身基本保持不变，但在其背后存在另一个对象——对象本质。对象本质的存在仅仅是为了连接不同的对象；它本身不具备其他属性。在这种策略中，合并是通过将对象连接到同一个对象本质来实现的。这意味着消息传递机制需要进行一些修改，因为对象必须了解自身的其他表象，并在做出响应时加以考虑。

The final strategy to consider is the essence/appearance model, shown in Figure 5.6. The object remains much the same, but sitting behind it is another object—the object essence.
