The reason is that debit and credit are not used consistently in the sense of deposit and withdrawal. For income statement accounts, credits increase an account and debits decrease it, which makes sense for the layperson. For balance sheet accounts, however, debits increase assets (that is, they are deposits), and credits decrease assets. This may seem strange to nonaccountants, but it is the usual accounting convention. I have thus avoided debit and credit, partly because they might confuse any nonaccountant readers, and partly because we are working with a more abstract model than regular financial accounting.

6.13 对应账户

6.13 Corresponding Account

尽管收入和支出账户是外部账户——钱不是我的——但它们实际上是我的账户，因为我选择了账户的分类。银行对账户的看法就说明了这一点。我有一个支票账户，它是我个人账户系统中的一项资产。银行在其账户系统中也有一个看起来非常相似的账户。银行是该账户的分类者，但我拥有账户内的资产。我们可以将这个账户视为与我个人账户系统中的账户相同，但这并不合理。例如，我可能在3月1日记入一笔ATM取款的账目，因为那天是我取款的日期。银行则在3月2日记入同一笔取款，因为那是银行的下一个工作日。这两个账户都指向同一资产，但它们并不相同，因为它们的账目记录不同。更好的做法是将这两个账户视为对应账户。

Although income and expense accounts are external—the money is not mine—they are my accounts in that I choose the classification. The bank's view of accounts illustrates this. I have a checking account that is an asset within my personal system of accounts. The bank has an account within its system of accounts that looks remarkably similar. The bank is the classifier of the bank's account, but I own the assets within it. We could consider this the same account as the one in my system of accounts, but this would not work. I might post an entry for an ATM withdrawal on March 1, which is the day I made the withdrawal. The bank posts the same withdrawal on March 2 because that is the next working day at the bank. The two accounts both refer to the same asset, but they are not the same because their entries differ. It is better practice to consider the two accounts as corresponding.

相应的账户理应在某种程度上保持一致，并且通常会在某个时间点进行对账。例如，当我将支票簿（我的账户）与银行对账单（银行的账户）进行核对时，就会发生这种情况。对账过程可能非常精确，也可能允许存在一些误差，例如日期上的细微差别。

Corresponding accounts are expected to match in some way and are usually reconciled at some point. This is what happens when I match my checkbook (my account) against the bank statement (the bank's account). The reconciliation process may be precise, or it may allow some imprecision, such as slight differences in dates.

图 6.29 展示了这种情况。只有余额账户才有所有者；损益表账户没有资产，因此不存在所有权问题。所有账户都有一个分类器来指示账户的创建者和操作者；我使用了“参与方”（参见 2.1 节）。对应关系展现出几个特殊属性：对称性和传递性 [3]。首先，它是对称的：如果账户 x 是账户 y 的对应账户，那么账户 y 也必须是账户 x 的对应账户。通常情况下，关联的默认属性是不对称的。传递性表明，如果账户 y 是账户 x 的对应账户，且账户 z 也是账户 y 的对应账户，那么账户 z 也是账户 x 的对应账户。

Figure 6.29 illustrates this situation. Only balance accounts have owners; income statement accounts do not have assets so there is no question of ownership. All accounts have a classifier to indicate who creates and manipulates the accounts; I have used party (see Section 2.1). The correspondents relationship shows a couple of special properties: symmetry and transitivity [3]. First it is symmetric: If account x is a correspondent of account y then account y must be a correspondent of account x. The usual default for associations is that they are asymmetric. Transitivity indicates that if account y is a correspondent of account x and account z is a correspondent of account y, then account z is a correspondent of account x.

图 6.29 对应账户。

Figure 6.29 Corresponding accounts.

6.14 专业账户模式

6.14 Specialized Account Model

我提供了几个例子来说明该模型可以作为财务会计和库存跟踪的基础。会计模型通常会进行子类型划分，以便提供特定领域的信息。例如，考虑库存管理——这是一个适合使用账户的问题。我们可以为每种商品种类和存放地点的组合创建一个账户（并赋予它一个不太专业的会计名称，例如“持有”）。

I have provided several examples to show that this model can be used as a basis for both financial accounting and inventory tracking. With the accounting models it is usual to subtype to provide the information for the particular domain. For example, consider inventory management—a problem suited to the use of accounts. We can form an account for each combination of kind of goods and location (and give it a less accounting name, such as holding).

因此，如果我们追踪麦卡伦、泰斯卡和拉弗格威士忌在伦敦、巴黎和阿姆斯特丹之间的流转，我们将拥有九个资产账户（例如伦敦-麦卡伦、伦敦-泰斯卡、巴黎-泰斯卡等等）。每当我们将货物从一个地点转移到另一个地点时，我们都会创建一个转移（交易）来记录这一转移。与货币一样，转移必须保持平衡。此外，在整个转移过程中，货物的种类必须保持一致。图 6.30 展示了这种账户模型的扩展。

Thus if we are tracking bottles of Macallans, Talisker, and Laphroig whiskey between London, Paris, and Amsterdam we would have nine holdings (asset accounts, such as London-Macallans, London-Talisker, Paris-Talisker, and so on). Whenever we move goods from one location to another, we create a transfer (transaction) to handle the movement. As with money, transfers have to balance. In addition, the kind of object must be the same throughout the movement. Figure 6.30 shows this kind of extension to the account model.

图 6.30 专门化账户模型以支持库存。

Figure 6.30 Specializing the account model to support inventories.

这种专业化是为了将会计模型应用于特定 领域。

This kind of specialization should be done to use the accounting model in a particular domain.

这种方法也适用于追踪订单，包括收发货。每个供应商都会有一个收入账户，如果供应商所在地很重要，则可能需要多个账户。同样，每个客户都会有一个支出账户。我们可以通过两种方式追踪订单：我们可以允许转账的子类型，例如已订购或已实际；或者我们可以为订单提供另一组库存，例如，我们可以有“伦敦-泰斯卡-已订购”和“伦敦-泰斯卡-已实际”。当订单生成时，我们会将资金从供应商的已订购库存转移到我们要求交付地点的已订购库存。当订单交付时，我们会将资金从已订购库存转移到我们所在地的已订购库存。这与在财务账簿中使用应收账款账户完全相同。

This approach could also work to track orders, both incoming and outgoing. Each supplier would have an income account, perhaps more than one if supplier location was important. Similarly each customer would get an expense account. We can track orders in two ways: We could allow subtypes of transfer, either ordered or actual, or we could provide another set of holdings for orders, so we would have, for example, London-Talisker-Ordered and London-Talisker-Actual. When an order is placed, we would make a transfer from a supplier ordered holding to the ordered holding at the location we want it delivered. When the order is delivered, we would make the transfer between the ordered holding and the actual holding at our location. This is exactly the same as using a receivables account in financial books.

我们可以使用持仓汇总来了解整体情况。所有已订购持仓的汇总持仓可以得出已订购持仓的总数量，而泰斯卡（Talisker）的汇总持仓则可以得出所有地点泰斯卡的总数量。

We can use summary holdings to get an overall picture. A summary holding of all ordered holdings can give the total ordered position, and a summary holding of Talisker gives the total amount of Talisker in all locations.

6.15 记账分录到多个账户

6.15 Booking Entries to Multiple Accounts

处理账户时，一个常见的问题是需要将同一笔款项记入多个账户。例如，假设我花了 500 美元购买机票参加 OOPSLA 会议。我应该将这笔费用记入 OOPSLA 账户（以便计算参加 OOPSLA 的总成本），还是记入机票账户（以便计算机票支出）？处理这种情况有几种方法，这些方法不仅能说明使用账户的一些要点，还能展示比前面提到的简单账户层级结构更复杂的账户结构。

A common problem in dealing with accounts is when there is more than one place to book an entry. For example, suppose I paid $500 for my airline ticket to attend the OOPSLA conference. Do I book this to an OOPSLA account (so that I can work out how much it cost me to attend OOPSLA) or to an air travel account (so that I can work out how much I spent on air travel)? There are several ways to handle this, which illustrate some useful points about using accounts and also illustrate more complex account structures than the simple account hierarchies mentioned earlier.

一份典型的咨询账单就能说明这个问题。假设我为ACM公司提供了三天的咨询服务，收费6000美元。此外，我还产生了一些费用：机票500美元，酒店250美元，租车150美元，餐费100美元。我该如何核算这些费用？更准确地说，如果我有一个完善的会计系统，我该如何核算这些费用？显然，我需要为ACM公司设立一个账户，以便向他们开具账单。然而，一个账户是不够的。我更关心的是我从各个客户那里赚了多少钱。在进行这项分析时，我不想看到这些费用，因为它们并非收入。同样，我的纳税义务估算也需要忽略这些费用。这意味着我可以分别设立ACM公司费用和ACM公司支出账户。我的ACM账单就是由这两个账户的汇总账户构成，如图6.31所示。但问题在于，我需要一个单独的账户来记录所有已赚取的费用。此费用账户将包含ACM费用、Megabank费用和其他客户费用。它也可以用作汇总账户，但这违反了图6.5和图6.6所示的层级结构限制。因此，我需要修改模型，允许一个明细账户拥有多个汇总账户作为其父账户，如图6.32所示。

A typical consultant's bill illustrates the problem. Let's say that I do three days' consultancy for ACM. I charge them $6000 for the work. In addition, I run up some expenses: $500 for the air fare, $250 for the hotel, $150 for car rental, and $100 for meals. How do I account for this, or more precisely, how do I account for this if I have a decent accounting system? Clearly I need an account for ACM so that I can send them a bill. However, one account is not enough. I am interested in seeing how much I earn from various clients. When I do this analysis, I do not want to see the expenses because they are not earned money. Similarly my tax liability estimates also need to ignore expenses. This indicates that I could use separate accounts for ACM fees and ACM expenses. My ACM bill is then formed by a summary account over these two accounts, as shown in Figure 6.31. The problem with this is that I need a separate account for all earned fees. This fee account would include accounts for ACM fees, Megabank fees, and other clients' fees. This also works as a summary account, but it breaks the hierarchical restriction of Figures 6.5 and 6.6. Thus I need to alter the model to allow a detail account to have multiple summary accounts as parents, as shown in Figure 6.32.

图 6.32 中的模型允许账户构成有向无环图。因此，一个账户可以有多个父账户，但我们避免了循环（一个账户不能是它自己的祖账户）。这种结构允许存在多个汇总账户。

The model in Figure 6.32 allows the accounts to form a directed acyclic graph. Thus an account can have many parents, but we avoid cycles (an account cannot be its own grandparent). This structure allows multiple summary accounts.

图 6.31 典型的费用/支出账户结构。

Figure 6.31 A typical fee/expense account structure.

带粗边框的图标是详细信息，其概要如箭头所示。

The heavy bordered icons are detail accounts, summarized as shown by the arrows.

图 6.32 允许多个汇总账户。

Figure 6.32 Allowing multiple summary accounts.

该图用有向无环图代替了图 6.5 的层次结构。

This diagram replaces the hierarchy of Figure 6.5 with a directed acyclic graph.

然而，这里有一个小问题需要考虑。如果我的账户结构如图 6.33 所示，会发生什么情况？账户 X 包含了 ACM 和费用，因此 ACM 费用账户会被计算两次。

However, there is a small wrinkle that we must consider. What would occur if I had the account structure of Figure 6.33? The account X sums over ACM and fees, so the ACM fees account gets counted twice.

根据图 6.32 中的模型，我们仍然可以得到 X 的正确余额。余额是基于一组派生的条目定义的。集合本身并不……

According to the model in Figure 6.32, we would still get a correct balance for X. The balance is defined on a derived set of entries. Sets do not

图 6.33 账户结构凸显了一个问题。

Figure 6.33 Account structure that highlights a problem.

如果使用多个汇总账户，则有人可能会定义一个汇总账户，该汇总账户与 明细账户重叠。

If multiple summary accounts are used, someone could define a summary account that has overlapping detail accounts.

允许重复项，因此 ACM 费用中的所有条目在 X 中只会出现一次，从而确保 X 的余额正确。然而，此余额并不等于费用和 ACM 余额之和，这可能会造成混淆。如果这种混淆确实存在，我们需要对组件关系施加约束，禁止选择任何存在重叠的组件。这是一个合理的约束，因为很难找到 X 这种账户的实用示例。定义此类账户更有可能是偶然的产物，而非刻意设计。

allow duplicates, so all the entries in ACM fees will only appear once in X, thus giving us a correct balance for X. However this balance will not be equal to the sums of the balances for fees and ACM, which might prove confusing. If this confusion is a problem, we need a constraint on the components relationship that would not allow us to select components that had any overlap. This is a reasonable constraint since it is difficult to come up with an example where such an account as X would be useful. Defining this kind of account is more likely to be the product of accident than design.

6.15.1 使用备忘录条目

该模型目前运行良好，但需考虑一些细节。可能需要更详细地细分支出。税法可能要求我们将差旅、住宿和餐饮支出分开列示（例如，ACM-机票、ACM-住宿、Megabank-机票等等）。虽然可以通过将每个支出账户细分为多个子账户来实现，但由于账户组合复杂，管理起来可能会比较困难。因此，值得探索其他方案。

The model works well at this level, but consider some further details. There may be a need to break down expenses in more detail. Tax regulations may require us to separate expenses for travel, lodging, and meals (for example, ACM-airfare, ACM-lodging, Megabank-airfare, and so on). This could be done by breaking each expense account into detail accounts, but this could become difficult to manage due to all the complex combination accounts. It is worth exploring some other options.

一种方法是使用备注账户记账。例如，一张价值 500 美元的 ACM 总部访问机票，需要同时记入 ACM 费用账户和机票账户。这种方法无需单独设立 ACM 机票账户，但需要额外的记账分录。虽然过账规则可以在一定程度上解决这个问题，但我们仍然需要明确指定需要记入哪个费用账户。这可以通过创建特殊的费用交易来实现，该交易需要指定“来源账户”、“目标账户”和“费用类型（备注账户）”等参数。

One option is to use entries into memo accounts. Thus $500 for a ticket to visit ACM headquarters would result in depositing into both the ACM expenses account and an airfare account. This method removes the need for an ACM-airfare account but requires additional entries. A posting rule might deal with this to some extent, but we still need some statement about which expense account is needed. This might be done by a special expense transaction creation that takes parameters of from account, to account, and expense type memo account.

选择将 ACM 费用账户还是机票账户设为备注账户，取决于账户的后续用途。如果 ACM 费用账户用于追踪发票付款情况，而机票账户仅用于税务申报，那么机票账户更适合作为备注账户。与使用备注账户相比，选择哪些账户存放主要资金流存在一定的随意性。

Choosing whether the ACM expense account or the airfare account should be a memo account depends on subsequent use of the account. If the ACM expense account is being used to track the payment of invoices, while the airfare account is only being used for tax reporting, then the airfare account would make the better memo account. There's a certain amount of arbitrariness in choosing which accounts hold the main stream of money, compared to those working with memo accounts.

6.15.2 衍生账户

另一种方法是使用派生账户，如图 6.34 所示。在这种情况下，条目是通过为派生账户提供一个筛选器（参见 6.9 节）来指定的，该筛选器会选择匹配的条目。为了正常工作，派生账户需要一个可以作为其派生基础的对象。支持费用类别的条目子类型就是一个很好的选择，然后创建一个成员资格测试为“费用类别 = 机票”的账户，即可生成所需的信息。

A different approach is to use a derived account, as in Figure 6.34. In this case the entries are specified by providing the derived account with a filter (see Section 6.9), which selects matching entries. To work, the derived account needs something on which to base its derivation. A subtype of entry that supports an expense category would do nicely, and then an account where the membership test is expense category = airfare would create the desired information.

图 6.34 引出账户。

Figure 6.34 Introducing derived accounts.

我们可以考虑进一步拓展这种方法。为什么不完全放弃使用账户，而采用类似图 6.35 的方式呢？这样，我们只需查询费用就能了解情况了。

We might consider taking this approach further. Why not abandon using accounts altogether and just have something like Figure 6.35? We can then work out what is going on just by queries on expense.

图 6.35 费用定义放弃会计模型。

Figure 6.35 Expenses defined to abandon the accounting model.

派生账户仍然可以让我们使用所有报告行为，但我们会失去 跟踪行为。

A derived account can still allow us to use all the reporting behavior, but we lose the tracking behavior.

这个问题有助于解释账户的用途以及衍生账户的价值。账户在相对静态的结构中最为有效，尤其是在需要追踪复杂的资产流动时。如果流动很简单，例如只是将费用分配给机票，那么账户就不是必需的。但是，假设我在同一趟旅行中同时访问了Megabank和ACM，并将三分之二的机票费用记入其中一家，三分之一记入另一家。这种多方交易正是账户能够很好地处理的。然而，图6.35中的模型在处理这种情况时存在一个实际问题。我该如何以这种方式拆分一笔简单的付款呢？请注意，图6.35中的模型还存在另一个问题：它没有说明资金来源。我可以添加信用卡关联，但这样一来，费用看起来就非常类似于两方交易了。

This question helps define why accounts are useful and why derived accounts are valuable. Accounts work best within relatively static structures where complex movements of assets need to be tracked. If the movements are simple, such as just assigning an expense to airfare, then accounts are not really needed. However, consider the situation where I visit both Megabank and ACM in one trip and charge two-thirds of the airfare to one and one-third to the other. This is the kind of multilegged transaction that accounts handle well. However, the model in Figure 6.35 has a real problem with this. How do I split a simple payment up in this way? Note that the model in Figure 6.35 has another problem: It does not say where the money comes from. I could add a credit card association to it, but then expense looks very similar to a two-legged transaction.

当账户结构并非十分固定时，使用属性创建派生账户非常有效。如果存在多种信息切入点，派生账户可以利用账户本身的报表功能轻松计算这些信息。然而，派生账户仅限于报表功能，无法进行过账，因此不能用于跟踪资产的变动。

Using attributes for derived accounts is effective when the account structure is not very static. If there are many possible cuts of information, then the derived account allows these to be computed easily using the same reporting facilities that accounts have. However, they only have the reporting facilities. Derived accounts cannot be posted to and thus cannot be used to track the ebb and flow of assets.

因此，每当我们试图表示某个条目的某个方面时，我们可以在条目的属性和新的账户层级之间进行选择。具体选择取决于您需要账户行为的哪一部分。如果仅仅是报表方面，我们可以使用属性，并在需要时派生出一个账户。否则，就需要一个新的账户层级。

So whenever we are trying to represent an aspect of an entry, we have a choice between an attribute of the entry or a new account level. The decision is based on what part of the account behavior you need. If it is simply the reporting side, we can use an attribute and derive an account when it's needed. Otherwise, a new level of accounts is required.

延伸阅读

Further Reading

我可以推荐一些其他的会计资料，它们能提供与本章不同的视角。Hay [2] 专门有一章讲解会计。他对账户和交易的基本概念与我的非常相似，尽管他没有介绍过账规则。他对公司中存在的账户类型进行了更深入的探讨。他还讨论了公司中常用的交易类型以及它们如何融入会计模型。此外，他还给出了这些账户和交易类型的知识水平要求。

I can recommend a couple of other sources for information on accounts that will give a different perspective to that presented in this chapter. Hay [2] has a chapter dedicated to accounting. His basic concepts of accounts and transactions is very much the same as mine, although he does not present anything on posting rules. He goes into much more depth on the account types that are present in corporations. He also discusses the common transactions that are used in corporations and how they fit into this accounting model. He also presents a knowledge level for these account and transaction types.

伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校在开发会计框架方面做了大量工作[4]。¹ 这与我和Hay的方法截然不同。它首先将发票上的信息（例如）视为针对高层账户的高层“交易”。然后，可以将此“交易”分解为针对低层账户的低层“交易”。他们对“交易”一词的使用与我截然不同：他们不遵循守恒原则。高层“交易”可能是一张包含所有明细项目的发票。该框架的重点在于将其分解为低层“交易”，例如明细项目本身。因此，该框架旨在将一组条目分解为其组成条目，而不是像我那样，构建一个账户网络及其之间的转账关系。

There has been a lot of work at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Cham-paign on developing an accounting framework [4].1 This takes a very different approach to Hay and myself. It starts with treating the information on an invoice (for example) as a high-level "transaction" against a high-level account. This "transaction" can then be broken down to lower-level "transactions" against lower-level accounts. They use the word transaction very differently than I do: They do not follow the principle of conservation. A high-level "transaction" might be an invoice with all its line items. The framework concentrates on breaking this down into lower-level "transactions," such as the line items themselves. Thus the framework is designed to break down a cluster of entries into its component entries, rather than my approach of a network of accounts and transfers between them.

第七章 会计模型的应用

Chapter 7. Using the Accounting Models

要充分理解本章内容，您需要先阅读第六章。本章与本书其他章节有所不同。它并非描述一系列模式，而是展示如何运用第六章中介绍的模式。这并非易事，因为第六章中的会计模式相当抽象。为了真正理解这些模式的运作方式，我们需要参考一个完整的示例。

To fully understand this chapter, you will need to read Chapter 6 first. This is an unusual chapter in this book. Instead of describing a group of patterns, this chapter shows how we can use the patterns presented in Chapter 6. This is a difficult task because the accounting patterns in Chapter 6 are quite abstract. To understand how the patterns really work, we need to look at a fully worked example.

本章探讨了电信公司 Total Telecommunications (TT) 模型中使用的账户和记账规则。秉承教科书的优良传统，本章提供的示例较为简化，但足以让您大致了解模型的工作原理。本章旨在说明账户模型的用法，而非构建一个完整的电信公司模型。

This chapter looks at accounts and posting rules used in a model for a telephone utility, Total Telecommunications (TT). In the best textbook tradition, the examples presented here are somewhat simplistic. They should be sufficient to at least give you a feel for how the models work. The aim is to illustrate the use of the account model, not to model a telephone company.

由于本章为示例章节，我使用了一些代码来说明示例。我选择 Digitalk Smalltalk 而不是 C++，是因为 Smalltalk 更容易让我传达基本概念。这些概念应该很容易移植到 C++。我在转换模型时使用了第 14 章中的模式。我还参考了 Kent Beck 的编码模式 [1]，并做了一些修改。我必须强调，我没有尝试优化代码。此外，我没有提供完整的代码，只做了重点标注。

Since this is an example chapter, I have used some code to illustrate the examples. I chose Digitalk Smalltalk over C++ because Smalltalk makes it easier for me to convey the basic ideas. The concepts should be readily trans-ferable to C++. I have used the patterns from Chapter 14 in transforming the models. I have also used Kent Beck's coding patterns [1], with some variations. I must stress that I have made no attempt to optimize the code. I also have not provided complete code, only highlights.

TT的基本计费方案非常简单。所有通话均分为日间通话和夜间通话。日间通话时间为上午7:00至晚上7:00。计费依据通话开始时间。日间通话费用为98美元（首分钟2美元），之后每分钟30美元。夜间通话费用为70美元（首分钟2美元），接下来的20分钟每分钟20美元，之后每分钟12美元。政府对每月通话费用的前50美元征收6%的税，之后每50美元征收4%的税。

TT's basic billing plan is very simple. All calls are divided into day and evening calls. Daytime runs from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. The classification is based on the time the call begins.1 Day calls cost 98(2 for the first minute and 30$ for subsequent minutes. Evening calls cost 70<2 for the first minute, 20<s for the next 20 minutes, and 12# thereafter. The government charges a 6 percent tax on the first $50 of calls in a calendar month and 4 percent on calls thereafter.

为了简单起见，我省略了跨越边界的呼叫情况。

For the sake of simplicity, I have skipped the case of calls crossing the boundary.

本章首先讨论结构模型（7.1），该模型自然基于第6章中介绍的模式。接下来，我们将探讨实现该结构的一些有趣特性（7.2）。为了设置对象，我们首先设置新的电话服务（7.3），然后设置呼叫（7.4）。之后，我们初步了解记账规则，并检查实现基于账户的触发机制的代码（7.5）。本章给出了三个记账规则示例：将呼叫分为白天和晚上（7.6）、按时间计费（7.7）以及计算税费（7.8）。每个规则都展示了行为的特定方面。前两个规则逐条操作，并且使用一个公共超类型——每个条目记账规则——来处理通用行为。将费用分为白天和晚上则由每个条目记账规则的简单单例子类型来处理。白天和晚上的呼叫需要不同的规模，但由于基本流程相同，我们可以使用由费率表参数化的策略对象。这使我们能够处理任何根据通话时长按一定比例收费的记账规则。用作策略对象的费率表类可以用于任何基于通话时长的计算。实际上，它被用于下一个计算税费的记账规则。与之前的规则不同，此规则必须按月运行，但我们不能假设它每月运行一次。

The chapter begins with a discussion of the structural models (7.1), which is naturally based on the patterns presented in Chapter 6. We then look at some interesting features of implementing the structure (7.2). To set up the objects, we begin by setting up new phone services (7.3), followed by setting up calls (7.4). We then take a first look at the posting rules, examining the code for implementing account-based firing (7.5). Three example posting rules are given: separating calls into day and evening (7.6), charging for time (7.7), and calculating the tax (7.8). Each rule illustrates a particular aspect of behavior. The first two rules operate on an entry-by-entry basis, and a common supertype—each entry posting rule—handles the common behavior. Splitting charges into day and evening is handled by a simple singleton subtype of each entry posting rule. A different scale is required for day and evening calls, but since the basic process is the same, we can use a strategy object parameterized by a rate table. This allows us to handle any posting rule that charged according to some scale based on the length of the call. The rate table class used as the strategy object can be used for any calculation based on lengths in this way. Indeed it is used for the next posting rule that calculates tax. Unlike the prior rules, this rule has to work on a month-by-month basis, but we cannot assume it is run once per month.

这三个过账规则类应该能很好地说明我们如何使用账户/库存模式来显示货币交易和非货币交易。

The three posting rule classes should give a good idea of how we can use the account/inventory patterns to show both monetary and nonmonetary transactions.

在代码开发过程中，我喜欢先构建结构模型的框架。然后我会制作原型，并注意在开发过程中不断更新结构模型（否则我可能会忘记自己做到哪一步了）。遇到棘手的行为时，我可能会在编程初期或过程中使用事件图或交互图。如果我认为记录我对这些行为的处理方式很重要（就像我在这本书中所做的那样），我会在代码整理完毕后绘制图表。这些图表并非代码的替代品；它们有助于阐明代码的功能。（当然，如果使用合适的工具，事件图也可以直接作为代码使用。）

In developing code I like to begin with building the skeleton of the structural model. I then prototype, being careful to update the structural model as I go (otherwise, I can forget where I am). As tricky behaviors come up, I may use event diagrams or interaction diagrams at the start or during the programming. If I think it is important to document what I have done with these behaviors (as I do for this book), I produce diagrams once I have the code sorted out. The diagrams are not replacements for the code; they help to illustrate what the code is doing. (With a suitable tool, however, event diagrams could be used as the code.)

7.1 结构模型

7.1 Structural Models

最好的切入点是结构模型，因为它们能概览最终模型的各个组成部分。图 7.1 展示了模型中的各个模块。我将模型分为两个模块：电话服务和账户。会计框架的一个优点是它可以应用于不同的行业，因此我们需要确保会计模型与任何行业特定概念完全分离（即，不受任何行业特定概念的影响）。

The best place to start is with the structural models because they give an overview of the various pieces of the final model. Figure 7.1 shows the packages within the model. I've split the model into two packages: phone service and account. One virtue of an accounting framework is that it can be used for different industries, so we need to ensure that the accounting model is kept separate from (that is, has no visibility to) any industry-specific concepts.

图 7.2 TT 的账户模型。

Figure 7.2 Accounts model for TT.

图 7.1 TT 示例的软件包。

Figure 7.1 The packages for the TT example.

账户包包含抽象的会计类型， 电话服务包针对此特定域扩展了这些类型。

The account package holds the abstract accounting types, which are extended by the phone service package for this specific domain.

图 7.2 展示了基于第 6 章模式的 TT 会计模型。该模型包含从过账规则到账户的三重关联。触发器和输出是常见的，但键值输出是新增的。这使得需要多个输出账户的过账规则可以拥有多个输出账户。本章后续的示例将阐明其必要性。

Figure 7.2 shows the accounting model for TT, based on the patterns from Chapter 6. This model has three associations from posting rule to account. Trigger and output are familiar, but the keyed output is new. This allows multiple output accounts for those posting rules that need them. The need will become clear with examples later in the chapter.

图 7.3 展示了电话服务的模型。客户可以拥有多条电话线路。电话服务实际上就是分配给客户的一条电话线路。每项电话服务都与一个会计准则相关联，该准则描述了其计费方式。此图说明了为什么在图 7.2 所示的明细账户中添加了主体映射。我们需要一种方法来确定明细账户所对应的服务，但我们不希望从账户包访问电话服务包，因为这会影响重用。因此，我们创建了明细账户的子类型。通过子类型化，可见性仅限于从子类型到超类型。服务账户完全可以知道电话服务，因为它们都属于电话服务包。但是，我们可能引用了一个明细账户，却不知道它是一个服务账户。明细账户上的抽象映射告诉我们，明细账户可以链接到一个对象（类型未指定）作为主体。所有这些都将通过明细账户的子类型来实现——这是多态性的一个经典案例。

Figure 7.3 shows the model of the phone service. Customers are allowed multiple phone lines. A phone service is really a phone line assigned to a customer. Each phone service is tied to an accounting practice that describes how it will be billed. This diagram illustrates why the subject mapping was added to detail account shown in Figure 7.2. We need a way to find out what detail account is accounting for, but we do not want visibility from the account package into the phone service package because it would compromise reuse. Thus we form a subtype of detail account. With subtyping, visibility only runs from the subtype to the supertype. It is perfectly permissible for the service account to know the phone service because they are both in the phone service package. However, we could have reference to a detail account and not know it is a service account. The abstract mapping on detail account tells us that a detail account could be linked to an object (type unspecified) as a subject. This will all be implemented by subtypes of detail account—a classic case of polymorphism.

图 7.3 电话服务的结构模型。

Figure 7.3 The structural model of phone service.

7.2 结构的实施

7.2 Implementing the Structure

我们可以使用基于第 14 章所述模式的设计模板来实现这些模型。所有关联都通过访问和修改操作来表示。单值映射遵循 Smalltalk 的惯例。因此，过账规则上的名为 trigger 的映射由访问​​器 trigger 和修改器 trigger: anAccount 实现。多值映射（例如，会计实务的过账规则）具有访问器 postingRules 和修改器 addPostingRule: aPostingRule 和 removePostingRule: aPostingRule。

We can use design templates based on the patterns described in Chapter 14 to implement the models. All associations are represented by access and modify operations. Single-valued mappings follow the usual Smalltalk convention. Thus the mapping named trigger on the posting rule is implemented by the accessor trigger and modifier trigger: anAccount. Multivalued mappings—for example, posting rules on accounting practice— have accessor postingRules and modifiers addPostingRule: aPostingRule and removePostingRule: aPostingRule.

对帐户的条目操作是多态的——详细帐户返回一个实例变量，而汇总帐户对其子帐户求和（如清单 7.1 所示）。

The entries operation on account is polymorphic—detail account returns an instance variable while summary account sums over its children, (as shown in Listing 7.1).

此模型没有账户类型。过账规则由汇总账户定义。本章示例中，我们可以使用账户类型或汇总账户来定义过账规则。使用汇总账户稍微复杂一些，因此更适合作为示例。已定义的高级汇总账户保存在账户类的一个类变量中，并可通过类方法 `findWithName: aString` 访问，其风格与 14.5.1 节相同。

This model has no account types. The posting rules are defined by summary accounts. For the examples in this chapter, we could use either account types or summary accounts to define posting rules. Using summary accounts is slightly more complicated, making it a better illustration. The high-level summary accounts that are defined are held in a class variable in the account class and are accessible with the class method findWithName: aString, following the style of Section 14.5.1.

代码的各个部分需要查找特定电话服务在特定汇总帐户下的服务帐户。不难想到几种方法：让电话服务查找给定汇总帐户下的帐户，或者让汇总帐户查找与其关联的电话服务的子帐户。这两种方法都合理，但很难选择哪种最佳。此外，每种方法都意味着特定的路径，其中一种可能比另一种更好。在这种情况下，我们可以使用完全不同的技术，按照 14.5.1 节所述构建一个类方法。然后，我们可以使用任一路径来实现该方法，并在不更改声明式接口的情况下修改该方法。如清单 7.2 所示，这也有助于记住这些查找方法的位置。

Various bits of code need to find a service account for a particular phone service under a particular summary account. It's not difficult to think up various ways of doing it: asking a phone service to find the account under a given summary account or asking a summary account to find its descendent attached to a phone service. Both of those ways are reasonable, but it is difficult to choose which one is the best. Furthermore, each implies a certain navigation path, and one may be better than the other. In such cases we can use an entirely different technique, building a class method following Section 14.5.1. Then we can implement the method with either path and change the method without changing the declarative interface. It also makes it easier to remember where these find methods are, as shown in Listing 7.2.

在实际应用中，使用类似 accountNamed: aString 的电话服务方法通常更方便。该方法会调用 findWithPhoneService: topParent，从而兼具两种方法的优点。

In practice a method on phone service, such as accountNamed: aString, is often more convenient to use. That method calls findWithPhoneService: topParent and provides the advantages of both approaches.

这里的所有示例都使用两腿交易，尽管该模型支持多腿交易。我们可以使用清单 7.3 中所示的特殊交易创建方法来创建两腿交易。一种方法包含所有信息，包括源条目和创建过账规则。另一种方法用于在开始时读取初始属性。

All the examples here use two-legged transactions, although the model supports multilegged transactions. We can create a two-legged transaction with the special creation methods for transaction shown in Listing 7.3. One method carries all the information, including the source entries and the creation posting rule. The other method is used for the initial attributes read in at the beginning.

清单展示了多种编码技巧。构造函数参数方法 [l]（以 set 为前缀）使用参数初始化新对象。在创建参数方法中，使用 `requi re:` 消息进行前提条件检查。为了提高性能，可以通过重新定义 `requi re:` 方法来移除此检查。另一个体现契约式设计 [3] 的元素是使用不变式检查。

The listing shows a number of coding techniques. A constructor parameter method [l] (prefixed with set) initializes the new object with parameters. Within the creation parameter method, precondition checking is done with the requi re: message. To improve performance, the checking can be removed by redefining the requi re: method. Another element from design by contract [3] is the use of an invariant check.

7.3 设置新的电话服务

7.3 Setting Up New Phone Services

创建新的电话服务并非仅仅是实例化一个电话服务对象。还需要创建服务帐户才能启动会计系统。虽然本示例仅包含一个会计准则，但它应该足够灵活，可以根据所使用的会计准则设置帐户，如图 7.4 和 7.5 以及清单 7.4 所示。

Creating a new phone service is not simply a question of instantiating a phone service object. Service accounts must also be created to get the accounting system going. Although this example does not contain more than one accounting practice, it should be flexible enough to set up the accounts for whichever accounting practice is being used, as shown in Figures 7.4 and 7.5, and Listing 7.4.

图 7.4 创建新电话服务的事件图。

Figure 7.4 Event diagram for creating a new phone service.

此图使用跨产品控制条件（常规事件图的扩展）。该控制条件针对其 传入触发器的每种组合进行评估，在本例中，即针对新建电话服务和记账科目的每种组合。它会为 会计实务中的每个电话服务和汇总记账科目调用创建服务科目操作。

This diagram uses a cross-product control condition (an extension to the regular event diagrams). The control condition is evaluated for each combination of its incoming triggers, in this case for each combination of new phone service and posting account. It invokes the create service account operation for each phone service and summary posting account in the accounting practice.

图7.5创建新电话服务的交互图。

Figure 7.5 Interaction diagram for creating a new phone service.

为了确定需要哪些账户，需要向会计事务所索取其过账账户，如图 7.6 和清单 7.5 所示。会计事务所可以包含引用明细账户的过账规则（尽管此处并未这样做）。因此，必须对过账账户进行筛选，仅保留汇总账户。

To determine which accounts are required, the accounting practice is asked for its posting accounts, as shown in Figure 7.6 and Listing 7.5. An accounting practice can contain posting rules that reference detail accounts (although that it is not done here). Thus the posting accounts have to be filtered to keep only the summary accounts.

7.4 设置通话

7.4 Setting Up Calls

电话通话被建模为从网络账户到基本时间账户的交易。电话通话记录的单位是分钟。

Phone calls are modeled as transactions from a network account to a basic time account. The units for phone call entries are minutes.

以下方法展示了如何设置电话服务并进行一些示例呼叫。请注意，它定义在一个名为 Scene 的类中，如清单 7.6 所示。测试方法可能会变得非常复杂；因此，最好将它们放在一个场景对象中（在测试用例中使用 scene）。

The following method shows the setting up of a phone service and the placement of some sample calls. Note that it is denned on a class called Scenariol, as shown in Listing 7.6. Test methods can get quite complex; thus it is good practice to put them on a scenario object (using scenario in the

（此处“用例”一词并非如第 9.4 节所定义）在没有合适的测试框架的情况下，为了控制这些用例，需要使用它们。变量 basicAccount 和 theService 是此测试类的类变量。

sense of a use-case, not as defined in Section 9.4) to keep them under control if no proper testing framework is available. The variables basicAccount and theService are class variables of this test class.

使用用户自定义的基础类（例如 quantity）可能会使创建新对象变得困难。因此，quantity 类有一个方法 n: aString，它可以根据字符串创建一个新的 quantity 对象。这是我个人使用的约定，因为 fromString: aString 可能会变得相当笨拙。

Using user-defined fundamental classes, such as quantity, can make creating new objects difficult. Hence quantity has a method n: aString, which creates a new quantity from the string. This is a personal convention that I use since fromString: aString can get rather unwieldy.

7.5 实施基于账户的解雇

7.5 Implementing Account-based Firing

这里我们使用基于账户的触发方案（参见第 6.7.3 节）。每个账户都有一个方法来处理自身，该方法会触发所有以该账户为触发器的过账规则，如清单 7.7 所示。

We use the account-based triggering scheme here (see Section 6.7.3). Each account has a method to process itself by firing all posting rules that use it as a trigger, as shown in Listing 7.7.

条目存储在有序集合中，新条目会添加到集合末尾。TastProcessed 实例变量用于跟踪处理状态。

Entries are held in orderedCollection, with new ones added on the end. The TastProcessed instance variable keeps track of the state of processing.

7.6 将通话分为白天和晚上

7.6 Separating Calls into Day and Evening

为了将通话分为白天通话和晚上通话，我们查看每笔记录，考虑记录的时间，然后从基本时间账户向白天账户或晚上时间账户进行交易。

To separate the calls into day and evening calls, we look at each entry, consider the time on the entry, and then make a transaction from the basic time account into either the day time account or the evening time account.

逐条处理条目的过账规则非常常见。我们可以创建一个名为“逐条过账规则”（EachEntryPR 类）的抽象子类型过账规则。如图 7.7 和清单 7.8 所示，该子类型会调用处理程序 `Entry: anEntry`，处理触发账户中每个未处理的条目。消息 `currentInput:` 会加载一个实例变量来保存过账规则正在处理的服务账户，如清单 7.9 所示。该变量仅可通过私有方法访问，并且仅在 `processAccount` 执行期间定义。临时的私有实例变量通常用于处理临时数据。

A posting rule that operates on an entry-by-entry basis is quite common. We can create an abstract subtype of posting rule called an each-entry posting rule (the class EachEntryPR). This subtype calls the operation process Entry: anEntry on each unprocessed entry in the triggering account, as shown in Figure 7.7 and Listing 7.8. The message currentInput: loads an instance variable to hold the service account that is being processed by the posting rule, as shown in Listing 7.9. It is accessed by private methods and is only defined within the execution of processAccount. A temporary, private instance variable is often

图 7.7 每个条目过账规则处理帐户的方法。

Figure 7.7 Each-entry posting rule's method for processing an account.

我们对每个未处理的条目使用处理条目操作。

We use the process entry operation on each unprocessed entry.

在这种情况下使用这种方法是因为发布规则通常（尽管本例并非如此）被定义为实例。因此，我们无法实例化它们来调用规则。另一种方法是将已定义的发布规则实例视为原型[2]，并克隆它以执行。

used in such cases because posting rules in general (although not in this case) are defined as instances. Thus we cannot instantiate them for invocation of the rule. An alternative is to treat the defined posting rule instance as a prototype [2] and clone it for execution.

currentInput: 消息还会为与输入电话服务相同的电话服务设置当前输出服务帐户。

The currentInput: message also sets up current output service accounts for the same phone service as the one provided as input.

此方法并不执行实际的计算和过账操作。这些操作由 `processEntry:` 方法完成，该方法是抽象的，应该由子类定义。因此，这里存在三层子类化。`PostingRule` 定义了过账规则的基本接口和服务。`EachEntryPR` 类中的 `process account` 方法是一个模板方法，它概述了逐条处理账户条目的步骤，但将具体如何处理每条条目的任务留给了子类。

This method does not do the actual calculation and posting. Instead it is done by processEntry:, which is abstract and should be defined by subclasses. Thus we see three layers of subclassing here. PostingRule defines the basic interface and services of posting rules. The process account method on EachEntryPR is a template method,2 which outlines the steps of processing an account entry by entry but leaves a subclass to actually work out how to process each entry.

对于此发布规则，我们可以定义一个名为 EveningDaySplitPR 的 EachEntryPR 子类。这是一个单例类实现的示例（参见 6.6.1 节）。该类中硬编码了相应的账户，这些账户在初始化时设置，如清单 7.10 所示。

For this posting rule we can define new subclass of EachEntryPR called EveningDaySplitPR. This is an example of the singleton class implementation (see Section 6.6.1). Hard-coded into this class are the appropriate accounts, which are set up at initialization, as shown in Listing 7.10.

分割是通过重写的 processEntry: 方法完成的，如图 7.8 和清单 7.11 所示。

The splitting is done by the overriding processEntry: method, as shown in Figure 7.8 and Listing 7.11.

7.7 时间充电

7.7 Charging for Time

如图 7.9 所示，白天和晚上的通话计费模式相同。费用同样是逐笔计算的，因此使用了 EachEntryPR 的子类。使用了两条过账规则——一条用于白天，一条用于晚上。这两条规则都使用同一个类 TransformPR。

Charging for both the evening and day calls follows the same pattern, as shown in Figure 7.9. Again the charges are calculated on an entry-by-entry basis, so a subclass of EachEntryPR is used. Two posting rules are used—one for day, one for evening. The same class, TransformPR, is used for both of them.

模板方法是算法的骨架，它将一些步骤推迟到子类中[2]。

A template method is a skeleton of an algorithm that defers some steps to subclasses [2].

图 7.8 晚间/白天拆分流程规则的流程输入操作方法。

Figure 7.8 Evening/day split process rule's method for the process entry operation.

图 7.9 具有转换过账规则的帐户处理交互图。

Figure 7.9 Interaction diagram for processing an account with a transform posting rule.

此记账规则的一个特殊之处在于，它由分钟数触发，但生成的条目却以美元计价，因此被称为“转换”。其实际操作是生成两笔交易。第一笔交易将分钟数转回网络账户，从而完成分钟数的循环。第二笔交易在货币领域生成一笔新交易：从网络收入账户转至活动账户，如图 7.10 和清单 7.12 所示。

A special feature of this posting rule is that it is triggered by an entry in minutes but produces entries in dollars, hence the term transform. Its actual reaction is to generate two transactions. One transfers the minutes back to the network account, thus completing the cycle for minutes. The second generates a new transaction in the money world: from a network income account to an activity account, as shown in Figure 7.10 and Listing 7.12.

图 7.10 流程 输入操作转换过账规则方法的事件图。

Figure 7.10 Event diagram for transform posting rule's method for the process entry operation.

转换后的金额由方法对象（参见 6.6.2 节）计算得出，具体来说，是由费率表（例如表 7.1 和表 7.2 中所示的费率表）计算得出。该方法类定义了抽象的 calculateFor: 方法。费率表是一个子类，它存储一个包含两列的数量表，用于生成问题所需的分级收费。它使用字典实现。字典的键指示各个阈值点，并且

The transformedAmount is calculated by a method object (see Section 6.6.2), specifically a rate table, such as that shown in Tables 7.1 and 7.2. The method class defines the abstract calculateFor: method. The rate table is a subclass that stores a two-column table of quantities to produce the kind of graded charging that the problem demands. It is implemented using a dictionary. The keys of the dictionary indicate the various threshold points, and

表 7.1 日间通话费率。
通话时长 成本
最多 1 分钟 98美分
1分钟以上 30美分
表 7.2 晚间通话费率。 部分表格：源 PDF 文件省略了标题和最后一行。仅复制可见的源行；下面的清单 7.13 提供了完整的速率设置。

the corresponding value indicates the rate that applies up to that threshold. Listing 7.13 shows how the evening rate is set up. The top rate indicates which rate applies once you get over the top threshold.

清单 7.14 展示了费率表如何计算金额。它分两步进行：首先，遍历费率表中的每一步；其次，加上超过最高阈值的任何金额。这里无需绘制图表；表格本身已经从概念上清晰地说明了所需的操作。需要特别注意的是，这些系统可以通过使用绝对值来平等地处理正数和负数。

Listing 7.14 shows how the rate table then calculates the amount. It does this in two parts: taking each step in the rate table and adding any amount over the top threshold. There is not much point showing a diagram for this; the tables indicate what is needed from a conceptual perspective clearly enough. One particular thing to watch for with these systems is that they can handle both positive and negative numbers the same by using absolute values.

7.8 计算税款

7.8 Calculating the Tax

最终的记账规则显示了税款的计算方法。该规则与之前的规则不同，它并非逐笔计算，而是需要查看一个月内的所有费用以评估税款。

The final posting rule shows the calculation of the tax. This rule differs from the previous rules in that it does not operate on an entry-by-entry basis. This posting rule has to look at all charges over a one-month period to assess the tax.

另一个复杂之处在于，我们无法（或者更确切地说，我们不希望）保证记账规则仅在月底运行一次。因此，记账应考虑因之前已收取的税款。这符合记账规则应遵循的原则。

Another complication is that we cannot (or rather do not wish to) guaran-tee that the posting rule is only run once at the end of the month. Thus the posting should take into account any tax already charged for the month due to an earlier firing. This follows the principle that the posting rules should be

这些定义独立于它们的触发方式。这提高了模型的灵活性并降低了模型的耦合性。

defined independently of how they are fired. This increases flexibility and reduces coupling in the model.

MonthlyChargePR 类是过账规则的子类型，因此实现了 processAccount，如图 7.11 和清单 7.15 所示。

The MonthlyChargePR class is a subtype of posting rule and thus implements processAccount, as shown in Figure 7.11 and Listing 7.15.

图 7.11 月度费用记账规则处理帐户的方法。

Figure 7.11 Monthly charge posting rule's method for processing an account.

该过程基于一段时间内的余额，而不是每笔交易。

This process is based on a balance over a time period, rather than each entry.

每个月都使用 processForMonth: 进行处理，如图 7.12 和清单 7.16 所示。

Each month is processed with processForMonth:, as shown in Figure 7.12 and Listing 7.16.

最后一笔交易是从输出账户到输入账户，因为由于纳税义务，活动账户会增加。

The final transaction is from the output account to the input account, because the activity account will be increased due to the tax liability.

7.9 总结性思考

7.9 Concluding Thoughts

这是一个非常简单的例子，因此很难从中得出太多结论。读者完全可以论证，这个问题可以用更简单的方式解决，而无需所有这些框架。然而，该框架对于可扩展性至关重要。一个实际的企业可能拥有数十个业务单元，每个业务单元又有数十条流程规则。利用这种结构，我们可以表示会计业务单元的新计费方案。当我们构建一个新的业务单元时，我们会创建一个新的过账规则实例网络。我们可以在系统仍在运行的情况下完成此操作，而无需重新编译或重建系统。虽然偶尔会遇到需要新的过账规则子类型的情况，但这种情况非常罕见。

This is a very simple example, so it is difficult to draw too many conclusions from it. The reader can convincingly argue that this problem can be tackled in a much simpler form without all this framework stuff. The framework, however, is valuable for scalability. A real business may have dozens of practices, each with dozens of process rules. With this structure we represent a new billing plan by an accounting practice. When we build a new practice, we create a network of new instances of the posting rule. We can do this without any recompilation or rebuilding of the system, while it is still up and running. There will be unavoidable occasions when we need a new subtype of posting rule, but these will be rare.

7.9.1 发布规则的结构

图 7.13 展示了本章讨论的过账规则的泛化结构。抽象过账规则类包含一个抽象方法 processAccount。各个子类型都实现了 processAccount 方法。每个条目过账规则通过调用另一个抽象方法 processEntry 来实现该方法。其他子类型根据需要实现 processEntry 方法。日/夜拆分过账规则的 processEntry 方法被硬编码，而转换过账规则则委托给费率表。示例展示了如何……

Figure 7.13 shows the generalization structure of the posting rules discussed in this chapter. The abstract posting rule class has an abstract processAccount method. The subtypes each implement processAccount. The each entry posting rule implements this method by calling another abstract method, processEntry, on each entry. The further subtypes implement processEntry as needed. The day/evening split posting rule's method is hard coded, while the transform posting rule delegates to a rate table. The example shows how a

图 7.13 发布规则的概括结构

Figure 7.13 Generalization structure of posting rules

抽象方法、多态性和委托的结合可以提供一种结构，以有组织的结构支持各种发布规则。

combination of abstract methods, polymorphism, and delegation can provide the kind of structure that supports a variety of posting rules in an organized structure.

这并非我们唯一可以使用的记账规则结构。另一种方法是将计算费用的两个步骤合并为一个步骤。这样的记账规则将包含两个费率表，一个用于日间费用，一个用于夜间费用，并负责费用拆分和费率表计费。

This is not the only structure of posting rules we could use. Another alternative would be to combine the two steps of working out the charge into a single step. Such a posting rule would have two rate tables, one for day charges and one for evening charges, and would be responsible for both the splitting and the rate table charging.

划分发布规则并没有固定的规则。我们的根本目标是在无需创建新的发布规则子类型的情况下构建新的实践。我们希望发布规则子类型的数量尽可能少，这样便于理解和维护。但同时，这些子类型也必须具备所有必要的功能，以便我们能够将它们组合起来用于新的实践。我们希望尽可能减少创建新发布规则子类型的次数。

There are no rules for deciding how to divide up posting rules. Our fundamental aim is to be able to build new practices without needing a new subtype of posting rule. We want to have as small a set of subtypes of posting rule as we can, for that will make it easier to understand and maintain the posting rule types. Yet we need these subtypes to have all the function that is required so we can put them together for new practices. We want to minimize the times when we need to build new posting rule subtypes.

更简单的发布规则适用于规模更大的实践，通常也更容易被广泛应用。我倾向于先将发布规则限制在较小的行为范围内。如果我发现某种发布规则组合经常被使用，那么我可能会构建一个功能更强大的发布规则来表示这种组合。

Simpler posting rules result in larger practices and are usually more widely available. I tend to keep posting rules to small behaviors initially. If I see a frequently used combination of posting rules, then I might build a more functional posting rule to represent that combination.

7.9.2 何时不应使用该框架

另一种替代此框架的方法是，每个计费方案仅使用一个类来处理所有行为（日/晚拆分、计费和税费），如图 7.14 所示。该类将接收一个月内的所有条目并生成账单。每个计费方案都将有一个这样的对象。

An alternative to using this framework is to have only one class per billing plan to handle all the behavior (day/evening split, charging, and taxing), as shown in Figure 7.14. The class would take all the entries in a month and produce a bill. There would be one such object for each billing plan.

图 7.14 使用计费方案。

Figure 7.14 Using a billing plan.

计费方案虽然简单，但灵活性稍差。

A billing plan is simple but not as flexible.

这种方法相当可行。虽然计费方案可能有很多种，但通常有一些基本的计费方法可以进行参数化，就像转换过账规则可以针对许多不同的费率表进行参数化一样。就这个问题而言，这种类型的计费方案可以通过晚间费率表、日间费率表和税收费率表进行参数化。

This approach is quite plausible. Although there may be many billing plans, there are usually a few basic methods for billing that can be parameterized, much as the transform posting rule can be parameterized for many different rate schedules. Such a type, for this problem, would be parameterized by an evening rate table, a day rate table, and a taxing rate table.

关键问题在于计费方案有多少种子类型。如果我们可以用十几种计费子类型来表示所有的计费结构，

The key question is how many subtypes of billing plan there are. If we can represent all the billing structures with a dozen or so subtypes of billing

如果有一个计划（尽管可能有数百个实例），那么使用计费计划类型是合理的。会计模型的优势在于它允许您……

plan (although there might be hundreds of instances), then using a billing plan type is plausible. The accounting model's strength is that it allows you

通过将过账规则和帐户对象连接起来，构建等效于新型计费计划子类型的功能。如果计费计划子类型众多或经常变化，这将具有强大的优势。

to build the equivalent of new subtypes of billing plan by wiring together posting rule and account objects. This is a powerful advantage if there is a large or frequently changing set of subtypes of billing plan.

另一种理解方式是将计费计划视为一条过账规则，它将基本时间账户中的数据一步过账到活动账户。使用账户仍然很有价值，因为它可以提供计费计划输入和结果的通话和费用历史记录。但我们会丢失中间总计。

Another way to think about it is to consider the billing plan as a posting rule that posts from the basic time account to the activity account in one step. Using accounts would still be valuable to give the history of phone calls and charges at the input and result of billing plan. We would lose the intermediate totals.

7.9.3 会计实务图表

图表通常有助于将复杂问题可视化。图 7.15 和 7.16 是这方面的一些建议（当然也只是初步的）。这类图表有助于处理复杂的操作。我们可以设想，通过绘制图表来构建系统，从而减少所需的编程量，进而提高此类应用程序的效率。

A diagram often helps to visualize a complex problem. Figures 7.15 and 7.16 are suggestions (and most certainly tentative ones) in that direction. Complex practices will be helped by these kinds of diagrams. We might imagine that we could build a system by drawing a diagram and decreasing the amount of programming required and thus increase the productivity of such applications.

练习应该能形成一个简洁但又能传达关键信息的图表。图 7.15 的优点在于其简洁性，展示了关键的触发和输出关系。然而，它并没有像图 7.16 那样完整地展示所有已核算项目的流程。如果您使用这些图表，请注意以下事项：

Practice should result in a diagram form that is simple yet conveys the key information. Figure 7.15 has the advantage of being simple, displaying the key triggering and output relationships. It does not, however, show the full flow of accounted items in the way that Figure 7.16 does. If you use these

图 7.15 流程规则和帐户布局的简单图示方法。

Figure 7.15 A simple way of diagramming the layout of process rules and accounts.

它显示了每个过账规则的触发条件和主要输出账户，但隐藏了完整的 交易流程。

It shows the trigger and main output account for each posting rule but hides the full flow of transactions.

图 7.16 账户和记账规则的更直观的图示。

Figure 7.16 A more expressive diagram of the accounts and posting rules.

此图清晰地展示了交易流程。每条记账规则都由一个 账户触发，并引发一系列交易流。流程方向显示了 款项的提取和存入位置。该图包含更多信息，因此也 更为复杂。

This diagram makes the flow of transactions explicit. Each posting rule is triggered by a single account and causes a number of flows. The direction of the flow shows where items are withdrawn and deposited. The diagram shows more information and is thus more complicated.

对于模式，我强烈建议使用图表。可以先从这里建议的图表开始，然后让图表标准逐渐演变成最实用的一种（并告诉我它是什么）。

patterns, I strongly recommend using diagrams. Start with the ones suggested here and let the diagram standard evolve to one that is the most useful (and let me know what it is).
