第九章 交易

Chapter 9. Trading

本章探讨商品买卖以及商品价值随市场变化而变化的情况。本章以一家银行构建交易系统的经验为例，从买卖双方的角度分析买卖，即银行买卖同一种商品的情况。银行必须了解这些交易在不同情况下产生的净价值。

This chapter looks at the buying and selling of goods and at the value of these goods with respect to changing market conditions. Using the experience of building a trading system for a bank, the chapter looks at buying and selling from both angles, where the bank buys and sells the same goods. The bank has to understand the value of the net effect of these trades in different circumstances.

每笔交易都由一份合约（9.1）描述。合约可以买卖商品，对于需要追踪交易双向往来的企业非常有用。我们可以利用投资组合（9.2）来考察多份合约的净效应。我们设计投资组合，使其能够轻松地组合起来，从而以不同的方式选择合约。我们为投资组合提供一个单独的对象——投资组合过滤器，用于定义选择标准。投资组合过滤器定义了一个可以由各种子类型实现的接口。这种结构为简单和复杂的选择标准提供了灵活性。它是一种以灵活方式定义集合的有效技术。

Each trade is described by a contract (9.1). The contract can either buy or sell goods and is useful for businesses that need to track both directions of deals. We can look at the net effect of a number of contracts by using a portfolio (9.2). We design portfolios so we can assemble them easily to select contracts in different ways. We give the portfolio a separate object, the portfolio filter, to define the selection criteria. The portfolio filter defines an interface that can be implemented by various subtypes. This construction provides flexibility for simple and complex selection criteria. It is a useful technique for defining collections in a flexible manner.

要了解合约的价值，我们需要了解交易商品的价格。商品的价格通常会因买卖双方的不同而有所差异。这种双向定价行为可以用报价（9.3）来体现。

To understand the value of a contract, we need to understand the price of the goods being traded. Goods are often priced differently depending on whether they are bought or sold. This two-way pricing behavior can be captured by a quote (9.3).

在波动剧烈的市场中，价格可能瞬息万变。交易者需要根据一系列可能的变化来评估商品价值。情景 (9.4) 将一系列条件组合在一起，这些条件可以作为市场估值的单一状态。情景可能很复杂，我们需要一种方法来定义其构建方式，以便在不同时期以一致的方式使用相同的情景构建方法。情景对于任何价格变化复杂的领域都非常有用。

In volatile markets, prices can change rapidly. Traders need to value goods against a range of possible changes. The scenario (9.4) puts together a combination of conditions that can act as a single state of the market for valuation. Scenarios can be complex, and we need a way to define their construction so we can use the same scenario construction at different times in a consistent manner. Scenarios are useful for any domain with complex price changes.

本章基于为一家大型银行开发外汇衍生品交易系统的项目。

This chapter is based on a project to develop a foreign exchange derivatives trading system for a major bank.

关键概念：合同、投资组合、报价、方案

Key Concepts Contract, Portfolio, Quote, Scenario

9.1 合同

9.1 Contract

最简单的金融交易是从另一方购买某种金融工具。该金融工具可以是股票、商品、外汇或任何其他常见的交易品种。图 9.1 所示的模型是一个基本的起点。该模型包含一份合约，即与另一方（称为交易对手）达成的交易，涉及一定数量的金融工具。图中仅显示一种金融工具，但严格来说，所有交易都涉及两种金融工具——一种金融工具用于交换另一种金融工具。对于大多数市场而言，其中一种金融工具始终是市场上流通的货币。因此，价格以货币对象来表示。货币是数量的一个子类型（参见 3.1 节），其单位是货币。

The simplest kind of financial deal is that of buying some instrument from another party. The instrument can be stock, a commodity, foreign exchange, or any other commonly traded item. A basic starting point is the model shown in Figure 9.1. This model has a contract that is a deal with another party, referred to as the counterparty, involving some amount of an instrument. Only a single instrument is shown, although strictly speaking all trading involves two instruments—one instrument being traded for another. For most markets one instrument is always the currency prevailing in the market. The price is thus represented as a money object. Money is a subtype of quantity (see Section 3.1) whose unit is a currency.

在外汇市场中，交易工具就是汇率。这或许听起来有些奇怪，但实际上所有交易工具本质上都是汇率。一份道琼斯指数股票的买卖合约，实际上就是一份将股票兑换成美元的合约。在大多数情况下，用“交易工具兑换价格所对应的货币”来表示这种兑换更为简便，但对于汇率而言，最好将两种货币都包含在交易工具中，而将价格简化为一个简单的数字。

In foreign exchange markets the instrument is the exchange rate. This might seem odd, but really all instruments are exchange rates. A contract to sell stock on the Dow is really a contract to exchange stock for dollars. In most cases it is easier to represent this by saying that the instrument is exchanged for the currency of the price, but for exchange rates it is better to have both currencies on the instrument and let the price be a simple number.

图 9.1 合同的简单模型。

Figure 9.1 Simple model for a contract.

该工具的数量与交易对手进行交易。 “多头”和“空头”分别指 买入和卖出。单一交易对手限制了可以 代表的合约数量。

The amount of the instrument is traded with the counterparty. Long and short are terms for buy and sell, respectively. The single counterparty limits the contracts that can be represented.

“长线”和“短线”分别是交易者用来表示买入和卖出的术语。（并非只有计算机领域的人才会使用奇怪的术语！）图 9.1 展示了使用子类型表示法区分长线和短线。另一种方法是使用布尔属性 isLong。两种方法都可接受，但我更倾向于在概念建模中使用图 9.1 的明确性。在概念建模中，子类型和布尔属性是等价的；子类型并不意味着子类。在实现建模技术中（当子类型确实意味着子类时），除非长线和短线的行为不同（甚至可能即使不同），否则图 9.1 并不适用。接口模型可以采用这两种方式。第 14.2 节描述了如何进行这种转换，以便在使用子类或标志时保持相同的接口。

The terms long and short are the terms traders use for buy and sell, respectively. (Computer people are not the only ones with strange jargon!) Figure 9.1 shows the difference between long and short with subtyping notation. An alternative is to have a Boolean attribute isLong. Either method is acceptable, but I prefer the explicitness of Figure 9.1 in conceptual modeling. Subtyping and a Boolean attribute are equivalent in conceptual modeling; subtyping does not imply subclassing. In an implementation modeling technique (when sub-typing does imply subclassing), Figure 9.1 is not appropriate unless the behavior of the long and short differ (and possibly not even then). An interface model can go either way. Section 14.2 describes how this transformation can be made to preserve the same interface whether subclasses or flags are used.

例如， Megabank 以每股 30 美元的价格向 Martin Fowler 出售 1000 股 Aroma Coffee Makers 股票。这是一份空头合约，交易对手是 Martin Fowler，交易标的物是 Aroma Coffee Makers 股票，数量为 1000 股，价格为 30 美元。

Example Megabank sells 1000 shares of Aroma Coffee Makers stock to Martin Fowler at $30. This is a short contract whose counterparty is Martin Fowler, the instrument is Aroma Coffee Makers stock, the amount is 1000, and the price is $30.

例如， Megabank 从英国铁路公司出售 200 万美元（USD），换取 100 万英镑（GBP）。这是一份多头合约，交易对手方为英国铁路公司，金额为 100 万美元，价格为 2 英镑/美元，交易品种为英镑/美元。或者，它也可以作为一份空头合约，金额为 200 万美元，价格为 0.5 英镑，交易品种为美元/英镑。

Example Megabank sells 2 million US dollars (USD) for 1 million British pounds (GBP) from British Railways. This is a long contract in which the counterparty is British Railways, the amount is 1 million, the price is 2, and the instrument is GBP/USD. Alternatively it could be a short contract in which the amount is 2 million, the price is 0.5, and the instrument is USD/GBP.

例如，东北钢铁公司向克莱斯勒公司出售1万吨钢材。对克莱斯勒公司而言，这是一份与东北钢铁公司交易对手签订的长期合同。该合同的标的物为钢材，因此数量需要根据钢材的吨数进行调整，以表示1万吨。（另一种方法是将标的物限定为钢材吨数，但这对于其他数量而言灵活性较差。）

Example Northeast Steel sells 10,000 tons of steel to Chrysler. For Chrysler this is a long contract with a counterparty of Northeast Steel. The instrument is steel, in which case the amount changes to a quantity to allow 10,000 tons to be represented. (An alternative is to allow the instrument to be tons of steel, but that is less flexible for other quantities.)

这种模型风格适用于捕捉东道机构与其他方之间的交易。然而，交易通常发生在东道机构内部，例如期权交易部门和商品交易部门之间。这些内部交易用于风险管理。一个常见的例子是用于对冲期权风险的交易（称为套期保值）。这类内部交易引出了一个问题：谁是内部交易方？图 9.2 所示的模型提供了一种更灵活的方法来回答这个问题。合约中显示了两个交易方：多头（买方）和空头（卖方）。

This style of model is good for capturing deals done between the host organization and other parties. Often, however, deals are done internally within the host organization, such as between the options desk and the commodities desk. These internal deals are used in the management of risk. A common example is a deal to offset the risk of an option (called a hedge). Such internal deals raise the question of who is the internal party. The model shown in Figure 9.2 presents a more flexible way of answering this question. Two parties are shown on a contract: the long (buyer) and the short (seller). In

图 9.2 按不同关系表示买方和卖方。

Figure 9.2 Indicating buyers and sellers by separate relationships.

双方参与支持内部交易、完全外部交易以及 与东道组织内不同方进行交易。

Having two parties supports internal deals, completely external deals, and dealing with different parties within the host organization.

在这种表示方法中，期权交易部门和商品交易部门被视为独立的交易方。如果期权交易部门与外部交易方进行期权交易，并通过与商品交易部门进行对冲交易，那么期权交易部门将是每份合约的参与方。如果期权交易部门是期权的多头，那么它将是对冲合约的空头。

this kind of representation, the options desk and the commodities desk are represented as separate parties. If the options desk does an option with an external party and hedges it with a deal with the commodities desk, then the options desk would be a party to each contract. If the options desk were the long party in the option, it would be short in the hedge contract.

图 9.3 以略微不同的方式展示了类似的情况。同样，使用两种关系可以表示内部交易。然而，这里存在主交易方和交易对手的概念，而不是多空关系。当东道银行与外部机构进行交易时，东道银行始终是主交易方。在内部交易中，主交易方和交易对手的选择是任意的，尽管按照惯例，主交易方通常是发起交易的一方。多空关系的子类型是指主交易方所看到的交易性质。

Figure 9.3 represents a similar situation in a slightly different way. Again the use of two relationships allows internal deals to be represented. However, here there is a notion of primary party and counterparty rather than long and short. The host bank party is always the primary party when doing a deal with an outside organization. In internal deals the choice between primary party and counterparty is arbitrary, although by convention the primary party is usually the one that initiates the deal. The subtype of long and short is the nature of the deal as seen by the primary party.

图 9.3 交易对手和主要当事人。

Figure 9.3 Counterparty and primary party.

虽然不如图 9.2 简洁，但能更好地支持交易者的观点。

This is less concise than Figure 9.2 but can better support the traders' view.

初步分析显示，图 9.3 所示的模型似乎不如图 9.2 所示的模型有价值，因为它增加了一对额外的子类型，但并没有带来任何显著优势。当然，从数据建模的角度来看，这会因为数据结构更加复杂而否定这种做法。就面向对象建模而言，关键问题在于接口。是提供需要指定主交易方和交易对手方以及多头或空头合约的操作更有用，还是提供多头和空头双方更有用？图 9.4 所示的模型实际上同时提供了这两种接口，或许才是最佳选择。最终的决定因素是哪种方式对概念的用户最有用。就我们的示例系统而言，图 9.3 的模型对交易员来说比图 9.2 的模型更有意义，并且在软件开发中也更有用，尽管最终我们采用了图 9.4 的接口。

On initial analysis the model shown in Figure 9.3 looks less valuable than the model shown in Figure 9.2 because it adds an extra pair of subtypes without any great advantage. Certainly a data modeling view would reject this on the basis of a more complex data structure. The important issue, in terms of OO modeling, is interface. Is it more useful to provide operations that ask for primary and counterparty and the contract as long or short, or is it more useful to have a long and short party? It may be that the model shown in Figure 9.4, which essentially provides both interfaces, is the best. The deciding factor is what is most useful to the users of the concepts. For our example system, the Figure 9.3 model was more meaningful to the traders than that of Figure 9.2 and proved more useful in constructing software, although the Figure 9.4 interface was ultimately provided.

图 9.4 使用四方映射。

Figure 9.4 Using four party mappings.

通过提取重复元素，这涵盖了所有观点。

This covers all points of view by deriving the duplicate elements.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当可以提供多组等效特征时，选择领域专家最认可的那组。如果领域专家认为两组特征都很有价值，则同时展示两组特征，并将其中一组标记为派生特征。
When more than one equivalent set of features can be provided, pick the one that the domain expert is most comfortable with. If the domain expert feels that both are very valuable, show both and mark one derived.

图 9.4 中哪些部分需要推导是相当任意的。我们可以同样地将长映射或短映射都推导出来。模型不应限制实现者，他们可以使用任何一种实现方式。有人可能会认为，你可以完全不使用任何推导，而只是简单地使用规则（例如，如果合约是短合约，则短合约方与主合约方是同一对象）。我倾向于展示一些推导过程，以明确它们之间的相互关系，但归根结底，这更多是建模偏好的问题。

The choice of what to make derived in Figure 9.4 is quite arbitrary. We could equally well make the long or short mapping derived. The model should not constrain the implementor who can use either kind of implementation. It could be argued that you could make nothing derived but simply use rules (such as, if the contract is short, then the short party is the same object as the primary party). I prefer to show some derivations to make the interrelationships explicit, but ultimately it is more a matter of modeling taste.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
将某个特征标记为派生特征是对接口的一种约束，不会影响底层数据结构。
Marking a feature as derived is a constraint on the interface and does not affect the underlying data structures.

图 9.2-9.4 所示模型的一个后果是，可能会记录一些不涉及本行的合同。我们可以通过强制至少主要交易方必须是本行的参与方来避免这种情况。或者，我们可以咨询领域专家，了解记录这些交易是否有用。销售人员通常喜欢记录客户与其他银行达成的交易，因为这能让他们了解客户的潜在风险状况，并有助于他们推销能够改善客户状况的合同。在此，该模型的灵活性支持了新的业务能力。

A consequence of the models shown in Figures 9.2-9.4 is that contracts can be recorded that do not involve the host bank. We can avoid this by forcing at least the primary party to be a party of the host bank. Alternatively we can ask the domain expert if holding these deals would be useful. Salespeople often like to record deals that their customers have made with other banks because it gives them information on their customers' possible risk profiles and allows them to sell a contract to improve matters. Here the flexibility of the model supports new business capabilities.

一个悬而未决的问题是，本交易模型中的合约与第六章会计模型中的交易之间的关系。交易可以理解为例如从Megabank账户提取1000股Aroma Coffee Makers股票并存入Martin Fowler账户，同时反向转移相应金额的资金。交易和转账都有其用途，但目的不同。需要进行更多建模来探索它们之间的相互关系。

An open issue is the relationship between a contract in this trading model and a transaction in one of the accounting models from Chapter 6. A trade can be seen as a transaction that, for example, withdraws 1000 shares of Aroma Coffee Makers stock from a Megabank account and deposits them in a Martin Fowler account, while transferring the appropriate amount of money in the opposite direction. Both trades and transactions are useful, but for different purposes. More modeling needs to be done to explore their interrelationships.

9.2 投资组合

9.2 Portfolio

我们很少单独考虑合同，尤其是在进行风险管理时。通常，银行会考察一组相关的合同，并评估它们的联合风险。这可能包括同一交易员经手的合同、特定金融工具的合同、与特定交易对手方签订的合同，或其他组合。

We rarely consider contracts alone, especially when we are managing risk. Typically a bank will look at a group of related contracts and assess their joint risk. This might be the contracts dealt by a single trader, the contracts in a particular instrument, the contracts with a particular counterparty, or some other combination.

本质上，投资组合是一系列合约的集合，如图 9.5 所示。投资组合和合约的价值可以通过根据某种情景进行定价来评估。情景是对市场状态的描述，可以是真实的，也可以是假设的（我们将在 9.4 节中更详细地讨论情景）。投资组合的价值本质上是其所包含的基础合约价值的总和。

In essence a portfolio is a collection of contracts, as shown in Figure 9.5. Portfolios and contracts can be valued by pricing them according to some scenario. A scenario is a representation of the state of the market, either real or hypothetical (we will discuss scenarios in more detail in Section 9.4). The value of a portfolio is essentially the sum of the values of the underlying contracts.

图 9.5 投资组合简介。

Figure 9.5 Introducing portfolios.

投资组合是指可以作为一个整体进行估值的一系列合约的集合。

A portfolio is a collection of contracts that can be valued as a whole.

关键问题在于合约到投资组合映射的基数。一份合约是否可以合理地存在于多个投资组合中，取决于我们如何创建和使用这些投资组合。如果投资组合是交易员的账簿，那么一份合约就存在于负责该交易的交易员的投资组合中。然而，这并不能将与特定交易对手的所有交易放在一起考虑。因此，允许一份合约存在于多个投资组合中似乎具有优势。这样，就可以根据不同的视角构建投资组合来管理风险。

A key question lies in the cardinality of the mapping from contract to portfolio. Whether a contract can sensibly lie in more than one portfolio depends on how we create and use the portfolios. If a portfolio is a trader's book, then a contract lies in the portfolio of the trader who is managing the deal. This, however, does not allow all trades with a particular counterparty to be considered together. Thus there seems to be an advantage in allowing a contract to lie in many portfolios. Portfolios can thus be built to manage risk according to different perspectives.

然而，以这种方式使用投资组合会引出另一个问题。假设我们需要构建一个包含与特定交易对手签订的所有合约的投资组合。我们可以开发一个应用程序来搜索所有合约并将它们分配到不同的投资组合中。但是，更好的方法是让投资组合来分配合约。我们可以为投资组合添加一个布尔方法，该方法以合约作为参数，如图 9.6 所示。然后，投资组合将包含所有布尔方法结果为真的合约。这使我们能够构建可以选取合约任意属性组合的投资组合，并在此基础上执行投资组合的管理功能。

Using portfolios in this way raises another question, however. Suppose we need to form a portfolio that contains all contracts done with a particular counterparty. We could build an application that would search all contracts and assign them to portfolios. A better way, however, is to get the portfolio to assign contracts. We can give a portfolio a Boolean method, which takes a contract as an argument as shown in Figure 9.6. The portfolio then consists of all contracts for which the Boolean method evaluates to true. This allows us to construct portfolios that can select any combination of properties of a contract and then carry out the management functions of a portfolio on this derived set.

图 9.6 带过滤器的动态投资组合。

Figure 9.6 Dynamic portfolios with filters.

这样就可以通过合约的属性来隐式地描述投资组合。

This allows portfolios to be described implicitly by properties of the contract.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果能够根据各种标准形成一组对象，则应该使用作品集。
If a set of objects can be formed with various criteria, a portfolio should be used.

允许投资组合拥有能够自行构建合约的方法，这是一个强大的概念。这意味着无需选择单一结构来处理合约组。可以根据需要灵活使用各种结构。一旦定义了这样的结构，就可以将其记住以便将来使用，并定期更新其内容。即使在原始合约创建很久之后，也可以随时定义该结构。实际上，我们是在执行查询，而查询结果中的对象集合本身就成为了一个独立的对象。

Allowing portfolios to have methods so that they can form themselves with contracts is a powerful notion. It means that there is no need to choose a single structure to consider groups of contracts. Various structures can be used, in an ad hoc manner. Once such a structure is defined, it can be remembered as used in the future and its contents regularly updated. The structure can be defined at any time, long after the original contract was put together. In effect we are making a query, and the resulting collection of objects becomes an object in its own right.

布尔方法是如何实现的？一般来说，该方法可以是任何一段代码块，当以合约作为参数时返回 true 或 false。Smalltalk 程序员可以看到，将一个单参数代码块赋值给 portfolio 的实例变量即可实现所需的功能。C++ 程序员也可以使用大致相同的原理，尽管由于 C++ 需要编译后的函数，因此实现起来会更复杂一些。这与 6.6 节中讨论的单个实例方法的问题相同。

How is the Boolean method implemented? In general the method can be any block of code that returns true or false when given a contract as an argument. Smalltalk programmers can see that assigning a single argument block as an instance variable of portfolio would provide the desired capability. C++ programmers can use roughly the same principle, although it is more tricky since C++ needs a compiled function. This is the same problem as the individual instance methods discussed in Section 6.6.

从理论上讲，布尔方法可能是最佳方案，但实际上更简单的方法也同样有效。投资组合通常由合约的多个属性构成，包括交易对手方、交易商（主要交易方）、交易品种和交易日期。我们可以将这些属性组合成一个特定的合约选择器对象，如图 9.7 所示。合约选择器不如布尔方法通用，只能处理有限的筛选范围。但是，它易于设置；用户可以通过合适的界面轻松配置。如果我们使用合约选择器来处理用户所需的大部分投资组合，就可以显著减少所需的编程量。

In the abstract the Boolean method might be the best approach, but in practice a simpler method does as well. Portfolios are commonly formed from a number of properties of contracts, including counterparty, dealer (the primary party), instrument, and dates of the deal. We can combine these attributes into a particular contract selector object, as shown in Figure 9.7. A contract selector is not as general as a Boolean method and can only handle a limited range of filtering. However, it is easy to set up; the user can configure it easily with a suitable user interface. If we use a contract selector to handle most of the portfolios needed by the user, we can considerably reduce the amount of programming required.

图 9.7 合同选择器。

Figure 9.7 Contract selectors.

请注意，这是一个参数化方法的示例（参见第 6 节和 6.4 节）。它无法 选择所有可能的投资组合，但 与完全一般的情况相比，它可以更容易地涵盖实践中使用的大多数投资组合。

Note that this is an example of a parameterized method (see Section 6,6.4). It cannot select all possible portfolios, but it can cover most portfolios used in practice more easily than the completely general case.

例如， A投资组合包含所有涉及Aroma Coffee Makers公司股票出售给John Smith的交易。该投资组合设有筛选条件，以Aroma Coffee Makers公司的股票为交易工具，John Smith为交易对手方。

Example A portfolio consists of all deals involving Aroma Coffee Makers stock sold to John Smith. This portfolio has a filter with Aroma Coffee Makers stock as an instrument and John Smith as a counterparty.

我们不必在合约选择器和布尔方法之间做出选择。通过使用图 9.8 所示的模型，我们可以兼得两者的优势。该模型将布尔方法和合约选择器的接口抽象成一个单一的抽象类型——投资组合过滤器。这使得我们能够针对简单情况使用合约选择器，而针对更复杂的情况使用一系列硬编码的过滤器。我们可以轻松地添加其他投资组合过滤器。这是一个策略模式的示例 [ 1 ]。

We are not forced to choose between contract selectors and Boolean methods for our filters. We can have the best of both worlds by using the model shown in Figure 9.8. This model abstracts the interfaces of both the Boolean method and the contract selector into a single, abstract type—the portfolio filter. This allows us to use the contract selector for simple cases and use a range of hard-coded fiiters for more complex situations. We can easily add other portfolio filters. This is an example of the strategy pattern [ 1 ] .

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当将某个过程作为类型的一个特性时，应该为其提供一个抽象接口，以便实现方式能够轻松地通过子类化而变化。纯粹的硬编码实现是一种子类，各种参数驱动的方法则是其他的。
When making a process a feature of a type, the process should be given an abstract interface so that the implementation can easily vary by subclassing. A purely hard-coded implementation is one subclass, various parameter driven approaches are others.

图 9.8 提供多个投资组合筛选器。

Figure 9.8 Provision of several portfolio filters.

该模型既能灵活处理复杂情况， 又能简单参数化处理简单情况。它是策略和参数化实现的结合 （参见第 6.6 节）。

This model provides both flexibility to handle the complicated cases and simple parameterization for the simple cases. It is a combination of strategy and parameterized implementations (see Section 6.6).

投资组合筛选器的 select 操作接受一个合约集合并返回另一个合约集合。对于输入集合中的每个合约，select 操作会评估 isIncluded 方法，如果为真，则将其添加到结果中。投资组合筛选器的子类会重写 isIncluded 方法以提供其特定的行为。投资组合可以使用 isIncluded 来检查单个合约。

The select operation on the portfolio filter takes a collection of contracts and returns another collection of contracts. For each contract in the input collection, the select operation evaluates isIncluded and, if true, adds it to the result. Subclasses of the portfolio filter override isIncluded to provide their specific behaviors. A portfolio may use isIncluded to check individual contracts.

关于投资组合过滤器和合约选择器的命名，我应该补充一点。我合作过的同事都认为区分这两个术语在实践中非常有用。选择器用于选择与其名称对应的对象类型；因此，合约选择器用于选择合约，并返回一个合约集合。过滤器则代表其指定的类型选择其他类型，并且设计用于与其指定的类型一起使用。因此，投资组合过滤器用于为投资组合选择合约。通过保持一致的命名，更容易记住这两种对象的职责：过滤器仅是一种选择机制，而投资组合则添加了其他功能，例如生成总价值。此外，投资组合会被系统的其他部分引用，而过滤器仅用于选择目的。

I should add a word about the naming of portfolio filter and contract selector. People I've worked with found the distinction between the terms quite valuable in practice. A selector selects objects of the type it is named after; thus a contract selector is used to select contracts, and it returns a collection of contracts. A filter selects some other type on behalf of its named type and is designed to be used with its named type. Hence a portfolio filter selects contracts for a portfolio. By sticking to a consistent naming, it is easier to remember the responsibilities of these two kinds of objects: The filter is only a selection mechanism, but the portfolio adds additional behavior, such as producing an overall value. In addition, the portfolio is referred to by other parts of the system, while the filter is only used for selection purposes.

投资组合可以是临时的，也可以是持久的。临时投资组合按需填充。系统会指定筛选条件，并检查所有合约实例是否符合筛选条件。客户使用完毕后，该投资组合将被丢弃。持久投资组合的创建方式相同，但不会被丢弃。创建新合约时，系统会将其与现有的持久投资组合进行比对。如果符合筛选条件，则将其添加到投资组合中。任何基于该投资组合的处理都必须更新，理想情况下应以增量方式更新。持久投资组合的查询性能更高，但会降低合约创建速度并占用更多存储空间。一个重要的建模原则是，用户不应感知投资组合是临时的还是持久的。投资组合应在无需用户任何操作的情况下自动切换。这就要求系统将新的投资组合筛选条件与任何现有的持久投资组合筛选条件进行比对。如果存在匹配的筛选条件，则应引用现有投资组合，而不是创建新的投资组合。

Portfolios can be transient or persistent. Transient portfolios are filled on demand. The filter is specified, and all instances of the contract are checked to see if they match the filter. Once a client has finished with the portfolio, it is discarded. Persistent portfolios are created in the same way but are not discarded. When new contracts are created, they are checked against existing persistent portfolios. If they match the filter, they are added to the portfolio. Any processing based on the portfolio must then be updated, ideally incrementally. Persistent portfolios provide much faster query performance but slow down creation of contracts and use up storage. An essential modeling principle is that users should be unaware of whether portfolios are transient or persistent. Portfolios should switch from one to the other without requiring any action by the user. This requires that a new portfolio filter be checked against any existing persistent portfolio filters. If a matching one exists, then the existing portfolio should be referenced rather than a new portfolio created.

投资组合在许多领域都非常有用。投资组合的本质特征在于它封装了一种选择机制，用于选择一组特定类型的对象。投资组合可作为进一步汇总处理的基础。这种处理可以是客户端对象（如本章所述），也可以内置于投资组合本身。

Portfolios are useful in many domains. The essential characteristic of a portfolio is that of an object that encapsulates a selection mechanism for choosing a group of objects of some type. The portfolio acts as a basis for some further summary processing. This processing can be a client object, as in this chapter, or it can be built into the portfolio itself.

例如，汽车制造商可以建立已生产车辆的投资组合，用于汇总生产和故障数据。筛选器可以根据工厂、车型、生产班次或特定日期范围来选择车辆。

Example A car manufacturer can develop portfolios of produced cars for summarizing production and fault data. Filters can select cars according to their plant, model, shift of production, or some date range.

例如，公共卫生是医疗保健的一个重要分支，它关注患者群体的健康状况。我们可以根据一系列特征选择人群：年龄、居住地、适用的观察概念等等。这些人群可以通过筛选条件来定义，然后可以对他们进行观察，例如每天吸烟超过20支的人的平均峰值流速。（人群是指筛选条件为每天吸烟超过20支的人群。¹）

Example Public health is a significant branch of health care that deals with the health of populations of patients. We can select populations according to a range of characteristics: age, where they live, observation concepts that apply, and so on. These populations can be defined by filters, and then observations can then be made about them, such as the average peak flow rate for people who smoke more than 20 cigarettes a day. (The population is a portfolio of people where the filter is smokes more than 20 cigarettes a day.1)

1 香烟上的过滤嘴是另一回事。

1 The filter on the cigarette is a different matter.

9.3 引述

9.3 Quote

任何在金融市场上交易的商品都有价格。然而，这个价格通常不是一个单独的数字。报价通常包含两个数字：买入价（买价）和卖出价（卖价）。我们可以用一对数字来表示价格，如图 9.9 所示。

Anything traded on a financial market has a price. That price, however, is not usually a single number. Two numbers are quoted: the price to buy (the bid) and the price to sell (the offer). We can model this using a pair of numbers to represent the prices, as shown in Figure 9.9.

图 9.9 通过两个数值属性表示价格。

Figure 9.9 Representing the price through two numeric properties.

金融工具可以用数字或货币对象来估值。通常股票用货币估值，而汇率用数字估值。报价在这两种情况下表现相同。（我们可以把报价看作是一种参数化类型。）

An instrument can be valued using numbers or money objects. Typically stocks are valued using money but exchange rates have numbers. A quote behaves the same in either case. (We can think of a quote as a parameterized type.)

虽然报价通常包含两个数字，但并非总是如此。有时报价只有一个价格，代表价格的中间值。这种单一价格的报价会包含点差——买入价和卖出价之间的差额。有时我们可能只看到买入价，或者只看到卖出价。这会影响报价的显示方式。在外汇市场，美元/英镑汇率可能报价为 0.6712/5，表示买入价为 0.6712，卖出价为 0.6715。如果只有买入价，则报价显示为 0.6712/；如果只有卖出价，则显示为 /0.6715。

Although two numbers are common, they are not always used. Sometimes the quote is a single price, which represents the mid-value of the price. A single price is quoted with a spread—the difference between the bid and the offer. On other occasions we may see only a bid, or only an offer. This affects the way the quote is displayed. In foreign exchange markets an exchange rate such as USD/GBP might be quoted as 0.6712/5, which indicates a bid of 0.6712 and an offer of 0.6715. If only a bid is present, the quote is shown as 0.6712/; an offer-only quote appears as /0.6715.

任何可能涉及双向定价的对象（例如汇率、商品等）都需要一些行为，如图 9.10 所示。将这些行为提取到一个单独的报价对象中（如图 9.11 所示），即可提供双向定价所需的所有行为。任何以报价作为价格的对象都需要一个报价属性。

Any object that may have two-way pricing—such as exchange rates, commodities, and so on—requires a number of behaviors as shown in Figure 9.10. Pulling these behaviors out into a separate quote object, as shown in Figure 9.11, provides all behaviors needed for two-way pricing. Anything that has a quote as a price requires a quote property.

图 9.10 支持双向价格所需的行为。

Figure 9.10 Behaviors required to support two-way prices.

引用成为一种基本类型，因此在那些区分属性和对象类型的建模方法中，最好将其表示为属性。需要注意的是，属性并不代表数据结构，而仅仅代表是否存在合适的操作。

A quote becomes a fundamental type and as such can best be represented as an attribute in those modeling methods that distinguish between attributes and object types. It is important to remember that an attribute does not represent the data structure, merely the presence of suitable operations.

图 9.11 使用单独的报价对象。

Figure 9.11 Using a separate quote object.

这是一种很好的方法，因为它将具体的职责整合到一个简单的 可重用概念中。

This is a good approach since it brings the particular responsibilities together into a simple reusable concept.

例如，美元/英镑汇率为0.6712/6。交易品种为美元/英镑。该交易品种的报价为：买入价0.6712，卖出价0.6716，中间价0.6714，点差0.0004。

Example The USD/GBP rate is 0.6712/6. The instrument is USD/GBP. This instrument has a quote with a bid of 0.6712, an offer of 0.6716, a mid of 0.6714, and a spread of 0.0004.

例如，一家 CD 交换店以 12 美元的价格出售二手全价 CD，并以 8 美元的价格收购。出价为 12 美元，出价为 8 美元，中间价为 10 美元，价差为 4 美元。乐器是全价古典 CD（即使是肖邦夜曲）。

Example A CD exchange sells used full-price CDs for $12 and buys them for $8. The bid is $12, the offer is $8, the mid is $10, and the spread is $4. The instrument is a full-price classical CD (even for a Chopin nocturne).

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当多个属性与可能在多种类型中使用的行为相互作用时，这些属性应该合并成一个新的基本类型。
When multiple attributes interact with a behavior that might be used in several types, the attributes should be combined into a new fundamental type.

双向价格很常见，但有时也会使用单向价格。对单向价格进行建模比较棘手。一种方法是允许价格既可以是报价，也可以是数字。这在 C++ 等强类型语言中几乎不可能实现。即使在 Smalltalk 中，股票交易客户端也必须先确定价格返回的对象类型，才能对其进行任何操作。

Two-way prices are common, but sometimes one-way prices are used. Modeling one-way prices is somewhat tricky. One alternative is to allow the price either to be a quote or a number. This is nearly impossible in strongly typed languages such as C++. Even in Smalltalk the client of stock is forced to determine what kind of object the price returns before doing anything with it.

另一种方法是将报价设为数字的子类型。这种方法可行，因为报价可以进行算术运算，但除了打印之外，在操作股票价格时，客户端仍然需要注意报价和数字之间的差异。在 C++ 中，由于 number 不是内置类型，而 real 和 integer 是，因此除非提供了 number 类，否则不应使用此方法。

An alternative is to make the quote a subtype of the number. This can work because quotes can respond to arithmetic operations, but it still forces the client to be conscious of the differences whenever manipulating stock prices, other than for printing. In C++, where number is not a built-in type but real and integer are, this method should not be used unless a number class is provided.

另一种方案是将数字作为报价的子类型。从概念上讲，这确实很有吸引力。数字本质上就是简单的报价，很容易理解为每个数字实例都是一个报价实例，具有相同的出价和报价。（类似的论证也可以用来证明数字是复数的子类型。）尽管这种论证在概念上是合理的，但在接口模型中却行不通。要使数字成为报价的子类型，它必须继承报价的完整接口。报价仅适用于少数领域，而数字几乎适用于所有领域。从报价中创建子类型意味着报价将被应用于所有领域，包括许多报价行为并不适用的领域。报价的设计必须使其能够被数字访问，而不是反过来。

Another alternative is to make number a subtype of quote. Conceptually this has a definite appeal. Numbers are just simple quotes, and it is not too difficult to consider that every instance of a number is an instance of a quote, with identical bid and offer. (A similar argument can be used to say that number is a subtype of complex number.) Although the argument has conceptual merit, it falls down with an interface model. For a number to be a subtype of a quote, it must inherit the complete interface of the quote. A quote is only useful for a few domains, while a number is useful in almost every domain. Subtyping from a quote means that the quote is used in all domains, including many where the quote's behavior is not useful. A quote must be designed so it has visibility to number, and not the other way round.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果超类型处于狭窄领域而子类型被广泛使用，则不应使用泛化。
A generalization should not be used where the supertype is in a narrow domain and the subtype is widely used.

此时，我们应该考虑双向报价和单向报价之间的共性。有两种选择：要么将单向报价视为报价，即出价等于报价；要么对单向报价请求出价或报价是错误的。前者表明存在抽象报价，如图 9.12 所示；而后者则避免了任何此类概括。在第一种选择中，客户端可以以相同的方式处理单向报价和双向报价，而无需关注它们之间的差异。然而，这可能会导致不准确，因为客户端无法确定是否处理了双向报价的出价。因此，需要一个类型测试操作（`isTwoWay` 或 `hasType('TwoWayQuote')`），以便客户端进行测试。如果没有抽象报价，就不会出现这些不准确的情况，但客户端每次调用操作时都必须使用类型测试，以确定该操作是否可以安全使用。

At this point we should consider what commonalities exist between quotes in their two-way and one-way forms. Two alternatives exist: Either a one-way quote is treated as a quote, with the bid equal to the offer, or it is an error to ask for a bid or offer on a one-way quote. The former points to the presence of an abstract quote, as shown in Figure 9.12, while the latter avoids any such generalization. In the first alternative the client can treat the one-way and two-way quotes with the same behavior and not be concerned with differences. However, this can lead to inaccuracies because the client cannot be sure of dealing with the bid of a two-way quote. A type test operation (i sTwoWay or hasType ('TwoWayQuote')) is needed so that the client can make the test. With no abstract quote, these inaccuracies cannot occur, but the client must use the type test every time an operation is invoked to know whether the operation is safe to use.

图 9.12 带有子类型的摘要引用。

Figure 9.12 Abstract quote with subtypes.

单向价格被视为双向价格的一种特殊情况。

One-way prices are treated as a special case of two-way prices.

这项决定取决于忽略双向报价和单向报价之间差异的频率。如果几乎从不可接受，那么最好不要使用抽象报价类型。但是，如果经常可以接受（实践表明确实如此），那么我强烈建议使用抽象报价类型。需要注意的是，使用抽象报价并不会比不使用抽象报价给客户增加额外的工作量。当不需要区分双向报价和单向报价时，使用抽象报价反而可以节省精力。

The decision hinges on how often it is acceptable to ignore the difference between two- and one-way quotes. If it is almost never acceptable, then it is best not to have an abstract quote type. However, if it is frequently acceptable (which practice suggests it is), then I would strongly encourage the use of an abstract quote type. It is important to note that using the abstract quote never requires more effort by the client than not using one. It saves effort when the distinction is not required.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果两个相似类型之间的区别经常被忽略，则可以使用抽象超类型。如果它们之间的区别通常很重要，则不应使用抽象超类型。
If the difference between two similar types is often ignored, then an abstract supertype can be used. If the distinction between them is usually important, then an abstract supertype should not be used.
建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果抽象类型不需要客户端付出额外的努力就能使用，那么就应该提供它。
If an abstract type never needs more effort for a client to use it, then it should be provided.

图 9.11 使用单独的报价对象。

Figure 9.11 Using a separate quote object.

这是一种很好的方法，因为它将具体的职责整合到一个简单的 可重用概念中。

This is a good approach since it brings the particular responsibilities together into a simple reusable concept.

例如，美元/英镑汇率为0.6712/6。交易品种为美元/英镑。该交易品种的报价为：买入价0.6712，卖出价0.6716，中间价0.6714，点差0.0004。

Example The USD/GBP rate is 0.6712/6. The instrument is USD/GBP. This instrument has a quote with a bid of 0.6712, an offer of 0.6716, a mid of 0.6714, and a spread of 0.0004.

例如，一家 CD 交换店以 12 美元的价格出售二手全价 CD，并以 8 美元的价格收购。出价为 12 美元，出价为 8 美元，中间价为 10 美元，价差为 4 美元。乐器是全价古典 CD（即使是肖邦夜曲）。

Example A CD exchange sells used full-price CDs for $12 and buys them for $8. The bid is $12, the offer is $8, the mid is $10, and the spread is $4. The instrument is a full-price classical CD (even for a Chopin nocturne).

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当多个属性与可能在多种类型中使用的行为相互作用时，这些属性应该合并成一个新的基本类型。
When multiple attributes interact with a behavior that might be used in several types, the attributes should be combined into a new fundamental type.

双向价格很常见，但有时也会使用单向价格。对单向价格进行建模比较棘手。一种方法是允许价格既可以是报价，也可以是数字。这在 C++ 等强类型语言中几乎不可能实现。即使在 Smalltalk 中，股票交易客户端也必须先确定价格返回的对象类型，才能对其进行任何操作。

Two-way prices are common, but sometimes one-way prices are used. Modeling one-way prices is somewhat tricky. One alternative is to allow the price either to be a quote or a number. This is nearly impossible in strongly typed languages such as C++. Even in Smalltalk the client of stock is forced to determine what kind of object the price returns before doing anything with it.

另一种方法是将报价设为数字的子类型。这种方法可行，因为报价可以进行算术运算，但除了打印之外，在操作股票价格时，客户端仍然需要注意报价和数字之间的差异。在 C++ 中，由于 number 不是内置类型，而 real 和 integer 是，因此除非提供了 number 类，否则不应使用此方法。

An alternative is to make the quote a subtype of the number. This can work because quotes can respond to arithmetic operations, but it still forces the client to be conscious of the differences whenever manipulating stock prices, other than for printing. In C++, where number is not a built-in type but real and integer are, this method should not be used unless a number class is provided.

另一种方案是将数字作为报价的子类型。从概念上讲，这确实很有吸引力。数字本质上就是简单的报价，很容易理解为每个数字实例都是一个报价实例，具有相同的出价和报价。（类似的论证也可以用来证明数字是复数的子类型。）尽管这种论证在概念上是合理的，但在接口模型中却行不通。要使数字成为报价的子类型，它必须继承报价的完整接口。报价仅适用于少数领域，而数字几乎适用于所有领域。从报价中创建子类型意味着报价将被应用于所有领域，包括许多报价行为并不适用的领域。报价的设计必须使其能够被数字访问，而不是反过来。

Another alternative is to make number a subtype of quote. Conceptually this has a definite appeal. Numbers are just simple quotes, and it is not too difficult to consider that every instance of a number is an instance of a quote, with identical bid and offer. (A similar argument can be used to say that number is a subtype of complex number.) Although the argument has conceptual merit, it falls down with an interface model. For a number to be a subtype of a quote, it must inherit the complete interface of the quote. A quote is only useful for a few domains, while a number is useful in almost every domain. Subtyping from a quote means that the quote is used in all domains, including many where the quote's behavior is not useful. A quote must be designed so it has visibility to number, and not the other way round.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果超类型处于狭窄领域而子类型被广泛使用，则不应使用泛化。
A generalization should not be used where the supertype is in a narrow domain and the subtype is widely used.

此时，我们应该考虑双向报价和单向报价之间的共性。有两种选择：要么将单向报价视为报价，即出价等于报价；要么对单向报价请求出价或报价是错误的。前者表明存在抽象报价，如图 9.12 所示；而后者则避免了任何此类概括。在第一种选择中，客户端可以以相同的方式处理单向报价和双向报价，而无需关注它们之间的差异。然而，这可能会导致不准确，因为客户端无法确定是否处理了双向报价的出价。因此，需要一个类型测试操作（`isTwoWay` 或 `hasType('TwoWayQuote')`），以便客户端进行测试。如果没有抽象报价，就不会出现这些不准确的情况，但客户端每次调用操作时都必须使用类型测试，以确定该操作是否可以安全使用。

At this point we should consider what commonalities exist between quotes in their two-way and one-way forms. Two alternatives exist: Either a one-way quote is treated as a quote, with the bid equal to the offer, or it is an error to ask for a bid or offer on a one-way quote. The former points to the presence of an abstract quote, as shown in Figure 9.12, while the latter avoids any such generalization. In the first alternative the client can treat the one-way and two-way quotes with the same behavior and not be concerned with differ-ences. However, this can lead to inaccuracies because the client cannot be sure of dealing with the bid of a two-way quote. A type test operation (i sTwoWay or hasType ('TwoWayQuote')) is needed so that the client can make the test. With no abstract quote, these inaccuracies cannot occur, but the client must use the type test every time an operation is invoked to know whether the operation is safe to use.

图 9.12 带有子类型的摘要引用。

Figure 9.12 Abstract quote with subtypes.

单向价格被视为双向价格的一种特殊情况。

One-way prices are treated as a special case of two-way prices.

这项决定取决于忽略双向报价和单向报价之间差异的频率。如果几乎从不可接受，那么最好不要使用抽象报价类型。但是，如果经常可以接受（实践表明确实如此），那么我强烈建议使用抽象报价类型。需要注意的是，使用抽象报价并不会比不使用抽象报价给客户增加额外的工作量。当不需要区分双向报价和单向报价时，使用抽象报价反而可以节省精力。

The decision hinges on how often it is acceptable to ignore the difference between two- and one-way quotes. If it is almost never acceptable, then it is best not to have an abstract quote type. However, if it is frequently acceptable (which practice suggests it is), then I would strongly encourage the use of an abstract quote type. It is important to note that using the abstract quote never requires more effort by the client than not using one. It saves effort when the distinction is not required.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果两个相似类型之间的区别经常被忽略，则可以使用抽象超类型。如果它们之间的区别通常并不重要，则不应使用抽象超类型。
If the difference between two similar types is often ignored, then an abstract supertype can be used. If the distinction between them is usually im-portant, then an abstract supertype should not be used.
建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果抽象类型不需要客户端付出额外的努力就能使用，那么就应该提供它。
If an abstract type never needs more effort for a client to use it, then it should be provided.

抽象引用包含了所有子类型的行为，因为子类型上没有额外的操作或关联。通常我们不会使用子类来实现抽象引用的子类型化，尤其是在 C++ 中，这种基础对象通常使用包含关系。引用类中的内部标志是一种更合适的实现方式，特别是当我们经常需要解析双向引用（即将其转换为单向引用）以及反向解析时，这就需要动态分类。

The abstract quote subsumes all the behavior of the subtypes because there is no additional operation or association on the subtypes. Typically we do not use subclasses to implement the subtyping of an abstract quote, especially since such a fundamental object usually uses containment in C++. An internal flag in a quote class is a more likely implementation, especially since we often need to par a two-way quote (that is, turn it into a one-way quote) and vice versa, which requires dynamic classification.

隐性报价可以是买入报价或卖出报价，在这种情况下不需要双向报价。只有当买卖双方都需要报价时，才需要双向报价。

An implicit quote can be either a buy or a sell, in which case two-way prices are not needed. Only when both buying and selling are required are two-way quotes needed.

有时我们需要将合​​约价格以报价的形式呈现。通常情况下，当交易对手询问合约价格时，他们不会明确指出交易方向；在这种情况下，交易员会以报价的形式回复。通过保留报价，交易员可以记住合约报价时的点差。实际收取的费用可以根据合约方向和报价轻松推算出来。

Sometimes we want to represent the price of a contract as a quote. Often when counterparties ask the price for a contract, they do not specify the direction; in that case the trader replies with a quote. By holding on to the quote, the trader remembers what the spread was when the contract was quoted. The actual amount charged can easily be derived from the direction of the contract and the quote.

9.4 情景

9.4 Scenario

金融工具的价格永远不会恒定不变；否则，全球股票市场将黯然失色。我们需要能够展现价格随时间的变化，并记录这些变化的历史。我们可以通过在报价上添加时间点来实现这一点，如图 9.13 所示；也可以通过在金融工具与报价之间的关系上添加时间点来实现这一点，如图 9.14 所示。这两种方法之间的差异虽小，但意义重大。在前一种方法中，报价本身既要体现其双向性，又要体现其随时间变化的特性。而在后一种方法中，这两者是分开的。由于我认为报价是一种基本类型，应该尽可能保持简单，因此我更倾向于使用图 9.14 所示的方法。

The price of an instrument is never constant; otherwise, the stock markets of the world would be much less interesting places. We need to be able to show how prices can change over time and to keep a history of those changes. We can do this by placing a timepoint on the quote, as shown in Figure 9.13, or by placing a timepoint on the relationship between the instrument and the quote, as shown in Figure 9.14. The difference between the two methods is small but significant. In the former, the quote is responsible for both its two -way nature and its time-dependent behavior. In the latter method those responsibilities are separated. Since I see a quote as a fundamental type that should kept as simple as possible, I prefer to use the approach shown in Figure 9.14.

图 9.13 向引用中添加时间点。

Figure 9.13 Adding a timepoint to a quote.

时间点表示该报价对于该仪器而言何时是正确的。

The timepoint indicates at what time the quote is correct for the instrument.

在这些模型中，计算市场收盘价需要选取该市场中的所有股票，并查找每只股票的最新报价。另一种方法是将这些报价集合视为一个独立的对象——一个场景，如图 9.15 所示。该场景代表了市场状态。

In these models, finding the closing prices for a market involves taking all the stocks within that market and looking for the latest quotes for each stock. Another alternative is to treat this collection of quotes as an object in its own right—a scenario, as shown in Figure 9.15. The scenario represents the state

图 9.14 某股票在特定时间的价格。

Figure 9.14 A price made for a stock at a particular time.

这使得双向行为（报价） 与某个时间点的工具价值（价格）的概念区分开来。

This separates the two-way behavior (quote) from the notion of a value for an instrument at a timepoint (price).

图 9.15 情景

Figure 9.15 Scenario

这样就可以将同一时间的一组价格视为一个对象。

This allows a group of prices at a single time to be treated as a single object.

市场在某一特定时间点的状态，而场景中的要素则代表了该时间点的价格。

of the market at a certain point in time, and the elements within the scenario represent the prices at that point.

如果我们只想获取证券交易所公布的价格，那么情景分析似乎意义不大。通过分析非情景模型中的时间点，就能轻松生成情景。这里的关键问题是交易者从哪里获取价格。交易所的公开报价是价格来源之一。对于股票基金经理来说，另一个需要考虑的因素是未来可能的价格。基金经理和交易员的大部分精力都集中在管理投资组合的风险上，以应对市场状况的变化。这种风险管理涉及分析各种可能的情况，并考虑它们对资产价格的影响。

If we only want to capture the published prices of a stock exchange, then a scenario seems to add little to the picture. It is easily generated by looking at the timepoints in the nonscenario model. The important question here is where the trader gets prices. One source is the exchange's public quotes. For those that manage funds of stocks, another consideration is possible future prices. Much of the effort of fund managers and traders goes into managing the risks of their portfolios as market conditions change. This risk management involves looking at alternative situations and considering their effects on prices of assets.

例如，一位基金经理正在管理一个股票投资组合。她担心油价下跌的可能性，油价下跌会推高许多股票的价格，但也会压低另一些股票的价格，例如石油公司的股票。这位经理希望研究几种不同幅度的油价下跌，并分析它们对投资组合的影响。每一种油价下跌都会导致不同的结果。

Example A fund manager is managing a portfolio of stocks. She is concerned with the possibility of a fall in oil prices, which would boost the prices of many stocks but decrease the price of others, such as oil companies. This manager wants to look at several falls of differing magnitudes and consider how they affect a portfolio. Each of these falls leads to a different scenario.

例如，一位生产经理正在评估汽车的可能生产成本。原材料成本和人工成本是影响定价的工具变量。可以构建几个情景，每个情景对应不同的可能值。

Example A production manager is assessing likely production costs for cars. The costs of raw materials and labor are instruments concerned with pricing. Several scenarios can be constructed with different likely values for these instruments.

以上示例均为假设案例，旨在展示情景分析方法的优势。情景对象提供了一个基础框架，可以将假设案例中的所有因素整合在一起，从而便于对不同案例进行比较。

The above examples are hypothetical cases that show the strength of the scenario approach. The scenario object provides a base to pull together all the factors in a hypothetical case so that different cases can be compared easily.

我们还需要考虑那些没有单一价格发布机构的市场，例如外汇市场。在这种情况下，我们需要将价格发布方添加到模型中。图 9.16 和 9.17 展示了添加了价格发布方的早期模型。情景法和非情景法都有效，而风险管理中假设情景的需求再次成为决定性因素。

We also need to consider markets that do not have a single publisher for a price, such as the foreign exchange market. In such cases we need to add the party that is publishing the price to the model. Figures 9.16 and 9.17 show earlier models with publishing parties added. Both the scenario and non-scenario approaches are effective, and again the need for hypothetical scenarios for risk management is the deciding factor.

图 9.16 图 9.14 中的模型与出版方

Figure 9.16 Model in Figure 9.14 with a publishing party

图 9.17 图 9.15 中的模型与出版方。

Figure 9.17 Model in Figure 9.15 with a publishing party.

使用发布商是使用场景的另一个原因。

Using a publisher is one more reason to use a scenario.

例如，一位进出口商人正在考察多个欧洲国家的商品价格。我们可以构建一个情景来描述这些价格，其中交易标的物是这位商人感兴趣的商品。通过比较这些市场之间的价格差异（使用双向价格），他可以寻找价格差大于运输成本的交易机会（这个过程称为套利）。

Example An import/export merchant considers the prices of goods in a number of European countries. We can describe these prices by forming a scenario where the instruments are the goods he is interested in trading. By looking at the differences between these markets, using two-way prices, he can look for opportunities where the price difference is greater than the cost of transporting the goods (a process referred to as arbitrage).

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当需要将一组价格或费率作为一个整体来考虑时，应该使用情景分析。
Scenarios should be used when a combination of prices or rates should be considered as a group.
9.4.1 定义如何构建场景

价格从何而来？在某些情况下，这可能是一个简单的问题，例如，当价格由交易所公布时。但在其他情况下，尤其是在存在假设情景时，可能会采用更复杂的机制。

Where do prices come from? In some cases this can be a simple question, for instance, when prices are published by an exchange. In other cases, particularly when there are hypothetical scenarios, more complex schemes might be used.

总体而言，价格来源可分为三类：市场广泛引用的机构发布的报价、根据其他价格或市场特征计算得出的价格，以及单个交易员或分析师团队的意见。第一种情况（如图 9.18 所示）最为直接。获取相关信息需要明确的指示。通常，这些指示来自路透社等信息来源，会说明在哪里查找信息（例如，“第 3 页，以 IBM 开头的行的第二列”）。

In broad terms we can see three origins of a price: publication by some body that is widely quoted in the market, calculation from other prices or market characteristics, or the opinion of an individual trader or team of analysts. The first case, shown in Figure 9.18, is the most straightforward. Instructions are required to source the relevant information. Typically these instructions come from a source, such as Reuters, that tells where to look for information (for example, "Page 3, second column of the row starting IBM").

图 9.18 场景元素的来源。

Figure 9.18 Sourcing a scenario element.

该模型描述了特定元素的来源。

This model describes where a particular element comes from.

实际上，使用已公布的价格使得来源场景元素的报价成为派生报价。我们并非断言来源场景元素的报价，而是使用来源索引来派生它。因此，将报价链接设为派生链接是有道理的。如果链接永远无法断言，例如交易员记录直觉时，这样做是安全的。断言报价可能会导致问题，因为有时报价可以断言，有时则需要派生。一种解决方法是使用混合或期权派生关系的表示法（参见 Odell [2]，第 56 页）。但这似乎对派生问题过于敏感。我倾向于根据最常见的情况进行表示，并在支持文档中详细描述具体情况。

In effect, using a published price makes the quote for a sourced scenario element derived. Rather than asserting the quote for a sourced scenario element, we derive it using the sourcing index. There is thus an argument for making the link to a quote a derived link. This can be done safely if the link can never be asserted, as when a trader records a hunch. Asserting the quote can cause problems because sometimes the quote can be asserted and sometimes derived. One way out of this is to use a notation for hybrid or option ally derived relationships (see Odell [2], page 56). This seems to take the derived issue too far. I tend to notate according to the most common case and describe what happens precisely in the supporting documentation.

例如，分析师在分析邮购商品价格时，可以将每家公司视为一个信息来源。信息来源索引可以是产品目录中的页码。这样，就可以为每家零售商分别构建一个场景，也可以构建一个包含所有零售商的总体场景。除了询问某个乐器的价格之外，还可以询问诸如该乐器的最低价格和平均价格之类的问题。

Example An analyst looking at prices for mail order goods can treat each company as an information source. The sourcing index can be a page number in a catalog. There can then be a separate scenario for each retailer, or an overall scenario can be built that combines all retailers. Rather than asking for the price of an instrument, questions such as lowest price and average price of some instrument are supported.

图 9.18 将市场指标引入为一种超类型工具。这反映了情景中除了工具之外，还可以包含其他要素。对于衍生品而言，定价方法的一个重要组成部分是工具的波动率——该数值表示工具价值的变化幅度。波动率本身并非可交易的工具，但它以与工具相同的方式记录在情景中。因此，市场指标不仅包含工具，还包含波动率。

Figure 9.18 introduces market indicator as a supertype of instrument. This reflects the fact that scenarios can contain things other than instruments. For derivatives, an important part of the pricing approach is the volatility of an instrument—a number that indicates how much the value of the instrument is changing. This volatility is not an instrument that can be traded, but it is recorded in a scenario in the same way as an instrument. Hence a market indicator includes volatilities, as well as all instruments.

例如，外汇市场有很多市场指标并非金融工具，包括各种货币的利率和汇率波动性——汇率波动性表明汇率变化的幅度。

Example Foreign currency markets have many market indicators that are not instruments, including interest rates on the various currencies and the volatility of an exchange rate—an indication of how much the exchange rate is changing.

例如，一位分析师在研究邮购商品价格时，对牛仔裤价格的上涨很感兴趣。牛仔裤价格上涨可以作为市场指标，但并非交易工具。牛仔裤既是市场指标，也是交易工具。

Example An analyst looking at prices for mail order goods is interested in the increase in jeans prices. Jeans price increase becomes a market indicator but not an instrument. Jeans are both a market indicator and an instrument.

计算情景元素也很简单。关键在于要认识到，计算价格的算法本身就是一个对象。一个简单的例子是外汇交易中使用的交叉汇率。如果我们知道美元/德国马克和美元/英镑的汇率，那么我们可以计算英镑/德国马克的汇率，公式为 (美元/德国马克) / (美元/英镑)。我们可以用一个交叉汇率情景元素来表示这个计算，该元素通过一个子类型的情景元素来建模，该子类型引用交叉汇率分子和分母的其他情景元素，如图 9.19 所示。交叉汇率情景元素的报价则由分母和分子情景元素的报价计算得出。

Calculating scenario elements is also straightforward. The key is to accept that the algorithm for calculating the price can be an object in its own right. A simple example of this is cross-rates used in foreign exchange. If we know the exchange rates for USD/DEM and for USD/GBP, then we can calculate the exchange rate for GBP/DEM as (USD/DEM) / (USD/GBP). We can represent this by having a cross-rate scenario element, which we model by having a subtype of scenario element that references other scenario elements for the numerator and denominator of the cross-rate, as shown in Figure 9.19. The quote for the cross-rate scenario element is then derived from the quotes for the denominator and numerator scenario elements.

请注意，分母和分子均以情景要素而非市场指标表示。如果我们仅将交叉汇率表示为

Note that the denominator and numerator are expressed as scenario elements rather than market indicators. If we are just expressing cross-rates as

分子

numerator

图 9.19 通过交叉比率计算情景要素。这可用于

Figure 9.19 Calculating scenario elements by cross-rates. This can be used to

根据两种已知元素的比例，确定第三种元素。

determine a third element from the ratio of two known elements.

如上所述，参考市场指标似乎是最合理的（美元/英镑就是一个市场指标）。然而，提供情景分析的意义在于，允许我们在不同的假设条件下，针对同一市场指标发布多个不同的价格。参考情景分析要素可以帮助我们确定使用哪个价格。例如，美元/德国马克可能有两个数据：一个来自路透社，一个来自伦敦银行间同业拆借利率（LIBOR）。通过参考情景分析要素，我们可以指明我们想要使用哪个数据。

described above, then referencing the market indicators seems the most sensible (USD/GBP is a market indicator). However, the whole point of provid ing scenarios is to allow us to post several different prices, under different assumptions, for the same market indicator. Referencing the scenario element allows us to focus on which of these prices we are to use. There might be two USD/DEM figures: one from Reuters and one from LIBOR. By referencing the scenario elements, we are able to indicate which one we want.

例如，一位交易员是法郎专家。她利用德国马克 (DEM) 的交叉汇率来确定荷兰盾 (NLG) 和法郎 (FFR) 之间的汇率。她通过创建一个交叉汇率情景元素来实现这一点。该情景元素的市场指标是 NLG/FFR。分子部分，她使用路透社提供的 NLG/DEM 汇率；这是路透社情景中 NLG/DEM 交易品种的情景元素。然而，分母部分，她并没有从路透社获取 DEM/FFR 汇率；而是使用她自己基于专业知识构建的情景。因此，她通过不同情景中的情景元素来构建交叉汇率。

Example A trader is a specialist on the French franc. She determines the exchange rate between Dutch guilders (NLG) and French francs (FFR) by cross-rates using the German mark (DEM). She does this by creating a cross-rate scenario element. The market indicator for this scenario element is NLG/FFR. For the numerator she uses the NLG/ DEM rate quoted by Reuters; that is the scenario element for the instrument NLG/DEM in the Reuters scenario. However she does not get the DEM/FFR rate for the denominator from Reuters; instead she uses her own scenario (built on the basis of her own specialized knowledge). Thus she forms the cross-rate from scenario elements in different scenarios.

用于交叉率计算的方法也可用于多种常见计算，其中新的计算类型由场景元素的新子类型支持。图 9.20 展示了这种结构的概括。在这种情况下，计算场景元素包含一个场景元素列表作为参数和一个公式。该公式表示计算算法，它使用由计算场景元素提供的参数。对于交叉率，公式为 arg[1] / arg[2]。实际的参数由计算场景元素提供。这使得单个公式可以被多个计算场景元素重复使用。

The kind of approach used for cross-rates can be used for a number of common calculations, where new kinds of calculations are supported by new subtypes of the scenario element. Figure 9.20 shows a generalization of this structure. In this case the calculated scenario element has a list of scenario elements as arguments and a formula. The formula represents the algorithm for the calculation, which uses arguments provided to it by the arguments on the calculated scenario element. For the cross-rate the formula is arg[l] / arg[2]. The actual arguments are provided by the calculated scenario element. This allows a single formula to be reused by several calculated scenario

图 9.20 计算情景要素的更一般方法。

Figure 9.20 A more general approach to calculated scenario elements.

该公式可以是基于参数的电子表格式公式。它支持 场景元素的各种算术组合。

The formula can be a spreadsheet-style formula based on the arguments. It supports a range of arithmetic combinations of scenario element.

元素。英镑/德国马克交叉汇率使用参数为<USD/DEM, USD/GBP>的公式，英镑/日元交叉汇率使用参数为<USD/JPY, USD/GBP>的公式。请注意，参数必须以列表形式提供，而不是像通常的多值映射那样使用集合。位置对于公式的正确编写至关重要。

elements. The cross-rate for GBP/DEM uses the formula with arguments <USD/DEM, USD/GBP>, and the GBP/JPY cross-rate uses the arguments <USD/JPY, USD/GBP>. Note the importance of providing the arguments as a list rather than the usual set for multivalued mappings. The position is essential for the formulas to be correctly written.

例如，牛仔裤的价格变化是通过计算场景元素来计算的，该元素取今年场景下牛仔裤价格与去年场景下牛仔裤价格之间的差值。

Example The price change for jeans is calculated by a calculated scenario element that takes the difference between prices of jeans in this year's scenario and last year's scenario.

我们可以用几种方式实现这些公式。一种方法是将公式硬编码到实现语言中。由于常用公式（例如交叉比率）被广泛复用，因此在这种情况下硬编码并无劣势。如果公式数量较少且不经常更改，这是最佳方案。即使每月添加一个新公式，对于复杂的系统来说，控制起来也相当容易。如果我们想让用户能够添加公式，可以使用更复杂的方法。我们可以构建一个解释器[1]来识别一系列简单的公式表达式。任何使用过电子表格的用户都熟悉这种技术。我们可以提供一个交互式公式生成器，但任何能够构建公式的用户可能都能输入类似电子表格的公式。因此，解释器[1]无需识别所有可能的公式。一些公式由解析器生成，一些公式硬编码，这完全没问题。用于场景元素的软件并不关心公式是如何构建的，而是负责为公式提供参数，从而生成计算出的报价。遵循面向对象的最佳原则，接口与实现是分离的。（更多相关讨论请参见第 6.6 节。）

We can implement the formulas in several ways. One way is to hard-code formulas in the implementation language. Since common formulas (such as cross-rates) are widely reused, hard-coding is not a disadvantage in this case. If the number of formulas is small and does not change too often, this is the best approach. Even if a new formula is added every month, this would be fairly easy to control even for a complex system. We can use a more sophisticated approach if we want to give the user the ability to add formulas. We can build an interpreter [1] that recognizes a simple range of formulaic expressions. This technique is familiar to any user who has used spreadsheets. We could provide an interactive formula builder, but any user who can build a formula can probably type a spreadsheet-like formula. The interpreter [ 1 ] thus does not have to recognize all possible formulas. It is perfectly all right to have some formulas built by the parser and some hard-coded. The software for scenario elements does not care how a formula is built but is concerned with providing arguments to the formula that generate the calculated quote. Following the best principles of object-orientation, interface is separated from implementation. (For further discussion on this see Section 6.6.)

建模原理
Modeling Principle
要使某个过程成为某种类型的特征，该过程必须具有抽象接口，以便实现方式能够轻松地通过子类化而变化。纯粹的硬编码实现是一种子类；各种参数驱动的方法则是其他子类。
To make a process a feature of a type, the process must have an abstract interface so that the implementation can easily vary by subclassing. A purely hard-coded implementation is one subclass; various parameter driven approaches are others.

图 9.21 所示的交互图揭示了这种行为的一些有用之处。首先，请注意公式的输入是报价列表，而不是场景元素列表。这虽然略显随意，但输入与输出保持一致是一种值得遵循的策略。否则，程序员很容易对他们正在处理的对象类型感到困惑。当然，这假设所有算术运算都是基于报价定义的，而报价正是处理双向价格运算的理想场所。在这种情况下，我们可以设置公式，使其适用于任何支持算术运算的对象，而不仅仅是报价。

The interaction diagram shown in Figure 9.21 reveals some useful points about how this behavior might work. First note how the formula is given a list of quotes as input, rather than a list of scenario elements. This is mildly arbitrary, but providing the same thing as input as is returned as output is a useful policy to follow. Without this, coders can quickly get confused about the type of things they are dealing with. This, of course, assumes that the arithmetic operations are all defined with a quote, which would be a natural place to deal with two-way price arithmetic. In this case we can set up the formulas so that they work on anything that supported arithmetic, not only quotes.

图 9.21 计算场景元素的交互图。

Figure 9.21 Interaction diagram for calculated scenario elements.

由于 `getQuote` 操作会对所有参数调用 `getQuote`，因此其行为本质上是递归的，这可能会导致一长串的计算。与许多递归结构一样，这种递归结构非常巧妙（但很难在交互图中展现出来）。然而，在实践中，它会导致大量的冗余计算。我们需要一种缓存策略来存储计算出的报价值，以防止因对同一对象重复调用 `getQuote` 而导致不必要的重新计算。当然，与任何缓存一样，我们必须确保在源值发生变化时正确更新缓存。我们可以反向使用参数映射来重置所有依赖的场景元素。

The behavior is naturally recursive in that the getQuote operation calls getQuote on all the arguments, potentially resulting in a long chain of calculations. This, like many recursive structures, is very elegant (but difficult to show on an interaction diagram). In practice, however, it can lead to quite a number of redundant calculations. A caching policy for calculated quote values is needed to prevent unnecessary recalculation caused by repeated calls of getQuote to the same object. As with any cache, of course, we have to ensure that the cache is properly updated when a source value changes. We can use the arguments mapping in the reverse direction to reset all dependent scenario elements.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当可以从信息源检索信息或从其他可用数据计算信息时，应提供以信息源和计算为子类的抽象接口。
When information can be retrieved from an information source or calculated from other available figures, an abstract interface with sourcing and calculation as subclasses should be provided.

  2. Gamma, E., R. Helm, R. Johnson, and J. Vlissides. Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software. Reading, MA: Addison-Wesley, 1995.
  3. Martin, J. 和 J. Odell.面向对象方法：基础，Englewood Cliffs, NJ: Prentice-Hall, 1995。
