第十章 衍生合约

Chapter 10. Derivative Contracts

要充分理解本章内容，您需要先阅读第 9.1 节和第 9.2 节。衍生金融交易[3]在交易中扮演着越来越重要的角色。衍生交易是指其价值取决于另一种证券价值的交易。较简单的衍生品形式已经存在很长时间了；例如，股票期权于 1973 年首次在正规交易所进行交易。自那时以来，出现了越来越多更复杂的衍生品。它们对投资者来说很有价值，因为它们可以降低价格波动带来的风险。然而，如果管理不当，衍生品也可能带来危险：最近，在一些著名的案例中，一些机构因管理不善的衍生品而损失惨重。

To fully understand this chapter, you will need to read Sections 9.1 and 9.2 first. Derivative financial trades [3] are gaming an increasingly prominent role in trading. A derivative trade is one whose value depends on another security's value. The simpler forms of derivatives have been around for quite a while; for example, stock options were first traded on an organized exchange in 1973. Since then, more and more exotic variants of derivatives have appeared. They are valuable to investors because they reduce the risk that comes from changing prices. However, when they are not properly controlled, derivatives can be dangerous: Recently, in several famous cases, organizations have lost spectacular amounts of money on ill-managed derivatives.

对导数进行建模可以展现建模的许多有用方面，因为导数构成了一个自然的概括层次结构——比通常的动植物例子更有趣。因此，本章旨在以导数为例，探讨这种概括层次结构的一些问题。

Modeling derivatives brings out many useful aspects of modeling because derivatives form a natural generalization hierarchy—one that is more interesting than the usual examples of plants and animals. The purpose of this chapter, therefore, is to explore some of the problems of this kind of generalization hierarchy using derivatives as examples.

我们首先介绍简单的衍生品：远期合约（10.1）和期权（10.2）。远期合约引入了期限的概念，由此引出了日期计算为何比简单地将天数相加更为复杂的问题。期权则带来了一些建模上的难题：如何处理交易者对看涨期权和看跌期权的定义，以及期权与标的合约之间的关系。

We begin by introducing the simple derivatives: forward contracts (10.1) and options (10.2). Forward contracts introduce the notion of tenor, which leads to a discussion of why date calculations are more complicated than adding up days. Options present a couple of awkward modeling areas: han dling the trader's definitions of calls and puts, and the relationship between an option and the underlying contract.

组合期权是一种更为复杂的衍生品，可以看作是若干简单期权的聚合。从具有复合模式的期权中划分子类型并非总是有效；这就引出了乘积（10.3）模式。该模式基于卖方和交易者对交易的不同看法，也可应用于常规交易。它也说明了我们通常首先想到的概括方法，但概括并非总是最佳选择。

A more complex type of derivative, the combination option, can be seen as an aggregation of simpler options. Subtyping from options with the composite pattern is not always effective; this leads to the product (10.3) pattern. This pattern is based on the difference between the seller's and trader's views of the deal and can be applied to regular trading as well. It also serves as an example of how generalization is often the first method we think of using but is not necessarily the best.

使用子类型时，我们必须确保子类型的行为与超类型的行为保持一致。我们将以屏障选项为例，探讨子类型和状态图如何与子类型状态机交互（10.4）。

With subtyping we must ensure that the subtype's behavior is consistent with that of the supertype. Using barrier options as an example, we will explore how subtyping and state charts interact with subtype state machines (10.4).

如果我们有一系列选项，我们可以选择使用浏览器，根据选项的类型突出显示相关细节。这会导致应用程序层级和领域层级并行出现的情况（10.5）。这两个层级耦合得非常不协调。这种模式带来了一些问题，虽然有多种解决方案，但没有一种是万能的。

If we have a portfolio of options, we can choose to have a browser that highlights pertinent details, depending on the kind of option. This leads to a situation where there are parallel application and domain hierarchies (10.5). The two hierarchies are awkwardly coupled. This pattern poses a problem with several solutions, none of which is all-powerful.

关键概念：远期合约、期限、期权、产品

Key Concepts Forward Contract, Tenor, Option, Product

10.1 远期合约

10.1 Forward Contracts

第 9.1 节讨论的合约较为简单，涉及即时交易。大多数市场涉及一系列更为复杂的交易。其中最简单的就是远期合约。普通合约（通常称为现货合约）的交割日期尽可能接近合约交易日，通常在几天内完成。远期合约则是约定在未来某个时间进行交易。例如，一家公司将在两个月后收到一艘满载石油的油轮，需要支付数百万美元。然而，如果该公司是德国公司，其通常以马克进行融资。如果未来两个月美元/马克汇率发生显著变化，该公司可能最终需要支付的马克金额将超出预期，这可能会造成重大问题。当然，汇率的有利变化也会使该公司受益；但这种不确定性对该公司不利。为了降低这种不确定性，该公司可以选择签订远期外汇合约，预先支付约定的马克金额，以换取两个月后交付的美元。该价格由执行交易的银行根据市场对未来几个月美元/马克汇率走势的预期而定。此类交易的期限通常为两个月（而非即期）。

The contracts discussed in Section 9.1 are simple and involved in immediate deals. Most markets involve a range of more complex deals. The simplest of these is the forward contract. With a normal contract, often referred to as a spot contract, delivery occurs as close as possible to the date on which the contract is traded. Delivery usually occurs in a couple of days. Forward contracts are agreements to do a deal some time in the future. For example, a company is due to receive a tanker full of oil in two months. The company will have to pay several million dollars for this oil. However, if the company is German, its normal financing is done in marks. If the dollar/mark exchange rate changes significantly in the next two months, the company could find itself having to pay more marks than it expected, which could be a significant problem. Of course, the company would also gain from a favorable change in exchange rates; but the uncertainty is not good for the company. To allay this uncertainty, the company could choose to buy several million dollars in a forward contract exchange rate deal, paying an agreed amount of marks now for delivery of dollars in two months. The price is offered by the bank who is carrying out the deal based on the market's perception of where the dollar/ mark rate is likely to go in the next couple of months. Such a deal is said to have a tenor of two months (as opposed to a tenor of spot).

如图 10.1 所示，远期合约可以通过分别设置合约的交易日期和交割日期来轻松表示。即期交易的交易日期和交割日期通常比较接近，而远期合约的交易日期和交割日期则相隔两个月。虽然无需使用子类型来表示这一点，但为了更清晰地展示，我们也可以添加一个子类型。

A forward contract is quite easily captured by holding separate trade and delivery dates for the contract, as shown in Figure 10.1. A spot deal will have suitably close trade and delivery dates, while a forward contract deal will have these dates separated by two months. A subtype is not needed to show this, although we can add one for clarity.

图 10.1 可支持远期合约的合约。

Figure 10.1 A contract that can support forward contracts.

期限是根据交易日期和交割日期之间的差额来确定的。

The tenor is based on the difference between trade and delivery dates.

例如， Aroma Coffee Makers公司于1997年1月1日同意从Brazil Coffee Exports公司购买5000吨巴西咖啡。交货日期定于1997年10月20日，价格按当日价格确定。

Example Aroma Coffee Makers agrees on January 1, 1997 to buy 5000 tons of Bra zilian coffee from Brazil Coffee Exports. Delivery is set for October 20, 1997, and the price is set at today's price.

例如，我购买了一张三个月后的机票，支付了当前报价。

Example I buy an airline ticket for travel in three months, paying the price currently quoted for the journey.

讨论远期合约时，合约期限是一个重要的考虑因素。合约期限是指交易日和交割日之间的时间段，在本例中为两个月。市场报价通常会考虑特定的合约期限，因此合约期限是合约对价的重要组成部分。然而，合约期限并非仅仅指交易日和交割日之间的时间。如果我们的两个月合约在5月4日交易，交割日不会是7月4日，因为7月4日是美国的公共假日。公共假日对交割日的计算方式有很大影响。假设7月4日不是周末，那么5月4日交易的两个月合约将在7月5日交割。需要注意的是，如果德国在7月5日是公共假日，交割日将顺延一天。即使交割日与交割日为两个月零一天的合约相同，该合约的合约期限仍然是两个月。请注意，现货合约也必须遵循此规则：即使现货交易按两天结算，周四达成的交易也将在周一交割（除非周一是节假日）。因此，图 10.1 包含了交易日、交割日和期限。

An important consideration when discussing forward contracts is the tenor of the contract. The tenor is the period between the trade date and the delivery date, in our example two months. Prices are generally quoted on the market with a particular tenor in mind, and the tenor is an important part of the contract's consideration. However, the tenor is not simply the duration between trade and delivery dates. If our two-month contract is traded on May 4, the delivery date will not be on July 4, simply because the 4th of July is a holiday in the United States. Holidays have a big impact on how these dates are calculated. Assuming July 4 does not fall on a weekend, a two-month contract dealt on May 4 will take delivery on July 5. Note that if for some reason Germany had a holiday on July 5, the delivery date would be shifted forward another day. The contract still has a tenor of two months, even though its delivery date is the same as a contract with a delivery date of two months and one day. Note that this behavior is required for spot contracts as well: a deal done on a Thursday will be delivered on a Monday (unless it is a holiday) even though spot is taken as two days. Hence Figure 10.1 includes trade date, delivery date, and tenor.

在这种结构中，仅凭交易日期和期限无法计算交割日期。如果不考虑节假日，我们可以通过日期和期限之间的简单计算来确定交割日期。然而，市场节假日必须考虑在内。这意味着市场具有日期计算程序，可以对节假日进行调整，如图 10.2 所示。在许多工作日概念至关重要的领域，考虑节假日是一项重要的功能。通常无法在全球范围内确定工作日，因为节假日因国家/地区而异，甚至可能更加细致。各个地区也可能有影响工作日计算的本地节假日惯例。

In this kind of structure, the calculation of the delivery date is not something that can be done by the trade date and tenor alone. Without considering holidays, we can determine the delivery date by a simple calculation between date and tenor. However, the market holidays have to be taken into account. This means that the market has a date calculation routine that allows it to adjust for holidays, as shown in Figure 10.2. This consideration of holidays is an important feature in many areas, where the concept of working days becomes important. It is usually not possible to determine working days globally because holidays vary from country to country, or possibly with even greater granularity. Individual sites may also have local holiday conventions that will affect working day calculations.

图 10.2 让市场计算日期。

Figure 10.2 Getting the market to calculate dates.

当需要计算工作日时，日期计算通常需要委托给另一个对象。

Date calculations often need to be delegated to another object when working days need to be calculated.

例如，某公司需要在 1997 年 6 月 30 日起的五个工作日内向一名员工支付款项。如果是一家美国公司，则截止日期为 7 月 8 日（不包括周末和 7 月 4 日）；如果是一家英国公司，则截止日期为 7 月 7 日。

Example A company needs to make a payment to an employee within five working days from June 30,1997. If it is a US company, this is by July 8 (skipping over weekends and July 4); for a UK company it is July 7.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
日期计算通常会受到节假日的影响，因此需要忽略节假日。节假日因国家/地区而异，而且往往也因相关组织而异。
Date calculations are often affected by holidays, which need to be skipped over. Holidays vary from country to country and often by the organizations involved.

10.2 选项

10.2 Options

对于我们这家德国石油公司而言，远期合约是降低汇率波动风险的有效工具，避免因汇率波动导致石油价格上涨。但如果汇率朝着有利于该公司的方向发展，该公司也面临亏损的风险。财务总监实际上需要押注汇率走势。如果他们认为马克会上涨，就应该在现货市场购买；如果他们认为马克会下跌，就应该购买远期合约。期权可以降低这种风险。期权赋予买方在预先约定的汇率下购买美元的权利。因此，如果马克下跌，石油公司可以行使期权，以预先约定的价格购买美元；如果美元上涨，他们可以放弃期权（任其到期），直接在现货市场购买。银行向石油公司收取期权溢价，因此风险实际上是由银行管理的。由于银行处理大量此类交易，他们可以对冲不同交易的风险。图 10.3 和图 10.4 描述了期权的行为。

For our German oil company, a forward contract is a valuable tool for reducing the risk of an exchange rate change that would cause them to pay more for their oil. But the company does run the risk of losing out should the exchange rate change in their favor. Financial directors essentially have to bet on the exchange rate movement. If they think the mark will go up, they should buy on the spot market; if they think it will go down, they should buy forward contracts. Options reduce this risk. An option gives the buyer the right to buy dollars at a prearranged exchange rate if the holder wishes. Thus, if the mark goes down, the oil company can exercise its option and buy the dollars at the prearranged price; if the dollar goes up they can ignore their option (let it expire) and buy on the spot market. The bank charges a premium to the oil company to sell them the option, so the bank now manages the risk. Since the bank handles many such deals, they can offset the risks of various deals against each other. Figures 10.3 and 10.4 describe the behavior of an option.

价内期权

option in the money

图 10.3 使用选项的过程事件图。

Figure 10.3 Event diagram for the process of using an option.

期权只能在到期日开始后才能行使，并且只有在期权“处于价内”时才能行使，也就是说，行使期权比 按当前价格进行现货交易更划算。

An option can only be exercised after the start of the expiration date and will only be exercised if it is "in the money," that is, if exercising the option is a better deal than a spot trade at the current price.

图 10.4 Harel 状态图，用于说明期权的行为方式。

Figure 10.4 Harel state chart to illustrate how an option behaves.

该期权只能在到期日行使（“欧式”期权）。

The option can only be exercised on its expiration date (a "European" option).

期权的许多特征与普通合约类似。与普通合约一样，期权也有交易对手方和交易日期。期权的其他特征包括到期日、权利金金额以及权利金交付日期。

Many features of the option are similar to that of a normal contract. Like a normal contract, options have counterparties and trade dates. Other features of the option include the expiration date, the amount of premium, and date the premium is delivered.

因此，我们可以将期权视为合约的一种子类型，如图 10.5 所示。期权结构的一个关键特征是其多态运算价值（情景）。现货合约的价值很容易理解，因为它只是将给定情景下的现货汇率应用于合约金额的结果。而期权的价值计算则要复杂得多。最常用的方法是布莱克-斯科尔斯分析法[3]。本书篇幅有限，无法详细解释其原理，只需指出，就调用此运算的一方而言，它只是一个单一的运算。复杂的数学运算可以巧妙地隐藏在运算本身之中。

Thus we can consider an option to be a subtype of a contract, as shown in Figure 10.5. A key feature of the option structure is the polymorphic operation value (Scenario). The value of a spot contract is easy to understand because it is simply the result of applying the spot exchange rate in the provided scenario to the amount of the contract. Options are rather more complex to value, to put it mildly. The most common technique is Black-Scholes analysis [3]. An explanation of this is beyond the scope of this book, except to point out that as far as the caller of this operation is concerned, it is a single operation. The complexities of the mathematics can safely be hidden within the operation.

图 10.5 期权的结构。

Figure 10.5 Structure of an option.

看涨期权和看跌期权这两个术语源于多头和空头交易。

Call and put are terms derived from the longs and shorts.

10.2.1 多头、空头、看涨期权和看跌期权：表示复杂的术语

多空问题确实需要讨论。在9.1节中，我们解释了合约可以做多（买入）或做空（卖出）。然而，对于期权而言，我们发现有四种可能的选择：我们可以卖出期权来卖出资金，卖出期权来买入资金，买入期权来卖出资金，或者买入期权来买入资金。合约本身仍然存在多空选择，但期权本身又增加了多空选择。交易者的词汇包括看涨期权和看跌期权。看涨期权是买入期权（即做多合约），而看跌期权是卖出期权（即做空合约）。当然，我们可以买入或卖出看涨期权，也可以买入或卖出看跌期权。用这些术语来表达既复杂又容易让人困惑。

The question of longs and shorts does need discussion. In Section 9.1 we explained that a contract can be long (buy) or short (sell). For options, however, we find that there are four possible choices. We can sell an option to sell money, sell an option to buy money, buy an option to sell money, or buy an option to buy money. The long/short choice still exists on the contract, but it is supplemented by a further long/short choice on the option. The trader's vocabulary includes the terms call and put. A call is an option to buy (that is, a long contract), while a put is an option to sell (a short contract). Naturally we can buy or sell a call, or buy or sell a put. Repr esenting this language is somewhat tricky, as well as confusing.

如果我卖出日元期权，交易对手可以在到期日从我这里购买日元。这与远期合约的区别在于，交易对手可以选择不购买。如果我买入日元期权，头寸情况相同，但行使期权的控制权现在掌握在我手中。无论哪种情况，我（可能）都持有日元空头头寸，因此合约是空头头寸。在前一种情况下，期权也是空头头寸；而在后一种情况下，期权是多头头寸。在前一种情况下，交易者会说他们卖出（做空）了一份看涨期权；在后一种情况下，他们会说他们买入（做多）了一份看跌期权。

If I sell an option to buy yen, then the counterparty can buy yen from me at the expiration date. The difference between this and a forward is that the counterparty can choose not to. If I buy an option to sell yen, then the position is the same, but the control over exercising the option is now mine. Either way, I am (potentially) short on yen, hence the contract is short. In the former the option is also short, while in the latter the option is long. In the first case traders would say they are selling (short) a call, and in the second they would say they are buying (long) a put.

一种理解方式是，我们可以用“看涨期权”/“看跌期权”来代替合约的长/短描述。但这实际上行不通，因为我们不会在非期权合约中使用“看涨期权”和“看跌期权”这样的术语。

One way of looking at this would be to say that we could replace the long/ short description of a contract by call/put. But this does not really work because we do not use the terms call and put on contracts that are not options.

另一种可能性是仅用“多头”和“空头”来表示期权的状态，而非合约的状态。因此，上面的第一个例子是卖出看涨期权，第二个例子是买入看跌期权。这对于交易员来说可能比较容易理解，但很容易让软件感到困惑。在评估风险时，合约数量的位置非常重要，而上述两个例子都是空头。因此，我们需要能够查询合约的方向（这定义了仓位）、期权的方向以及看涨/看跌期权。所以这两个例子分别是（空头合约，空头期权，看涨期权）和（空头合约，买入期权，看跌期权）。显然，其中一个可以从另外两个推导而来。图表显示看涨/看跌期权是推导出来的。这种推导是为了提醒开发者，某个是推导出来的，而不是对实际存储或计算内容的任何指示。

Another possibility is to use the terms long and short for options only to indicate the state of the option rather than the contract. Thus the first example above would be a short call and the second a long put. This might make sense to a trader but would be apt to confuse any software. When evaluating risk, the position of the amount of the contract is important, and in the above examples both are short. Hence we need to be able to ask the direction of the contract (which defines the position), the direction of the option, and the call/put. So the two examples are (short contract, short option, call) and (short contract, long option, put). Clearly one of these can be derived from the other two. The diagram indicates that call/put is derived. The derivation is a reminder that one is derived rather than any direction to an implementor of what is actually stored or calculated in the implementation.

表达这类语言总是有点棘手，尤其当它看起来不合逻辑的时候。重要的是以合乎逻辑的方式表达基本概念。这些基本概念可能是领域专家的术语，也可能是在建模过程中创建的（但如果是创建的，领域专家必须对其感到满意）。其余的术语都可以从这些基本概念中推导出来。

Representing language like this is always a bit of a battle, particularly when it seems unnecessarily illogical. The important thing is to represent the fundamentals in a logical manner. These fundamentals may be part of the domain expert's terminology or invented during the modeling process (but if they are invented, the domain expert must be comfortable with them). The rest of the terminology can then be derived from these fundamentals.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
衍生标记应该用于定义从模型中其他结构衍生出的术语。
Derived markers should be used to define terminology that is derived from other constructs on the model.
建模原理
Modeling Principle
将某个特征标记为派生特征是对接口的一种约束，它不会影响底层数据结构。
Marking a feature as derived is a constraint on the interface. It does not affect the underlying data structures.

例如， 1997年6月1日，我获得一份期权，可以在1999年1月1日以每股5美元的价格购买200股Aroma Coffee Makers公司的股票。这份期权的交易日期为1997年6月1日，标的物为Aroma Coffee Makers公司的股票，数量为200股，交割日和到期日均为1999年1月1日，期权费为0美元，行权价格为5.1美元。因此，该合约（对我而言）是多头合约，期权也是多头合约（因为我持有该期权）；因此，这是一份看涨期权。

Example On June 1, 1997, I am given an option to buy 200 shares of Aroma Coffee Makers on January 1,1999 at a price of $5 per share. This is an option with a trade date of June 1, 1997, an instrument of Aroma Coffee Makers stock, an amount of 200, delivery and expiration dates of January 1,1999, a premium of $0, and a price of $5.1 will gain shares, so the contract is long (with respect to me), and the option is also long (since I hold it); it is thus a call.

例如，当我预订航班时，机票上会提供一个提前取消的选择权。该选择权的有效期就是机票必须出票的日期。

Example When I make a reservation for a flight, I am being given a call option on the ticket. The expiration date of the option is the date the reservation must be ticketed.

另一个需要考虑的问题是交割日期和到期日之间的交互。对于期权，如果已知到期日，则可以计算交割日期（交割日期 = 到期日 + 现货价格）。但反过来则不然（因为节假日会造成干扰）。这意味着，对于期权，交割日期是一个计算映射。关键在于接口没有改变：仍然有一个用于访问交割日期的访问器；但是，该信息会被存储起来。有两种方法可以描述这种情况：我们可以指出（通常在术语表中），对于期权，交割日期属性会被重写，并根据公式从到期日计算得出。另一种方法是将该公式描述为期权类型的约束。两种方法都完全合理，选择哪种方法取决于个人偏好。最终使用哪种代码和数据结构完全由实现者决定。

Another concern is the interaction between delivery date and expiration date. For an option, the delivery date can be computed if the expiration date is known (delivery date = expiration date + spot). The reverse is not true, however (due to the interference of holidays). This means that, for options, delivery date is a computed mapping. The important point here is that the interface does not change: There is still an accessor for delivery date; however, the information is stored. There are two alternatives to describe this situation: We can note (typically in the glossary) that for options the delivery date attribute is overridden and calculated from the expiration date according to the formula. Another option is to describe the formula as a constraint on the option type. Both are perfectly reasonable and the choice is a matter of taste. It is entirely up to the implementor what code and data structure to use.

10.2.2 是否进行子类型划分

图 10.5 所示的结构并非处理期权的唯一方式；图 10.6 展示了另一种选择。两种结构的区别在于如何将期权属性添加到合约中。在图 10.5 中，我们通过子类型化来添加期权属性。在这种方案中，期权是一种具有附加属性和某些可变行为的合约。在图 10.6 中，我们可以说期权有一个基础合约，交易者通常将其称为期权的标的资产。这里至少存在某种包含性的概念，尤其体现在我们不太可能要求作为期权标的资产的合约对其自身进行估值。同样，交割日期将取决于期权的到期日。

The structure shown in Figure 10.5 is not the only way to handle options; another choice is shown in Figure 10.6. The difference between the two structures is how the optionality is added to the contract. In Figure 10.5 we add it by subtyping. In this scheme an option is a kind of contract with additional properties and some variant behavior. In Figure 10.6 we may say that an option has a base contract often referred to by traders as the underlying of the option. There is at least some notion of containment here, especially in the fact that we would not be likely to ask the contract to value itself if it was an underlying to an option. Similarly the delivery date would be dependent on the option's expiration date.

在这两种结构之间做出选择并不容易。它们各有千秋。图 10.6 模型将期权和合约的概念与明确的标的资产的概念区分开来。这种方案的一个缺点是，一个合约需要用两个对象来表示。修改图 10.6 来处理复合期权（标的资产本身也是期权）相对容易。由于两者之间的选择余地很小，我们很容易陷入僵局。原型设计有时可以帮助我们理清思路，但并非总是如此。当出现这样的替代方案时，最好先采用更简单的方法，必要时再切换到更复杂的方法。然而，就本例而言，哪种方法更简单尚有争议。当两者如此接近时，我倾向于相信领域专家的直觉，询问他们哪种方法更合适。我们将继续以图 10.5 为基础进行进一步讨论。

The choice between the two structures is not easy. Both have elegant qualities. The Figure 10.6 model separates the notion of option and contract with a definite notion of underlying. One disadvantage of this scheme is that a single contract is represented by two objects. It is easier to alter Figure 10.6 to handle compound options (options where the underlying is an option). With so little choice between them, we can easily end up getting bogged down. Prototyping can sometimes clarify the situation b ut not always. When alternatives like this present themselves, it's a good idea to use the simpler approach and then change to the more complicated one later if necessary. With this case, however, it is arguable which is the simpler. When it is this close, I trust the domain experts' instincts by asking them which feels best. We will continue to use Figure 10.5 as the basis for further discussion.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当面临多种方法时，首先选择最简单的方法，然后根据需要改为更复杂的方法。
When faced with alternative approaches, choose the simplest first and change to a more complex one as needed.
建模原理
Modeling Principle
当建模方案之间没有太大区别时，要听从领域专家的直觉。
When there is little to choose between modeling alternatives, follow the instincts of the domain expert.

图 10.6 期权和合约的独立对象方法。

Figure 10.6 The separate object approach to options and contracts.

图 10.5 和本文所述方法都是合理的替代方案，尽管本章在此基础上进行了扩展。

Both this and Figure 10.5 are reasonable alternatives, although this chapter builds on

图 10.5。

Figure 10.5.

10.3 产品

10.3 Product

衍生品交易长期以来被认为风险较高，主要是因为评估风险需要复杂的数学运算。作为大部分评估过程基础的布莱克-斯科尔斯方程[3]是一个二阶偏微分方程。即使我拥有工程背景，这些动物仍然让我感到毛骨悚然。

Derivative trades have long been considered somewhat risky, mainly because of the complex mathematics required to evaluate risk. The Black-Scholes equation [3], which serves as the building block for much of the evaluation process, is a second-order partial differential equation. Even with an engineering background, these animals still give me the willies.

衍生品交易陷阱最引人注目的例子莫过于英国历史悠久的巴林银行倒闭。据最新报道，导致巴林银行倒闭的主要原因是交易了一种名为跨式期权（straddle）的特殊衍生品——跨式期权是一种组合期权。组合期权可以看作是其他期权的组合。因此，以跨式期权为例来讨论这一部分内容似乎很合适。

The most spectacular example of the pitfalls of derivatives trading is the collapse of Britain's venerable Barings Bank. According to current reports, the primary cause of the collapse was dealing in a particular kind of derivative called a straddle—an example of a combination option. Combination options can be seen as a composite of other options. It seems appropriate to discuss this section with straddles as an example.

跨式期权策略的概念其实很简单。假设你持有价值约7000万美元的股票（具体价值取决于价格），你担心未来三个月内其价值的大幅波动。价格上涨或下跌都会带来问题。为了规避风险，你可以买入一份看涨期权和一份看跌期权，两者的价格均为7000万美元，到期日均为三个月。假设每份期权的权利金为250万美元。如果价格上涨，你可以行使看涨期权，获得新价格下股票的价值减去7000万美元和500万美元的权利金。因此，如果股票价值上涨到7500万美元以上，你就能获利。同样，如果股票价值下跌到6500万美元以下，你也能获利。最糟糕的情况是价格保持不变，在这种情况下，你将损失500万美元的权利金。跨式期权策略的吸引力在于，它用固定的风险覆盖了原本可能非常大的波动范围。当然，波动性较大的金融工具可能会导致跨式期权溢价较高，但如果您想在波动性较大的市场环境中降低风险，这可能是一种非常有用的产品。

The concept of a straddle is in fact very simple. You have a holding worth some $70 million, depending on prices, and you are concerned about any large change in its value over the next three months. Either going up or down will cause a problem. To avoid the problem, you can buy a call and a put, both with a price of $70 million and an expiration in three months. Let's assume the premium on each of these is $2.5 million. If the price goes up you exercise the call and you gain the value of the holding at the new price, less $70 million and the $5 million total premium. Thus if the value of the holding rises above $75 million you are happy. Similarly if the value falls below $65 million you are happy. The worst thing that can happen is that the price stays steady, in which case you lose the $5 million premium. The attractiveness of a straddle comes from a fixed risk that covers an otherwise very wide range of movement. Naturally a very volatile instrument can result in a higher premium for the straddle, but if you are trying to reduce your risk in a volatile environment, this can be a very useful product.

当然，如果你是卖方，面临的情况就更加棘手：如果价格大幅波动，你可能会损失惨重。这正是导致某家银行破产的原因。同样，该银行本应通过其他交易来对冲这种风险。

If you are the seller, of course, you are faced with a more tricky prospect: You can lose an unlimited amount of money if the price moves a large amount. This is indeed what caused a certain bank to lose its barings. Again, the bank should have used other trades to hedge this risk.

在对这种跨式期权进行建模时，我们应立即注意到它由两个期权组成，这两个期权受到价格、日期、方向和标的资产的约束。图 10.7 展示了一个作为期权子类型的跨式期权模型。作为一种组合期权，它可以包含多个组成部分，而跨式期权的约束条件定义了这些组成部分的具体特征。其他组合期权的子类型则用于其他常见情况，例如价差期权、勒式期权等等。

In modeling this straddle we should immediately note that it is composed of two options that are constrained by their prices, dates, direction, and instruments. Figure 10.7 shows a straddle modeled as a subtype of an option. As a combination option it can have components, with the constraint on the straddle defining the precise characteristics. Other subtypes of combinations would be used for other common cases: spreads, strangles, and the like.

图 10.7 将跨式期权建模为期权的子类型。

Figure 10.7 Modeling straddles as subtypes of options.

跨式期权是将看涨期权和看跌期权结合起来的一种策略。

A straddle is a combination of a call and a put.

使用子类型可以确认跨式期权是一种期权，并且其行为与其超类型相同。但这引出了一个问题。某些行为可以安全地继承，例如自我定价和交易日期。我们可以将期权费视为组成期权的期权费之和。但是价格呢？对于跨式期权，所有组成期权的价格都相同，因此我们可以将其视为跨式期权的价格。然而，另一种常见的组合是价差期权。如前所述，价差期权包含两个期权，但这两个期权方向相同（即两个看涨期权或两个看跌期权），价格不同。在这种情况下，价格是什么？回到跨式期权，它是看涨期权还是看跌期权？

Use of the subtype confirms that a straddle is a kind of option and has the same behavior as its supertype. This raises a question, however. Some behavior can be safely inherited, such as the ability to value itself and the trade date. We can think of the premium as the sum of premiums of the component options. But what about the price? For a straddle, the components are all priced the same, so we could consider it to be the price of the straddle. Another common combination, however, is the spread. As previously mentioned, a spread is two options, but both options are the same direction (that is, two calls or two puts) at different prices. What is the price in this case? Going back to the straddle, is it a call or a put?

图 10.8 展示了一种解决这个问题的方法。那些在两个层面上都合理的属性可以放在一个期权上，而那些不合理的属性则放在一个普通的期权上。这种方法在一定程度上有所帮助，但当我们意识到价格是在合约而非期权上定义的，并且存在一些将期权与普通合约结合的组合（例如备兑看涨期权和保护性看跌期权）时，这种方法就开始失效了。同样，这种概括可以进行调整，但人们不禁要问，哪些属性可以安全地放在超类型上呢？

Figure 10.8 shows one way of dealing with this problem. Those attributes that can make sense at both levels can be put on an option, while the awkward attributes are placed on a conventional option. This helps to some extent but begins to fail as we recall that price was defined on the contract not the option, and that there are combinations (such as covered calls and protected puts) that combine options with regular contracts. Again, the generalization could be manipulated, but one wonders what could safely be put on the supertype.

图 10.8 将亚型分为组合型和常规型。

Figure 10.8 Separating the subtypes into combination and conventional.

这些问题足以引发人们对同时使用组合合约和子类型合约的严肃质疑。主要问题在于，交易员在进行风险管理时，实际上并不关注组合合约本身。组合合约不过是组成合约的集合。我们认为其风险与将合约出售给同一投资组合中的不同交易对手方的风险相同。是客户和销售人员构成了组合合约，并将这些合约视为一个组合。一旦组合合约完成交易，其运作方式与其他任何合约并无二致。

These concerns are enough to raise a serious question about using composition and subtyping together. The main problem is that, when managing risk, traders do not actually concern themselves with combinations. A combination is nothing more than the component contracts. We consider its risk the same as if the contracts were sold to separate counterparties in the same portfolio. It is the customer and the salesperson who form the combination and think of the contracts as a combination. Once the combination is dealt it behaves no differently than any other contract.

这就引出了图 10.9 所示的模型。在这个模型中，销售人员的视角与风险经理的视角被明确区分开来。风险经理看到的是合同，这些合同由销售人员组合成产品。跨式套利现在是一种特殊的产品。这使我们能够重新审视合同的行为，并将与销售相关的行为转移到产品层面，同时将风险方面的问题留给合同本身。这包括产品的参与方，他们通常与风险管理无关（除非正在考虑对特定参与方的风险敞口）。由于合同必须与产品相关联（这是强制性的），因此合同仍然可以通过与产品协作来找到参与方（但请参阅 10.3.1 节中的讨论）。

This leads us to the model shown in Figure 10.9. Here the salesperson's view is explicitly separated from that of the risk manager. The risk manager sees contracts, which are assembled into a product by a salesperson. The straddle is now a particular kind of product. This allows us to reconsider the behavior of the contract and move the sales-related behavior to the product while leaving the risk side of things to the contract. This includes the parties to the product who are generally irrelevant to risk management (unless exposure to a particular party is being considered). Since contracts must have a product (due to the mandatory relationship), a contract can still find its parties by collaborating with its product (but see the discussion in Section 10.3.1).

图 10.9 产品介绍。

Figure 10.9 Introducing the product.

该产品反映了销售视角。在风险分析中，合同 组合成产品的方式被忽略了。

The product reflects the perspective of sales. In risk analysis the way in which contracts are combined as products is ignored.

在考虑是否进行子类型划分时，我们需要问两个问题。第一个问题是，子类型是否真正继承了超类型的所有特征。像图 10.7 所示的直接子类型划分，应该对照超类型的所有特征进行审查，包括超类型的子类型的特征。这一点很容易被忽略，从而导致错误的判断。这种分析会导致对泛化层次结构的重构，而这种重构可能并非易事。我们需要问的第二个问题是，领域专家是否真的认为这种子类型划分是合理的？在我们的例子中，领域专家反对进行子类型划分，更倾向于图 10.9 所示的模型。后来，图 10.8 所示的风格再次出现，但到目前为止，它似乎还不足以说服我们改变模型（以及实现该模型的框架）。

In considering whether to subtype, we need to ask two questions. The first is whether all the features of the supertype are really inherited by the subtype. An immediate subtyping, such as is shown in Figure 10.7, should be reviewed against all the features of the supertype, including features of supertypes of the supertype. It is easy to forget this and be led down a dangerous path. This analysis will lead to refactoring the generalization hierarchy, and this refactor-ing may not be trivial. The second question we need to ask is, does the domain expert really consider the subtyping to hold? In our example the domain expert resisted subtyping, preferring the Figure 10.9 model. Later on, the Figure 10.8 style did reappear but has not, so far, seemed compelling enough to change the model (and the framework that implements it).

建模原理
Modeling Principle
只有当超类型的所有特征都适合该超类型，并且从概念上讲，每个子类型的实例都是超类型的实例时，才应该使用子类型。
Subtyping should be used only when all the features of the supertype are appropriate to the supertype and it makes sense conceptually to say that every instance of the subtype is an instance of the supertype.

这就引出了一个有趣的问题：是否值得在产品上构建某种显式的泛化结构来表示各种组合，如图 10.10 所示。显然，这并非用于风险计算。然而，它对于创建此类新产品非常有用。事实上，这种泛化的最深层应用可能位于应用层和表示层（参见 12.3 节），在这些层中，定价和交易捕获需要特定的表示方法。在这种情况下，即使目前仅在销售工作中使用，领域模型中的共享定义也十分有价值。更复杂的交易分析可能需要理解这些组合的定义方式。

This leaves an interesting question as to whether it is worth putting some explicit generalization structure on the product to represent the various kinds of combinations, as shown in Figure 10.10. Clearly it is not for risk calculation purposes. It is useful, however, for creating new products of this form. Indeed the deepest examples of this kind of generalization are likely to lie at the application and presentation layers (see Section 12.3) where specific presentations are required for pricing and deal capture of combinations. In such situations a shared definition in the domain model is very valuable, even if the definition is currently used only in sales work. More sophisticated analysis of trades may require an understanding of how these combinations are defined.

约束条件：各条款的执行价格相同

Constraint: strike prices of legs are the same

图 10.10 常见组合产品。

Figure 10.10 The common combination products.

这是一个基于约束条件的层级结构的绝佳示例。与产品相关的合同被称为该产品的各个组成部分。

This is a good example of a hierarchy based on constraints. The contracts linked to a product are called the legs of the product.

例如，一位客户持有大量 Aroma Coffee Makers 的股票，他担心未来 6 个月内股价的走势，因为之后他无法出售这些股票。他可能会在当前股价 5 美元附近买入跨式期权。对交易者而言，这种产品被分解为两个独立的期权。

Example A client has a large holding in Aroma Coffee Makers stock and is concerned about the movement in stock price over the next 6 months before he can sell it. He might buy a straddle around the current price of $5. To the trader this product is broken down into two separate options.

例如，我想购买7000股Aroma咖啡机公司的股票。交易员找不到任何其他愿意出售相同数量的股票的买家。他可以找到一个愿意出售2000股的买家，以及另一个愿意出售5000股的买家。我与交易员签订了一份购买7000股股票的合约。该合约包含两份合约，每份合约对应一笔交易。

Example I wish to buy 7000 shares of Aroma Coffee Makers. The trader is not able to find a single other party who wishes to sell the exact amount. He can find one party to sell 2000 shares and another to sell 5000 shares. I have one product with the trader to buy 7000 shares. The product consists of two contracts for each trade.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
当客户看到交易者将一笔交易拆分成多笔交易时，应使用产品/合约拆分。
The product/contract split should be used whenever the customer sees a single deal that is broken into several deals by the trader.

产品与合同的主要区别在于，产品代表客户的意图，而合同指的是交易双方和主要当事人之间实际交易的内容。

The key difference between a product and a contract is that the product represents the customer's intention while the contract refers to what actually gets traded between the counter and primary parties.

10.3.1 产品是否应该始终存在？

图 10.9 所示模型的一个结果是，非组合情况用一份合同和一个产品来表示。该产品本身并没有为整个模型增添什么（除了销售和风险管理之间的责任分离）。

One of the consequences of the model in Figure 10.9 is that noncombinations are represented by a single contract and a single product. The product is adding little to the picture (other than the separation of responsibilities between sales and risk management).

另一种可能性是不对产品链接进行强制要求。在这种方案中，只有组合才包含产品。更简单的合同没有产品链接。合同与一方存在链接，但这些链接是在产品存在时才产生的。这种方案的缺点在于其责任处理不一致。合同负责处理与一方的关系，除非它将责任委托给产品。这种不一致性可能导致很多混乱。因此，我更倾向于使用图 10.9 所示的模型。

Another possibility is not to make the link to product mandatory. In such a scheme only a combination has a product. Simpler contracts have no product link. A contract has links to a party, but they are derived when a product is present. The disadvantage of this scheme is that it handles responsibilities inconsistently. A contract is responsible for handling the relationships with a party, except when it delegates the responsibilities to a product. This inconsistency can lead to a great deal of confusion. For that reason I prefer to use the model in Figure 10.9.

传统数据建模者会从不同的角度得出相同的结论。规范化促使他们避免重复建立指向参与方的链接，因此会选择类似图 10.9 的模型（尽管在实际物理模型中，出于性能考虑，该模型可能会有所修改）。面向对象理论的论点则有所不同，因为它侧重于明确的职责划分，但两者都遵循一个共同的主题：概念上的简洁性促使我们尽可能减少基数为 1 的关联。在面向对象开发中，这一原则引导我们明确划分职责；而在关系数据建模中，它则引导我们达到第 14 范式（或者现在的范式编号）。

Traditional data modelers would come to the same conclusion from a different route. Normalization leads them not to wish to duplicate the links to party and thus choose a model like Figure 10.9 (although it might get altered for performance reasons in a physical model). The object-oriented argument is different because it focuses on having clear responsibilities, yet both arguments share an underlying theme: Conceptual simplicity leads us to having the minimum of base1 associations. In OO development this principle leads us to clearly separated responsibilities, and in relational data modeling it leads us to 14th normal form (or whatever the number is these days).

建模原理
Modeling Principle
不要重复创建含义相同的基本关联。遵循此原则可以创建职责分离良好的类型。
Do not duplicate base associations that have the same meanings. Following this principle leads to types with well-separated responsibilities.

我们可以创建任意数量的派生关联。

We can have as many derived associations as we like.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
分配职责时要保持一致性。要警惕那种有时自己负责某件事，有时又把责任委派出去的人。（这种行为或许正确，但始终应该质疑。）
Be consistent in the allocation of responsibilities. Be wary of a type that sometimes is responsible for something and sometimes delegates that responsibility. (This behavior may be correct but it should always be questioned.)

10.4 子类型状态机

10.4 Subtype State Machines

尽管许多常见的衍生品都可以表示为期权的组合，但这并非绝对。障碍期权会在标的工具价格（以某个约定的市场报价，例如路透社的报价为准）达到特定限值时出现或消失。例如，可以买入一份以90日元/美元的价格买入（看涨）1000万日元的期权，该期权会在汇率跌至85日元/美元时被敲入。这种期权的运作方式与标准期权不同。实际上，除非汇率在到期日之前跌破85日元/美元，否则该期权无法行使。如果汇率跌破该限值，则期权被敲入，并且无论从该日期到到期日期间价格如何变化，该期权都可行使。如果价格从未跌破限值，则买方永远无法行使该期权。（障碍期权也可以是敲出式，在这种情况下，只有当汇率没有跌破限值时才能行使。）

Although many common derivatives can be represented as combinations of options, this is not uniformly the case. A barrier option can either appear or disappear when the price of the instrument, as quoted on some agreed market pricing (such as a Reuters page), reaches a particular limit. Thus an option could be bought to buy (call) 10 million yen at a price of 90 JPY/USD, which would knock-in at 85 JPY/USD. This option behaves differently than a standard one. Effectively the option cannot be exercised unless the exchange rate falls below 85 JPY/USD before the expiration date. If it does fall below this barrier, then the option is knocked in and will remain exercisable whatever happens to the price between that date and the expiration. If the price never falls below the barrier level, then the purchaser can never exercise. (Barriers can also be knock-outs, in which case they can only be exercised if the exchange rate does not pass the barrier.)

这种不同的行为可以通过修改障碍物的状态图来表达，有效地将其替换为图 10.11 所示的状态图。使用该状态图的事件图如图 10.12 所示。

This different behavior can be expressed by a modification of the state chart for a barrier, effectively replacing it with the one shown in Figure 10.11. The event diagram for using it is shown in Figure 10.12.

唯一的结构性变化是为期权增加了障碍水平，这作为一种期权的子类型效果很好，因为它改变了行为并增加了一个新功能（障碍水平）。

The only structural change is the addition of the barrier level to the option, which does work well as a subtype of option since it provides a change in behavior and adds a new feature (the barrier level).

10.4.1 确保状态图的一致性

状态图本身就提出了一个有趣的问题。我们可以用图 10.11 的状态图替换图 10.4 所示的状态图，从而展现屏障子类型的不同行为。然而，这引出了一个问题：我们是否可以这样做？大多数方法都强调能够用子类型替换超类型的重要性；这体现在对象图中，对象图只允许添加关联，而不允许删除关联。许多教科书没有提及子类型状态图的规则。Shlaer 和 Mellor [6] 指出，状态图只能放置在超类型或子类型上。但是，如果所有子类型共享一个公共部分，则可以将其放置在超类型上以方便维护（拼接）。Rum-baugh [5] 指出，子类型（通常）只能添加正交状态图。

The state chart presents an interesting issue in its own right. We can replace the state chart shown in Figure 10.4 with that of Figure 10.11, providing the different behavior of the barrier subtype. However, this raises a question: Are we allowed to do that? Most methods stress the importance of being able to substitute a subtype for a supertype; this is reflected in object diagrams by only allowing us to add associations, not remove them. Many textbooks do not mention what rules govern state diagrams with subtypes. Shlaer and Mellor [6] indicate that state diagrams can only be placed at either a super-type or a subtype. However, if all subtypes share a common portion, that may be placed at the supertype to ease maintainability (splicing). Rum-baugh [5] indicates that subtypes can (usually) only add orthogonal state diagrams.

关于子类型和状态如何运作的最佳论述来自 Cook 和 Daniels [1]，他们用整整一章的篇幅讨论了子类型和状态图。他们强调了契约式设计原则 [4]，这些原则可以概括为：

The best discussion of how subtyping and states work is given by Cook and Daniels [1], who devote a whole chapter to subtypes and state diagrams. They stress the principles of design by contract [4], which can be summarized

图 10.1 1 敲门呼叫的 Harel 状态图。

Figure 10.1 1 Harel state chart for a knock-in call.

如果标的资产的价格始终未突破障碍价，则期权无法行使。 价格一旦突破障碍价，之后发生的任何其他变化都无关紧要 。

If the instrument's price never passes the barrier, the option cannot be exercised. After the price has passed the barrier once, it does not matter what other changes occur.

图 10.12 使用敲入选项的过程事件图。

Figure 10.12 Event diagram of the process of using a knock-in option.

也就是说，超类型的状态图可以通过两种方式扩展：一是添加一个正交状态图，二是将超类型的状态拆分成子状态。超类型的转换只能通过将其重定向到其超类型状态的子状态来修改。

by saying that a supertype's state chart can be extended in two ways: either by adding an orthogonal state chart or by taking a supertype's state and splitting into substates. Supertype transitions can be modified only by redirecting them to substates of their supertype's state.

将这些准则应用于期权状态模型，我们发现了一些问题。首先是到期日开始事件的处理方式。在图 10.4（期权图）中，这会导致状态从已买入状态转变为可行权状态；但在图 10.11（障碍图）中，转变却是从新敲入状态开始的。到期日结束事件也存在类似的问题：图 10.4 显示它仅从可行权状态转变，而图 10.11 显示它可以从任何状态转变。

Applying these guidelines to the option state models, we see a number of problems. The first lies in the treatment of the start of expiration date event. In Figure 10.4 (the option diagram), this causes a transition from purchased to exercisable, but in Figure 10.11 (the barrier diagram), the transition comes from the new knocked-in state. The end of expiration date event has a similar problem: Figure 10.4 shows it transitioning from the exercisable state only, while Figure 10.11 has it transitioning from any state.

第一个问题源于考虑当对象接收到一个事件，而该事件所处的状态又无法对其进行任何操作时，对象应该如何处理。对象可以选择静默忽略该事件，也可以抛出错误。需要制定一些通用策略来解释如何处理这种情况；例如，Cook 和 Daniels 建议 [l] 明确列出对象感兴趣的事件。任何在没有定义转换的情况下通常会被静默忽略的事件，都应被列为允许的事件。这解决了图 10.11（屏障）图在购买状态开始时接收到“到期日”事件时会发生什么情况。如果“到期日”事件是允许的事件，则对象会直接忽略它。

The first question comes from considering what an object should do if it receives an event that is not in a state in which we can do anything with it. The object can either silently ignore the event or raise an error. Some general policy should be stated to interpret how to deal with this; for example, Cook and Daniels advise [l] explicitly listing events in which an object is interested. Any events that normally would be silently ignored if there were no defined transition are listed as allowable events. This resolves what would happen should the Figure 10.11 (barrier) diagram receive a start of expiration date event while in the purchased start. If start of expiration date is an allowed event, it will just ignore it.

然而，这与超类型仍不完全一致。图 10.11 显示，当收到到期日开始事件时，已购买的期权变为可行权。从合约条款来看，变为已购买是到期日开始事件的后置条件的一部分。我们无法在子类型中削弱此后置条件，只能加强它。要将敲入式看涨期权作为期权的子类型，我们必须将两个状态图替换为图 10.13 和图 10.14 中所示的状态图。

However, this is still not entirely consistent with the supertype. Figure 10.11 shows that when the start of expiration date event is received, a purchased option changes to exercisable. Looking at this in contract terms, the change to purchased is part of the postcondition of start of expiration date. We cannot weaken this postcondition in the subtype, only strengthen it. To have a knock-in call as a subtype of an option, we must replace both state charts with those shown in Figures 10.13 and 10.14.

图 10.13 修改后的状态图，允许 Cook 和 Daniels 符合敲门呼叫。

Figure 10.13 Modified state chart for option to allow Cook and Daniels conformance with knock-in calls.

图 10.14 修改后的敲入调用状态图，以支持 与图 10.13 的一致性。

Figure 10.14 Modified state chart for knock-in calls to support conformance with Figure 10.13.

为了确保一致性，这些图表反映了两项更改。第一项更改是将已购买且可行权的状态统一为“激活”状态。这样，我们就可以从此处重定向到期日结束事件。第二项更改是在到期日开始事件上添加 `canBeExercisable` 作为守卫条件。此操作表明，到期日开始并不总是意味着期权处于可行权状态。对于常规期权，`canBeExercisable` 始终为真。期权的子类型可以覆盖此条件以实现其他行为。

To provide conformance, these diagrams reflect two changes. The first is to generalize purchased and exercisable into an active state. We can then redirect the end of expiration date event from here. The second modification is to add canBeExercisable as a guard on the start of expiration date event. This operation is a way of saying that the start of expiration date does not always lead to the exercisable state. For regular options canBeExercisable is always true. Subtypes of an option can override it for other behavior.

图 10.14 展示了这种覆盖机制如何应用于敲入式屏障。我们引入了“已购买”子状态来指示屏障是否已被敲入。然后，我们拆分了到期日起始日期转换的源状态，并弱化了守卫，以显示未受保护的转换。由于我们已允许超类型上的到期日起始日期，因此当屏障未被敲入时，它可以忽略到期日起始日期。

Figure 10.14 shows how this override occurs for knock-in barriers. We introduce substates of purchased to indicate whether the barrier has been knocked-in or not. We then split the source of the start of expiration date transition and weaken the guard to show the unguarded transition. Since we have allowed start of expiration date on the supertype, the barrier can ignore start of expiration date when unknocked.

10.4.2 使用一致性的问题

经过这次达成一致性的过程，我们应该停下来思考几个问题。在我看来，图 10.4 和 10.11 比图 10.13 和 10.14 更简洁明了地表达了行为。因此，尽管我们达成了一致性（至少根据 Cook 和 Daniels 的定义），但我们却失去了可理解性。此外，对敲入调用进行建模导致我们修改了超类型图。原有的超类型图已经很好了——我们修改它仅仅是因为我们需要一个不同的状态图，这迫使我们构建一个符合规范的子类型状态图。这意味着，除非我们足够聪明，能够构建一个极其灵活的超类型状态图，否则新的子类型可能会迫使我们修改超类型状态图。不幸的是，我认为自己没有那么聪明，所以子类型化将会充满困难。

Having gone through this exercise of gaining conformance, we should stop and ask ourselves a few questions about the process. In my judgment Figures 10.4 and 10.11 represent simpler and clearer expressions of behavior than Figures 10.13 and 10.14. Thus, although we have gained conformance (at least according to the Cook and Daniels definition), we have lost comprehen-sibility. In addition, modeling the knock-in call caused us to change the supertype diagram. It was perfectly good as it was—we only changed it because we needed a different state chart that forced us to construct a conforming subtype state chart. This implies that a new subtype can force us to change supertype state charts, unless we are clever enough to produce a remarkably flexible supertype state chart. Unfortunately I don't think I'm that clever, so subtyping is going to be fraught with difficulties.

解决这些难题的一个方法是重新构建泛化层级结构，从而避免考虑一致性问题。我们假设敲入式看涨期权是期权的子类型，每个子类型都有自己的状态图，如图 10.15 所示。另一种方法是将期权视为没有自身状态图的抽象类型，并创建一个常规期权子类型来保存图 10.4 所示的状态图，如图 10.16 所示。这种方法避免了考虑一致性状态图的问题，允许使用更自然的状态图，但引入了一个单独的类型。它也更符合 Rumbaugh、Shlaer 和 Mellor 的指导原则，他们没有讨论状态模型之间的一致性问题。

One solution to these difficulties is to recast the generalization hierarchy to avoid needing to worry about conformance. We assumed that a knocked-in call would be a subtype of an option, each with their own state chart, as shown in Figure 10.15. Another approach is to treat an option as an abstract type without its own state chart and create a conventional option subtype to hold the Figure 10.4 state chart, as shown in Figure 10.16. This avoids having to worry about the conforming state charts, allows the more natural state charts, but does introduce a separate type. It is also more consistent with the guidelines of Rumbaugh and Shlaer and Mellor, who do not discuss conformance between state models.

图 10.15 敲入式看涨期权作为期权的子类型。

Figure 10.15 Knocked-in call as a subtype of an option.

这是自然而然的方法，但是状态模型之间有什么关系呢？

This is the natural approach, but how are the state models related?

契约式设计要求子类型必须满足其超类型的后置条件。然而，这并不一定意味着到期日开始的后置条件必须包含向可执行状态的转换。如果我们选择不将其作为后置条件的一部分，那么……

Design by contract says that subtypes must satisfy their supertypes' postconditions. However, that does not necessarily imply that the postcondition on start of expiration date should include the transition to the exercisable state. If we choose not to include it as part of the postcondition, then the

图 10.16 创建常规期权类型。

Figure 10.16 Creating a conventional option type.

这使得处理状态模型变得更容易，但并不自然。

This can make it easier to cope with the state models, but it is not as natural.

原图可以接受。重要的是，在任何情况下都应允许开始计算到期日；至于这是否会导致状态转换，则未定义。

original diagram is acceptable. The important thing is that start of expiration date should be allowed in all cases; whether it causes a transition or not is undefined.

事实上，这正是契约式设计中一个更广泛的问题。人们常说，操作的后置条件应该定义对象可观察状态的所有变化。形式化方法界经常提倡这一原则，但它并不适用于契约式设计。后置条件仅仅规定了操作结束时必须保持的状态。我们当然可以指出，除了已规定的状态之外，其他状态都不能改变，但这并非契约式设计的前提。

This is, in fact, an example of a wider issue in using design by contract. Often people say that the postconditions of an operation should define all changes to the observable state of an object. This principle is often advocated by the formal methods community but is not true for design by contract. The postcondition merely specifies the state that must hold at the end of the operation. We can always indicate that nothing must change other than what is specified, but that is not assumed in the approach.

事实上，子类型化使得这种限制性的后置条件变得危险。子类型化的关键在于，超类型无法预测子类型可能进行的所有扩展。使用过于限制性的后置条件会削弱子类型化所提供的灵活性。后置条件定义了对象可观察状态中必须为真的方面。因此，只要不违反后置条件的明确子句，任何其他更改都可以发生。

Indeed subtyping makes such a restrictive postcondition dangerous. The whole point of subtyping is that the supertype cannot predict all the extensions that subtypes might make. Using an overly restrictive postcondition cripples the flexibility offered by subtyping. Postconditions define aspects of the object's observable state that must be true. Thus any other changes can occur providing they don't violate the explicit clauses of the postcondition.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
泛化对状态图的影响尚未被充分理解。确保超类型上的所有事件都能被子类型处理至关重要。任何可以进行子类型化的状态图都必须允许未知事件的发生。
The effect of generalization on state charts is not well understood. It is important to ensure that all events on a supertype can be handled by the subtype. Any state chart that can be subtyped must allow unknown events.
建模原理
Modeling Principle
后置条件定义了操作后对象必须满足的条件。除了后置条件中未提及的更改之外，还可以发生其他更改。
A postcondition defines a condition that must be true of the object after the operation. Other changes that are not mentioned by the postcondition can take place.

10.5 并行应用程序和域层次结构

10.5 Parallel Application and Domain Hierarchies

面对包含多种合约的投资组合，交易者可能希望查看合约列表及其重要信息。这样的列表会将每份合约列在一行中。每行显示的信息会根据合约类型而有所不同。列可能包括：多头/空头、交易日期、行权价格、看涨/看跌（仅限期权）、到期日（仅限期权）、障碍位（仅限障碍位）、敲入或敲出（仅限障碍位）。

Faced with a portfolio of various contracts, a trader might like to look at a list of the contracts together with important information about them. Such a list would show each contract on one line. The information shown on the line would vary depending on the kind of contract. The columns might be long/ short, trade date, strike price, call/put (options only), expiration date (option only), barrier level (barrier only), knock-in or knock-out (barrier only).

在这种方案中，表格中的某些列仅与期权的特定子类型相关。这增加了问题的复杂性。我们不能假设某个浏览器代码类会向每个合约请求所有相关属性。这种方法行不通，因为浏览器代码类无法向非期权请求其到期日，因为根据定义，非期权没有到期日。

In this scheme some columns in the table are only relevant for certain subtypes of the option. This adds a certain amount of complexity to the problem. What we cannot do is assume that some browser line class asks each contract for each relevant attribute. Such an approach would not work because the browser line class cannot ask a nonoption for its expiration date, since by definition a nonoption does not have one.

设计布局的第一步是使用第 12 章讨论的分层结构。在这种结构中，投资组合、浏览器和浏览器线类型是应用程序外观，其运行方式如图 10.17 所示。投资组合浏览器的主题是投资组合，浏览器线的主题是合同。投资组合和合同对投资组合浏览器或浏览器线均不可见，因为后两者位于应用程序层，而域类型对应用程序类型也不可见（参见图 12.6）。

A first stage in laying out a design is to use the layered structure discussed in Chapter 12. In using this the portfolio, browser and browser line types are application facades operating as shown in Figure 10.17. The portfolio browser's subject is a portfolio, the browser line's subject is a contract. Neither portfolio nor contract have any visibility to the portfolio browser or browser line, since the latter types lie within the application tier and domain types have no visibility to application types (see Figure 12.6).

图 10.17 投资组合浏览器及其与领域模型的关系。

Figure 10.17 A portfolio browser and its relationship to the domain model. A

投资组合浏览器和浏览器线是应用程序外观。

portfolio browser and browser line are application facades.

这种结构允许浏览器行拥有界面所需的所有列的属性。对于表示层程序员来说，每一行都具有这些属性，这些属性可以为 nil。如果某个属性为 nil，则意味着浏览器表格中存在空白。问题在于浏览器行与领域模型之间的关联。

This structure allows a browser line to have attributes for all the columns required by the interface. As far as a presentation programmer is concerned, each line has these attributes, which may be nil. If an attribute is nil, then that implies a blank space in the browser's table. The problem lies in the link between the browser line and the domain model.

浏览器代码行知道它正在处理一组合约。但遗憾的是，它需要查询的信息仅在合约的某些子类型中定义。如果浏览器代码行向非选项类型查询其到期日期，则会收到错误。有几种策略可以用于处理这种交互：在应用程序外观中进行类型检查、为超类型提供一个包含性接口、使用运行时属性、使应用程序外观对领域模型可见，以及使用异常处理。

The browser line knows it is dealing with a collection of contracts. Unfortunately it needs to ask for information that is only defined on certain subtypes of the contract. If a browser line asks a nonoption for its expiration date, it will get an error. Several strategies can be used to deal with this interaction: type checking in the application facade, giving the supertype an encompassing interface, using a run-time attribute, making the application facade visible to the domain model, and using exception handling.

10.5.1 应用程序外观中的类型检查

在这种策略中，浏览器负责处理问题。每次向合约发出请求之前，都会对合约进行类型检查，以确保请求可以安全发出，如图 10.18 所示。在 C++ 中，这表现为先进行类型检查，然后进行向下转型，最后发出请求。

In this strategy the browser line is responsible for dealing with the problem. Before each request to the contract, a type check is made on the contract to ensure that the request can be issued safely, as shown in Figure 10.18. In C++ this takes the form of a type check, followed by a downcast, followed by the request.

图 10.18 浏览器行中的类型检查交互。

Figure 10.18 Interactions for type checking in the browser line.

在调用仅在子类型上定义的操作之前，会先检查类型。

The type is checked before an operation is called that is only defined on the subtype.

这种策略存在一些缺点。由于合约子类型众多，浏览器类变得相当复杂。此外，合约层级结构的任何更改都会导致浏览器发生变化。当然，如果更改的是引入新子类型，从而在浏览器中添加新列，那么无论如何，由于显示方式的改变，都需要进行这样的更改。

This strategy has a number of disadvantages. The browser class, in the face of many subtypes of the contract, becomes quite complex. Furthermore any changes in the contract hierarchy causes changes in the browser. Of course, if the change is a new subtype that introduces a new column to the browser, then such a change would be required in any case, driven by a presentation change.

这种方案隐含的类型检查程度可以通过几种方法来降低。我们可以为每种合约子类型使用一个浏览器行的子类。我们可以使用类型检查来实例化正确的浏览器行子类来完成任务。另一种方法是使用访问者模式[2]。虽然在类型检查程度过高的情况下，这些方法是可取的，但它们仍然要求浏览器行（及其子类）了解合约层次结构。

The degree of type checking that this scheme implies can be reduced by a couple of approaches. We can use a subclass of browser line for each subtype of contract. We can use a type check to instantiate the correct subclass of browser line to do the job. Another approach is to use the visitor pattern [2]. Although these approaches are preferable if the degree of type checking is excessive, they still require the browser line (and its subclasses) to know about the contract hierarchy.

10.5.2 为超类型赋予一个包容性接口

根本问题在于，向合约询问其到期日是错误的。一种解决方案是将所有子类型操作添加到合约中。合约自然会为所有这些操作返回 nil，但相关的子类型可以重写该操作以提供其值。

The essential problem is that it is an error to ask a contract for its expiration date. One solution is to add all of the subtype operations to contract. Contract would naturally reply with a nil for all of these, but the relevant subtypes could override that operation to provide their value.

这种方法存在诸多问题。它使得我们无法区分合约中哪些操作是真正合法的，哪些操作是真正的错误。编译时类型检查也因此失效，因为它无法区分二者。每次引入子类型时，合约的接口都必须进行修改。因此，我并不赞成这种方法。

This approach has many problems. It becomes impossible to tell what is a truly legal operation on a contract and what is really an error. Compile-time type checking is defeated because it cannot tell which is which. Each time a subtype is introduced, contract's interface must be altered. Thus I'm not a fan of this approach.

10.5.3 使用运行时属性

运行时属性提供了一种非常灵活的系统，允许在不更改概念模型的情况下向类型添加属性。实现后，它们允许在系统执行期间无需重新编译即可更改属性。

Run-time attributes provide a very flexible system of adding attributes to types without changing the conceptual model. When implemented they allow attribute changes without recompilation during the execution of the system.

合约的基本模型如图 10.19 所示，或者更推荐使用图 10.20，后者采用键值映射（参见 15.2 节）。所有合约都有若干条款，每个条款都对应一个条款类型。在本例中，合约及其子类型（例如行权价格、是否为看涨期权、障碍水平等）的每个属性都属于条款类型。如果查询合约的条款，且该合约存在条款，则合约会返回相应的值对象。这样，查询非期权合约的到期日就不会出错。

The basic model for contracts is shown in Figure 10.19, or preferably Figure 10.20, which uses a keyed mapping (see Section 15.2). All contracts have a number of terms, and each receives a term type. In this example each attribute of the contract and its subtypes (strike price, is call, barrier level, and so on) would be term types. If a contract is asked for a term, it replies with the value object if there is a term. In this way it is not an error to ask for a nonoption's expiration date.

图 10.19 合约的运行时属性。

Figure 10.19 A run time attribute for contract.

这样，对于仅在选项中定义的属性，请求非选项值就不会导致 错误。

This way asking a nonoption for a property only defined on option would not cause an error.

图 10.20 图 10.19 使用键控映射。

Figure 10.20 Figure 10.19 using a keyed mapping.

当然，这种模型允许意外地为非期权赋予到期日。可以通过两种方式避免这种情况。第一种是使用知识层（参见第 2.5 节），如图 10.21 所示。另一种是将期限类型视为派生接口。模型属性（合约及其子类型的属性）和期限类型接口均已提供。更新仅通过模型属性进行。

Of course, this model allows a nonoption to be given an expiration date by accident. This can be prevented in a couple of ways. The first is to use a knowledge level (see Section 2.5), as shown in Figure 10.21. The other is to treat the term type as a derived interface. Both the model attributes (those on contract and its subtypes) and the term type interface are provided. Updates are only provided through the model attributes.

图 10.21 利用知识水平来控制合同条款的放置。

Figure 10.21 Using a knowledge level to control the placing of terms on contracts.

这样可以防止合同条款被错误地放置，但只能 在运行时进行检查。

This would stop terms from being placed incorrectly on contracts but can only be checked at run-time.

使用运行时属性确实提供了灵活性，但也存在一些显著的缺点。首先，使用术语类型会使合约及其子类型的接口更难理解。合约用户不仅需要查看类型上定义的操作，还必须查看术语类型的实例，以及哪些实例是有效的。其次，属性类型无法在编译时进行类型检查，这使得编译时检查失去了一个非常重要的优势。对于浏览器端来说，这并不重要，因为其目的就是为了放宽编译时检查的限制，但对于系统的其他部分来说，这却至关重要。第三个缺点是，它破坏了基本的语言机制。编译器无法感知正在发生的事情，因此诸如多态之类的语言特性必须由程序员手动编写代码来实现。此外，运行时属性的性能也不如模型属性。

Using run-time attributes does provide flexibility but it comes with significant disadvantages. First, using term types makes the interface of a contract and its subtypes harder to understand. As well as looking at the operations defined on the type, the user of a contract must also look at the instances of the term type, and indeed which instances are valid. Second, attribute types cannot be type checked at compile time, removing a very important advantage of compile-time checking. This does not matter for the browser line, since the whole point is to relax any compile-time checking, but it does matter a great deal for other parts of the system. A third disadvantage is that the basic language mechanisms are being subverted. The compiler is not aware of what is going on, and language features, such as polymorphism, must be hand-coded by the programmer. Also, run-time attributes do not perform as well as model attributes.

通过同时提供这两种接口，可以缓解许多此类缺点。软件中那些在编译时就知道属性的部分可以使用模型属性，而浏览器可以使用运行时属性。

Many of these disadvantages can be mitigated by providing both interfaces. Those parts of the software that know about attributes at compile time can use the model attributes, and the browser can use the run-time attributes.

10.5.4 使应用程序外观对领域模型可见

在这种方法中，加载浏览器行的责任交给了该浏览器行所概括的合约，如图 10.22 所示。由于控制权现在掌握在合约或其子类型手中，因此它可以为该子类型加载正确的值。浏览器行包含应用程序所需的所有信息，而合约或子类型则知道哪些信息适用于该子类型。

In this approach the responsibility for loading a browser line is given to the contract that browser line is summarizing, as shown in Figure 10.22. Since control is now in the contract, or its subtype, it can load the browser line with the correct values for that subtype. The browser line supports all necessary information for the application, and the contract or subtype knows what is applicable for that subtype.

图 10.22 合同加载浏览器行的交互。

Figure 10.22 Interactions for contracts loading browser lines.

浏览器层必须对合约可见，这违反了 域层和应用层之间通常的可见性规则。

The browser line must be visible to the contract, which violates the usual visibility rules between domain and application tiers.

这种方法的优势在于，由于无需类型检查，交互更加简单，而且契约也不需要更复杂的接口。此外，添加新契约无需更改浏览器行，除非呈现方式也发生了相应的变化。只需要一个新的重写操作来加载浏览器行即可。

The advantages of this approach include the fact that the interaction is much simpler because no type checking is required, and a more complex interface is not needed for the contract. In addition, adding a new contract does not require the browser line to change, unless there is a corresponding change in the presentation. All that is needed is a new overriding operation to load the browser line.

最大的缺点在于打破了第 12 章讨论的应用层和领域层之间的可见性规则。如图 10.23 所示，可以通过将浏览器线放在其自身的包中来避免这个问题。这样，对领域模型的依赖就仅限于浏览器线类型。通过将浏览器线类型拆分为两个，可以进一步降低可见性。浏览器的表示层和契约层使用与浏览器线完全不同的接口。可以在浏览器门面包中为浏览器线提供其自身的浏览器线门面。该门面与浏览器线的交互非常简单。在这种情况下，可以消除浏览器表示层对浏览器线包的可见性。

The biggest disadvantage lies in the breaking of the visibility rules between application and domain tiers that are discussed in Chapter 12. This can be avoided by placing the browser line in its own package, as shown in Figure 10.23. In this way the dependency from the domain model is limited to only the browser line type. Visibilities may be further reduced by splitting the browser line type into two. The presentation for the browser and the contracts use very different interfaces to the browser line. The browser line can be given its own browser line facade in the browser facade package. This facade has a simple interaction with the browser line. In this case the visibility from the browser presentation to the browser line package can be removed.

图 10.23 浏览器行包的可见性（基于图 12.6）。

Figure 10.23 Visibilities for a browser line package (based on Figure 12.6).

浏览器层包是应用层和域层之间的一个特殊情况。

The browser line package is a special case between the application and domain tiers.

另一个缺点源于多个浏览器应用程序可能存在略微不同的需求。每个应用程序都需要自己的浏览器接口，而这些接口都需要通过协议明确规定。浏览器接口的拆分可以解决这个问题。每个应用程序都可以创建一个独立的浏览器接口，所有应用程序都使用同一个浏览器接口包。这样，除非浏览器接口包添加了新功能，否则添加新的浏览器类型不会改变协议的职责。

Another disadvantage arises from the possibility of several browser applications that may have slightly different needs. Each application would need its own browser line, which would all need to be known by contract. The splitting of browser line can help here. One browser line facade would be created for each application, all of which would use the single browser line package. Adding new kinds of browsers thus would not alter the contract's responsibilities unless a new feature were added to the browser line.

事实仍然是，浏览器线所需的任何新功能都需要修改整个合约及其所有子类型。这就是将控制权置于浏览器线还是将控制权置于合约中的根本权衡。如果新增合约的频率高于浏览器线新增功能的频率，那么我们应该将控制权置于合约中。然而，这种对正常可见性模式的改变不容轻视。除非新增合约子类型的频率远高于浏览器线的变更频率，否则我不会将控制权置于合约中，因为合约中的许多新增子类型本身就意味着浏览器线需要新增功能。

The fact remains that any new feature required of the browser line requires modification of the entire contract and all its subtypes. This is the fundamental trade-off between putting control in the browser line as opposed to putting control in the contract. If new contracts are added more frequently than features are added to the browser line, then we should put control in the contract. However, the change to the normal pattern of visibility is not to be taken lightly. Unless new contract subtypes occur significantly more often than changes in the browser line, I would not put control in the contract because many new subtypes in the contract would themselves imply new features to the browser line.

10.5.5 使用异常处理

当然，以上所有想法都基于这样一个前提：向一个非屏障对象询问其屏障级别是不妥的。然而，在合适的环境下，这并非什么大问题。如果向一个对象发出请求导致运行时错误，并且该错误通过异常显式地表现出来，那么浏览器代码行可以简单地捕获该异常并将其视为 nil。浏览器代码行应该检查该异常是否确实是由于接收方无法理解请求，而不是其他更严重的错误。它还假设可以向接收方没有对应接口的对象发送消息。正是在这种情况下，缺乏类型安全反而成为了一种优势，再加上新实现中提供的异常处理特性。由于 Smalltalk 是无类型的，因此始终可以以这种方式使用。在 C++ 中，可以通过向下转型来绕过类型安全。

Of course all of the above ideas are based on the idea that it is a bad thing to ask a nonbarrier for its barrier level. With the right environment, however, this is not such a problem. If making a request of an object results in a run-time error and that error is made manifest through an exception, then the browser line can simply catch the exception and treat it as a nil. The browser line should check that the exception is actually a result of the receiver not understanding the request and not some other, more worrying error. It also assumes that it is possible to send a message to an object for which the receiver does not have an interface. This is where a lack of type safety becomes an advantage, coupled with the exception handling features now present in the newer implementations. Smalltalk can always be used in this way, since it is untyped. Type safety can be bypassed in C++ by using a downcast.
