第十一章 交易包裹

Chapter 11. Trading Packages

要充分理解本章内容，您需要先阅读第9章和第12章。开发大型信息系统面临着特殊的挑战。处理大型系统的基本方法是将其分解为更小的系统。这需要某种形式的架构建模，如A.5节所述。

To fully understand this chapter, you will need to read Chapters 9 and 12 first. Developing large information systems presents particular challenges. The fundamental way to deal with a large-scale system is to decompose it into smaller systems. This requires some form of architectural modeling, as discussed in Section A.5.

任何信息系统的首要组织工具都是第 12 章讨论的分层架构。该架构识别了系统中的许多包划分。然而，在大型系统中，领域模型会变得过于庞大，无法用单个包来容纳。本章将探讨如何拆分大型领域模型。包和可见性（参见 A.5 节）的概念再次被用作划分的基本工具。第 9 章中的交易概念提供了示例。

The first organizing tool of any information system is the layered architecture discussed in Chapter 12. This architecture identifies many of the package divisions of the system. In a larger system, however, the domain model becomes too large for a single package. This chapter looks at how we can split a large domain model. The concepts of package and visibility (see Section A.5) are again deployed as the basic tool for the division. The trading concepts of Chapter 9 provide the examples.

第一种模式着眼于如何组织情景和投资组合模型。主要问题在于对同一软件包存在多个访问级别（11.1）。风险管理应用程序使用情景来获取评估投资组合所需的信息。另一个应用程序需要设置和管理情景。这两个应用程序都需要访问情景类型，但它们所需的访问级别却截然不同。不同客户端需要不同的接口是一个常见问题。解决方案包括允许一个软件包使用多种协议以及使用不同的软件包。

The first pattern looks at how to organize the models of scenarios and portfolios. The main problem is that of multiple access levels to a package (11.1). A risk management application uses scenarios to get the information needed to value portfolios. Another application needs to set up and manage scenarios. Both applications need access to the scenario types, but they need very different levels of access. Different clients needing different interfaces is a common problem. Solutions include allowing a package to have multiple protocols and using different packages.

合同与当事人之间的关系引发了相互可见性问题（11.2）。有三种解决方案：合同与当事人之间单向可见；将二者置于同一包中；或将二者置于各自独立的相互可见的包中。这三种方案均存在明显的缺陷。

The relationships between contracts and parties raise the problem of mutual visibility (11.2). Three solutions suggest themselves: a one-way visibility between contract and party, putting them both in the same package, or putting them in separate mutually visible packages. All three solutions have significant disadvantages.

最后一个模式探讨了子类型包（11.3），具体来说，就是考虑如何将第 10 章讨论的派生类型定位到包结构中。该模式表明，子类型可以放置在与其超类型分离的包中，并且子类型对超类型是可见的。

The final pattern explores subtyping packages (11.3) by considering how to position the derivatives discussed in Chapter 10 onto the package structure. This pattern illustrates that subtypes can be placed in a package separate from their supertypes with visibility from the subtype to the supertype.

11.1 对软件包的多个访问级别

11.1 Multiple Access Levels to a Package

投资组合由合约构成，并以市场指标作为描述。情景分析独立用于确定市场指标的价格。投资组合和合约需要利用情景分析进行自我估值，但情景分析本身无需了解投资组合和合约的任何信息，如图 11.1 所示。

Portfolios are constructed from contracts using market indicators as descriptions. Scenarios are used independently to develop prices for market indica tors. Portfolios and contracts need to use scenarios to value themselves, but scenarios do not need any knowledge of portfolios and contracts, as shown in Figure 11.1.

图 11.1 包装可见性的初始图像。

Figure 11.1 An initial picture of package visibilities.

为了进行估值，投资组合只需要市场指标的价格。投资组合包无需了解情景的具体设置方式。因此，虽然情景元素类型需要对投资组合可见以便发送 `getQuote` 消息，但无需查看定义报价方式的子类型。实际上，我们甚至可以说情景元素本身对投资组合也无用。更好的方法是向投资组合提供如图 11.2 所示的接口。该接口在情景上有一个键值映射（参见 15.2 节），并以市场指标作为参数。由于情景元素的其他属性并不重要，因此投资组合包的接口非常简单。

To carry out valuations, a portfolio only requires the price of a market indicator. The portfolio package does not need to know how the scenario is set up. Thus, although the scenario element type needs to be visible to the portfolio so the getQuote message can be sent, there is no need to see the subtypes with the definition of how the quote is formed. Indeed we can go further and say that even the scenario element is not useful to the portfolio. A better approach would be to present the interface to the portfolio as shown in Figure 11.2. This interface has a keyed mapping (see Section 15.2) on the scenario, which takes a market indicator as an argument. Since no other properties of the scenario element are important, the interface for the portfolio package is simple.

图 11.2 场景包的界面，隐藏场景元素。

Figure 11.2 An interface for the scenario package that hides scenario elements.

这是投资组合软件包的最佳界面，它不需要了解 场景元素。

This is the best interface for the portfolio package, which does not need to know about scenario elements.

这种方法需要两种不同类型的场景包：一种用于与投资组合的接口，另一种用于设置场景。因此，仅仅将类型分配给包是不够的。最直接也最显而易见的方法是将场景包中的类型分为包内的公共类型和私有类型。公共类型对其他可以访问该场景包的包（例如投资组合）可见。私有类型仅对场景包内部的类型可见。在本例中，场景是公共类型，而场景元素是私有类型。这种逻辑可以扩展到操作。公共操作可以在包内公开，也可以对其他包公开。虽然这提供了精细的控制，但维护起来可能过于困难。良好可见性设计的精髓在于选择一个足够精细的可见性级别，既要保证实用性，又不能过于精细以至于让投资组合的管理变成一场噩梦。（难以管理的事物往往得不到管理，这会导致模型过时且无用。）

This approach requires two different types of scenario package: one for the interface to portfolio and another for setting up scenarios. Thus something more than a simple assignment of types to packages is needed. The immediate and obvious approach is to divide the types in the scenario package into public and private types in the package. Public types are those visible to other packages that have a visibility into the scenario package (such as portfolio). Private types are only visible to types within the scenario package. In this case the scenario is a public type and the scenario element is a private type. This logic can be extended to operations. Public operations can be public within a package and public to other packages. Although this represents a fine degree of control, it can be too difficult to maintain. The art of good visibility design is to choose a degree of visibility that is fine enough to be useful but not so fine as to make the portfolio a nightmare to manage. (Things that are difficult to manage tend not to be managed, which leads to out-of-date, useless models.)

这种方法的一个问题是，用户需要软件来设置和操作场景。这需要在应用程序逻辑层和表示层添加组件，如第 12 章所述。因此，该模型必须包含一个独立于场景包的场景管理应用程序包。图 11.3 展示了场景管理应用程序包和风险管理应用程序包的添加。然而，这种方法不适用于上述的公有/私有方法，因为场景管理应用程序需要场景包的私有类型。尽管投资组合管理和场景管理都需要对场景包可见，但它们需要的可见性类型不同。

One problem with this approach is that users need software to set up and manipulate scenarios. This requires components at the application logic and presentation layers, as discussed in Chapter 12. Thus the model must include a scenario management application package that is separate from the scenario package. Figure 11.3 shows the addition of a scenario management application package and a risk management application package. This approach would not work with the public/private approach described above, however, because the scenario management application requires the private types of the scenario package. Although both portfolio and scenario management require visibility of the scenario package, they need different types of visibility.

Wirfs-Brock [1] 提出的一个解决方案允许一个包拥有多个协议。在我们最初的模式中，我们将协议设置为一组操作；然而，将其设置为一组类型更为合理，这样可以更轻松地控制可见性。使用不同的协议会生成如图 11.4 所示的图表，其中场景包含两个协议：投资组合使用的协议仅允许使用较小的协议，而场景管理应用程序则使用更深层的协议。协议在包框上以半圆形端口表示。（我只显示了具有多个协议的包上的端口。）

One solution to this problem, proposed by Wirfs-Brock [1], allows a package to have more than one protocol.1 In our original pattern, we set up a protocol as a set of operations; however, it is quite reasonable to make it merely a set of types to allow simpler control of visibility. Using separate protocols results in a diagram such as Figure 11.4, in which the scenario has two protocols: The one used by the portfolio permits only the small protocol, while the scenario management application uses the deeper protocol. The protocols are shown by semicircular ports on the package box. (I'm only showing ports on packages with more than one protocol.)

Wirfs-Brock 使用了“合同”一词，这在本例中容易引起混淆，所以我使用“协议”。

Wirfs-Brock uses the term contract which is confusing in this example, so I use protocol.

228 包的多个访问级别

228 Multiple Access Levels to a Package

图 11.3 向图 11.1 添加应用程序包。

Figure 11.3 Adding application packages to Figure 11.1.

问题在于，场景管理应用程序需要 比投资组合包需要的更大的场景包接口。

The problem with this is that the scenario management application needs a much larger interface to the scenario package than the portfolio package needs.

图 11.4 图 11.3 中的软件包及其协议。

Figure 11.4 The packages of Figure 11.3 with protocols.

每个协议都对应一个独立的接口。

Each protocol implies a separate interface.

使用单独的协议是解决多重可见性问题的一种方法。另一种方法是引入一个额外的包，如图 11.5 所示。场景元素及其子类型从场景包移至场景结构包。场景包仅包含场景类型及其简单关联。组合包具有可见性。

Using separate protocols is one way to deal with the multiple visibility issue. Another is to introduce an extra package, as shown in Figure 11.5. The scenario element and its subtypes are moved from the scenario package into the scenario structure package. The scenario package contains only the scenario type and its simple associations. The portfolio package has visibility

图 11.5 使用额外的软件包来构建场景结构。

Figure 11.5 Using an extra package for the scenario structure.

仅对场景包可见，而场景管理应用程序则同时可以看到场景和场景结构包。我们可以利用这种额外的可见性定义新的场景。

only into the scenario package, while the scenario management application sees both the scenario and the scenario structure package. We can define new scenarios with the extra visibility.

细心的读者可能会想到一个问题：场景是否需要对场景结构可见？响应报价请求需要使用内部结构。继承和多态的一个有趣特性就体现在这些可见性上。场景包可以包含一个场景类，该类定义了所有对场景可见的包所需的接口。然而，这个场景类无需实现接口的全部内容（因此它是抽象的）。我们可以在场景结构包中放置第二个场景类来实现该接口。第二个场景类完全可以访问场景结构的内容。任何其他包使用的场景对象都是场景结构中场景类的实例，但这些类的客户端并不会意识到这一点。它们看到的只是一个符合场景包中场景类接口的对象。或许可以提供一种符号来表示这种跨包边界的子类化，尽管我个人并没有使用这种符号。

A question that might occur to the attentive reader is whether the scenario needs to have visibility to the scenario structure. Responding to a request for a quote requires use of the internal structure. An intriguing aspect of inheritance and polymorphism manifests itself in these visibilities. The scenario package can contain a scenario class that defines the interface required by all packages with visibility to the scenario. However, this scenario class need not implement all of the interface (and thus is abstract). We can place a second scenario class in the scenario structure package that implements the interface. This second scenario class has full visibility to the contents of the scenario structure. Any scenario object used by another package is an instance of the scenario structure's scenario class, but those clients of the class do not realize it. All they see is an object that conforms to the interface of the scenario package's scenario class. It may be worth providing a notation to show where this kind of subclassing occurs across package boundaries, although I don't use one.

因此，当投资组合包中的对象向某个场景发送消息时，实际上是将消息发送给了场景管理包中具体场景类的实例。然而，调用者却认为它调用的是场景包中的抽象场景类的实例。一个对象可以向它无法访问的包中的对象发送消息，前提是被调用对象是调用对象可以访问的包中某个类的子类。

So when an object in the portfolio package sends a message to a scenario, it is actually sending a message to an instance of the concrete scenario class that lies in the scenario management package. However, the caller thinks it is calling an instance of the abstract scenario class that lies in the scenario package. An object can send a message to an object in a package it cannot see, providing the called object is a subclass of a class in a package the calling object can see.

由此导致的结果是，可见性无法反映编译或加载依赖关系。虽然场景结构对场景本身不可见，但场景需要场景结构才能正常运行（严格来说，它依赖于实现了该接口的某个包）。场景结构包含场景的具体子类，缺少这些子类，场景包就无法工作。

A consequence of this is that visibilities do not reflect compilation or load dependencies. Although the scenario structure is not visible to the scenario, the scenario needs the scenario structure to function (strictly speaking, it is dependent on some package that implements the interface). The scenario structure contains the concrete subclasses of the scenario without which the scenario package cannot work.

尽管此方案需要两种不同的场景类，但它们可以遵循同一种场景类型。在这种情况下，会提供一个新的子类型，以便场景管理等应用程序能够访问场景的内部结构。但是，如果其他类型不需要调用仅存在于子类型中的特殊功能，则也可以只使用一种类型。

Although two different scenario classes are needed in this scheme, they may conform to a single scenario type. In this case a new subtype is provided to allow access to the internal structure of a scenario for applications such as scenario management. It is possible to have a single type, however, when other types do not need to call special features only present on the subtype.

11.2 相互可见性

11.2 Mutual Visibility

添加合同和参与方相关的软件包会引发更复杂的问题。对于场景和投资组合，之所以使用单独的软件包，原因有二。首先，场景和投资组合似乎是模型中独立的组成部分。它们本身就是复杂的模块，构成一个独立的工作单元。其次，我们无需了解投资组合即可构建场景模型。第二个原因最为重要，因为它引出了图 11.1 所示的可见性关系。

Adding packages for contracts and parties raises more complex issues. With scenarios and portfolios, separate packages were used for two reasons. First, scenarios and portfolios seem to be separate lumps of the model. They are themselves complex sections that seem to make a unit of labor. Second, we do not need any knowledge of portfolios to construct a model of scenarios. The second reason is the strongest because it leads to the visibility relation-ships shown in Figure 11.1.

由此可以合理得出结论：即使不了解投资组合，也可以构建和建模合约。如图 11.6 所示，合约的记录可以独立于用于风险评估的投资组合的动态结构。

It is reasonable to conclude that contracts can be put together and modeled without a knowledge of portfolios. Contracts can be recorded independently of the dynamic structure of the portfolio used to group them together for risk assessment purposes, as shown in Figure 11.6.

图 11.6 投资组合和合同的软件包。

Figure 11.6 Packages for portfolio and contract.

风险管理应用程序需要这两个软件包，但定价应用程序只 需要了解合同信息。

The risk management application needs both packages, but the pricing application only needs to know about contracts.

当事人与合同之间的关系是一个更大的问题。我们可以论证将当事人单独打包的必要性。许多应用程序可能只需要了解当事人的信息，而无需了解与他们进行的交易详情。一个通用的当事人包可以包含许多交易系统使用的当事人通用信息，类似于联系人数据库。因此，我们可以得出结论：当事人包是有价值的。

The relationships between parties and contracts are a greater problem. We can make an argument for placing a party in its own package. A number of applications might look for information about parties without wanting to know anything about the deals being carried out with them. A common party package might hold common information about parties used by many dealing systems, rather like a contact database. Thus we can conclude that a party package is valuable.

当事人与合同包之间会存在怎样的关系？当事人需要了解哪些合同是与其相关的，而合同也需要说明合同的各方是谁。这意味着当事人与合同之间存在相互可见性，如图 11.7 所示。但相互可见性可能会在包模型中引发问题。总体而言，我们力求设计具有分层架构和清晰可见性边界的包模型。许多人认为，这种架构中不应存在可见性关系的循环，因为循环会破坏清晰的层级结构。相互可见性是循环关系中最简单的例子。

What would be the relationship between the party and contract packages? It would be valuable for a party to tell which contracts were dealt with it, and for a contract to tell who the parties for the contract were. This implies mutual visibility between a party and a contract, as shown in Figure 11.7. But mutual visibility may cause problems in a package model. On the whole we try to design package models with a layered architecture and simple lines of visibility. Many people believe such an architecture should never have cycles in visibility relationships, because a cycle breaks the rule of clear layers. Mutual visibility is the simplest case of a cycle.

图 11.7 单独的当事人和合同包。

Figure 11.7 Separate party and contract packages.

有些应用只需要参与方包或合约包中的一个，但这 两个包又彼此依赖。这可能意味着相互可见。如果相互 可见不可接受，我们可以选择单一方向或将这两个包合并。

Some applications need only one of either the party package or the contract package, but both of these packages need each other. This can imply mutual visibility. If mutual visibilities are unacceptable, we can choose a single direction or combine the packages.

为了消除双方的知情权，我们必须要么改变参与方或合同的条款，使只有一方知晓另一方的信息，要么将它们合并为一个整体。每种方案都有其优缺点。

To remove mutual visibility we must either alter the features of party or contract so that only one knows about the other, or combine them into a single package. Each alternative has trade-offs.

将参与方和合约类型之间的可见性限制为单向的好处在于，它降低了两种类型（及其各自的包）之间的耦合度。如果我们移除从参与方到其合约的映射（使关联变为单向），我们就可以在无需了解任何合约信息的情况下开发参与方包。这降低了耦合度（参与方不再与合约耦合），这是一个优势。然而，如果用户想要了解特定参与方是哪些合约的交易对手，则必须查看每个合约，并使用到参与方的映射来构建合约集合。因此，我们降低了参与方包开发者的复杂度，但却增加了任何需要使用这两种类型的应用程序开发者的复杂度。这里没有绝对正确的答案；我们必须权衡每个方向的利弊，并决定哪个选择负担更小。

The benefit of restricting the visibility between the party and contract types to one direction is that it decreases the coupling between the two types (and their respective packages). If we remove the mappings from party to its contracts (making the association one-way) we can work on the party package without needing to know anything about contracts. This reduces the coupling (the party is no longer coupled to the contract), which is an advantage. However, a user who wants to know which contracts a particular party is the counterparty for must look at every contract and use the mappings to the party to form the set. Thus we have reduced the complexity for the developer of the party package but increased the complexity for the developer of any application that needs to use both types. There is no absolute right answer here; we have to look at the trade-offs in each direction and decide which choice is the lesser burden.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
单向关联和双向关联之间的选择，是在减少相关类型开发人员的工作量（通过降低耦合度）和为类型用户提供便利之间进行权衡。
The decision between a one-way and two-way association is a trade-off between less work for the developers of the types involved (by reducing their coupling) and convenience for the users of the types.

假设我们决定采用双向关联，那么消除相互可见性的唯一途径就是将参与方和合同管理包合并。然而，这样做并非没有缺点。如图 11.7 所示，合同管理包只需要了解参与方信息，无需了解合同信息。合并这两个管理包会移除这一信息。合同管理将被迫拥有超出实际所需的信息量。

Assuming we decide in favor of the two-way association, our only route to eliminating the mutual visibility is to combine the party and contract packages. This is not free of disadvantages, however. In Figure 11.7 we can see the contact management package only needs to know about parties, not contracts. Combining these two packages would remove this information. Contact management would be forced to have greater visibility than it needs to have.

这种情况让我不打算禁止相互可见性或其他循环。当然，循环应该尽可能减少。然而，完全取消循环会导致要么强制在单向关联和双向关联之间做出权衡，要么导致大型软件包的出现，而这些软件包的客户并不需要其中隐含的所有可见性。

This situation leads me not to ban mutual visibilities or other cycles. Certainly cycles should be reduced to the minimum. Eliminating them com pletely, however, leads to either forcing the trade-off between one-way and two-way associations or large packages whose clients do not need all the visibility that is implied.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果一个软件包只需要对另一个软件包的一部分可见，请考虑将后者拆分为两个相互可见的软件包。
If a package only needs visibility to part of another package, consider splitting the latter package into two mutually visible packages.

图 11.8 展示了这种情况的另一个例子。产品（参见 10.3 节）被添加到其自身的软件包中。前面的论证导致了产品、参与方和合同之间的相互可见性。这使得领域模型软件包之间的耦合度相当高。然而，应用程序软件包只需要看到部分信息，并且每个应用程序软件包的需求略有不同。这三个相互可见的软件包使我们能够清晰地了解这些需求。

Figure 11.8 shows another example of this situation. The product (see Section 10.3) is added in its own package. The preceding arguments lead to the mutual visibilities among product, party, and contract. This leads to fairly coupled domain model packages. The application packages, however, need to see only parts of the picture, and each application package has slightly different needs. The three mutually visible packages allow us to be clear on these needs.

另一种方法是将协议放在软件包中。然后，将参与方、产品和合同软件包合并，并提供三个独立的协议来对应原有的软件包。应用程序随后以与选择软件包相同的方式选择协议，如图 11.8 所示。

Another way of doing this puts protocols on packages. Then the party, product, and contract packages are combined and three separate protocols are provided to correspond to the old packages. Applications then select the protocols in the same way that they select the packages shown in Figure 11.8.

图 11.8 将产品添加到包装中。

Figure 11.8 Adding a product to the package.

同样，不同的应用需求可以通过相互可见的软件包来满足。

Again different application needs may be served by mutually visible packages.

总而言之，当类型之间天然紧密耦合时，我们有三种选择。我们可以通过设置单向关联来解耦类型（但这会增加类型使用者的负担）。我们可以将它们放入一个大型包中（但这意味任何包的使用者都可以访问整个包，即使他们只需要其中的一部分）。我们可以创建两个相互可见的包（但这会在包结构中引入循环）。如果包中包含协议，则可以创建一个包含多个独立协议的大型包。

To summarize, when types are naturally closely coupled, we have three options. We can decouple the types by making the associations one-way (but this makes it harder for the user of the types). We can put them into a single large package (but this means that any user of the package has visibility to the whole package, even if only part of it is needed). We can have two mutually visible packages (but this introduces cycles into the package structure). If you have protocols on packages, you can have one big package with separate protocols.

11.3 子类型包

11.3 Subtyping Packages

考虑可见性问题，子类型划分最为简便。子类型必须始终能够访问上类型，但反之则不然。因此，我们需要添加组合、选项和障碍（详见第 10 章），如图 11.9 所示。

Visibility is easiest to consider with subtyping. The subtype always needs to see a supertype, but we should avoid the reverse. Hence we add combinations, options, and barriers (described in Chapter 10), as shown in Figure 11.9.

我们还应避免子类型与其超类型之间的相互可见性。子类型化的全部意义就在于允许类型在不依赖 Portfolio 的情况下进行扩展。

We should also avoid mutual visibility between a subtype and its super-type. The whole point of subtyping is to allow a type to be extended without Portfolio

图 11.9 添加各种类型的选项。

Figure 11.9 Adding various kinds of options.

子类型需要对其超类型可见，但反之则不然。

Subtypes need visibility to their supertypes, but not vice versa.

超类型需要了解其子类型。如果我们设计的超类型了解其子类型，那么未来的特化可能会更加困难，因为我们在超类型中内置了关于子类型的假设。任何消除此类依赖性的努力都会在后续的增强中得到回报。正确设计超类型通常需要先积累一些设计子类型的经验，因此最好在构建几个子类型之后再去修改超类型。

the supertype being aware of it. If we design types with supertypes knowing about their subtypes, then future specialization is likely to be more difficult because we have built assumptions about subtyping into the supertype. Any effort to remove such dependencies is repaid in later enhancements. Designing supertypes correctly usually requires experience in designing a few subtypes first, so it is better not to fix the supertype until a few subtypes have been put together.

11.4 总结性思考

11.4 Concluding Thoughts

可见性总是意味着权衡取舍。限制可见性会降低模型的易用性。如果存在大量单向可见性，那么在模型中导航就如同在遍布单行道的城市中穿行一样困难。双向可见性则大大简化了导航，这意味着需要编写和维护的代码量更少。然而，这种可见性也并非没有代价。系统中相互可见的部分越多，就越难控制模型变更的影响。限制可见性可以降低这种相互依赖性。

Visibility always implies trade-offs. To restrict visibility reduces the ease with which the model can be navigated. With lots of one-way visibilities, getting around the model can be rather like getting around a city with lots of one-way streets. Two-way visibilities make navigation much easier, which means less code to write and maintain. Such visibilities come at a price, however. The more bits of the system see each other, the more difficult it is to control the effects of change in the model. Restricting visibility cuts down this interdependence.

不同的面向对象建模者对这种权衡的处理方式各不相同。有些人会大幅限制可见性，例如使用单向关联和类型可见性图等技术。我认为这种做法过于严格。我更倾向于在包级别而非类型级别考虑可见性。第 12 章介绍的架构将系统划分为多个基本层。在领域层中，可以进一步限制可见性，但这通常比较复杂。不过，由于我在信息系统方面的经验，我更倾向于这种方法。其他类型的开发则需要不同的权衡。

Different OO modelers make this trade-off differently. Some restrict visibility to a great extent, using techniques such as one-way associations and visibility graphs on types. I find this too restrictive. I consider visibility at the package rather than the type level. The architecture presented in Chapter 12 separates a system into basic layers. Within the domain tier, further visibility restrictions can be used, but this is seldom simple. I prefer this approach, however, because of my experience with information systems. Other kinds of developments merit different trade-offs.

大多数项目并未对包架构进行深入考虑。通常情况下，即使有架构，也只具备基本层级。这会给项目带来不利影响，并且难以评估一个完善的架构模型的价值。只有通过更多的实践，我们才能更深入地理解这里讨论的权衡取舍。

Most projects do not consider package architecture in any great detail. Often only the basic layers of the architecture are in place, if anything. This results in disadvantages to the project concerned and makes it difficult to assess the value of a properly enforced architectural model. Only more practice will allow us to further understand the trade-offs discussed here.

如果为单个项目开发软件包架构已经很复杂，那么当我们尝试为大型组织集成信息系统时，复杂性将增加十倍。大型组织往往被多个无法通信的系统所困扰。即使硬件和软件都经过了完善，由于系统底层概念的差异，这种集成仍然难以实现。一种普遍认可的解决方案是进行企业级建模。然而，这种方法的缺点是耗时过长。即便最终能够完成，之前的努力通常也早已过时且失去了价值。我认为，一次性能够处理的建模工作量是有限的，这与能否在合理的时间内交付能够证明建模成本合理的实用系统密切相关。因此，我们需要采取一种更具机会主义的方法来集成这些系统。我认为，对于这项任务而言，软件包和可视化是必要的工具。但它们并不足以完成这项任务，我也不敢妄称知道还需要什么。这种企业范围内的整合仍然鲜为人知，而且，像许多人一样，我只知道什么不该做！

If developing a package architecture is complex for one project, the complexity increases tenfold when we try to integrate information systems for a large organization. Large organizations are plagued by multiple systems that cannot communicate. Even if the hardware and software are beaten into shape, such integration is defeated by the difference between the concepts that underlie the systems. One generally recognized solution is to do enter prise-wide modeling. The problem with this approach, however, is that it takes too long. By the time it is done, if it ever is, the effort is usually discredited and out of date. I believe that there is an upper limit to the size of chunk of modeling that can be tackled in one go, and this is linked to delivering useful systems that justify the expense of modeling within a reasonable period of time. A more opportunistic approach needs to be taken to integrating them. For this task I believe that packages and visibilities are necessary tools. They are not sufficient for the task, and I will not pretend to know what else is needed. Such enterprise-wide integration is still little understood and, like many people, I have only learned what not to do!

参考

References

  2. Wirfs-Brock, R., B. Wilkerson, and L. Wiener. Designing Object-Oriented Software. Englewood Cliffs, NJ: Prentice-Hall, 1990.

第二部分：支撑模式

Part 2. Support Patterns

分析模式探讨分析中的问题，以及一些可以处理这些问题的模型。支持模式则着重解决围绕分析模式构建计算机系统时遇到的问题。第 12 章和第 13 章将探讨客户端/服务器信息系统的架构，以及如何对这类系统进行分层以提高其可维护性。第 14 章将着眼于如何实现概念模型，并提出将分析模式转化为软件的常用模式。

Analysis Patterns discuss problems in analysis, and some models that can deal with them. Support patterns address problems in building computer systems around the analysis patterns. In Chap-ters 12 and 13 we consider the architecture for a client/server in-formation system and how such a system can be layered to improve its maintainability. Chapter 14 looks at how conceptual models can be implemented, suggesting common patterns to turn analysis patterns into software.

最后，第15章更侧重于抽象层面，探讨建模技术本身以及如何将高级建模结构视为模式。这为我们扩展建模方法以支持特定需求奠定了更好的基础。

Finally Chapter 15 is more abstract, examining modeling techniques themselves and how advanced modeling constructs can be viewed as patterns. This gives us a better basis for extending modeling methods to support particular needs.

第十二章 信息系统的分层架构

Chapter 12. Layered Architecture for Information Systems

本书中的分析模式对企业信息系统开发人员来说极具价值。然而，信息系统 (IS) 开发不仅仅需要对某个领域有深入的了解，还必须兼顾众多用户、数据库和遗留系统。本章将讨论信息系统的架构模式。架构模式描述了系统在高层级上的划分，包括主要子系统以及子系统之间的依赖关系。信息系统架构模式将系统划分为多个层（或层级）。架构模式本身就很有用，但它们也展示了分析模式如何融入更广泛的上下文。第 13 章将介绍一种运用本章模式的技术。

The analysis patterns in this book will be of great value to developers of cor-porate information systems. Information system (IS) development involves more than an understanding of a domain, however. A world of many users, databases, and legacy systems must be accommodated. This chapter discusses architectural patterns for information systems. An architectural pattern describes the high-level division of a system into major subsystems and the dependencies among the subsystems. An information system architectural pattern divides the system into layers (or tiers). Architectural patterns are useful on their own, but they also show how the analysis patterns fit into a wider context. Chapter 13 describes a technique for using the patterns in this chapter.

面向对象技术的早期发展阶段并未过多关注信息系统（IS）的开发。主要问题在于，大量且往往复杂的信息需要由多人共享。尽管信息共享，但不同用户的需求却各不相同。提供既能满足通用需求又能进行本地化定制的信息是大型信息系统的首要目标。此外，为了满足不断变化的信息需求，系统需要具备高度的灵活性。大多数信息系统都以维护为主导，而维护工作主要涉及应对不断变化的信息需求。在这些环境下，面向对象技术的主要优势不在于构建新系统的速度，而在于降低维护负担[3]。

The early days of object technology did not focus much on IS develop-ment. The main problem is that large volumes of often complex information must be shared by many people. Although this information is shared, differ-ent users have different needs. Providing common information that can also be locally tailored is a primary goal of large information systems. Further-more, a great deal of flexibility is required to meet constantly changing infor-mation needs. Most information systems are dominated by maintenance, which primarily involves coping with changing information demands. The main advantage of object technology in these environments is not in the speed of building new systems but in reducing the maintenance burden [3],

开发现代信息系统最根本的问题在于理解其底层软件架构。在讨论采用哪些技术或考虑哪些流程之前，必须先对适用于信息系统的软件架构有一个全面的了解。

The most fundamental issue in developing a modern information system is understanding the underlying software architecture. A broad picture of the software architecture that is suitable for information systems must precede any discussion of which techniques to use or what process to consider.

大多数信息系统开发都默认采用两层架构（12.1），这种架构源于大型机交互系统，如今在客户端/服务器架构中也很常见。尽管两层架构应用广泛，但由于用户界面与物理数据布局的紧密耦合，它存在诸多缺陷。三层架构（12.2），也称为三模式架构，通过在用户界面和物理数据之间添加一个中间层来解决这个问题。这个领域层紧密地模拟了问题域的概念结构。面向对象技术尤其适合三层架构，而且领域层可以部署在客户端或服务器端。

Most IS developments tacitly assume a two-tier architecture (12.1), which follows from mainframe interactive systems and is common in client/server developments today. Despite its wide use, the two-tier architecture has many shortcomings due to the tight coupling of the user interface to the physical data layout. The three-tier architecture (12.2), also called the three-schema architecture, addresses this by putting an intermediate layer between the user interface and the physical data. This domain tier closely models the concep-tual structure of the problem domain. Object technology is particularly well suited to three-tier approaches, and the domain tier can be placed on either client or server machines.

接下来，我们将注意力转向应用程序，它负责操作领域层的对象并在用户界面上显示信息。这两项职责可以用来将应用程序拆分为表示层和应用逻辑层（12.3）。应用逻辑层可以组织成一组领域层上的外观层（Faceway），每个表示层对应一个外观层。这种划分方式有很多优点，应用外观层可以简化客户端/服务器交互。

Next we turn our attention to applications, which manipulate the objects of the domain tier and display information on the user interface. These two responsibilities can be used to split the application into presentation and application logic (12.3). The application logic can be organized as a set of facades on the domain tier, one facade for each presentation. This division has many advantages, and the application facades can be used to simplify client/server interactions.

数据库交互（12.4）可以通过两种方式处理。领域层可以负责访问数据库，而数据库则自行处理持久化。这种方式适用于面向对象或简单的关系型系统。当数据格式复杂或存在多个数据源时，可能需要额外的数据接口层。

Database interaction (12.4) can be handled in two ways. The domain tier can be responsible for accessing the database, which handles its own persis-tence. This works well for object-oriented or simple relational systems. When there are complex data formats or multiple data sources, an additional data interface layer may be required.

本章基于各种经验，特别是英国国家医疗服务体系的 Cosmos 项目和伦敦一家银行的衍生品交易系统。

This chapter is based on various experiences, in particular the Cosmos project of the UK National Health Service and a derivatives trading system for a London bank.

12.1 两层架构

12.1 Two-Tier Architecture

大多数交互式信息系统开发至少大致遵循两层架构原则，如图 12.1 所示。两层架构将系统划分为共享数据库和多个应用程序。共享数据库位于具有足够磁盘空间和处理能力的服务器上，以应对繁重的请求。数据库包含企业大部分业务所需的数据，其结构旨在满足该部分业务的所有需求。（对于大型公司而言，单一的企业级数据库是不切实际的，因此数据库通常只包含部分业务。）数据库由数据库团队设计和维护。虽然这里使用了“数据库”一词，但需要注意的是，数据通常存储在平面文件中（大多数商业数据仍然存储在平面文件，例如 VSAM 文件中）。因此，“数据库”可以指任何数据源。应用程序是为特定的本地用途而开发的。传统上使用 CICS/COBOL，但最近的开发工作更多地使用第四代编程语言 (4GL) 以及流行的应用程序开发工具 PowerBuilder 和 Visual Basic。这些工具

Most interactive IS development is organized, at least roughly, along the two-tier principle, as shown in Figure 12.1. A two-tier architecture divides the system into a shared database and several applications. The shared database sits on a server that has the disk space and processing needed to cope with heavy demands. The database contains the data required by a significant portion of the enterprise, structured to support all the needs of that portion. (For large companies a single corporatewide database is infeasible, so a data-base will take only a portion.) The database is designed and maintained by a database group. Although the term database is used here, it should be remembered that data is often stored in flat files (most commercial data still is on flat files such as VSAM). As such database can refer to any data source. Applications are developed for specific local uses. Traditionally CICS/ COBOL was used, but more recent efforts have used 4GLs and the popular application development tools Powerbuilder and Visual Basic. These tools

图 12.1 两层架构。

Figure 12.1 Two-tier architecture.

应用程序直接访问数据库。

Applications directly access databases.

为开发图形用户界面 (GUI) 系统提供完善的功能，而习惯于在电子表格和文字处理软件中使用类似功能的 PC 用户通常也需要良好的 Windows 界面。应用程序通常根据具体情况进行开发。任何所需的新数据功能都需向数据库组提出申请。

provide sophisticated features for developing GUI systems, and a good Windows interface is generally demanded by PC users who are used to such capabilities on their spreadsheets and word processors. Applications are usually built on a case-by-case basis. Any new data capabilities required are requested of the database group.

双层架构具有一些优势。大多数组织都拥有需要集中控制和持续维护的数据。而解读这些数据的应用程序则不需要那么集中的控制。许多信息系统工作都涉及以一种新的、有意义的方式呈现现有数据。

The two-tier architecture has some advantages. Most organizations have data that needs central control and consistent maintenance. Applications that interpret this data need much less centralized control. Much IS work involves presenting some existing data in a new and meaningful manner.

两层架构也存在诸多缺点，其中大部分是现有技术固有的。所有数据共享、所有处理都在本地进行的说法虽然大致正确，但过于简单化。企业中的许多处理环节都是共享的。无论是 SQL 还是更早的数据库，都无法提供计算完备的语言。此外，数据也未封装，导致应用程序员需要承担大量的数据完整性控制责任。这使得修改已经运行着大量应用程序的数据库结构变得十分困难。存储过程可以有效缓解这些问题，因为它能够提供数据处理支持并封装数据。

There are also many disadvantages of the two-tier architecture, most of which are inherent in current technologies. The idea that all data is shared and all processing is local is broadly true but a gross simplification. Many processing aspects of an enterprise are shared. Databases, whether SQL or older, are unable to provide a computationally complete language. The data is also unencapsulated, leaving a lot of integrity control in the hands of the application programmer. This makes it difficult to change a database struc-ture that already has many applications running against it. These problems are reduced by stored procedures that can provide support for processing and encapsulate data.

数据库通常无法真实地反映企业的实际状况。这是由于缺乏建模结构，这些结构在概念建模技术中很常见，但在日常数据库中仍远未得到充分支持。平面文件和层级数据库在数据结构方面存在众所周知的局限性。当前新开发的标准——关系型数据库——也存在连接操作成本高昂的问题。能够忠实反映底层业务语义的数据模型通常高度规范化，需要进行重组才能获得合理的性能。

Databases are often unable to give a true representation of the enterprise. This is due to the lack of modeling constructs, which are common in concep-tual modeling techniques but are still a long way from support in everyday databases. Flat files and hierarchic databases have well-known limits on data structure. The current standard for new development, relational databases, also suffer from the high cost of joins. Data models that are true to underlying business semantics are usually highly normalized and need reorganization for performance to be reasonable.

应用程序的数据不太可能全部存储在同一个数据库中。数据库即使在创建之初组织得当，经过几年的业务变化和公司重组后，通常也会变得不再那么连贯。双层架构要求应用程序不仅要知道哪些数据库存储哪些数据，还要了解每个数据库中数据的结构，而这些数据的结构可能与实际的语义相去甚远。

The data for an application is also unlikely to be on one database. Data-bases, even if organized sensibly at the time of creation, are usually not so coherent after a few years of business changes and corporate reorganizations. The two-tier architecture requires the applications to know which databases hold which data, as well as the structure of the data in each database, which may be quite a distance from the semantics of this data.

12.2 三层架构

12.2 Three-Tier Architecture

事实上，更优的架构早已存在。三层架构早在 20 世纪 70 年代就被提出 [4]。它提供了一种三层架构，如图 12.2 所示：外部模式、概念模式和存储（内部）模式。存储模式是数据库设计，外部模式是应用程序；新增的一层是概念模式，我称之为领域层。它代表了企业的真实语义，并且应该忽略数据存储结构和数据位置的限制。

A better architecture has in fact been around for a ve ry long time. The three-schema architecture was proposed back in the 1970s [4]. This provides a three-tier approach, as shown in Figure 12.2: external schema, conceptual schema, and storage (internal) schema. The storage schema is the database design, and the external schema is the applications; the new layer is the con-ceptual schema, which I refer to as the domain tier. This represents the true semantics of the enterprise. It should ignore the limitations of data storage structures and data location.

外部模式 概念模式 内部（存储）

External Schema Conceptual Schema Internal (storage)

模式

Schema

图 12.2 三层架构。

Figure 12.2 Three-tier architecture.

三层架构的主要优势在于，它允许应用程序完全基于领域语义进行描述。应用程序无需关注数据的物理位置和结构，而是可以着眼于消除这些依赖关系的逻辑图景。这使得数据管理员能够在不破坏现有应用程序的情况下更改物理结构和位置。

The main advantage of the three-tier approach is that it allows applica-tions to be described purely on the semantics of the domain. They do not have to be concerned with the physical location and structure of the data but can look instead at a logical picture that removes these dependencies. This also frees the data administrators to change the physical structure and loca-tion without breaking existing applications.

三层架构虽然被广泛认可，但实际应用却很少。主要原因在于它难以与现有技术兼容。现有的工具可以用于数据存储和应用程序开发，但却缺乏用于实现领域层的工具。最有价值的成果是逻辑数据模型，它通常被视为数据库设计中必不可少的第一步。逻辑数据模型允许设计人员在确定物理设计之前考虑企业语义。因此，物理设计的修改可以基于充分的信息进行。

The three-tier architecture is widely approved but rarely implemented. The principal reason for this is the difficulty of using it with existing technol-ogy. There are tools for data storage and for application development but not for implementing a domain tier. The most useful development is the logical data model, which is generally seen as a necessary first step in database design. This allows designers to consider enterprise semantics before com-mitting to a physical design. As such the modifications for physical design could be made in an informed manner.

对数据的重视程度很高。大多数从业者将领域层视为逻辑数据模型。他们或许也会进行流程建模，但这通常由应用程序开发人员单独考虑。然而，并非所有数据建模师都认同这种观点。语义数据建模师中有一派认为数据建模与面向对象建模非常相似，因为它包含了子类型和派生数据，将流程与对象关联起来，将流程视为数据，并将流程嵌入到语义模型中。

The stress on data is significant. Most practitioners consider the domain tier to be a logical data model. They might do process modeling, but it is usually considered separately by application developers. However, this view is not shared by all data modelers. A strong school of semantic data modelers view data modeling as very comparable with object-oriented modeling because it embraces subtyping and derived data, ties processes to objects, treats processes as data, and embeds processes within the semantic model.

随着面向对象技术的发展，领域层开始崭露头角。对象是实现领域层的一种非常有效的方式。它们支持封装、复杂的结构关系、规则、流程以及高级语义建模人员所考虑的所有方面。可重用的类库（或者更好的选择是框架）也是领域层的核心。企业的关键可重用对象是那些描述领域的对象——即实现领域层的框架（因此有了领域框架这个术语）。因此，对象建模和领域层开发能够非常有效地协同工作。

With the development of object-oriented techniques, the domain tier can begin to come to the fore. Objects represent a very good way to implement domain tiers. They support encapsulation, complex structural relationships, rules, processes, and all the things considered by advanced semantic model -ers. Reusable class libraries (or, better still, frameworks) are also at the heart of the domain tier. The key reusable objects of an enterprise are those that describe the domain—the framework that implements the domain tier (hence the term domain framework). Thus object modeling and domain tier develop-ment coincide very effectively.

实现方面的问题虽然比较复杂，但基本原则仍然非常有效：如果将领域层表示为面向对象的模型，并将其实现为领域框架，那么就可以基于该领域框架编写应用程序。这实现了应用程序和数据库之间亟需的分离。

Implementation issues are somewhat more complex, but the basic princi-ple still works very well: If the domain tier is expressed as an object-oriented model and implemented as a domain framework, then applications can be written against this domain framework. This provides the separation between applications and databases that is so sorely needed.

12.2.1 域层的位置

在客户端/服务器架构中，一个重要的问题是域层应该位于何处。两层架构将应用软件部署在客户端（桌面计算机）上，而将数据存储在各种数据服务器上。对于域层，我们有两种基本选择：我们可以将域层部署在客户端，或者我们可以引入一个新的处理器层，即域服务器，它由一台或多台联网的计算机组成。

In a client/server world an important question is where this domain tier should sit. A two-tier approach places application software on the client (desktop machines) and the data on various data servers. With the domain tier we have two basic choices: We can place the domain tier on the clients, or we can introduce a new layer of processors, which is the domain server and consists of one or many networked machines.

基于客户端的领域框架使我们能够将开发重点放在客户端机器上，从而简化系统支持。引入新的机器层对许多企业来说可能是一个棘手的问题，需要维护另一套机器和系统。领域层以库的形式提供给客户端系统的应用程序开发人员，他们可以根据需要编写应用程序代码。

Client-based domain frameworks allow us to concentrate development on client machines, simplifying our systems support. Introducing a new layer of machines may well be a new headache for many shops and provides another set of machines and systems to maintain. The domain tier is provided as a set of libraries to application developers of client systems who can then write application code as necessary.

基于客户端的域层架构的一个问题是，我们可能需要在客户端进行大量的数据选择和处理。这迫使我们使用性能强大的客户端机器。随着桌面机器性能的不断提升，这个问题有所缓解，但我们不能想当然地认为所有机器都具备如此强大的性能。技术的发展推动着我们采用更小的机器；一些用户希望使用掌上电脑和PDA，这可能会限制处理能力。通常情况下，当需要更强大的处理能力时，升级服务器会更加便捷。

One problem with a client-based domain tier is that we may need to do a lot of data selection and processing on the client. This forces us to use power-ful client machines. As desktop machines become ever more powerful, this becomes less of a problem, but we cannot assume such power. Technology pushes us to ever smaller machinery; some users want to use palmtops and PDAs, which can limit processing. Often it is easier to upgrade servers when more processing power is required.

现有软件非常适合基于客户端的方法。Smalltalk 通常是信息系统应用中最常用的语言，它需要一个与域层集成的用户界面，尽管现在也开始出现一些无需用户界面、运行在服务器上的“无头”Smalltalk 版本。

Available software fits quite well with a client-based approach. Smalltalk, generally the most useful language for IS applications, requires a user inter-face tied into the domain tier, although "headless" Smalltalks that run on a server without a user interface are beginning to appear.

在基于服务器的域层中，域层更容易控制和更新。如果域层位于客户端，则任何修订都需要发送给每个客户端。服务器上的软件更新可以采用更直接的方式进行处理。这种控制也延伸到对静态数据的支持，特别是那些涉及数据访问方式的数据。

The domain tier is easier to control and update in a server-based domain tier. If the domain tier is on the clients, then any revision needs to be sent out to each client. Software updates on a server can be handled in a much more straightforward pattern. This control also extends to support of standing data, particularly those items that involve how data is accessed.

我们需要考虑并发问题。有趣的是，信息系统应用程序可能比其他任何类型的软件都更依赖并发，但却最不担心并发问题。这得益于强大的事务模型，而数据库通常能够很好地处理这些事务，从而使应用程序员摆脱了大部分并发难题。随着领域层的引入，我们必须思考事务边界应该设在哪里。我们可以将其置于数据服务器或领域层本身。逻辑上来说，领域层是更合适的位置，但这需要我们构建事务控制功能——这是一项棘手的任务。这种布局也促使我们采用基于服务器的领域层，因为跨多个客户端的提交在当前技术上几乎不可能实现。我从不鼓励客户构建自己的事务控制系统；这项任务超出了大多数信息系统开发的范围。

We need to consider concurrency issues. It is interesting that IS applica-tions probably use more concurrency than any other style of software yet worry about it least. This is due to the powerful transaction model that is usually handled very well by a database, freeing the application programmer from most concurrency headaches. As the domain tier is introduced, we have to ask ourselves where the transaction boundary is to be. We can place it either in the data servers or in the domain tier itself. The logical place is the domain tier, but this requires us to build in transaction control features—a tricky business. Such placement also encourages the server-based domain tier, since a commit across many clients is pragmatically beyond current technology. I never encourage clients to build their own transaction control systems; that task is outside the scope of most IS developments.

面向对象数据库为解决这个问题提供了一种方案。信息系统领域对面向对象数据库的主要担忧在于如何将企业数据托付给一项新技术。面向对象数据库通过提供与传统数据库产品的连接通道来应对这一问题。在这种方法中，面向对象数据库可以充当事务控制机制，而无需自身存储任何数据。随着时间的推移，一些数据，特别是面向对象数据库能够出色管理的复杂且相互关联的数据，可以迁移到面向对象数据库中。然而，关键的企业数据可以根据开发人员的意愿保留在更传统的数据库中。这里需要特别注意的是，关于面向对象数据库的多用户性能信息很少。许多关于面向对象数据库性能显著提升的说法都基于小型单用户数据库。任何使用面向对象数据库的人，即使只是用于事务控制，也应该在最终选择该数据库之前进行基准测试。

OO databases provide a solution to this problem. The major concern in IS communities with OO databases is trusting the corporate data to a new tech-nology. OO databases have responded to this by providing gateways to tradi-tional database products. In this approach an OO database can act as the transaction control mechanism without necessarily storing any data itself. Over time some data, particularly the complex and connected data that an OO database can manage so well, can be moved to the OO database. How-ever, key corporate data can stay in more traditional places as long as the developers like. The important warning here is that there is little information on multiuser performance for OO databases. Many of the dramatic perfor -mance improvements quoted for OO databases are based on small, single-user databases. Anyone using an OO database, even if only for transaction control, should benchmark before committing to the database.

如果仅使用单个面向对象数据库，则数据存储层实际上会被合并到域层中。只要该架构有效，并且系统扩展以支持其他数据库的方式能够确保这些其他数据库位于域层之后，从而使应用程序无法访问它们，这种做法就是允许的。

If only a single OO database is used, then the data storage layer is effec-tively collapsed into the domain tier. This is permissible provided that this is an effective architecture and that extensions to the system to support other databases can be done in such a way that these other databases are provided behind the domain tier so that they are not visible from applications.

12.3 表示层和应用层逻辑

12.3 Presentation and Application Logic

三层架构提供了一些非常重要的优势。人们对如何构建领域层投入了大量精力，面向对象建模的大部分内容也直接应用于这一关键层。然而，关于应用层的讨论却很少。应用层是通过组装领域层中的可重用组件而构建的，虽然也有一些相关的指导原则，但这些原则通常缺乏详细描述。

The three-tier architecture provides some very important benefits. Much attention has been lavished on how the domain tier can be constructed, and a good portion of OO modeling is directly applied to this key layer. Little, how-ever, has been said about applications. Applications are built by assembling the reusable components in the domain tier, and there are guidelines for this task as well, although they are often not described in any detail.

在当今的开发环境中，程序员通常在基于领域层的图形用户界面（GUI）环境中开发应用程序。这需要同时掌握GUI环境和领域层的相关知识，而复杂的领域层会使学习曲线变得相当陡峭。此外，在许多图形环境（例如Visual C++）中进行编程也可能相当具有挑战性。

Typically in today's environment a programmer develops an application within a GUI environment, which is built on the domain tier. This requires knowledge of the GUI environment and of the domain tier, and a complex domain tier can make the learning curve quite steep. Programming in many graphics environments (such as Visual C++) can also be pretty daunting.

考虑一个相对简单的例子：一家金融机构持有美元（USD）和日元（JPY）衍生品合约组合。该机构关注的是管理此类组合的风险。多种因素会影响这种风险，包括即期汇率、汇率波动以及两种货币的利率。为了评估这种风险，分析师希望考察在这些不同因素的各种组合下，该组合的价格。一种方法是使用图 12.3 所示的矩阵。分析师选择两个变量进行分析，设定不同的值，然后查看一个矩阵，该矩阵显示了在不同值组合下组合的价值。

Consider a relatively simple example of a financial institution that has a portfolio of derivative contracts between US dollars (USD) and Japanese yen (JPY). Such an organization is concerned with managing the risk associated with such a portfolio. Several factors can affect this risk, including the spot exchange rate, the volatility of the exchange rate, and the interest rates of the two currencies involved. To consider this risk, the analyst wishes to look at the price of the portfolio under various combinations of these different fac-tors. One way of doing this is by using the grid shown in Figure 12.3. The analyst picks two variables to analyze, sets various values for these, and sees a matrix that shows the value of the portfolio under the combinations of values.

处理任务有哪些？我们应该如何将它们划分到应用层和领域层？一项基本任务是确定衍生品合约的价值，这是一个复杂的过程，通常使用布莱克-斯科尔斯模型分析法[2]来处理。任何衍生品交易环境中的系统都会广泛使用此过程，因此它应该放在领域层。另一项常见任务是对投资组合中的多个合约进行整体估值。

What are the processing tasks and how should we divide them between the application and domain tiers? One fundamental task is that of determining the value of a derivative contract, a complex process typically handled by Black-Scholes analysis [2]. This process would be widely used by any system in a derivatives trading environment, so it would be placed in the domain tier. Another common task is the valuing of many contracts together in a portfolio,

图 12.3 衍生品风险管理的应用示例。

Figure 12.3 An example application to manage derivative risk.

通常情况下，这部分代码位于域层。下一步是根据网格中的参数（上限、下限、步长、步数）构建一个值网格。这项任务是此风险报告屏幕特有的，因此从逻辑上讲，它应该属于应用层，与构建和控制 GUI 的代码放在一起。

which is usually placed in the domain tier. The next task is to build a grid of values from the parameters (upper, lower, step size, number of steps) in the grid. This task is unique to this risk report screen so logically should be part of the application tier, together with the code that builds and controls the GUI.

构建矩阵的任务相当复杂，需要仔细研究。它涉及设置各种参数，保持参数一致，然后使用这些参数构建数值网格。这个过程可以而且应该与图形用户界面 (GUI) 上的显示分离。因此，我建议将应用层拆分为两层：表示层和应用逻辑层，如图 12.4 所示。

The task of building the matrix is quite involved and requires a closer look. It involves setting the various parameters, keeping them consistent, and then using the parameters to build the grid of values. This process can and should be separated from the display on a GUI screen. Thus I recommend splitting of the application tier into two: a presentation tier and an applica-tion logic tier, as shown in Figure 12.4.

这两个层级的职责很容易区分。前表示层只负责用户界面，包括窗口、菜单、字体、颜色以及在屏幕或纸上的所有定位。它通常使用用户界面框架，例如 MFC 或 MacApp。它不进行任何计算、查询或对领域层的更新，实际上也不需要对领域层有任何可见性。应用逻辑层完全不进行任何用户界面处理，它负责所有对领域层的访问以及除用户界面处理之外的任何处理。它从底层领域层选择信息，并将其简化为表示层所需的精确格式。因此，领域层复杂的相互关系对表示层是隐藏的。此外，应用逻辑层还执行类型转换。表示层通常只处理一小部分常用类型（整数、实数、字符串和日期，以及软件中使用的集合类）。应用逻辑层仅提供这些类型。

The responsibilities of the two tiers are quite easy to separate. The pre-sentation tier is responsible for user interface only. It handles windows, menus, fonts, colors, and all positioning on screen or paper. Typically it uses a user interface framework such as MFC or MacApp. It does not do any calcu-lations, queries, or updates to the domain tier. Indeed it does not need to have any visibility to the domain tier. The application logic tier does no user interface processing whatsoever. It is responsible for all accesses to the domain tier and any processing other than user interface processing. It selects information from the underlying domain tier and simplifies it into the exact form that the presentation requires. The complex interrelationships of the domain tier are thus hidden from the presentation. Furthermore, the applica-tion logic tier performs type conversion. The presentation will typically deal only with a small set of common types (integer, real, string, and date, plus the collection classes used in the software). The application logic provides only

图 12.4 将应用层拆分为表示层和应用逻辑层

Figure 12.4 Splitting up the application tier into presentations and application logic

这些类型，并负责将底层域类型转换为这些类型，并解释表示层请求的任何更新。

these types and is responsible for converting the underlying domain types into these types and interpreting any updates requested by the presentation.

组织应用逻辑层的一种有效方法是开发一系列外观（facade）。外观[1]是一种为复杂模型提供简化接口的类型。我们可以为每个呈现方式准备一个外观。外观为相应用户界面上的每个元素都提供了一个特性。因此，每个呈现方式都具有一个简单的领域模型接口，从而最大限度地减少了除用户界面之外的任何呈现处理。（第13章讨论了设计这些外观的技术）。

A useful way of organizing the application logic tier is to develop a series of facades. A facade [1] is a type that provides a simplified interface to a com-plicated model. We can prepare a facade for each presentation. The facade has a feature for each element on the corresponding user interface. Each pre-sentation thus has a simple interface to the domain model that minimizes any processing for the presentation other than the user interface. (Chapter 13 discusses a technique for designing these facades).

图 12.5 展示了上述风险报告屏幕的组织结构。我们需要两个类：风险报告展示类和风险报告外观类。展示类创建屏幕布局并管理用户与其的交互。外观类提供了一个模拟展示类的底层结构。它包含用于获取和设置网格 x 和 y 坐标的参数（上限、下限、步数和步长）的操作。外观类包含确保这些值之间一致性的必要规则（例如不变式 xUpper - xLower == xNumberOfSteps * xStepSize）。它还提供了一个返回结果网格的方法。理想情况下，该方法使用通用矩阵类返回一个矩阵。（如果由于某种原因无法实现或不希望使用通用矩阵类，则外观类提供获取特定单元格的操作，但通常情况下，使用可重用的矩阵类（本质上是一种新型集合）是最佳解决方案。）

Figure 12.5 shows how this organization works for the risk report screen mentioned above. We need two classes: a risk report presentation and a risk report facade. The presentation creates the layout of the screen and manages the user's interactions with it. The facade provides an underlying structure that mimics the presentation. It has operations to get and set the parameter, upper, lower, number of steps, and step size for the x and y coordinates of the grid. The facade contains the rules necessary to ensure proper consistency among these values (such as the invariant xUpper - xLower == xNumberOfSteps * xStepSize). It also provides a method to return the answer grid. Ideally this returns a single matrix using a general matrix class. (If for some reason this is neither available nor desired, then the facade provides operations to get particular cells, but a reusable matrix class, essentially a new kind of collection, is usually the best solution.)

图 12.5 交互图总结了表示层、外观层和领域层之间的协作。

Figure 12.5 Interaction diagram summarizing collaborations between presentation, facade, and domain tiers.

外观层的 getResultMatrix 方法会检查展示层是否提供了足够的信息（如果信息不足，则会添加默认值），然后请求领域层使用各种参数组合对投资组合进行估值。领域层将结果放入矩阵中，并将其返回给展示层。

The getResultMatrix method on the facade looks to see if enough infor-mation has been provided by the presentation (if not, it can add defaults) and then asks the domain tier to value the portfolio with the various combina-tions of parameters. The domain tier puts the results into the matrix and returns it to the presentation.

参数设置是使用类型转换的一个例子。各种对象都可以作为参数放入此列表中，包括美元/日元现货、美元/日元波动率、美元利率和日元利率。（该列表取决于投资组合中合约的货币。）外观层会根据领域层中的类型（参见第 13.5 节）为展示层提供相应的字符串。外观层通常会提供一个字符串列表，供展示层将其添加到弹出菜单中。展示层可以选择一个字符串。外观层会将所选字符串与底层领域对象关联起来（字典可以很好地处理此过程）。这样，用户界面就与领域模型完全隔离了。

Setting of parameters is an example of using type conversion. Various objects can be placed as parameters in this list, including USD/JPY spot, USD/JPY volatility, USD interest rate, and JPY interest rate. (The list depends on the currencies of the contracts in the portfolio.) The facade provides appropriate strings to the presentation, translating from the types in the domain tier (see Section 13.5). The facade typically provides a list of such strings for the presentation to place in its pop-up menu. The presentation can then select a string. The facade correlates the selected string to the underly-ing domain objects (a dictionary handles this nicely). In this way the user interface is completely insulated from the domain model.

在这种情况下，域之间的可见性定义如图 12.6 所示。可见性仅从表示层流向应用逻辑层，再流向域层。这种可见性路径非常重要，因为它隔离了……

In this situation the visibilities between the domains are defined as shown in Figure 12.6. Visibilities flow only from presentation to application logic to domain tier. This line of visibility is valuable because it insulates the

图 12.6 展示、外观和领域类别之间的可见性。

Figure 12.6 Visibilities between presentation, facade, and domain categories.

领域层与依赖它的应用程序完全隔离。然而，如果领域模型发生变化时需要自动更新表示层，则可能会出现问题。一种方法是让表示层定期轮询，但这可能会变得非常混乱。更好的选择是使用观察者模式[1]。这允许外观层和表示层自动更新，而不会违反可见性规则。

domain tier completely from the applications that rely on it. A problem can occur, however, if the presentation needs to be automatically updated when a change occurs in the domain model. One option is for the presentation to poll at regular intervals, but this can get quite messy. A better option is to use the observer pattern [1]. This allows the facade and presentation to be auto-matically updated without breaking the visibility rules.

12.3.1 表示层/应用层逻辑分离的优势

分层架构在理论上是个好主意，但它也存在一些缺点：构建分层需要额外的工作，而且使用分层可能会带来性能损失。关键问题是，这些优势是否值得付出这些代价？

Layering is a good idea in principle, but it does have some disadvantages: the extra work is required to build the layer, and a performance penalty can be incurred in using it. The important question is, are the advantages worth the costs?

优势之一在于两层架构中不同的编程风格。GUI 编程可能非常复杂，需要掌握 GUI 框架及其使用方法。如果需要新的 GUI 控件，编程会变得更加复杂。另一方面，如果我们拥有一个优秀的 GUI 屏幕构建器，GUI 开发就可以相当简单，它允许我们在屏幕上绘制控件并创建事件处理程序，这些处理程序通常会作为调用传递给应用程序外观层。无论哪种情况，开发团队都可以聘用 GUI 专家，他们几乎不需要了解领域模型。同样，外观层程序员也不需要了解 GUI 系统的工作原理，他们只专注于与领域类型进行正确的交互。因此，我们可以看到，既有了解用户界面环境但无需了解领域模型的 GUI 开发人员，也有了解领域模型但无需了解 GUI 开发的外观层开发人员。表示层/应用程序逻辑的分离将不同的技能要求分开，使开发人员能够以更少的学习量做出贡献。

One advantage comes from the different styles of programming involved in the two layers. GUI programming can be very complex, requiring a knowl-edge of GUI frameworks and how to use them well. If new GUI controls are required, programming becomes even more complex. On the other hand, GUI development can be quite straightforward if we have a good GUI screen builder, allowing us to draw controls on the screen and make event handlers that would typically be relayed as calls to the application facade. In either case develo pment organizations can use GUI specialists who need to know little about the domain model. Similarly the facade programmers need know nothing about how the GUI system works, they concern themselves with getting the right interactions with the domain types. Thus we see that there can be GUI developers who understand the user interface environment but need to know nothing about the domain model, and facade developers who understand the domain model but do not need to know about GUI develop-ment. The presentation/application logic split separates different required skills, allowing developers to learn less in order to make a contribution.

这种拆分功能允许从单个界面创建多个演示文稿；当需要包含相同信息的自定义屏幕或纸质布局时，此功能尤其有用。使用屏幕和报表构建工具时，可以快速创建新的演示文稿样式。

The split allows multiple presentations to be developed from a single facade; this is particularly useful when customized screen or paper layouts containing the same information are required. When tools are used for screen and report building, this allows a quick turnaround for new presenta-tion styles.

外观层为测试提供了良好的平台。当外观层和表示层结合在一起时，基础计算只能通过图形用户界面 (GUI) 进行测试，需要手动测试（或使用 GUI 测试软件进行回归测试）。当它们分离时，可以为外观层的接口编写测试框架。这样就只剩下表示层代码需要使用更繁琐的工具进行测试。测试的分离强化了这两个层可以分别构建的观点，尽管表示层必须在构建外观层之前定义。

The facades provide a good platform for testing. When facade and presen-tation are combined, the base computation can only be tested via the GUI, requiring manual testing (or GUI testing software for regression testing). When these are separated a test harness can be written for the facade's inter-face. This leaves only the presentation code that needs to be tested by using more awkward tools. The separation of testing reinforces the point that the two layers can be built separately, although the presentation must be defined before the facade can be built.

12.3.2 在客户端/服务器环境中扩展外观

如果领域层基于服务器，那么外观（Face）作为客户端/服务器交互的焦点就显得尤为重要。在这种情况下，一种有效的技术是将外观“延伸”到客户端和服务器端，即在客户端和服务器上都放置一个外观类。当用户打开一个演示时，客户端会打开相应的外观。客户端外观会将请求传递给服务器端外观。服务器端外观会执行创建过程，从领域类中提取信息。当外观的所有信息都已准备就绪后，服务器端外观会将所有信息发送给客户端。由于服务器端和客户端外观可以位于不同的对象空间中，因此两个外观类之间可以进行一系列私有通信。然后，用户可以与演示进行交互，每次修改都会更新客户端外观。这些修改只有在用户提交后才会传递给服务器端外观。此时，修改后的外观对象会被传递回服务器，服务器端外观随后会更新领域层，如图 12.7 所示。

The facade is valuable as a focal point for client/server interactions if the domain tier is based on the server. A useful technique in these cases is to "stretch" the facade across the client and the server, placing a facade class on both the client and the server. When the user opens a presentation, the corre-sponding facade is opened on the client side. The client facade passes the request onto the server facade. The server facade goes through the creation process, pulling information out of the domain classes. When all the informa-tion for the facade is complete, the server facade sends all information for the facade over to the client. Since the server and client facades can be in differ-ent object spaces, a series of private communications between the two facade classes can occur. The user can then interact with the presentation, which will update the client facade with each modification. These modifications are not passed onto the server facade until the user commits the modifications. At that point the modified facade object is passed back to the server, and the server facade then updates the domain tier, as shown in Figure 12.7.

扩展外观模式的意义在于它为客户端/服务器交互提供了一个单一的引用点。如果客户端外观模式（或表示层）直接访问服务器域类，则需要通过网络进行多次调用才能填充客户端数据。这些网络调用会显著影响性能。外观模式可以提供方法来构建单个传输数据包，并将该数据包解析为外观模式自身的数据。这样，我们就可以通过一次网络调用传递所有信息。

The point of stretching a facade is that it allows a single point of refer-ence for client/server interaction. If a client facade (or a presentation) accesses the server domain classes directly, we will see many calls required across the network to populate the client. These network calls can be a signif-icant overhead on performance. The facades can have methods to build a single transfer packet and interpret such a packet into the facade's data. We can then pass all information in a single network call.

外观模式的各项职责可以分配给客户端和服务端类。只有服务端外观模式需要负责与领域模型交互。两个类都需要能够向对方发送和接收信息。理想情况下，只有客户端外观模式需要负责支持表示层的操作。然而，在实践中，我发现这样做是值得的。

The various responsibilities of the facade can be split between the client and server classes. Only the server facade needs the responsibilities for inter-acting with the domain model. Both classes need to be able to send and receive information to the other. Ideally only the client facade needs the oper-ations to support the presentation. In practice, however, I find it worthwhile to

图 12.7 图 12.3 的交互图，使用拉伸立面。

Figure 12.7 The interaction diagram of Figure 12.3 using stretched facades.

为了方便测试，给这两个类赋予相同的接口（即，它们的类型相同）。双方都需要加载和保存操作。客户端外观通过与服务器外观通信来实现这些操作，而服务器则通过与领域模型通信来实现这些操作。

give the two classes the same interface to make testing easier (that is, they are the same type). Both sides require load and save operations. The client facade implements these operations by communicating with the server facade, and the server implements them by communicating with the domain model.

12.4 数据库交互

12.4 Database Interaction

我们需要仔细考虑如何将数据库和遗留应用程序集成到这个架构中。最简单的情况是使用对象数据库。在这种情况下，最直接的方法就是将数据库集成到领域层。对象数据库随后会提供持久化、事务管理以及其他企业程序员无需操心的功能。

We need to think carefully about how to integrate databases and legacy applications into this structure. The simplest case is when an object database is used. In this case the straightforward approach is to simply integrate the database into the domain tier. The object database then provides facilities for persistence, transaction management, and other features that no enterprise programmer should have to worry about.

然而，在信息系统部门，很少有应用场景如此简单。许多信息系统部门对对象数据库抱有疑虑，不愿将关键数据存储其中。这部分是因为对象数据库出现时间较短，但也源于其复杂性。关系型表一旦出现问题，相对容易排查。而对象数据库由于磁盘指针众多，处理起来则困难得多。

Few applications, however, are that simple in an IS shop. Many IS organizations are distrustful of object databases and are reluctant to place critical data in them. This is partly because of their newness but also because of their complexity. Relational tables are relatively easy to dissect if something goes wrong. Object databases, with rampant disk pointers, are much more difficult.

即使对象数据库是新开发的理想选择，现有数据的问题依然存在。关系数据库虽然目前已被公认为成熟的数据库开发技术，但尚未能管理绝大多数企业数据。绝大多数企业数据仍然存储在层级数据库、平面文件等形式中。对象系统必须与这些系统交互，根据需要获取数据，并应对需要访问多个系统才能获得完整视图的现实。我们可以采用两种主要方法：让领域模型与数据源交互，或者使用数据库接口层。

Even if object databases were a confident choice for new development, there is still the issue of existing data. Even relational databases, despite their current position as the proven technology for database development, have not yet reached the position of managing the majority of corporate data. The vast majority of corporate data lies on hierarchical databases, flat files, and the like. Object systems must interact with these systems, taking feeds as necessary, dealing with the fact that many systems have to be accessed to get an integrated picture. There are two broad approaches we can use: letting the domain model interact with the data sources or using a database interface layer.

12.4.1 将域层与数据源连接起来

让我们考虑一个简单的独立系统，它需要使用关系数据库进行数据存储。我们可以专门设计关系数据库来支持领域模型。我们应该首先设计领域层，并以此为基础构建数据库模式。除了最简单的系统之外，几乎不可能简单地将领域模型中的每个对象类型都转换为关系表。尽管名为关系数据库，但它们在关联数据方面存在问题，因为计算连接操作非常耗时。因此，一个好的关系设计应该进行显著的非规范化，以获得良好的性能。领域模型为数据库设计提供了一个起点，但高质量的数据库设计需要时间。最终的数据库模式可能与原始对象图截然不同。

Let's consider the simple case of a stand-alone system that needs to use a relational database for data storage. We can design the relational database specifically to support the domain model. We should design the domain tier first and base the database schema on that. For all but the simplest systems, it is not possible to simply take each object type in the domain model and turn it into a relational table. Despite their name, relational databases have a problem relating data because computing joins is time-consuming. A good relational design thus should denormalize significantly to get good performance. The domain model provides a starting point for the database design, but the database design needs time to be done well. The resulting database schema can look quite different from the original object diagrams.

将领域层与数据库连接起来的最直接方法是让领域类知道如何从数据库中构建自身。类可以拥有加载例程，从数据库中提取数据，并利用这些数据创建和组装框架。重要的是，应用程序不应参与此过程。当应用程序请求一个对象时，领域层应该检查该对象是否已存在于内存中。如果不存在，则应从数据库中获取该对象并自行创建。应用程序无需了解此交互的具体过程。

The obvious way to link the domain tier to the database is to have the domain classes know how to build themselves from the database. Classes can have load routines that pull data out of the database and use this to create and knit together the framework. It is important that applications not get involved in this behavior. When an application requests an object, the domain tier should look to see if it is in memory. If not, it should get the object to create itself off the database. The application should not need to know how this interaction is occurring.

当应用程序需要特定的数据配置才能运行，并且该数据可以在启动时一次性从数据库中提取出来，从而提高性能时，此流程便不再适用。在这种情况下，域层可以提供应用程序特定的加载请求，让应用程序有机会告知域层即将请求的内容，这将非常有用。这在一定程度上违背了域层不应知晓哪些应用程序正在使用它的原则，但在某些情况下，性能提升可能非常显著。

An exception to this procedure occurs when applications need a particular data configuration to work on, and that data can be pulled from the database in one step at the beginning, thus improving performance. In this case it can be useful for the domain tier to offer application-specific load requests that give the application a chance to let the domain tier know what it is about to be asked for. To some extent this compromises the principle that the domain tier should not know what applications use it, but the performance gains can be compelling in some circumstances.

12.4.2 数据库接口层

领域层与数据库之间的直接连接确实存在一些重大问题。它赋予领域类两个独立的职责：提供业务的执行模型和从数据库提取数据，这会使领域类变得过于复杂。与数据库交互所需的代码量可能相当庞大，导致类臃肿不堪。如果需要从多个数据库和数据源提取数据，那么这个问题将变得尤为关键。

The direct link between the domain tier and the database does have some significant problems. It can complicate the domain classes excessively by giving them two independent responsibilities: providing an executing model of the business and pulling data from a database. The code required to interact with the database can be quite substantial, bloating the classes excessively. If data has to be pulled from multiple databases and feeds, then this problem becomes critical.

当然，解决方法是增加一个层——数据库接口层。该层负责将数据库中的数据加载到域层，并在域发生变化时更新数据库。此外，该层还负责处理信息流和其他遗留交互。

An answer, of course, is to add another layer—a database interface tier, which is responsible for loading the domain tier with data from the database and for updating the database when the domain changes. This tier is also in charge of handling feeds and other legacy interactions.

在许多方面，数据库接口层与应用程序逻辑层非常相似。两者都为复杂的领域层提供了一个外观层，以应对功能较弱的表示方式。该外观层选择并简化对象结构，并将类型转换为更简单的外部类型系统。同样，领域层应该无需了解对其的各种视图。通常，数据库接口类基于它们所操作的数据源。可以为关系数据库中的每个表或数据源中的每个记录类型构建一个数据库接口类。支持数据库交互的类库通常支持这种对应关系。

In many ways the database interface tier is very similar to the application logic tier. In both cases a facade is provided to a complex domain tier to cope with a less powerful representation. This facade selects and simplifies the object structure and performs type conversion to the simpler external type system. Again, the domain tier should be unaware of the various views that can be taken of it. Typically the database interface classes are based on the data source with which they are working. A database interface class can be constructed for each table in a relational database, or each record type in a feed. Class libraries to support database interaction often support this kind of correspondence.

这一层与应用逻辑层最大的区别在于活动的启动方式。对于用户界面，用户的操作会触发表示层启动活动。由于表示层可以访问应用逻辑，因此调用应用逻辑非常直接。活动的启动遵循可见性原则。然而，数据库接口的情况并非如此。领域层启动流程的初衷是保存自身数据，但我们不希望领域模型访问数据库。因此，活动的启动与预期的可见性相反。一种解决方案是再次使用观察者[1]，但这很可能会导致大量的消息流量。

The biggest difference between this tier and the application logic tier lies in the initiation of activity. With the user interface, the user's action causes the presentation to initiate the activity. Since the presentation has visibility to the application logic, then it is straightforward for it to call the application logic. The initiation of activity follows the line of visibility. However, this is not the case with the database interface. The domain tier begins the process by wanting to save itself, but we do not want the domain model to see the database. Thus the initiation of activity is opposite to the desired visibilities. One solution is to use the observer [1] again, but that could well lead to a very high degree of message traffic.

另一种方法是在架构中添加一个接口代理，该代理对领域层可见。该代理提供一个非常小的接口，仅允许发起数据库接口的消息。这些消息通常是像 `loadMe(anObject)` 和 `saveMe(anObject)` 这样通用的调用，它们将处理请求的所有责任都传递给了数据库接口层。代理的职责是将此请求传递给数据库接口中最适合处理该请求的类。因此，如果我们在一个数据库表中存储现货合约，在另一个数据库中存储常规期权，接口代理首先会查询对象以确定它是哪种类型的合约，然后将请求传递给相应的数据库接口类，如图 12.8 和图 12.9 所示。

An alternative is to extend the architecture with an interface broker, which is visible to the domain tier. This broker provides a very small interface, which allows only messages that initiate the database interface. These might typically be calls as general as loadMe(anObject) and saveMe(anObject), which pass on all responsibility to dealing with the request to the database interface tier. The broker's responsibility is to then pass this request onto a class in the database interface that can best handle the request. Thus if we have spot contracts held in one database table and conventional options held in another, the interface broker first interrogates the object to find which it is and then passes the request onto the appropriate database interface class, as shown in Figures 12.8 and 12.9.

这种分层架构的优势与其他分层架构的优势类似。同样，职责以一种有效的方式进行划分，将数据接口与企业模型分离。表格格式或数据源的更改可以……

The advantages of this layering are similar to the advantages of layering elsewhere. Again, responsibilities are split in a useful manner, separating the data interface from the enterprise model. Table formats or feeds change can be

图 12.8 交互图，用于说明典型的领域层与数据源的交互。

Figure 12.8 Interaction diagram to illustrate a typical domain tier interaction with a data source.

图 12.9 数据库接口层的类别。

Figure 12.9 Categories for database interface tier.

这一切都无需修改领域模型。这一点在项目团队无法控制表格格式，或者数据结构可能因性能提升而发生变化时尤为重要。数据源的波动性越大，使用中间层就越发重要。

done without altering the domain model. This is particularly important when table formats are outside the control of the project team or when it is likely that the data structure can change to help with performance. The greater the volatility of these sources, the more important it is to use an intermediate layer.

访问不同的数据库可能需要不同的工具和技能。存在专门的类库用于与数据库产品进行交互。可能需要掌握 SQL 和特定数据库格式的知识。其他数据库（例如多维数据库、层级数据库）有其自身的接口和结构需要学习。将这些交互工作分开，尤其是在存在许多不同数据源的情况下，可以让团队成员专注于他们最擅长的领域。

Access to different databases can require different tools and skills. Specialized class libraries exist to interface to database products. A knowledge of SQL and of the specific database format may be required. Other databases (multidimensional, hierarchical) have their own interfaces and structures to learn. Separating this interaction out, particularly if there are many different data sources, allows team members to concentrate on areas where their skills are strongest.

12.5 总结性思考

12.5 Concluding Thoughts

在客户端/服务器环境下构建大型信息系统仍然是一项充满挑战且陷阱重重的任务。其中许多陷阱源于两层架构的使用，这种架构虽然适用于小型系统，但扩展性不佳。三层架构能够显著改善这种情况，并且得到了面向对象技术的良好支持。表 12.1 简要描述了这三层架构。

Building large IS systems in a client/server environment is still a difficult activity with many pitfalls. Many of these lie in using a two-tier architecture, which works well for small systems but does not scale well. A three-tier architecture improves matters considerably and is well supported by object technology. Table 12.1 provides brief descriptions of the three tiers.

表 12.1 各层及其用途概述。
层级 描述
领域 一种适用于整个领域的直接业务对象模型，独立于各个应用程序和数据源。
应用程序逻辑 对应用程序的领域模型进行选择和简化。不包含用户界面代码，但提供了一组用于用户界面的领域层外观。将丰富的领域层类型转换为表示层所需的类型。
推介会 将应用程序界面上的信息格式化为图形用户界面或纸质报告。它只关注用户界面，不了解底层领域知识。
数据接口 负责在数据源和领域层之间传递信息。它将提供一个简单的接口代理，供领域层发出请求。它同时拥有领域层和数据源的可见性。它将根据所使用的数据源类型划分为多个子系统。

将应用层拆分，使应用逻辑与用户界面分离，是一种非常有价值的技术。它的优势包括：允许在不同的图形用户界面 (GUI) 中复用应用逻辑、便于测试、便于客户端/服务器系统的性能管理，以及支持更多专业开发人员。中间层对于数据访问也很有用，尤其是在存在大量复杂数据源的情况下。

Splitting the application tier to separate application logic from the user interface is a valuable technique. Its advantages include the reuse of application logic for different GUIs, ease of testing, performance management for client/server systems, and support for more specialized development staff. An intermediate layer is also useful for data access, particularly when there are many complex data sources.

有些类必须被所有层级使用。这包括常见的基本类型（整数、日期、数量）、集合，以及一些特定领域的基本类型。

Some classes must be used by all tiers. This includes common fundamental types (integer, date, quantity), collections, and also some domain specific fundamental types.
