第十三章 应用立面

Chapter 13. Application Facades

要充分理解本章内容，您需要先阅读第 12 章至 12.3 节。在 12.3 节中，我解释了如何将应用程序拆分为表示层和应用逻辑层。表示层包含所有用户界面逻辑，而应用逻辑层则为表示层提供一组自定义外观。这些应用外观负责选择和排列表示层所需的所有信息。

To fully understand this chapter, you will need to read Chapter 12 through Section 12.3 first. In Section 12.3 I explained how applications can be split into presentation and application logic. Presentations contain all user interface logic, and the application logic provides a set of custom facades for the presentation. These application facades are responsible for selecting and arranging all information for a presentation.

我们可以使用本章介绍的一种相当标准的技术来定义和构建应用程序外观。（与以往不同的是，本章不包含模式。）这种技术可以看作是对面向对象方法的补充。

We can define and build application facades by using a fairly standard technique described in this chapter. (Uncharacteristically, this chapter does not contain patterns.) This technique can be considered an addition to object-oriented methods.

应用程序外观与其他类型的应用程序外观非常相似：它包含属性和操作。然而，所有属性都源自领域模型。模型示例基于医疗保健领域（13.1）。外观的内容（13.2）由附加到每个属性的多个方法定义。这些方法描述了如何检索属性、如何更新属性、如何查找一组合法值、如何验证属性以及如何获取默认值。

An application facade looks much like any other type: It has attributes and operations. All of the attributes, however, are derived from the domain model. Models are given based on a health care example (13.1). The contents of a facade (13.2) are defined by a number of methods that are attached to each attribute. These methods describe how the attribute is retrieved, how it is updated, how a set of legal values can be found, how it can be validated, and how a default value can be obtained.

一些常用方法（13.3）可以在多个应用程序外观中使用，因此可以将其移至领域模型中。应用程序外观也包含操作（13.4），这些操作可以是外观本地的，也可以委托给领域模型。用户界面框架通常不会感知领域模型中众多相互关联的类型，因此应用程序可以执行类型转换（13.5），创建用户界面可以理解的更原始的类型。一个应用程序通常包含多个外观（13.6），这些外观可以使用结构模型进行描述。

Some common methods (13.3) can be used in many application facades, so they can be moved into domain models. Application facades also contain operations (13.4), which can be local to the facade or delegated to the domain model. User interface frameworks will not usually be aware of the many interrelated types in the domain model, so the application can perform type conversions (13.5), creating more primitive types that the user interface can understand. An application will often contain multiple facades (13.6), which can be described using a structural model.

我曾在多个项目中运用过这项技术，包括英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）和伦敦一家银行的交易系统。它专为应用逻辑层的门面设计，也可应用于其他场景的门面，例如数据库交互。

I have used this technique on several projects, including the UK National Health Service and a trading system for a London bank. It was designed specifically for facades in the application logic tier. It can also be used for facades in other circumstances, including database interaction.

13.1 医疗保健示例

13.1 A Health Care Example

要理解应用外观，最好借助一个相当复杂且抽象的领域模型。图 13.1 展示了这样一个模型，其基本结构基于专为医疗保健设计的 Cosmos 模型 [ 1 ]。许多概念的进一步解释可在第 3 章中找到，建议在继续阅读本章之前先阅读第 3 章。

Application facades are best understood from a fairly complex and abstract domain model. Figure 13.1 shows such a model whose basic structure is based on the Cosmos model designed for health care [ 1 ] . Further explanation of many of the ideas can be found in Chapter 3, and it may be worth reading that chapter before continuing with this chapter.

图 13.1 医疗保健领域的一个领域模型示例。领域层正是基于此模型构建的。

Figure 13.1 An example domain model from health care. This is the model on which the domain tier is built.

以医院信息系统为例，该系统需要记录从医院各个部门收集到的每位患者的信息，以便为每位患者建立完整的医疗记录。关于患者的信息范围非常广泛。为了简化模型，我们采用了一种抽象方法，如图 13.1 所示。

Consider an example from a hospital information system, which needs to record information on each patient gathered from all parts of the hospital so that it can keep a complete medical record for each patient. The range of information that can be recorded about a patient is vast. To reduce the bulk of the model, an abstract approach is used, as shown in Figure 13.1.

该模型描述了所有可以记录的患者信息，这些信息以生物现象及其类型来表示。例如，性别是一种生物现象类型，包含男性和女性两种生物现象；血型是一种生物现象类型，包含A型、B型、A/B型和O型四种生物现象。要记录患者的血型为O型，我们会使用一条将患者与相应生物现象关联的观察记录。我们还可以记录其他与该观察记录相关的必要信息，例如观察者（执行者）、观察时间（日期）和观察方法（方案）。如果之后发现该记录有误，正确的血型是A型，则我们会删除原始记录并用新的记录替换它。这样做是为了确保能够完整地记录患者的各项信息。

The model describes all the information that can be recorded about a patient in terms of biological phenomenon and biological phenomenon types. For example, there is a biological phenomenon type of gender with biological phenomena of male and female, and there is a biological phenomenon type of blood group with biological phenomena of A, B, A/B, and O. To say that a patient has a blood group of O, we use an observation that links the patient to the appropriate biological phenomenon. We can also indicate other appropriate information about the observation, such as who did it (the performer), when it was done (the date), and how it was done (the protocol). If it is later found to be wrong and the correct blood group is A, then we reject the original observation and replace it with a new one. This is necessary so that a full record of a patient can be held.

这样的模型可以处理各种各样的情况。然而，输血科的需求则更为简单和具体。它只需要记录患者的一组属性。例如，考虑献血者的登记。献血者的属性包括姓名、血型和上次献血日期。姓名很容易理解，因为它直接与患者类型相关联。但是，血型和上次献血日期则需要更复杂的处理，我们将在下文中看到。

Such a model can handle a wide range of cases. The blood transfusion department, however, has simpler and more focused needs. It merely wishes to record a set of attributes for a patient. For example, consider the registration of a blood donor. Attributes of a blood donor include name, blood group, and date of last donation. The name is straightforward since this is directly linked to the patient type. The blood group and last donation date, however, require more complex processing, as we shall see below.

13.2 立面的内容

13.2 Contents of a Facade

每个应用程序外观都包含对领域模型（称为外观的主题）的引用以及表示外观用户信息的若干属性，如图 13.2 所示。

Each application facade consists of a reference to the domain model (referred to as the subject of the facade) and a number of attributes that represent the information for the user of the facade, as shown in Figure 13.2.

应用程序外观（Facade）以领域模型中的特定对象作为主体（Subject）打开。该主体是外观所有操作的起点。定义外观时，我们需要定义主体的类型。例如，在输血登记示例中，主体是患者。外观的用户不会直接访问主体，而是将外观视为访问主体的逻辑窗口。

An application facade is opened with a particular object in the domain model as the subject. This subject acts as the starting point for all the manipulations that are done by the facade. When we define the facade, we define the type of the subject. For the blood transfusion registration example, the subject would be patient. The user of the facade never accesses the subject directly but treats the facade as a logical window on the subject.

外观中的每个属性都充当主体的逻辑属性。每个属性都应该定义其类型，并且该类型应与领域模型中的类型相对应。类似地，我们也可以在外观上定义操作。以献血者登记为例，我们有一个如下所示的献血者外观：

Each attribute in the facade then acts as a logical attribute of the subject. Each attribute should have its type defined, and this type should correspond to a type on the domain model. Similarly we can define operations on the facade. In the case of blood donor registration, we have a donor facade as follows:

应用界面：捐赠者 主题：患者

Application facade: donor Subject: patient

图 13.2 应用程序外观的组成部分。

Figure 13.2 The parts of an application facade.

属性：名称：字符串；血型：生物现象

Attributes: name: string blood group: biological phenomenon

上次输血日期：日期 手术：预约验血

date of last transfusion: date Operations: book blood test

接下来，我们为外观上的每个属性定义一系列方法。这些方法描述了如何将信息从领域模型转换到外观，以及外观如何更新共享信息。定义这些方法的方式有很多种。一种方法是使用英语句子，这种方法易于理解，但可能会产生歧义。另一种方法是采用形式化的方法，例如谓词演算，这种方法适用于所有人都能够理解的情况。介于两者之间的是各种形式的结构化英语。

We then define a series of methods for each attribute on the facade. These methods describe how information is translated from the domain model into the facade and how the facade updates the shared information. There are various ways of denning these methods. One is to use an English sentence, which would be easy to understand but could result in ambiguity. At the opposite end of the spectrum is a formal approach such as predicate calculus, which is appropriate if everyone understands it. In between lie various forms of structured English.

13.2.1 方法类型

检索方法定义了如何从模型中获取数据来填充属性。我们可以将此方法视为对模型的查询，从主体开始。检索方法可以非常简单；例如，注册名称可以对应于患者姓名。但检索也可能变得相当复杂。例如，获取患者的血型需要找到所有未被拒绝的、生物现象类型为血型的患者观测值。类似地，获取最后一次献血日期需要找到所有协议为献血的程序，并返回最近一次献血的日期。只读属性没有其他方法。

The retrieval method defines how data is obtained from the model to fill the attribute. We can consider this method to be a query over the model, starting at the subject. A retrieval method can be very simple; for example, the registration name can correspond to the name of the patient. But retrieval can become rather complex. The blood group of the patient requires finding all nonrejected observations of the patient whose biological phenomenon's biological phenomenon type is blood group. Similarly the last donation date is found by taking all procedures whose protocol is blood donation and returning the date of the latest one. Read-only attributes will not have any other methods.

合法值方法提供了一组可用于验证检查的合法值。通常（例如姓名），合法值没有固定的集合；类型本身就足以进行验证。然而，对于血型，则需要更复杂的方法：该属性的类型是生物现象，但只允许生物现象类型为血型的生物现象。因此，合法值由一个查询提供，该查询返回生物​​现象 A、B、A/B 和 O 的集合。除了用于验证检查之外，这些值还可以用于填充用户界面上的菜单或列表。

The legal values method provides a set of legal values that can be used for validation checking. Often (as for name) there is no finite set of legal values; the type is enough for validation. For blood group, however, something more sophisticated is called for: the type of the attribute is the biological phenomenon, but only biological phenomena whose biological phenomenon type is blood group are allowed. Thus the legal values are supplied by a query that returns the set of biological phenomena A, B, A/B, and O. As well as being useful for validation checking, these values can be used to fill a menu or list on a user interface.

更新方法需要最强大的技术。即使检索方法很简单，更新的含义也可能千差万别。例如，名称对象提供了一个简单的例子，用于更新患者的属性。更改血型则更为复杂，因此我们需要创建一个新的观察记录，该记录与属性提供的生物学现象相关联。旧的观察记录会被拒绝，并链接到新对象，以显示是哪个对象拒绝了它。此外，我们还可以提供一些隐含信息。例如，血型的更改总是由输血科提供，并且该科室始终使用相同的流程，因此我们可以通过将已登录的医生设置为操作执行者并使用标准流程，自动将此信息添加到记录中。显然，我们必须谨慎控制以这种方式隐含的信息量，并且这些信息应该反馈给用户。

The update method is the one that requires the most powerful techniques. Even if the retrieval method is simple, the meaning of an update can vary widely. Again the name object provides a simple case where the attribute of a patient is updated. Changing the blood group is more complex, so we need to create a new observation that is linked to the biological phenomenon supplied by the attribute. The old observation is rejected and linked to the new object to show which object rejected it. In addition we can supply some implied information. For example, a change in the blood group will always be supplied by the transfusion unit, and the unit always uses the same protocol, so we can add this information to the record automatically by making the logged-in physician the performer of the procedure and by using the standard protocol. Obviously we have to be careful about how much information can be implied in this way, and that information should be echoed back to the user.

如果仅凭法定值或属性类型不足以验证有效性，则可能需要一种验证方法。需要提供特定于外观的验证规则。例如，上次捐赠日期可能需要早于今天，但晚于当前值。

A validation method may be required if either the legal values or the attribute type are not enough to check validity. A validation rule that is context specific to the facade needs to be supplied. For example, the last donation date may need to be earlier than today and later than the currently held value.

默认方法用于创建新记录，而非更新现有记录。为简化操作，我们通常假设创建新记录与更新空白记录相同。用户可以填写属性，并应用与更新记录完全相同的验证方法。默认方法指示用户从空白记录开始时应提供哪些信息。它的构成方式与检索方法非常相似。

The default method is used when a new record is being created, as opposed to an existing one updated. To reduce complexity, we usually assume that creating a new record is the same as updating a blank record. The user can then fill in the attributes, and exactly the same validation methods are applied as are used for updating. The default method indicates what information should be supplied if the user is starting with a blank record. It is formed in much the same way as a retrieval method.

有些属性并非只有一个值，而是一个值列表。在这种情况下，有两种更新方法：一种用于添加项，另一种用于删除项。检索方法返回一个集合，可以是集合或列表。如果集合是集合，则需要指定排序标准来指示值的显示顺序。通常，这是基于数字或字符串的标准排序标准。表 13.1 总结了此处讨论的各种方法。

Some attributes will not have a single value but a list of values. In this case there are two update methods: one for adding an item and one for deleting an item. The retrieval method returns a collection, which can be a set or a list. If the collection is a set, then ordering criteria is specified to indicate the order in which the values are displayed. Usually this is the standard ordering criteria based on numbers or strings. Table 13.1 summarizes the various methods discussed here.

表 13.1 方法总结。
方法名称 描述
检索 根据领域模型的值
法律价值 如果小于类型，则允许的值
更新 如何根据值的变化更新模型？对于多值属性，必须同时指定添加和删除更新操作。
验证 用于测试新值，仅当新值比法定值更复杂时才需要。
默认 从外观创建新对象时要使用的初始值。
13.2.2 抽样方法

表 13.2 展示了这些方法的一种表述方式，该示例取自上文提到的献血者案例。这些规则并未采用正式的符号表示（因此存在歧义），而是以伪 SQL 的方式编写，这种方式已被证明是严谨性和易懂性之间的一种合理折衷方案。

Table 13.2 shows an example of how these methods might be worded, taken from the blood donor example given above. The rules have not been expressed in a formal notation (and are thus ambiguous) but are written in a pseudo-SQL manner, which has proven to be a reasonable compromise between rigor and ease of understanding.

13.3 常用方法

13.3 Common Methods

在使用外观模式的应用中，我们经常会看到许多结构相似的方法。血型属性就是医疗记录模型中一个非常常见的例子。血型方法会检索患者特定类型生物现象的特定生物现象，这里假设每位患者只有一种该类型的生物现象。查询血型时，我们实际上是在问：“这位患者有哪些血型类型的生物现象的观测数据？” 很多情况下（例如患者的性别），都存在类似的方法。因此，我们需要一个通用服务，它不仅能够处理常见的访问和更新情况，还能处理所有特殊情况（例如，当患者的观测数据不一致时）。

In applications that use facades, we see many methods that have a similar structure. The blood group attribute is an example of a very common case in the medical record model. The blood group methods retrieve a particular biological phenomenon of a particular biological phenomenon type for a patient, where it is assumed that a patient only has one biological phenomenon of that type. In asking for the blood group we ask "Which biological phenomena of type blood group does this patient have observations for?" There are many cases (such as a patient's gender) where this kind of method exists. Therefore it makes sense to have a general service that can hold not only the common access and updating cases but also all the processing for special cases (such as when a patient has inconsistent observations).

我们可以将这些服务作为操作或计算映射整合到领域模型中，应用于患者。以献血者为例，这将导致一项操作。

We can incorporate such services into the domain model as operations or computed mappings on the patient. In our blood donor example, this would lead to an operation

valueOf (aBiologicalPhenomenonType): aBiologicalPhenomenon。

valueOf (aBiologicalPhenomenonType): aBiologicalPhenomenon.

表 13.2 立面示例方法。
属性 方法名称 方法体
姓名 检索 主题名称
更新 更改主题名称
血型 检索 主题.观察.生物现象，其中生物现象。生物现象类型 = '血型'。
更新 oldObs:= 所有 subject.observations，其中 subject.observations.biologicalphenomenon.biologicalphenomenon type = 'blood group'。创建新的观察记录 (newObs)，其中 newObs.patient = subject，newObs.biologicalphenomenon = new Blood Group，并且 newObs.rejected observations = oldObs。
法律价值 所有生物现象，其生物现象类型 = '血型'

请注意，患者可能存在相应的更新操作，该操作也会包含应用程序外观的更新方法。

Note there might be a corresponding update operation on patient that would also subsume the application facade's update method.

将应用外观方法移至领域模型有两个好处。首先，它们为外观提供了一个更高层次的接口，简化了应用外观的开发。具体来说，这意味着处理这类属性的通用代码可以在领域模型中只保留一次，而无需在多个应用外观中重复编写。其次，这种方法为优化提供了良好的途径。由于代码足够通用，可以放在共享方法中，这意味着它会被频繁执行。因此，它是优化的理想目标。当面向对象系统提供导航式查询而非声明式查询时，这一点尤为重要。

Moving application facade methods into the domain model is useful in two ways. First, they provide a higher-level interface to the facade, easing development of application facades. In particular this means that common code to handle these kinds of attributes can be held once in the domain model and not duplicated in many application facades. The second virtue of this approach is that it provides a good route for optimization. The fact that the code is common enough to be held in a shared method implies that it will be executed frequently. It thus makes a good target for optimization. This can be particularly important when the OO system provides navigational as opposed to declarative queries.

显然，并非所有应用外观方法都应该移到领域模型中。应用外观的价值在于将特定于某个上下文的内容与必须共享的内容区分开来。每个移入领域模型的外观方法都会增加领域模型的复杂性。因此，设计人员必须谨慎考虑是否将外观方法移到领域模型，只有当其带来的收益大于由此增加的复杂性时才应这样做。

Clearly not every application facade method should be moved to the domain model. The value of application facades is that they separate what is local to one context from what is necessarily shared. Each facade method that moves into the domain model increases the complexity of the domain model. Thus the designer must be suspicious of moving facade methods to the domain model and only do so if the benefits outweigh the increased complexity that will occur.

13.4 操作

13.4 Operations

与其他对象类型一样，应用程序外观也包含数据和流程。第 13.2.1 节讨论的方法是外观上的私有方法，用于管理应用程序外观和领域模型之间的映射。此外，还存在公共方法，用于访问和更新外观的属性。

Just as any other object type, application facades contain both data and process. The methods discussed in Section 13.2.1 are private methods on the facade that manage the mapping between the application facade and the domain model. Public methods also exist to allow access and update of the facade's attributes.

应用程序外观中的附加操作并非简单的属性操作。这些操作应单独声明，并且通常涉及一些复杂的处理。如图 13.3 所示，考虑这些操作是本地操作还是共享操作非常有用。共享操作在整个组织内使用，而本地操作仅供该应用程序使用。如果操作是共享的，则应在附加到最合适的共享类的域模型中实现。共享操作应忽略任何外观，并且仅对共享对象进行操作。外观上的操作只需将调用传递给共享操作，提供必要的参数并解释返回值以供外观内部使用即可。

Additional operations within the application facade are not simply manipulations of attributes. These operations should be declared separately and typically involve some complex processing. It is useful to consider whether these operations are local or shared, as shown in Figure 13.3. A shared operation is used across the organization, while a local operation is only used by that application. If the operation is shared, then it should be implemented within the domain model attached to the most appropriate shared class. The shared operation should ignore any facades and operate solely on shared objects. The operation on the facade should then simply pass the call onto the shared operation, providing the necessary arguments and interpreting the returned values for use within the facade.

然而，本地操作不应置于领域模型中，而应在本地模型中实现。它不会使用领域模型的结构和操作，而是依赖于应用程序外观的属性和操作。这样就能清晰地划分本地代码和共享代码。

A local operation, however, should not be placed in the domain model but implemented within the local model. It would not use structures and operations of the domain model, relying instead on the attributes and opera tions of the application facade. In this way a clear separation is maintained between local and shared code.

请注意，本地操作和共享操作之间的区别仅仅在于代码的概念共享性。它并不影响客户端/服务器环境等具体实现细节。根据环境的不同，本地操作可以在服务器端运行，而共享操作可以在客户端运行。这种区别完全取决于操作在概念上是否共享。共享操作会被大量复用，因此必须像维护领域模型的其他部分一样，进行更细致的维护。本地操作则可以完全在外观模式内部处理。只有当它们所属的外观模式被复用时，本地操作才会被复用。

Note that the distinction between local and shared operations is purely an issue of conceptual sharing of the code. It does not affect the implementation concerns of, say, a client/server environment. Depending on that environment, local operations can be run on a server or shared operations run on a client. The distinction is based solely on whether the operations are conceptually shared or not. Shared operations are heavily reused and must be maintained more carefully, in the same way as the rest of the domain model. Local operations can be dealt with purely within the facades. They are reused only if the facade they are part of is reused.

图 13.3 应用外观中的操作。

Figure 13.3 Operations in application facades.

共享操作在领域模型中实现，并访问 领域模型的结构和服务。外观模式提供对该操作的引用，而 本地操作在外观模式中实现，并且仅访问 该外观模式的属性和操作。

A shared operation is implemented within the domain model and accesses the structures and services of the domain model. The facade provides a reference to that operation, while a local operation is implemented within the facade and only accesses the attributes and operations of that facade.

13.5 类型转换

13.5 Type Conversions

使用面向对象系统的一个难点在于，在网络中移动对象非常复杂，尤其是在不同对象空间之间移动对象时。当信息需要从一个面向对象系统移动到另一个具有不同对象 ID 的面向对象系统，或者从一个面向对象系统移动到一个非面向对象系统时，就会出现这个问题。在这些情况下，我们只能移动关于对象的信息，而不能移动对象本身。一种解决方案是使用代理，该代理旨在将对代理的调用转换为对原始对象的调用。当客户端和服务器都属于分布式数据库时，这种系统运行良好，但许多系统的客户端是连接到数据库服务器的 PC，在这种情况下，对对象的任何调用都会变成开销很大的网络调用。

One difficulty with using OO systems is the complexity of moving objects around a network, particularly when moving from one object space to another. This problem occurs when information needs to move either from one OO system to another with different object IDs, or from an OO to a non-OO system. In these cases we can move only information about the object, not the actual object. One solution is to use a proxy designed to translate calls made on the proxy to calls on the original object. This system works well where both client and server are part of a distributed database, but many systems have PC clients connected to database servers, where any calls on an object become expensive network calls.

当涉及的非面向对象系统无法理解对象和消息时，这一点尤为重要。信息必须使用底层表示形式（例如 ASCII 字符串）进行传输。在这种情况下，需要将对象信息转换为字符串，通过网络发送，然后再将其解码回对象。

This is particularly important when the non-OO systems involved do not have an understanding of objects and messages. Information must be transferred by using a lower-level representation, such as ASCII strings. In this case it is necessary to transform object information into a string, send it over the network, and decode it back into objects.

我们可以使用外观模式来简化网络访问，控制字符串转换，并允许应用程序一次性获取大量信息。如图 13.4 所示，我们通过将属性值保存为字符串来实现这一点。对象的链接可以通过在外观模式的类部分维护一个查找表来保持。查找表将字符串映射到数据库对象，从而简化验证和更新。该表可以使用字典来实现，其中键是字符串，值是数据库对象。键集可用于……

We can use facades to help simplify network access, controlling the translation to strings and allowing the application to take a large slice of information in one go. We do this by holding the attribute values as strings, as shown in Figure 13.4. The links to the objects can be maintained by holding a lookup table in the class portion of the facade. The lookup table maps from the strings to the database objects, making validation and updating easier. The table can be implemented with a dictionary, where the keys are the strings and the values are the database objects. The set of keys can be used for

图 13.4 类型转换示例对象。

Figure 13.4 Example objects for type conversion.

应用程序外观在领域模型中引用了其主体。 它存储字符串作为属性，并将字符串发送到表示层。它还通过静态链接或 类链接到一个字典，该字典将字符串与底层领域对象关联起来。 （为清晰起见，此处仅显示两种血型。）对于每个 需要进行此类类型转换的属性，它都有一个对应的字典。

The application facade has a reference to its subject in the domain model. For its attributes it stores strings and sends strings to the presentation. It also has a link (static or via its class) to a dictionary that associates the strings with the underlying domain objects. (For clarity only two blood groups are shown here.) It has a dictionary for each attribute that needs this kind of type conversion.

用于加载菜单或验证目的。当属性更改时，表格可以将其转换为对象，以便替换数据库中的数据。由于表格保存在类的类部分，因此它只保存一次。此外，只有当可用选项发生更改时才需要刷新表格：这种更改通常不频繁。

loading menus or validation purposes. When an attribute is changed the table can convert it to an object for replacement in the database. Since the table is held in the class portion of the class, it is only held once. It also only needs to be refreshed if a change is made to the available options: This change is usually infrequent.

因此，血型属性在类部分对应一个字典 BloodGroupValues。该字典的键为字符串 'A'、'B' 等，值则为数据库中的对象。检索时，血型信息会被转换为字符串（使用 name 函数或字典），并存储在属性中。更新时，新的字符串会作为字典的查找依据，并将对应的值用于数据库中的更新。

Thus the blood group attribute has a corresponding dicti onary, BloodGroupValues, in the class portion. This dictionary has keys of the strings 'A', 'B', and so on, with the objects in the database as values. On retrieval the blood group is translated to a string (using a name function or by the dictionary) and stored in the attribute. When updated the new string is used as a lookup to the dictionary, and the corresponding value is used for the update in the database.

当我们使用这种方法时，应该将外观属性描述为具有内部类型和外部类型。内部类型是领域模型中的类型，而外部类型是提供给表示层的类型。在血型示例中，内部类型是“生物现象”，而外部类型是“字符串”。

When we use this approach we should describe facade attributes as having internal and external types. The internal type is the type within the domain model, while the external type is that provided to the presentation. In the blood group example, the internal type is Biological Phenomenon, while the external type is String.

13.6 多立面

13.6 Multiple Facades

应用程序界面通常不是单独出现，而是成组出现。一个应用程序由多个展示界面及其对应的界面组成。这些组件可以通过两种方式连接。第一种方式是让界面包含组件，例如表格。例如，可以将输血记录（包括每次输血的地点和日期）以表格的形式显示在献血者整体展示界面中。第二种方式是允许用户在不同的展示界面之间导航。例如，正在查看血液检测信息的用户可以打开一个单独的屏幕来查看用于该检测的血液样本的详细信息。

Application facades do not usually appear alone but rather in groups. An application consists of a number of presentations and their corresponding facades. These components can be linked in two ways. The first method is to have the facade contain components, as in a table. For example, a history of transfusions, each with its place and date, can be displayed as a table within an overall blood donor presentation. The second way is to allow the user to navigate from one presentation to another. For example, a user looking at a screen of blood test information can open a separate screen to look at details of the blood sample used for the test.

图 13.5 所示的结构模型展示了这些外观之间的关联。我使用聚合来显示同一演示文稿（例如表格）中的信息，并使用常规关联来显示打开不同演示文稿时显示的信息。类似地，我使用单向关联来反映用户从一个演示文稿打开另一个演示文稿的路径。

The structural model shown in Figure 13.5 illustrates how these facades are related. I use aggregation to show information displayed in the same presentation (such as a table) and regular associations for information displayed by opening a different presentation. Similarly I use unidirectional associations to reflect the paths that the user can take in opening one presentation from another.

使用结构化模型非常有帮助，但必须记住建模风格有所不同。在领域模型中，我们应该避免职责重复，尤其是在信息存储方面。因此，我们可以使用不同的符号来强调不同的启发式方法。然而，总的来说，我认为额外的符号会增加过多的复杂性。

Using a structural model is very helpful, but it is important to remember that the style of modeling is different. In the domain model we should avoid duplicating responsibilities, particularly when it comes to holding information. For this reason we could use a different notation to stress the different heuristics. On the whole, however, I think the extra notation adds too much complexity.

图 13.5 应用程序外观的示例图。

Figure 13.5 An example diagram of application facades.

所示类型为外部类型（参见第 13.5 节）。该模型表明我们有一个 献血者信息展示，其中包含患者信息展示的所有信息以及 一些附加信息。它还显示了一个输血表格。用户可以导航至一个单独的 展示，其中显示了血液检测列表。从血液检测展示，用户 可以导航至相应的血液样本展示，然后从该 展示导航至献血者信息展示。

The types shown are external types (see Section 13.5). The model indicates we have a blood donor presentation that shows all the information on the patient presentation with additions. It also shows a table of transfusions. The user can navigate to a separate presentation that shows a list of blood tests. From the blood test presentation, the user can navigate to the appropriate blood sample presentation, from which the user can navigate to the blood donor presentation.

另一种非常重要的界面关系是子类型关系。患者界面可能已经涵盖了患者所需的大部分通用信息。捐赠者所需的信息则包含这些信息并加以补充。因此，捐赠者界面实际上是患者界面的一个子类型：患者界面的所有属性都存在于捐赠者界面中，并且捐赠者界面可以响应患者界面的所有消息。

The other kind of relationship between facades, which can be very important, is a subtyping relationship. A patient facade might already cover a lot of general information required for patients. The information required for donors would include this information and add to it. Thus the donor facade is truly a subtype of the patient facade: All attributes of the patient facade are present in the donor facade, and the donor facade can respond to all patient facade messages.

在许多方面，立面的结构是由其所支持的演示结构决定的。但如果一组立面支持多个演示，情况可能就不完全如此了。一个新的演示可能会将来自关联立面的信息整合到同一个演示中。这完全合理。虽然基于演示结构来构建立面结构很有用，但让一组立面支持多个类似的演示也是明智之举。在这种情况下，打破演示结构和立面结构之间的联系是可以接受的。

In many ways the structure of the facades is driven by the structure of the presentations that the facades support. In cases where one set of facades supports more than one presentation, this may not quite hold. A new presentation might combine information from associated facades in the same presentation. This is perfectly reasonable. Although it is useful to base facade structure on presentation structure, it is also wise to let one set of facades support multiple similar presentations. In this case, breaking the tie between presentation and facade structure is a justified sacrifice.
