第十四章 字体模型设计模板的模式

Chapter 14. Patterns for Type Model Design Templates

本书大量运用概念模型，因此对我来说，解释这些模型如何转化为软件至关重要。本章提供了可用于构建类型模型设计模板的转换模式。转换模式描述了将工件从一种形式转换为另一种形式的原则。设计模板描述了如何将隐式规范模型转换为显式规范模型和实现。由于隐式接口模型和概念模型几乎完全相同，因此它们是理解概念模型与实现之间关系的宝贵工具。

This book uses very conceptual models, thus it is important for me to explain how these models turn into software. This chapter provides transformation patterns that can be used to construct design templates for type models. Transformation patterns describe principles for transforming an artifact from one form into another. Design templates describe how to turn an implicit specification model into an explicit specification model and an implementation. Since implicit interface models and conceptual models are almost identical, they are valuable tools for understanding how conceptual models relate to implementations.

本章并非旨在提供适用于任何特定实现环境的完整设计模板集。实现环境千差万别，每种环境都需要不同的权衡取舍。这并非仅仅是 Smalltalk 或 C++ 的问题。硬件、数据库、网络、类库等诸多因素都会影响项目中实际使用的模板。因此，我着重探讨设计模板中常见的模式——即在进行转换时应考虑的一般原则和问题。

The chapter does not attempt to give a full set of design templates for any particular implementation environment. Implementation environments are too different, each requiring different trade-offs. It is not simply a matter of Smalltalk or C++. Many factors—hardware, databases, networks, class libraries— affect the templates that are actually used on a project. Thus I concentrate on the patterns that are found in design templates—the general principles and issues that should be considered when carrying out the transformations.

设计模板会根据所采用的建模方法、具体的实施环境、企业标准以及最终系统的性能要求而有所不同。它们既可以作为指导性文件使用，也可以作为参考性文件使用。它们（至少在理论上）可以通过代码生成器自动生成，也可以手动生成（例如作为编码标准）。

Design templates vary based on the modeling method used, the exact implementation environment, corporate standards, and the performance requirements of the final system. They can be used in a prescriptive manner or in an advisory manner. They can (at least in theory) be automated by a code generator, or they can be used by hand (as coding standards, for instance).

并非所有方法都需要设计模板。如果所有建模都使用一种深深植根于实现环境的方法，那么几乎不需要任何转换。这是使用基于实现的技术的主要优势。这种方法的缺点是……

Not all methods need design templates. If all modeling is done using a method that is deeply rooted in the implementation environment, then little if any transformation is needed. This is the principal advantage of using an implementation-based technique. The problem with such an approach is

本章由我与詹姆斯·奥德尔共同撰写。

This chapter was written in conjunction with James Odell.

人们的世界观与基于实现的模型之间存在着更大的差距。此外，将该模型迁移到其他实现环境时也常常会遇到问题。设计模板的目标如下：

that there is a greater distance between how people think about the world and an implementation-based model. Also there often are problems in moving that model to another implementation environment. Design templates have the following goals:

• 尽可能确保软件的结构与概念模型保持一致

• To ensure that the software is structured in the same way as the conceptual models, as far as practically possible

• 确保软件内部的一致性

• To provide consistency within the software

• 提供软件构建指南，以便知识能够在组织内部有效传播。

• To provide guidelines on constructing software so that knowledge is effectively propagated around the organization

这些目标引出一个重要原则：设计模板应定义软件组件的接口，并提出这些组件的实现方案。此过程的一个目标应该是，即使是该领域的新手程序员，只要熟悉模板，也能仅通过查看分析模型就了解所有组件的接口。在实践中，或许无法完全实现这一目标，但我们应该力求尽可能接近目标。

These goals lead us to an important principle: Design templates should define the interface of software components and suggest the implementation of those components. A goal in the process should be that a programmer, new to the domain but familiar with the templates, should know what the interface of all the components is simply by looking at the analysis model. In practice it may not be possible to achieve this goal completely, but we should aim to get as close as we can.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
设计模板定义了软件组件的接口，并提出了这些组件的实现方式。
Design templates define the interface of software components and suggest the implementation of those components.

因此，设计模板应明确定义所需的接口，并提供若干建议的实现方案。程序员必须接受强制性接口，但可以采用任何实现方式，既可以从建议列表中选择，也可以自行提出替代方案。类的用户无需了解或关心具体选择了哪种实现方式。尤其重要的是，类的实现者应该能够在不改变接口的情况下更改实现方式。

Design templates should thus provide a statement of the required interface and can provide a number of suggested implementations. Programmers must accept the mandatory interface, but they can make any implementation, either taking from the suggested list or coming up with their own alternatives. The user of the class should not need to know, or care, what implementation is chosen. In particular the class implementor should be able to change implementation without altering the interface.

维护一个纯粹的概念模型可能很困难。为了确保接口能够被完整定义，模型需要是一个规范模型。它不需要是一个非常明确的规范模型，因为模板会将模型转换为真正明确的规范模型。在某些情况下，接口问题会从纯粹的概念角度改变模型。这些改变并不严重，通常最好接受这些改变，而不是构建单独的模型并试图保持它们同步。这些问题将在本章后续内容中进行讨论。

It can be difficult to keep a purely conceptual model. To ensure that the interface can be fully defined, the model needs to be a specification model. It does not need to be a very explicit specification model, since the templates transform the model to a truly explicit specification model. There are a number of cases where interface issues alter the model from a purely conceptual point of view. These alterations are not serious, and it is usually better to put up with these than to build separate models and try to keep them in sync. These issues will be discussed as the chapter proceeds.

本章各节讨论了多种概念模型转换模式。我们首先讨论一种实现关联的模式（14.1）。这种模式有三种实现方式：双向指针、单向指针和关联对象。遵循基本原则，它们都具有相同的接口。基本类型有一些特殊考虑。关联几乎是所有技术所共有的，因此这种模式具有广泛的适用性。

Each section in this chapter discusses a number of patterns for transforming conceptual models. We begin by discussing a pattern for implementing associations (14.1). There are three implementations: pointers in both directions, pointers in one direction, and association objects. Following the basic principle, all have the same interface. Fundamental types have some special considerations. Associations are common to almost all techniques, so this pattern is widely applicable.

第二种模式讨论了泛化的实现（14.2）。许多方法将泛化等同于实现继承。本书采用多重动态分类（参见A.1.3节），这使得转换过程不那么直接。我们考虑五种实现方式：继承、多重继承组合类、标志、委托给隐藏类以及创建替换。我们再次定义了一个通用接口，其中包含一个用于测试对象类型的操作——该测试应谨慎使用。

The second pattern discusses implementing generalization (14.2). Many methods treat generalization the same as implementation inheritance. This book uses multiple and dynamic classification (see Section A.1.3), which make the transformation less direct. We consider five implementations: inher itance, multiple inheritance combination classes, flags, delegation to a hidden class, and creating a replacement. Again we define a common interface, which includes an operation to test the type of an object—a test that should be used with caution.

其余模式较短，包括对象创建模式（14.3）、对象销毁模式（14.4）、查找具有入口点的对象模式（14.5）以及约束实现模式（14.6）。我们将简要提及其他技术的设计模板（14.7），但不作详细讨论。

The remaining patterns are shorter and include patterns for object creation (14.3), object destruction (14.4), finding objects with an entry point (14.5), and implementing constraints (14.6). We will briefly mention design templates for other techniques (14.7), but there is no detailed discussion.

如果你不使用设计模板，那么你可以将本章视为程序员如何解读概念模型的指南。本章中的技巧对于将本书中的模型转换为更注重实现的方法以及转换为面向对象语言都很有价值。任何希望将本书中的分析模式与Booch的方法（例如）结合使用的人都需要使用这些模式，尤其是在处理泛化问题时。

If you don't use design templates, then you might treat this chapter as an indication of how programmers should interpret conceptual models. The techniques in the chapter are valuable in transforming the models from this book to more implementation-based methods, as well as transforming to OO languages. Anyone wishing to use the analysis patterns in this book with Booch's method (for example) will need to use these patterns, particularly when dealing with generalization.

不同的语言对各种元素有不同的名称。我使用术语“字段”来表示类的数据值（Smalltalk 的实例变量或 C++ 的数据成员）。我使用术语“操作”来指代类可以识别的消息（Smalltalk 的方法或选择器，或 C++ 的成员函数）。我区分操作（声明）和方法（主体）；因此，一个多态操作可以有多个方法。我使用术语“特性”来表示字段或操作。

Different languages have different names for various elements. I use the term field to represent a data value of the class (a Smalltalk instance variable or a C++ data member). I use the term operation to refer to a message that a class will recognize (a Smalltalk method, or selector, or a C++ member function). I distinguish between operation (the declaration) and method (the body); thus a polymorphic operation has many methods. I use the term feature to represent either a field or an operation.

本章假设您已拥有集合类库。集合（也称为容器）是用于存储一组对象的类。在传统编程语言中，最常见且通常也是唯一提供的集合是数组。对象环境可以提供多种集合。Lewis [5] 对 Smalltalk 中最常见的集合进行了精彩的概述。许多 C++ 版本也采用了类似的方法，尽管这些方法最终会被标准模板库 (STL) [7] 所取代。这些集合包括集合（无序，无重复元素）、列表（Smalltalk 中的 orderedCollections，STL 中的 vector 和 deque）、包（类似于集合，但允许重复元素，STL 中的 multiset）以及字典（STL 中的 map）。字典是一种查找表或关联数组，允许您使用另一个对象作为键来查找对象。因此，我们可以创建一个按姓名索引的人员字典。您可以通过发送格式为 PeopleDictionary@("Martin Fowler") 的消息来找到我。

This chapter assumes that you have access to a class library of collection classes. Collections, also known as containers, are classes that hold a group of objects. In conventional programming languages the most common, and usually only, provided collection is the array. Object environments can provide many collections. Lewis [5] gives an excellent overview of the most common Smalltalk collections. Many C++ versions use similar approaches, although these will be superseded by the Standard Template Library (STL) [7]. Such collections include sets (not ordered, no duplicates), lists (orderedCollections in Smalltalk, vectors and deques in STL), bags (like sets but with duplicates, multisets in STL), and dictionaries (maps in STL). A dictionary is a lookup table or associative array that allows you to look up an object using another object as a key. So we could have a dictionary of people indexed by name. You would find me by sending a message of the form PeopleDictionary at ("Martin Fowler").

这些集合极大地简化了编程，而它们的存在正是面向对象环境的一大优势。许多环境，包括所有 Smalltalk 语言，都自带这样的类库。大多数 C++ 环境并不包含集合类，不过您可以轻松地从许多供应商处购买。我强烈建议您熟悉并使用集合类。在面向对象环境中工作却不使用集合类，就好比编程时一只手被反绑着一样。

These collections greatly simplify programming, and having these available is one of the great boons of an object-oriented environment. Many environments, including all Smalltalks, come with such a class library. Most C++ environments do not come with collection classes, although they can easily be bought from a number of vendors. I strongly encourage you to familiarize yourself with and use collection classes. To work in an object-oriented environment and not use collection classes is like programming with one hand behind your back.

14.1 实施关联

14.1 Implementing Associations

本章首先介绍关联，因为它们提供了一个简单而重要的例子，说明模板的工作原理。在本节中，我们假设所有对象类型都以类的形式实现；这个假设稍后会进行修改。

The chapter begins with associations because they provide a simple yet important example of how templates work. For the purposes of this section, we will assume that all object types are implemented as classes; this assumption will be modified later on.

许多面向对象实践者对在面向对象分析中使用关联感到不安。他们认为关联违反了面向对象编程的封装原则。封装将类的数据结构隐藏在操作接口之后。一些实践者认为关联会使数据结构公开。解决这一困境的方法是理解在面向对象语言的上下文中如何解释关联。关联之所以存在，是因为它们在概念建模中很有用。如果将关联视为描述一种对象类型有责任跟踪和更改其与另一种对象类型之间关系的一种方式，那么它们就与封装并不冲突。因此，图 14.1 中的示例表明，员工有责任了解其雇主并能够更换雇主。反之，组织有责任了解其员工并能够更换员工。在大多数面向对象语言中，这种责任是通过访问器和修改器（get 和 set）操作来实现的。当然，数据结构可能存在，而且在大多数情况下都会存在，但概念模型并不指定数据结构。

A number of object-oriented practitioners are uncomfortable with using associations in OO analysis. They see associations as violating the OO programming principle of encapsulation. With encapsulation the data structure of a class is hidden behind an interface of operations. Some practitioners believe that associations make the data structure public. The way out of this dilemma is to understand how associations are interpreted in the context of OO languages. Associations are present because they are useful in conceptual modeling. They do not clash with encapsulation if they are seen as a way of describing that one object type has a responsibility to keep track of and alter its relationship with another. Thus the example in Figure 14.1 shows that the employee has responsibility to know its employer and to be able to change his employer. Conversely the organization has a responsibility to know its employees and to be able to change them. In most OO languages this responsibility is implemented by accessor and modifier (get and set) operations. A data structure may be present of course, and in most cases it will be, but a data structure is not specified by the conceptual model.

图 14.1 一个关联示例。

Figure 14.1 An example association.

属性可以表示为单值映射，通常映射到基本类型。因此，关于单值映射的讨论也适用于使用属性的方法。

Attributes can be represented as single-valued mappings, usually to fundamental types. Thus the discussion of single-valued mapping also applies to attributes for those methods that use them.

14.1.1 双向关联和单向关联

我们首先需要考虑的问题之一是使用双向关联还是单向关联。关于这个问题存在很多争议。单向关联更容易实现，并且能减少软件耦合。但它们确实会增加代码的可读性。本书中的模式使用的是双向关联。我们可以选择将所有关联都实现为双向关联，全部实现为单向关联，或者混合使用。混合使用虽然一致性较差，但也有其优势。如果我们全部使用双向关联，可能会遇到耦合问题。如果我们全部使用单向关联，可能会发现一些关联确实需要双向关联，值得为此做出例外处理。

One of the first questions we need to consider is whether to use a bidirectional or a unidirectional association. There is a lot of controversy on this subject. Unidirectional associations are easier to implement and cause less coupling in the software. But they do make it harder to find our way around. The patterns in this book use bidirectional associations. We can choose to implement all associations as bidirectional, all as unidirectional, or to use a mixture. Using a mixture is less consistent but does have advantages. If we use all bidirectional associations, we can get into coupling problems. If we use all unidirectional associations, we may find some associations that really do need to be bidirectional and may be worth making an exception for.

如果我们想使用单向关联，就需要决定支持哪个方向，放弃哪个方向。应用程序会给出建议。一个好的经验法则是：了解关联的客户端想要做什么，并遵循它们需要的方向。我不赞成像许多方法论那样对访问路径进行详细分析。我们应该先做最简单的事情，但要做好准备，以便在需求发生变化时进行更改。如果我们保留一个模型，就应该更新它，以表明我们正在使用的方向。

If we want to use a unidirectional association, we need to decide which direction to support and which to drop. This will be suggested by the application. A good rule of thumb is to see what the clients of the association want to do and follow the direction that they need. I don't believe in detailed analysis of access paths, in the style of many methodologies. We should do the simplest thing first but be prepared to change it should our needs change later. If we keep a model, we should update it to show which direction we are using.

如果使用双向关联，我们必须格外注意那些跨包的关联。如果我们保持双向性，就会造成类别之间的相互可见性，正如第 11.2 节所述。我使用双向关联时，会在同一类别内自由使用，但尽量避免类别之间的关联，因为降低类别间的可见性更为重要。

If we use bidirectional associations, we must be very wary of those that cross packages. If we maintain bidirectionality, we will cause a mutual visibility between the categories, as discussed in Section 11.2. When I use bidirectional associations, I use them freely within a category but try to avoid them between categories because it is more important to reduce visibilities between categories.

14.1.2 关联接口

面向对象语言中关联的接口是一系列用于访问和更新关联的操作。这些操作的具体术语和结构取决于所涉及的映射的基数。

The interface for associations in an OO language is a series of operations to access and update the association. The exact terms and structure of these operations depend on the cardinalities of the mappings involved.

通常，单值映射需要两个操作：访问器和修饰器。访问器不接受任何参数，并返回接收器映射到的对象。修饰器接受一个参数，并将接收器映射到该参数的对象更改为其他对象。命名约定多种多样。在 Smalltalk 中，通常将这两个操作都命名为 mappingName，修饰器与访问器的区别在于它是否带有参数。因此，对于图 14.1，employee 类将有两个操作：employer 和 employer: anOrganization。在 C++ 中，没有标准的命名约定，但诸如 getEmployer() 和 setEmployer(Organization org) 之类的名称很常见。使用 getEmployer() 和 setEmployer() 是最自然的，但有些人更喜欢使用 employerSet 和 employerGet()（或 employerOf() 和 employerIs()），这样这两个操作就可以在按字母顺序排列的浏览器中一起显示。

In general a single-valued mapping requires two operations: an accessor and a modifier. The accessor takes no arguments and returns the object to which the receiver is mapped to. The modifier takes one argument and changes the mapping of the receiver to that argument. Various naming conventions are possible. In Smalltalk it is conventional to name both operations mappingName, and the modifier is distinguished from the accessor by the presence of an argument. Thus for Figure 14.1 the employee class would have two operations: employer and employer: anOrganization. In C++ no standard convention exists, but frequently names such as getEmployer() and setEmployer (Organization org) are common. Using getEmployer() and setEmployer() is the most natural, but some prefer to use employerSet and employerGet() (or employerOf() and employerIs()) so that both operations appear together in an alphabetically sorted browser.

多值映射需要三个操作。同样，这里也有一个访问器，但这次它返回一个对象集合。除非另有说明，所有多值映射都假定为集合。非集合的接口有所不同，超出本节范围。需要两个修饰符，一个用于添加对象，一个用于删除对象。访问器的命名通常与单值映射相同，但我更倾向于使用复数形式，以进一步强调其多值特性（例如，`employees` 或 `getEmployees()`）。修饰符的形式为 `addEmployee(Employee emp)`、`removeEmployee(Employee emp)` 或 `employeesAdd: anEmployee`、`employeesRemove: anEmployee`。

A multivalued mapping requires three operations. Again there is an accessor, but this one returns a set of objects. All multivalued mappings are assumed to be sets unless otherwise indicated. The interface for nonsets is different and is beyond the scope of this section. Two modifiers are required, one to add an object and one to remove an object. The accessor is usually named in the same way as for single-valued mappings, except I prefer a plural form to further reinforce its multivalued nature (for example, employees or getEmployees()). Modifiers take the form of addEmployee (Employee emp), removeEmployee (Employee emp) or employeesAdd: anEmployee, employeesRemove: anEmployee.

双向关联的两端并非都必须提供修饰符。通常情况下，修饰符似乎只会在一个方向上使用，通常是约束最严格的方向（例如 Employee::employer）。双向关联的两端都必须提供访问器；这正是双向关联的意义所在。

It is not necessary to provide modifiers on both sides of a bidirectional association. Frequently it seems that modifiers are only likely to be used in one direction, usually the one that i s most constrained (such as Employee::employer). Accessors should always be provided in both directions of a bidirectional association; that is what makes it bidirectional.

在双向关联中，修饰符必须始终确保两个映射都得到更新。因此，更改员工的雇主不仅会更改从员工到组织的链接，还会更改反向链接。我们将在第 14.1.5 节至 14.1.8 节中讨论具体实现。

In a bidirectional association the modifiers must always ensure that both mappings are updated. Thus changing the employer of an employee changes not only the link from the employee to the organization but also the reverse links. We discuss the implementations in Sections 14.1.5 to 14.1.8.

修饰符还应确保检查约束。实际上，如果接口是单值或多值，则上限由接口的性质决定，只需检查其他数值即可。下限通常需要显式检查，尤其是在非零值的情况下。在单值映射中，下限指示是否可以将空值作为参数提供。对于多值映射，下限意味着在删除操作中进行检查。一个映射的基数会影响实现另一个映射的操作。例如，在图 14.1 中，不应该对组织执行删除员工的操作，因为这样做会破坏员工的约束。出于同样的原因，不应为不可变关联提供任何修饰符。

The modifiers should also ensure that constraints are checked. In practice the upper bound is covered by the nature of the interface if it is one or many and only needs to be checked for other numbers. The lower bound is the one that usually needs explicit checking if it is nonzero. In single-valued mappings the lower bound indicates whether a null can be provided as an argument. For multivalued mappings a lower bound implies a check in the remove operation. The cardinality of one mapping can affect operations implementing the other. For instance, in Figure 14.1 there should not be a remove employee operation on organization since that could not be done without breaking the constraint on employee. For the same reason no modifier should be provided for an immutable association.

如果语言本身没有内置类型检查，则可以在修饰符中进行类型检查。这在 Smalltalk 中无关紧要，因为它本质上是无类型的。要进行类型检查，你需要一些类型测试功能，例如 14.2.6 节中讨论的那种。我喜欢把类型检查放在一个特殊的前置条件块中。所有对象都有一个名为 `require: aBlock` 的操作。该操作会评估代码块，如果结果为 false 则抛出异常。然后，我使用类似 `self require re: [aCustomer hasType: #Customer]` 的语句来测试该子句中的类型。这样，出于性能考虑，我可以轻松地移除类型检查，这与 Eiffel 中的前置条件检查类似。（实际上，我通常使用这种结构来进行前置条件检查。）

Type checking can be performed in the modifiers if it is not built into the language. This is a moot point in Smalltalk, which is by nature untyped. To do type checking you need some type test capability, such as that discussed in Section 14.2.6. I like to put type checks into a special precondition block. All objects have an operation called require: aBlock. The operation evaluates the block and raises an exception if it results in false. I then test the type within this clause with a statement such as self requi re: [aCustomer hasType: #Customer]. This allows me to easily take out the type checking for performance reasons, rather like precondition checks in Eiffel. (Indeed I use this structure for precondition checking in general.)

访问多值操作的访问器返回的集合可以用于进一步操作，可以使用环境中存在的任何集合类的功能。但是，必须确保通过添加或删除对象来修改集合的成员关系不会改变构成该集合的映射关系。映射关系的修改只能通过显式接口中的修饰符操作来实现（参见第 6.9 节）。

The set returned by the accessor of a multivalued operation can be used for further manipulation using the facilities of whatever set class is present in the environment. However, you must ensure that modifying the membership of the set by adding or removing objects does not change the mapping from which the set was formed. Modification of the mapping can only come from modifier operations that are part of the explicit interface (see Section 6.9).

在某些情况下，多值访问器返回集合可能会影响性能。此时，可以扩展接口以包含常用的集合操作（​​例如 select、do 和 collect）以及迭代器 [4]。此类扩展应遵循所用集合类的命名约定。然而，这些接口扩展可能会导致接口变得臃肿。

In some cases the return of a set by a multivalued accessor may be a performance hit. In these cases the interface can be extended to include common set operations (such as select, do, and collect) and an iterator [4], Such extensions should follow the naming conventions of whichever set class you are using. These interface extensions can cause the interface to become bloated, however.

在 C++ 中，访问器应该返回什么经常是个问题：对象本身还是指向对象的指针？无论返回什么，都应该在设计模板中明确说明。常见的约定是：对于所有内置数据类型返回值，对于所有基本类返回对象，对于所有其他类返回指针。但在 Smalltalk 中，由于你总是操作对象，或者至少看起来是这样，所以这条约定并不适用！在下面的讨论中，我总是提到返回引用；对于 C++ 以及其他类似的指针显式语言，实际的模板应该明确说明返回的是什么。

In C++ there is often an issue about what should be returned by accessors: the object or a pointer to the object. Whatever is returned should be made explicit by the design templates. A common convention is to return the value for all built-in data types, the object for all fundamental classes, and a pointer for all other classes. In Smalltalk this does not apply since you always work with objects, or at least it seems that way! In the discussion below I always refer to returning references; the actual templates should make clear exactly what is being returned for C++ and similarly pointer-explicit languages.

14.1.3 基本类型

有些对象类型相当简单，并且贯穿模型的所有部分。因此，它们需要与大多数对象类型略有不同的处理方式，尤其是在关联方面。例如，编程环境中的经典内置数据类型：整数、实数、字符串和日期。然而，良好的面向对象分析通常会发现其他例子：数量、货币、时间段和货币都是典型的例子。很难给出定义某种类型是否为“基本类型”的规则——主要取决于它在整个模型中的普遍存在以及其内部的某种简洁性。这意味着，如果基本类型的关联以标准方式实现，它将承担大量将基本类型与其他类型关联起来的操作。因此，对于基本类型，不应实现到非基本类型的映射；也就是说，不应有任何操作。此外，与其他基本类型的关联也应根据具体情况进行处理。

Some object types are fairly simple and prevalent throughout all parts of a model. As such they require slightly different treatment than most object types, particularly with respect to associations. Examples of such object types are the classic built-in data types of programming environments: integer, real, string, and date. Good OO analysis, however, typically uncovers other examples: Quantity, money, time period, and currency are typical examples. It is hard to give rules for what makes a type fundamental—primarily it comes from its presence all over the model and a certain internal simplicity. This means that if the fundamental type's associations are implemented in the standard way, it will be burdened with a large number of operations linking the fundamental types to other types all over the model. Thus with fundamental types, mappings to nonfundamental types should not be implemented; that is, there should be no operations. In addition, associations to other fundamental types should be handled on a case-by-case basis.

在模型中以某种方式标明基本类型是很有用的。一种方法是在术语表中将对象类型标记为基本类型。另一种方法是使用单向关联。单向关联的问题在于，它们本质上是一种实现特性，可能会让非IT分析师感到困惑。

It is useful to indicate fundamental types in some way on a model. One way is to mark the object type as fundamental in the glossary. Another is to use one-way associations. The problem with one-way associations is that they are essentially an implementation feature and may confuse non-IT analysts.

基本类型的一个共同特征是其关键属性是不可变的：您不能更改该类型的任何属性。例如，考虑对象 $5。您不能在不创建单独对象的情况下更改数字 (5) 或货币 ($)。然而，并非所有属性都是不可变的。货币可以被视为基本类型，但它可能具有可变属性，例如其节假日列表（用于交易目的）。对于基本类型而言，确保正确强制执行其不可变属性尤为重要。

A common feature of fundamental types is that their key features are immutable: You cannot change any property of the type. Consider the object $5. You cannot change either the number (5) or the currency ($) without describing a separate object. Not all properties are immutable, however. Currency can be considered a fundamental type yet may have mutable properties such as its holiday list (for trading purposes]. It is particularly important with fundamental types to ensure that the immutable properties are properly enforced.

14.1.4 实现单向关联

实现单向关联非常简单。类中有一个字段作为单一映射的源，而该字段的 UP 4u 操作会影响实际的映射。然而，对于大型集合，这可能会带来显著的时间开销。替代方案是返回一个保护代理或外部迭代器 [3]。保护代理是一个简单的类，它只有一个包含集合的字段。所有允许的操作都在保护代理上定义，它通过将调用传递给包含的集合来实现这些操作。这样可以阻塞更新。外部迭代器类似于集合中的游标。迭代器可以返回它指向的对象，并且可以在集合中遍历。

Implementing a unidirectional association is pretty straightforward. You have a field in the class that is the source of the single mapping, and this UP4u of the sLÛ*41 1 rg 1 affect the actual mapping. However, this may incur a significant time overhead for large sets. Alternatives are to return a protection proxy or an external iterator [3]. A protection proxy is a simple class that has a single field containing the set. All permitted operations are defined on the protection proxy, which it implements by passing the call onto the contained set. This way updates can be blocked. An external iterator is rather like a cursor into the collection. The iterator can return the object that it is pointing to and can be advanced through the collection.

由于两个对象之间的每个链接都由两个指针实现，因此修饰符必须保持它们同步。例如，要将 Peter 的组织更改为 IBM，修饰符不仅必须将指向 Peter 的指针替换为指向 IBM 的指针，还必须删除 NASA 员工集合中指向 Peter 的指针，并在 IBM 员工集合中创建一个新的指针。但这样做会让我们陷入一个面向对象难题。Employee 需要使用某种操作来单独操作集合指针，而无需返回对 Peter 的调用（否则会陷入无限循环）。然而，此操作不能是组织接口的一部分。在 C++ 中，这是友元构造的经典用法。在 Smalltalk 中，我们必须创建这样的操作，但将其标记为私有（当然，这并不能阻止 employee 使用它）。在这种情况下，一个有效的方法是只让一个修饰符执行实际的数据操作和/或私有操作。另一个修饰符只需调用该修饰符即可。这样可以确保只有一份更新代码。

Since there are two pointers implementing each link between two objects, it is important that modifiers keep them in sync. Thus a modifier called to change Peter's organization to IBM must not only replace the pointer from Peter with one that points to IBM but also delete the pointer to Peter in NASA's employees set and create one in IBM's employees set. But doing this gets us into an OO conundrum. Employee needs to use some operation that will manipulate the set pointer alone without returning a call to Peter (otherwise, we get in an endless loop). However, this operation must not be part of organization's interface. In C++ this is a classic use of the friend construct. In Smalltalk we have to create such an operation but mark it as private (which of course does not stop employee from using it). In these cases a useful move is to have only one modifier do actual work that manipulates the data and/or the private operations. The other modifier should then just call that one modifier. This ensures that there is only one copy of the update code.

这种实现方式效果不错，双向导航速度都很快。虽然确保所有指针同时更新有点棘手，但一旦解决了这个问题，这个方案就很容易复现。它的主要缺点是多值映射所需的数据集比较大，以及更新速度较慢。

This implementation works well. It is fast in navigation in both directions. Although ensuring all pointers get updated together is a little tricky, once it has been sorted out, the solution is easy to replicate. Its principal disadvantages are the size of the sets required for multivalued mappings and a slower speed for updates.

14.1.6 单向指针的双向实现

此实现仅使用单向指针。要进行反向导航，我们需要查看类的所有实例，并选择指向源对象的实例。在图 14.3 中，员工映射需要获取所有 employee 实例，并选择雇主为 NASA 的实例。

This implementation uses pointers in one direction only. To navigate in the other direction, we need to look at all instances of the class and select ones that point back to the source object. In Figure 14.3 the employees mapping would require getting all instances of employee and selecting those whose employer is NASA.

修饰符的使用非常简单。指针所在类上的修饰符只会改变指针本身，而另一个类上的修饰符可以直接调用该公共例程。因此，不存在多个指针不一致的风险。

Modifiers are straightforward. The modifier on the class with the pointer merely changes the pointer, and that public routine can be called directly by a modifier on the other class. There is no danger of multiple pointers getting out of step.

这种方案空间利用率高，因为每个链接只存储一个指针，但逆指针方向导航时速度会比较慢。它的更新速度很快。

This scheme is space efficient because it stores only one pointer per link, but it will be slow when navigating against the direction of the pointers. Its update speed is fast.

图 14.3 指针单向实现。

Figure 14.3 Implementation with pointers in one direction.

14.1.7 通过关联对象实现双向

关联对象是简单的对象，它有两个指针，可以用来链接其他两个对象，如图 14.4 所示。通常，每个关联都会提供一个包含此类对象的表。访问器的工作原理是获取该表中的所有对象，选择指向源对象的对象，然后沿着每个指针找到映射的对象。修饰符很简单，仅用于创建或删除关联对象。可以构建特殊的关联类；也可以使用带有哈希表查找的字典类来实现它们。

Association objects are simple objects with two pointers that can be used to link two other objects, as shown in Figure 14.4. Typically a table of such objects is provided for each association. Accessors work by getting all objects within that table, selecting those that point to the source, and then following each pointer to the mapped objects. Modifiers are simple, merely creating or deleting the association object. Special association classes can be built; or dictionary classes with their hash table lookups can be used to implement them.

图 14.4 使用关联对象实现。

Figure 14.4 Implementation with association objects.

关联对象在双向映射中速度都不快，但通常可以通过索引（使用字典）来提高速度。如果映射中的大多数对象之间没有关联，则关联对象可以节省空间，因为只有在需要时才会占用空间。此外，如果无法更改任何参与映射的类的数据结构，关联对象也很有用。

Association objects are not very fast in either direction but can usually be indexed (by using a dictionary), which can improve speed. They are space efficient if most objects are not related in the mapping, in which case space is only used if needed. They are also useful if it is not possible to alter the data structure of either participating class.

14.1.8 双向实现方式的比较

大多数情况下，需要在双向指针和单向指针之间进行选择。前者提供双向访问速度，而后者空间利用率更高，更新速度也更快。基数和实际链接数会影响这种权衡。

In most cases the choice will be between pointers in both directions and pointers in one direction. The former provides speed of access in both directions, while the latter is much more space efficient and faster on update. The cardinalities and the actual number of links affect the trade-off.

关联对象在特殊情况下很有用，但总体而言，它们并不是首先要查找的对象。

Association objects are useful in special cases, but on the whole they are not the first place to look.

14.1.9 派生映射

总体而言，派生映射与其他类型的映射并无二致。访问器与基映射的访问器提供方式完全相同；它们应该无法区分。然而，通常情况下，我们无法提供修饰符。派生映射的关键在于它所隐含的约束，这种约束存在于派生映射本身以及构成该派生映射的其他映射的组合之间。

On the whole, derived mappings look no different than any other kind of mapping. Accessors are provided just the same as base mappings; they should be indistinguishable. Often, however, it is not possible to provide a modifier. The important thing about derived mappings is the constraint they imply between the derived mapping and the combination of other mappings that make up the derivation.

14.1.10 非集合映射

尽管大多数多值映射都是集合，但也存在例外。本书中，这些例外用诸如 [list]、[hierarchy] 和 [key: mappingName] 之类的简短语义语句来表示。这类语句暗示着不同的接口。标记为 [list] 的映射将返回一个列表而不是集合，并且会带有诸如 addFirst、addLast、addBefore(Object) 和 indexOf(anObject) 之类的修饰符。本书并未尝试提供所有这些情况的接口。但是，如果我们使用此类结构，则应确保为其设计模板。通常，我们应该基于底层集合的接口来设计映射。我们也可以将这些结构视为关联模式（参见第 15 章）。

Although the majority of multivalued mappings are sets, there are exceptions. In this book they are indicated by short semantic statements such as [list], [hierarchy], and [key: mappingName]. These kinds of statements imply a different interface. Mappings marked with [list] will return a list rather than a set and will have modifiers such as addFi rst, addLast, addBefore (Object), and i ndexOf (anObject). I have not attempted to provide all the interfaces for these cases in this book. If we use such constructs, however, we should ensure we work out the design templates for them. Usually we should base the interface on that of the underlying collection. We can also think of these constructs as association patterns (see Chapter 15).

14.2 实现泛化

14.2 Implementing Generalization

面向对象建模与大多数传统数据建模实践之间最显著的区别之一在于泛化的广泛应用。尽管泛化早已是许多数据建模方法的一部分，但它通常被视为一种高级或专门的技术。泛化与面向对象继承的紧密联系确保了它在面向对象分析中的核心地位。

One of the most noticeable differences between OO type modeling and most conventional data modeling practices is the great use of generalization. Although generalization has long been part of many data modeling approaches, it is often seen as an advanced or specialized technique. The close relationship between generalization and OO's inheritance ensures a central place for it in OO analysis.

许多面向对象方法将泛化作为与继承等效的分析手段。然而，使用动态和多重分类的方法需要更多思考，因为主流面向对象语言仅支持单一静态分类。实现多重动态分类的方法也可以用于重组继承结构，并在不支持继承的环境中实现泛化。

Many OO methods use generalization as an analysis equivalent to inheritance. Methods that use dynamic and multiple classification, however, require more thought because mainstream OO languages only support single static classification. The approaches to implementing multiple dynamic classification can also be used to reorganize inheritance structures and implement generalization in environments that do not support inheritance.

为了便于理解，我先描述实现方式，然后再描述接口，因为这样更容易理解接口需要支持的各种变化。

For generalization, I describe the implementations first and then the interface, since this makes it easier to understand the variations the interface needs to support.

14.2.1 通过继承实现

在大多数情况下，子类型和子类是同义词，因此提供了最佳的实现方式。每种类型的接口都位于相应的类上，并且语言对方法选择提供了完善的支持。因此，如果可能，这种方法总是首选。它的缺点是不支持多重或动态分类。

In most methods subtyping and subclasses are synonymous, thus providing the best possible form of implementation. The interfaces for each type are placed on corresponding classes, and method selection is properly supported by the language. Thus this approach is always preferred if possible. Its disadvantages are that it does not support multiple or dynamic classification.

14.2.2 通过多重继承组合类实现

图 14.5 展示了一个多重分类的示例，我们可以通过多重继承组合类来处理这种情况。在这个例子中，除了图中四种对象类型的类之外，我们还需要创建优先级公司类和优先级个人客户类。通过使用多重继承，这些类可以简洁地捕获所有必需的接口，并让编程系统以通常的方式处理方法选择。

Figure 14.5 shows an example of multiple classification, which we can deal with by multiple inheritance combination classes. In this example we would create classes for priority corporation and priority personal customer in addition to classes for each of the four object types on the diagram. By using multiple inheritance the classes can neatly capture all the required interfaces and let the programming system deal with method selection in the usual way.

图 14.5 多重分类示例。

Figure 14.5 An example of multiple classification.

这种方法有两个缺点。首先，具有多个分区的对象类型会导致组合类集合过于庞大。例如，四个完整的分区，每个分区包含两种类型，就需要 24 个组合类。另一个缺点是，这种方法仅支持静态分类。

There are two disadvantages to this approach. The first is that an object type with many partitions can cause an unwieldy set of combination classes. Four complete partitions, each with two types, require 24 combination classes. The other disadvantage is that this approach only supports static classification.

14.2.3 通过标志实现

如果问一位从未听说过继承的程序员如何实现客户记录优先级的功能，他很可能会回答“使用状态标志”。这种老式的方案仍然有效。它提供了一种快速支持多重动态分类的方法。标志可以随时轻松更改，并且可以为每个分区定义一个标志字段。事实上，这正是面向对象程序中用于状态更改的方案，尤其是在那些不基于动态分类的程序中。

If a programmer who had never heard of inheritance was asked how to implement the need for customers to record whether they are a priority or not, the answer would probably be "with a status flag." This old-fashioned scheme is still effective. It provides a quick way to support multiple and dynamic classification. Flags are easily changed at will, and one flag field can be defined for each partition. Indeed this is the scheme used for state changes in OO programs not based on dynamic classification.

这种方法的主要难点在于我们无法在语言内部使用继承和方法选择。因此，子类型接口中的所有操作都必须放在父类型的类中。此外，支持子类型所需的所有字段也必须包含在父类型类中。因此，客户类同时实现了客户对象类型和优先级客户对象类型。

The main difficulty with this approach is that we cannot use the inheritance and method selection within the language. Thus all operations in the interface of the subtype have to be put on the supertype's class. In addition, all fields required to support subtypes need to be included in the supertype class. Thus the customer class implements both the customer and the priority customer object types.

如果接收对象不是子类型的实例，那么显然不应该使用定义在子类型上的操作，例如请求非优先级客户的代表值，如图 14.6 所示。如果我们使用了继承，这将导致错误（在 Smalltalk 中是运行时错误，在 C++ 中可能是编译时错误）。所有定义在子类型上的操作都必须经过检查，以确保接收者是该子类型。如果检查失败，程序将退出，并给出一些问题指示，通常是抛出异常。这暴露了 C++ 中这种方案的另一个缺点——在编译之前无法捕获这些错误。

If the receiving object is not an instance of the subtype, it is clearly not appropriate to use operations defined on the subtype, such as asking for the rep of a nonpriority customer, as shown in Figure 14.6. This would cause an error (a run-time error in Smalltalk and probably a compile-time error in C++) if we are using inheritance. All operations defined on a subtype must be guarded by a check to ensure that the receiver is of that subtype. If that check fails, the routine exits, yielding some sign of the problem, usually an exception. This exposes a further disadvantage of this scheme in C++—it is not possible to catch these errors until compile time.

图 14.6 优先客户示例。

Figure 14.6 Priority customer example.

由于继承机制的丢失，其对应的多态性也仅仅停留在记忆层面。因此，如果运费计算操作是多态的，那么方法选择就需要由程序员来实现。这可以通过在客户类中使用 case 语句来完成。客户接口中提供了一个运费计算操作。该操作的方法中包含一个基于客户子类型的逻辑测试，并可能调用内部私有方法。如果 case 语句保留在类内部，并且只向外部发布一个操作，那么多态性的所有优势仍然得以保留。因此，即使没有实体，灵魂依然存在。

Since inheritance is lost, its partner polymorphism is also only a memory. Thus if a shipping price operation is polymorphic, then the method selection needs to be implemented by the programmer. This is done using a case statement inside the customer class. A single shipping price operation is provided as part of customer's interface. In the method for that operation, there is a logical test based on the subtypes of customer, with possible calls to internal private methods. If the case statement is kept within the class and a single operation is published to the outside world, all the advantages of polymorphism remain. Thus the soul remains even if the body is absent.

这种实现方式的最后一个缺点是，它为子类型使用的所有数据结构都定义了空间。所有非超类型的对象都会浪费这些空间。如果子类型上有很多关联，这可能会导致问题。

The final disadvantage of this implementation is that space is defined for all data structures used by the subtype. All objects that are not instances of the supertype waste this space. If there are a lot of associations on the subtype, this can cause problems.

14.2.4 通过委托给隐藏类来实现

这种方法是使用标志实现子类型的一种有效变体。在这种情况下，需要为子类型创建一个类，但该类对除超类型类之外的所有其他类都是隐藏的。我们必须在超类型类中提供一个字段来存储对子类型的引用（该字段也可以用作标志）。同样，我们必须将子类型的所有操作都移到超类型的接口中。然而，数据结构仍然保留在超类型中。所有来自子类型类的超类型类操作都会将调用委托给子类型类，由子类型类来执行实际的方法。

This approach is a useful variant on using flags to implement subtyping. In this case a class is prepared for the subtype, but this class is hidden from all but the supertype class. We must provide a field in the supertype class for a reference to the subtype (which can double as a flag). Again we must move all the operations of the subtype to the supertype's interface. However, the data structure remains on the supertype. All the operations on the supertype class, which come from the subtype class, delegate the call to the subtype class, which holds the actual method.

因此，对于图 14.7 所示的概念模型，一个 executive 实例将同时拥有一个 employee 实例和一个 executive 实例，如图 14.8 所示。除了 employee 类之外，任何其他组件都无法访问 executive 对象及其所属类。（在 C++ 中，executive 的所有成员都将是私有的，employee 是它的友元。）定义在 executive 类型上的 giveStock 操作将被放置在 employee 对象上。当向一个关联了 executive 的 employee 对象发送 pay 时，employee 对象上的 pay 方法只需调用 executive 对象上的 pay 方法并返回结果即可。这样，系统的其他部分就无需了解子类型是如何实现的。多态操作的方法选择与标志的选择方式相同（使用内部 case 语句），并在适当的时候调用 executive 对象的方法。另一种方法是将所有方法都放在 employee 对象上，而将 executive 对象仅仅作为一个数据结构。然而，这样做会降低 executive 对象的独立性。

Thus for the conceptual model shown in Figure 14.7, an instance of executive would have one instance each of employee and executive, as shown in Figure 14.8. The executive object and its class are not seen by any component other than the employee class. (In C++ all its members would be private and employee its friend.] The giveStock operation, defined on the executive type, would be placed on employee. When pay is sent to an employee object with an associated executive, the method on employee for pay merely calls the pay method on executive and returns any result. In this way no other part of the system knows how subtyping is implemented. Method selection for polymorphic operations are implemented in the same way as for flags (an internal case statement) with a call to the executive's method if appropriate. Another approach would be to place all methods on employee and make executive nothing but a data structure. This, however, would make executive less of a self-contained module.

图 14.7 员工和高管的概念模型。

Figure 14.7 Conceptual model of employee and executive.

图 14.8 图 14.7 的实现模型，使用委托给隐藏 类。

Figure 14.8 Implementation model of Figure 14.7 using delegation to a hidden class.

这种方法的逻辑结论是图 14.9 所示的状态模式 [3]。在这种情况下，始终存在一个隐藏类。不同的隐藏类都拥有一个共同的抽象超类，而该超类本身也是隐藏的。员工类只需将支付请求委托给其隐藏类即可。无论哪个子类存在，都会做出相应的响应。这样，只要不修改员工类，就可以在不改变员工类接口的情况下添加新的子类型（信封/信件模式 [3] 也采用了类似的方法）。

The logical conclusion of this approach is the state pattern [3] shown in Figure 14.9. In this case there is always a hidden class present. The different hidden classes all have a common abstract superclass, which is itself hidden. Employee simply delegates pay to its hidden class. Whichever subclass is present responds appropriately. This allows new subtypes to be added without changing the employee class, providing they do not add to the interface of employee (a similar approach is the envelope/letter idiom [3]).

与单独使用标志相比，使用隐藏类的主要优势在于，它为复杂的子类型提供了更高的模块化程度，并且还能避免空间浪费。

The main advantages of using a hidden class over using flags alone is that it provides greater modularity for complex subtypes. It also eliminates wasted space.

图 14.9 员工和高管的状态模式实现。

Figure 14.9 Implementation of employee and executive with the state pattern.

抽象类 EmployeeGrade 的一个实例始终存在。任何与状态相关的 行为都在 EmployeeGrade 上声明为抽象方法，并由 子类实现。我使用箭头来表示子类化（来自 Rational 的统一建模 语言 (UML) [1]），以强调子类化和子类型化之间的区别。

An instance of the abstract EmployeeGrade class is always present. Any state-dependent behavior is declared on EmployeeGrade as an abstract method and implemented by the subclasses. I have used an arrow to show subclassing (from Rational's Unified Modeling Language (UML) [1] to reinforce the difference between subclassing and subtyping.

14.2.5 通过创建替代方案来实现

处理类型变更的一种方法是使用子类来实现子类型，并在重新分类时移除旧对象，并用相应类的新对象替换它。这样，程序员既可以保留继承和方法选择的优势，又能实现动态分类。

One way to handle changes in type is to implement the subtype with a subclass and on reclassification to remove the old object and replace it with a new one of the appropriate class. This allows the programmer to retain the advantages of inheritance and method selection while still providing dynamic classification.

执行此操作的步骤是：在新类中创建对象，将旧对象的所有公共信息复制到新对象，将所有指向旧对象的引用更改为指向新对象，最后删除旧对象。

The procedure for carrying this out is to create the object in the new class, copy all common information from the old object to the new, change all the references pointing to the old object to point to the new one, and finally to delete the old object.

在许多环境下，最大的问题在于找到所有指向旧对象的引用并将其迁移到新对象。如果没有内存管理，这几乎是不可能的。任何未被捕获的引用都会变成悬空指针，导致难以调试的崩溃。因此，除非使用某种能够可靠地找到所有引用的内存管理方案，否则不建议在 C++ 中使用这种方法。具有内存管理功能的语言可能会更容易做到这一点；Smalltalk 提供了一个 `become` 方法来执行引用交换。

In many environments the biggest problem is finding all the references to the old object and moving them to the new one. Without memory management this can be nearly impossible. Any references that are not caught become dangling pointers and lead to a crash that is difficult to debug. Thus this approach is not recommended for C++ unless some memory management scheme is used that can reliably find all references. Languages with memory management may find this easier; Smalltalk provides a method (become) to do the swapping of references.

如果所有引用都能找到并修改，这种方法是可行的。它剩下的缺点是复制通用信息以及查找和修改引用需要花费时间。所需时间因环境而异，并决定了该方法的适用性。

If all references can be found and changed this approach is plausible. Its remaining disadvantage is the time taken in copying common information and in finding and changing the references. This amount of time varies considerably among environments and determines the approach's suitability.

14.2.6 通用化接口

这五种实现方式都运行良好，并且在面向对象编程中都经常使用。为了使每种实现方式都能成为概念泛化的替代方案，我们需要为它们提供一个统一的接口。

All five implementations work well, and all are regularly used in object-oriented programming. For each implementation to be an alternative for conceptual generalization, we need to have a single interface for all of them.

面向对象编程中一个颇具争议的问题是：是否应该提供一个返回对象分类的操作？这样的操作通常很重要——否则我们如何才能从一组人中筛选出女性呢？然而，这样的操作也存在一个风险：程序员可能会在 case 语句中使用它，从而破坏多态性及其带来的优势。在面向对象编程的现有结构中，似乎很难彻底解决这个难题。返回对象分类的操作通常是必要的，因此应该提供。但是，为了保持良好的编程风格，我们不应该用这样的操作来代替多态性。一般来说，分类信息应该只在纯粹的信息收集查询或界面显示时才需要。

A controversial question in OO programming is whether there should be an operation that returns an object's classification. Such an operation is often important—how else can we take a set of people and filter it to leave only the women? Such an operation, however, also presents the danger that programmers will use it within a case statement subvert polymorphism and the advantages that it brings. There seems little that can be done within the struc ture of OO programming to eliminate this dilemma. An operation to return an object's classification is often necessary and thus should be provided. However, for the sake of good programming style we should not use such an operation instead of polymorphism. As a general guideline, classification information should only be requested as a part of pure information gathering within a query or for interface display.

目前存在一些用于确定对象分类的约定。Smalltalk 和 C++ 程序员都使用名为 `isState-Name` 的操作来判断对象是否处于特定状态。Smalltalk 还有一个消息 `isKindOf: aClass` 来确定对象的类成员关系。C++ 在运行时不保存类信息（尽管即将发布的标准会改变这一点）。但是，有时在需要时，也会提供一些能够有效提供此类信息的操作。

Some conventions currently exist for finding out the classification of an object. Both Smalltalk and C++ programmers use operations named i sState-Name to determine whether an object is in a certain state. Smalltalk has a message isKindOf: aClass to determine class membership. C++ does not hold class information at run time (although that will change with the forthcoming standard). However, sometimes operations that effectively give this information are provided when a need is there.

可以使用两种主要的命名方案。第一种是使用 `isTypeName` 的命名形式。第二种是提供参数化操作，例如 `hasType(TypeName)`。第一种方案是标志和隐藏类常用的命名约定。它在这种情况下运行良好，但在处理子类时存在问题。如果我们想向现有类添加一个新的子类，我们需要在父类和子类中都添加 `isTypeName` 操作。否则，在父类上调用 `isTypeName` 会导致错误。`hasType` 约定更具可扩展性，因为可以在不更改父类的情况下添加子类。请记住，在任何情况下，我们都需要类型信息，而不是类信息。

Two broad naming schemes can be used. The first is to use the naming form isTypeName. The second is to provide a parametric operation such as hasType (TypeName). The first scheme is the normal convention used with flags and hidden classes. It works well in this guise but has a problem covering subclassing. If we want to add a new subclass to an existing class, we need to add the isTypeName operation to the superclass as well as the subclass. Otherwise, calling i sTypeName on the superclass causes an error. The hasType convention is more extensible since subclasses can be added without a change to the superclass. Remember that in all cases we want type information, not class information.

类型变更没有典型的命名标准。诸如 `make-TypeName` 或 `classifyAsTypeName` 之类的名称都是合理的（我更倾向于前者）。此类操作应负责将任何不相交的类型进行去分类。因此，一个完整的分区只需要拥有与分区中类型数量相同的修饰符即可。不完整的分区需要某种方式来恢复到不完整状态。这可以通过为分区中的每个对象类型提供 `declassifyAsTypeName` 方法来实现，也可以通过提供一个单独的 `declassifyIn-PartitionName` 操作来实现。请注意，预期不会动态变化的分区将不会包含这些修饰符。

No typical naming standard exists for type changes. Names such as make-TypeName or classifyAsTypeName are reasonable (I prefer the former). Such operations should be responsible for declassifying from any disjoint types. Thus a complete partition need only have as many modifiers as there are types in the partition. Incomplete partitions need some way to get to the incomplete state. This can either be done by providing declassifyAsTypeName methods for each object type in the partition, or by providing a single declassifyIn-PartitionName operation. Note that parti tions that are not expected to be dynamic will not have these modifiers.

使用这些修饰符时，关联关系会涉及与创建和删除部分讨论的类似问题。因此，强制映射需要在分类例程中提供参数，而取消分类则可能导致类似于单次删除和多次删除的选择。

When these modifiers are used, associations will imply similar issues to those discussed under creation and deletion. Thus mandatory mappings require arguments in a classification routine, and a declassification can lead to choices akin to single and multiple deletion.

并非所有子类型都是动态的，但是否将分区设为动态取决于模型是概念模型还是接口模型。在概念建模中，将分区标记为不可变是一个强约束，通常非常罕见。虽然有人可能会认为，在大多数应用中，我们不希望将人的性别从男性改为女性，但这种类型变更在概念上并非不可能。即使在近期的医学进步之前，这种变更也可能需要。例如，一家公司可能认为某人是女性，但后来才发现他是男性。这种发现从概念上讲是通过类型变更来处理的。

Not all subtypes are dynamic, but the decision about whether to make a partition dynamic or not depends on whether the model is a conceptual or interface model. In conceptual modeling, marking a partition as immutable is a strong constraint and is often quite rare. Although it might be argued that for most applications we would not want to change people from male to female, that type change is not a conceptual impossibility. Even before recent medical advances occurred, such a change might be required. A company might think that a person was female and only later discover that he is male. Such a discovery is conceptually handled by a type change.

大多数语言对类型变更的处理能力较差，这促使我们减少类型变更的次数。因此，如果一个分区仅在极少数情况下是动态的，那么在规范模型中将其声明为静态是合理的。这些罕见情况通常是由于识别错误或用户操作失误造成的，可以通过用户显式创建替换对象来处理。这也是纯粹概念模型和基于概念的规范模型之间的另一个区别。

The fact that most languages handle type changes poorly prompts us to reduce the amount of type changing that is going on. Thus when a partition is only dynamic in very rare cases, it is reasonable, in a specification model, to declare it as static. The rare cases, often due to error in identification or a mistake by the user, can be handled by the user creating a replacement object explicitly. This is another source of difference between a purely conceptual model and a conceptually based specification model.

14.2.7 实现 hasType 操作

此时，有必要简要介绍一下类型访问器的实现。系统中的每个类都需要一个 `hasType` 操作。该方法会将参数与类实现的所有类型进行比对。如果使用了标志，则会检查这些标志以判断类型。即使没有使用任何标志，该类也几乎肯定会实现某个特定类型，因此必须检查该类型。如果任何一项测试结果为真，则返回 `true`。但是，如果没有匹配的类类型，则必须调用超类的相应方法并返回其结果。如果没有超类，则返回 `false`。因此，在实践中，发送到类型层次结构底部的消息会沿着层次结构向上冒泡，直到找到匹配项或到达顶部并返回 `false` 为止。这种机制使得扩展类型层次结构变得容易，因为只有实现了该类型的类才需要检查该类型。

At this point it is useful to say a few words about implementing the type accessor. Each class in the system will need a hasType operation. The method will check the argument against all the types implemented by the class. If flags have been used, then they are checked to test for the type. Even if no flags are present, the class will almost certainly implement a particular type, and that type must be checked. If any of these tests are true, then true is returned. If, however, none of the class types match, then the method on the superclass must be called and the result of that returned. If there is no super-type, then false is returned. Thus in practice a message sent to the bottom of a hierarchy will bubble up the hierarchy until it hits a match or it runs out at the top and comes back false. This mechanism makes it easy to extend the type hierarchy because only the class that implements the type needs to check for that type.

14.3 对象创建

14.3 Object Creation

创建新对象需要各种机制，包括类直接实现的机制和间接实现的机制。

Mechanisms are required to create new objects, both those that are implemented directly by a class and those that are indirectly implemented.

14.3.1 创建界面

每个类都必须有办法创建它所实现类型的实例。创建不仅意味着形成一个新的实例对象，还意味着满足该对象存在的各种约束，使其成为一个合法对象。

Each class must have a way of creating instances of the types it implements. Creation implies not only forming a new instance object but also satisfying the various constraints that exist for the object so that it is a legal object.

所有必需关联必须在创建操作期间填充（完整的创建方法[1]）。这意味着创建操作必须为每个必需操作提供参数。类似地，类实现的完整分区中的任何子类型也必须通过参数选择。必需情况以及非必需的不可变关联或分区也应通过参数选择。

All mandatory associations must be filled during the creation operation (a complete creation method [1]). This implies that the creation operation must have arguments for each mandatory operation. Similarly any subtypes in complete partitions implemented by the class must be chosen through arguments. Mandatory cases and immutable association or partitions that are not mandatory should also be chosen through arguments.

有时，由于实现环境中的其他假设，使用默认的对象创建机制很难实现此目的。在这种情况下，应使用工厂方法[3]。

Sometimes it is difficult to use the default object creation mechanisms to do this, due to other assumptions in the implementation environment. Factory methods [3] should be used in these circumstances.

在创建参数中包含可选的、可变的特性也是允许的。但是，通常最好先创建对象，然后再向其发送设置这些特性所需的必要消息。

It is also permissible to include optional, mutable features in the creation arguments. However, it is usually better first to create the object and then to send it the necessary messages to set up these features.

14.3.2 创建实施

所有面向对象语言都有各自的创建新对象的约定。这些约定通常包括分配存储空间和初始化字段。然而，初始化例程并非总是设置通过参数传递的必需特性的合适位置。

All object-oriented languages have their own conventions for creating new objects. Typically these provide for allocating storage and the initialization of fields. However, the initialization routine is not always an appropriate place for setting up the mandatory features passed through arguments.

在 Smalltalk 中，通常的做法是让每个类都支持一个可以带参数的创建消息（通常称为 `new`）。在创建过程中，通常会向新对象发送一个不带参数的初始化消息。这个初始化消息可以用于将多值映射的实例变量设置为新集合，但由于它不带参数，因此无法用于初始化关联。最好的方法是使用 Kent Beck 的创建参数方法模式 [1]，即创建一个专门的方法来设置这些初始参数。

In Smalltalk the usual idiom is to have each class support a creation message (often called new) that can take arguments. During creation it is often arranged for the new object to be sent an initialize message that takes no arguments. This initialize is useful for setting the instance variables of multivalued mappings to a new set but cannot support initializing associations since it takes no arguments. The best thing is to use Kent Beck's Creation Parameter Method pattern [1] by having a special method to set these initial parameters.

C++ 提供了一个用于初始化的构造函数。虽然构造函数可以用于很多操作，但有时其语义可能会出现问题。通常情况下，最好只在其他创建操作中使用构造函数；“四人帮”创建模式 [4] 对这种情况特别有用。

C++ provides a constructor for initialization. Much can be done, here but sometimes there can be problems with constructor semantics. Often it is better to use the constructor only within another create operation; the "Gang of Four" creation patterns [4] are particularly helpful for such cases.

14.4 物体销毁

14.4 Object Destruction

事物有生有死。并非所有事物都能被销毁，有些事物必须永远保存（例如医疗记录）。即便如此，它们也可能因为已被存档于其他系统而被销毁。

As objects live, so may they die. Not all objects can be destroyed, some objects have to live forever (medical records, for example). Even then they may be destroyed by one system having been archived elsewhere.

销毁对象最大的问题在于如何处理由此产生的后果。例如，从图 14.10 中删除一个订单实例，如果该实例存在与之关联的订单行，就会引发问题。这些订单行必须关联一个订单（强制关联），因此如果我们直接删除该订单，这些订单行就违反了其关联约束。

The biggest problem with destroying objects is living with the consequences. For example, deleting an instance of order from Figure 14.10 causes a problem if there are any order lines connected to it. Such order lines must have an order (mandatory association), so if we simply delete the order, the order lines are in violation of their constraints.

图 14.10 客户和订单示例。

Figure 14.10 Example with customers and orders.

这个问题有两种解决方案。第一种是单次删除——一种比较温和的方法。如果删除操作导致任何对象违反其约束，则删除操作失败。另一种是多次（或级联）删除——一种强硬的方法。如果这种删除操作导致某个订单行违反其约束，则该订单行也会被删除。如果任何对象与该订单行存在强制映射关系，则所有依赖对象也会被删除——从而在整个信息库中产生连锁反应。

There are two solutions to this problem. The first is the single delete—the kinder, gentler approach. If the delete results in any object being left in violation of its constraints, then the destruction fails. On the other side is the multiple (or cascading) delete—the hard and nasty approach. If this delete leaves an order line in violation of its constraints that object is also deleted. If any thing has a mandatory mapping to this object, then those dependent objects are deleted as well—causing a ripple effect throughout the information base.

在实践中，删除操作可能存在不同程度的级联效应。对于某些映射，销毁操作可能是多次执行，而对于其他映射，则可能是单次执行。这完全允许，但必须确保销毁操作要么全部执行，要么全部不执行。

In practice, deletes can have varying degrees of cascade. A destruction operation can be multiple with respect to some mappings but single with respect to others. This is perfectly permissible, but it must be ensured that the destruction is all or nothing.

这些问题与 C++ 等缺乏内存管理机制的环境中对引用的担忧相叠加。单次删除和多次删除旨在确保对象不违反其基数约束，而内存管理则避免悬空指针的产生。

These issues are added to concerns about references in environments, like C++, that do not have memory management. Single and multiple deletes are about ensuring that objects do not break their cardinality constraints, and memory management avoids dangling pointers.

14.4.1 销毁接口

不同的面向对象环境对对象销毁的处理方式各不相同。所有可销毁的对象都应该只有一个销毁操作。这对于程序员来说已经足够了，但这同时也意味着类的用户有责任按照正确的顺序销毁对象。除了单一的销毁操作之外，还可以提供一些更复杂的删除操作。但是，必须明确指出哪些映射关系需要进行多次销毁。

Different object-oriented environments have their own approaches to destruction. All destroyable objects should have a fully single destroy operation. This is all a programmer needs, but it does put the onus on the user of the class to destroy things in the right order. Together with a fully single destroy, some harder deletes can also be provided. It must be made clear, however, for which mappings the destruction is multiple.

14.4.2 销毁的实施

在销毁过程中，内存管理的作用最为显著。它对销毁方法本身影响不大，但会影响错误造成的后果。

It is during destruction that the presence of memory management makes itself most felt. It makes little difference to the destruction method itself but does affect the consequences of error.

无论哪种情况，都必须断开待销毁对象与其关联对象的所有链接（双向链接）。必须进行必要的检查，以确定关联对象是否会违反其约束。如果删除操作涉及多个对象，则该对象也会被销毁。如果删除操作仅涉及单个对象，则整个销毁过程将被中止，信息库不会发生任何更改。之前所做的任何更改都必须回滚。对于非内存管理系统，最后一步是释放存储空间。对于内存管理系统，不会显式地释放存储空间——由于所有链接都被移除，该对象会自行销毁并被垃圾回收。

In both cases it is important that the object to be destroyed have all its links with associated objects broken (in both directions). The necessary checks must be made to see if the related object will be in violation of its constraints. If the delete is multiple, then the object too is destroyed. If the delete is single, then the whole destruction is abandoned and no changes are made to the information base. Any changes that were made so far must be rolled back. With a nonmemory-managed system the final step is to deallocate the storage. With a memory-managed system no explicit deallocation is made—with all its links removed the object dies of loneliness and gets garbage collected.

14.5 入口点

14.5 Entry Point

现在，我们拥有一个设计完善的关联对象结构。从任何一个对象出发，都可以轻松地利用类型模型来确定如何导航到另一个对象。然而，仍然存在一个重要的问题：我们首先如何进入对象结构？对于使用传统数据库（尤其是关系型数据库）的用户来说，这个问题可能显得有些奇怪，因为这些数据库的入口点是记录类型。获取数据需要从记录类型入手，然后选择单个记录。然而，从类型的所有实例列表开始并非总是最合适的方法。特别是面向对象的系统，可以提供不同的访问方式，这些方式可能更高效，并提供其他有用的功能。

There is now a well-designed structure of connected objects. From any object it is easy to use the type model to decide how to navigate to another object. There is still one important question, however: How do we get into the object structure in the first place? This question may seem odd to those who use traditional, and in particular relational, databases because the entry points to these databases are the record types. Getting hold of the data involves starting at the record type and selecting individual records. Starting from a list of all instances of a type is not always the most appropriate method, however. Object-oriented systems, in particular, can provide different forms of access that can be more efficient and provide other useful abilities.

我们不需要所有类型的所有实例列表。请看图 14.11 中的示例。由于所有订单行实例都与订单实例相关联，因此我们无需维护从订单行类型到其所有实例的引用。如果我们认为很少有人会请求所有订单行（无论订单类型或产品类型），那么我们可以忽略该引用。万一有人确实需要所有订单行的列表，我们可以通过获取所有订单实例的列表，然后通过映射关系找到订单行来提供该列表。这样，我们只需在需要所有订单行实例时增加一层间接寻址，即可节省维护所有订单行实例引用所需的存储空间。这纯粹是实现上的权衡。在关系数据库中，这种权衡无关紧要，因为关系数据库使用固定表。

We don't need a list of all instances for all types. Consider the example in Figure 14.11. Since all instances of order line are connected to an instance of order, we need not hold a reference from the type order line to all its instances. If we think it will be rare for anyone to ask for all order lines, regardless of order or product, then we can neglect the reference. In the unlikely occurrence that someone does want a list of all order lines, then we could provide this by getting a list of all instances of order and navigating across the mapping to order line. Thus we can save the storage required to hold all the references to all instances of order line at the cost of one level of indirection should we ever require all instances of order line. This is purely an implementation trade-off. In a relational database the trade-off is irrelevant since the database uses fixed tables.

图 14.11 客户、订单、产品示例。

Figure 14.11 Customer, order, product example.

同样的论证也可以推广到订单上。我们可以认为，如果用户想要通过输入订单号来选择订单，那么所有订单实例都是必需的。由于订单号通常是字符串，因此通常不会持有从字符串到订单的引用，所以所有订单实例都是必需的。然而，我们可以认为，一旦找到客户，实际上总是会访问订单。同样，是否持有指针取决于具体的实现方式。

The same argument can be extended to order. We might consider that all instances of order are required if a person wishes to select an order by typing in an order number. Since the order number typically is a string, references from string to order are not usually held, and all instances of order are required. However, we could argue that orders are, in reality, always accessed once the customer is found. Again it is an implementation question as to whether to hold the pointers or not.

这个论点不能推广到客户对象，因为客户对象本身不包含任何强制性关系。因此，一个客户对象可能不与其他任何对象关联。为了确保能够找到这样的客户对象，我们需要维护一个包含所有客户实例的列表。正是这种维护列表的必要性使得客户对象成为一个入口点。

This argument cannot be extended to customer because customer lacks any mandatory relationships. Thus it is possible for a customer not to be related to any other object. A list of all instances of customer is thus necessary to ensure that such a customer is found. This necessity to hold a list is what makes customer an entry point.

请注意，哪些对象类型应该作为入口点完全是一个概念性问题。没有强制关系的对象类型必须是入口点。具有强制关系的对象类型可以包含实例列表，但这本身并不能使它们成为概念上的入口点。

Note that the decision of which object types should be entry points is purely a conceptual issue. Object types with no mandatory relationships must be entry points. Those with mandatory relationships can hold a list of instances, but that in itself does not make them conceptual entry points.

14.5.1 查找对象的接口

对于所有类型来说，拥有一个能够返回该类型所有实例的操作都非常有用。当指针逆向指向目标时，这样的操作对于单向指针的正常工作至关重要。

It is useful for all types to have an operation that returns all instances of the type. Such an operation is essential for pointers in one direction to work when navigating against the grain.

提供一些操作来根据某些条件查找实例通常很有用。例如，`findCustomer(customer-Number)`。虽然很难为这类操作制定通用规则，但通常最自然的方式是使用导航。因此，与其查询所有客户为 ABC 的订单，不如直接查询客户 ABC 的所有订单，这样在概念上更容易理解。由于查询的导航表达式，这可能会导致一些优化问题，但这些问题通常可以在客户的访问器中解决。

It can often be useful to provide some operation to find an instance according to some criteria. An example might be findCustomer (customer-Number). Although it is difficult to provide general rules for using such an operation, in general the most natural way is to use navigation. Thus rather than asking to find all orders whose customer is ABC, it is conceptually easier to ask customer ABC for all its orders. This can cause optimization problems due to the navigational expression of the query, but these can often be resolved within customer's accessor.

当查找操作是针对基本类型进行的，此选项不适用，因此通用的查找例程更为有用。然而，即便如此，也应尽可能采用通用的方法。最简单的方法是获取类的所有实例，然后对返回的集合使用内置的 select 操作。但对于实例数量众多的类，这种方法效果不佳。下一步是提供一个 select 操作，该操作接受任何布尔运算作为参数。这样只需对类的接口执行一次操作，即可实现最大的灵活性。然而，在某些语言中实现起来比其他语言要困难得多。只有当这些方法都无效，且采用更通用的方法过于昂贵时，才应使用带有特定参数的查找操作。我们必须始终注意避免类的接口过于臃肿。

When the finding is being done with respect to fundamental types, this option does not apply, so a general find routine is more useful. However, even then it should be done in as general a way as possible. The easiest approach is to ask for all instances of a class and then use the built-in select operation on the returned set. This does not work well for classes with many instances. The next move is to provide a select operation that will take any Boolean operation as an argument. This allows maximum flexibility with only one operation on the class's interface. However, it is much harder to do in some languages than in others. Only when these approaches are exhausted and it is too expensive to do it in a more generic way should we use a find with specific arguments. We must always take care not to bloat a class's interface.

请注意，这些实例查找操作对于非入口点和入口点同样有效。实际上，实例访问器应该遵循相同的模式。

Note that these instance-finding operations are as valid for non-entry points as they are for entry points. Indeed the instance accessors should fit the same pattern.

入口点对象需要额外的操作才能使其适应结构。仅仅创建对象可能无法将其放置在结构中，尤其当它与结构中的任何其他对象都没有关联时。因此，入口点对象需要一个操作才能将其插入结构中。

Entry points need an additional operation to make an object fit within the structure. Merely creating an object may not place it within the struc ture, particularly if it is not related to any other object within the structure. Thus entry point objects need an operation to insert them within the structure.

上述接口说明适用于内存系统。使用数据库时，情况略有不同。不同的数据库管理系统（无论是面向对象数据库管理系统 (OODBMS) 还是关系型数据库）都有各自的约定。务实的做法是遵循这些约定，但前提是接口应尽可能避免涉及数据库管理系统的具体细节。

The above interface comments are true for in-memory systems. Slightly different characteristics occur when using databases. Different database management systems (either OODBMSs or relational interfaces) have their own conventions. The pragmatic thing to do is to use those conventions with the proviso that, as much as possible, interfaces should be free of database management system specifics.

14.5.2 查找操作的实现

通常实现入口点的方式是通过某个集合类。这个集合可以是特殊的单例类（例如客户列表），也可以是类中的一个静态字段。请求某个类型的实例意味着返回该集合中的对象。与多值关联一样，重要的是该集合除了通过入口点的接口之外，不能被修改。非入口点通常也提供一个返回所有实例的操作。这可以通过从入口点导航来实现。SELECT 和 FIND 操作的工作方式类似。

The usual way of implementing an entry point is through some collection class. This collection can be a special singleton class (such as customer list) or a static field in the class. Asking a type for its instances means that the objects of the collection are returned. As with multivalued associations, it is important that the collection be unchangeable except through the entry point's interface. A non-entry point also typically has an operation to return all instances. This can be done by navigating from an entry point. Selects and finds work in a similar way.

14.5.3 使用类或注册器对象

入口点的接口和实现既可以通过类来实现，也可以通过注册器对象来实现。基于类的入口点实现方式是，每个入口点类都持有一个包含其实例的集合，该集合以类变量或静态变量的形式存在。另一种方法是为每个入口点类创建一个单独的注册器对象，该对象持有一个实例集合。注册器方法的主要优势在于它允许存在多个独立的注册器对象，例如用于不同的上下文。因此，如果两个临床科室希望维护不同的疾病实例，则可以通过为每个临床科室创建一个单独的注册器对象来实现。

Both the interface and the implementation of entry points can be done either by classes or by registrar objects. A class-based implementation of entry points results in each entry point class holding a collection of its instances as a class or static variable. The alternative is to have a separate registrar object that holds a collection for each entry point class. The main advantage of the registrar approach is that it allows separate registrars to exist, perhaps for different contexts. Thus if two clinical departments wish to maintain different instances of disease, this can be done by having a separate registrar object for each clinical department.

在接口方面，区别在于程序员是将查找消息发送到类本身还是发送到注册器对象。使用注册器可以免除每个类的这项责任，但注册器至少需要为每个入口点类执行一次查找操作。如果查找操作也用于非入口点，则注册器至少需要为每个非入口点类执行一次查找操作。当程序员需要理解和切换不同的上下文时，使用注册器非常有用。如果只使用一个上下文，则可以将其设置为全局上下文，并将基于类的操作委托给相应的注册器。

In the interface the difference lies in whether programmers send find messages to the class or to a registrar object. Using a registrar removes this responsibility from each class, but the registrar needs at least one find operation for each entry point class. If find operations are also used for non-entry points, then the registrar needs at least one find operation for each class. Using a registrar is useful when programmers need to understand and swap between different contexts. If only a single context is used, it can be set up as a global and the class-based operations can delegate to the appropriate registrar.

14.6 实施约束

14.6 Implementing Constraints

类型模型有助于定义类型必须满足的约束。基数和划分都体现了这些约束。更复杂的情况需要更复杂的类型。本书中使用的简短和冗长的语义语句通常都体现了更复杂的约束。

Type models help define the constraints that a type must satisfy. Cardinalities and partitions both indicate constraints. More complex situations require more complex types. The short and long semantic statements used in this book most often indicate the more complex constraints.

约束通常不会影响编程语言中类的显式接口。Eiffel 语言是个例外，它定义了类的不变量。对于不具备 Eiffel 特性的语言，所有修饰符都必须考虑约束。编写修饰符操作的程序员必须确保使用该修饰符后，对象的状态不会违反任何约束。

Constraints do not generally affect the explicit interface of classes in programming languages. An exception is Eiffel, where constraints define the class invariant. For languages without Eiffel's features, the constraints must be taken into account by all modifiers. The programmers writing modifier operations must ensure that using the modifier leaves the object in a state that violates none of its constraints.

通常情况下，实现一个显式访问器来判断对象是否符合其约束条件非常有用。所有类都应该提供一个名为类似 `checkInvariant` 的操作，以便在出现问题时抛出异常，在一切正常时则不执行任何操作。这可以用作各种阶段的健康检查，例如在调试期间作为后置条件检查的一部分，以及在运行期间作为系统完整性检查的一部分——这对数据库系统尤其重要。

It is often useful to implement an explicit accessor to determine if an object fits within its constraints. An operation named something like checkInvariant should be provided for all classes to generate an exception if something is wrong and do nothing if all is well. This can be used as a health check at various points, included as part of a postcondition check during debugging and as part of system sanity checks during operation— which are particularly valuable for database systems.

Smalltalk 和 C++ 不像 Eiffel 那样提供显式的约束和断言功能。不过，它们可以通过一种功能较弱但相当有效的替代方案来实现。在 Smalltalk 中，你可以设置一个操作（例如 `require: aBlock`），该操作接受一个代码块作为参数。该方法可以编写在类对象中，用于执行代码块，并在返回 false 时抛出异常。`require` 方法可以用于前置条件检查、不变式检查以及一些后置条件检查。C++ 有一个名为 `assert` 的宏，可以用于相同的目的。

Smalltalk and C++ do not have explicit capabilities for constraints and assertions in the way that Eiffel does. They can be set up with a weak, but reasonably effective, alternative. In Smalltalk you can set up an operation (called something like requi re: aBlock) that takes a block as an argument. The method can be written in class object to execute the block and throw an exception if it comes back false. The require method can then be used for precondition checks, invariant checks, and some postcondition checks. C++ has a macro called assert that can be used for the same purposes.

14.7 其他技术的设计模板

14.7 Design Templates for Other Techniques

本书主要以类型模型为主。因此，本章中的设计模板都是从类型模型转换而来。类似的原则也适用于其他技术。虽然这种直接映射不太可行，但可以为事件图提供设计模板模式[6]。过去几年里，关于各种状态模型的设计模板已经有很多讨论，但我们仍在等待一个明确的结论。交互图与实现足够接近，因此它们与代码的关系相当显而易见。

This book is dominated by type models. Hence the design templates in this chapter are transformations from type models. Similar principles can apply with other techniques. Although such a direct mapping is not as plausible, design template patterns can be provided for event diagrams [6]. There has been quite a lot of discussion over the last few years about design templates for various kinds of state models, although we are still waiting for a solid statement on the subject. Interaction diagrams are sufficiently close to implementation to be fairly obvious in their relationship to code.

过去几年里，有一小群但重要的开发者强调这种转换方法。Shlaer 和 Mellor 一直是这群开发者的领军人物[8]。我希望随着时间的推移，这一主题能得到更多关注，并出现更多模式和完整的模板设计。我推测，一套完整的模板更有可能以商业工具（可能与 CASE 工具关联）或内部开发的形式出现。我希望此类模板的模式能够成为相关文献的常规内容。

Over the last few years there has been a small but significant group of developers stressing this kind of transformation approach. Shlaer and Mellor have been at the forefront of this group [8]. I hope that as time passes more attention will be paid to this topic and that we will see more patterns and some complete design templates. I suspect that a full set of templates is more likely to be produced as either a commercial tool (probably linked to CASE tools) or as an in-house effort. I hope that patterns for such templates will become a regular part of the literature.
