第十五章 关联模式

Chapter 15. Association Patterns

关联是分析和设计方法中常见的概念。通常，某种特定情况会以某种关联反复出现。虽然可以引入特殊的符号，但即使不使用这种符号，也可以对这种情况进行建模。一种有效的思考方式是将这种情况视为一种模式。这种关联模式可以用基本形式表示，也可以引入新的符号作为简写。两者含义相同。

Associations are a common construct in analysis and design methods. Often a particular situation will recur with an association. A special notation may be introduced, but it is possible to model the situation without this notation. A useful way of thinking about this is to consider the situation to be a pattern. This association pattern can be represented in a base form, or a new notation can be introduced as a shorthand. Both are equivalent in meaning.

本章重点讨论三种此类情况。关联类型 (15.1) 用于将关联视为一种类型，通常是通过赋予它一些特性来实现。键控映射 (15.2) 用于赋予映射查找表或字典的行为。每种模式都使用了许多带有附加符号的方法。理解这些符号背后的模式非常重要。某些方法可能不支持附加符号，因此了解如何在不使用附加符号的情况下工作至关重要。如果您习惯于使用支持某种符号的方法，而现在要切换到不支持该符号的方法，或者如果您在方法之间进行转换，而其中一个方法不支持某种符号，这一点尤其重要。

This chapter focuses on three such situations. An associative type (15.1) occurs when you want to treat an association as a type, typically by giving it some features. A keyed mapping (15.2) is used to give a lookup table, or dictionary, behavior to a mapping. Each of these patterns uses many methods with additional notations. Understanding the patterns behind the notations is valuable. A method may not support an additional notation, so it is essential to know how to work without it. This is particularly true if you are used to a method that supports a notation and are moving to one that does not, or if you are translating between methods and one method does not support a notation.

即使你的方法使用了关联模式的符号，理解这种符号与更简单概念之间的关系也至关重要。如果这种情况很少见，通常最好不要引入额外的符号来记忆，而是使用基本形式。

Even if your method uses a notation for an association pattern, it is important to understand how notation relates to simpler ideas. If the situation is rare, it is often better not to introduce an extra piece of notation to remember, but to use the base form.

第三种关联模式是历史映射（15.3）。我们可以使用历史映射来记录映射值的变化历史（例如员工的薪资历史）。据我所知，目前没有任何方法支持这种模式。然而，对于许多信息系统来说，历史映射是一种至关重要的模式。当需要使用历史映射时，引入一种简写符号来表示这种关联模式会很有帮助。

The third association pattern is the historic mapping (15.3). We can use historic mappings to keep a history of the value changes of a mapping (such as a history of salaries for an employee). This is not supported by a specific notation in any method that I am aware of. However, this is a vital pattern for many information systems. When a historic mapping is needed, it can be valuable to introduce a notation as a shorthand for the association pattern.

当不仅世界在变化，而且我们对它的认识在不同的地方也在变化时，就会出现特殊的复杂情况；这就导致了二维历史（15.3.1）。

Particular complications arise when not only is the world changing but also our knowledge of it is changing at different places; this leads to two-dimensional history (15.3.1).

选择使用符号还是基本形式取决于多种因素。从概念上讲，主要的权衡在于符号的简洁性和我们需要记住的额外符号之间的取舍。在规范模型中，符号意味着软件中存在不同的接口。这种接口可能比从基本形式转换而来的接口更方便使用。然而，我们始终可以向规范模型中添加操作，以提供更方便的接口。这样做虽然会向规范模型添加额外的显式操作，但可以避免额外的符号。

Several factors affect the choice between using the notation or the base form. Conceptually the principal trade-off is between the conciseness offered by the notation and the extra notation we need to remember. In a specification model, a notation implies a different interface in the software. This interface is probably more convenient to use than that obtained by transforming from the base form. However, operations can always be added to the specification model to provide the more convenient interface. This adds extra explicit operations to the specification model but avoids the extra notation.

使用符号还是基本形式取决于个人选择。本章我将阐述我的偏好，但我必须强调，我的偏好始终以客户的需求为先。作为一名顾问，我的职责就是让客户的工作更轻松。

Whether to use the notation or the base form is a matter of choice. In this chapter I indicate my preferences, which, I should stress always take second place to the desires of a client. It is my job as a consultant to make the client's life easier.

关联模式在元层面运作：它们是用于描述建模语言而非模型本身的模式。我使用术语“元模型模式”来描述这类通用模式。其他元模型模式可用于描述泛化、状态模型或任何其他建模技术中的元级概念。

Association patterns operate at the meta-level: They are patterns that are used in describing modeling languages rather than the models themselves. I use the term meta-model patterns to describe this general class of patterns. Other meta-model patterns could be used to describe meta -level concepts in generalization, state models, or any other modeling technique.

15.1 关联类型

15.1 Associative Type

当我们需要向关系中添加属性时，就会遇到常见的建模情况。例如，早期模型表明某人受雇于某公司，如图 15.1 所示。后续研究表明，我们还应该记录员工的入职日期，并且该属性必须添加到关系中。我们可以使用 Rumbaugh [2] 等表示法将入职日期属性添加到关系中，如图 15.2 所示。

A common modeling situation occurs when we wish to add an attribute to a relationship. For example, an early model indicates that a person is employed by a company, as shown in Figure 15.1. Later work reveals that we should record the day that the employee started, and it must lie on the relationship. We can add the start date attribute to the relationship using a notation such as Rumbaugh's [2], shown in Figure 15.2.

图 15.1 人与公司之间的简单关系。

Figure 15.1 Simple relationship between person and company.

如果建模方法不支持以这种方式向关系中添加属性，则有多种替代方案。在我们的示例中，一种替代方案是将开始日期添加到人员信息中。由于根据定义，一个人只能隶属于一家公司，因此不会产生歧义。我们可能会认为开始日期属性实际上是关系的一部分，但很难……

If a modeling method does not support adding an attribute to a relationship in this way, there are a number of alternatives. In our example one alternative is to add the start date to the person. Since a person has, by definition, only one company, there is no danger of ambiguity. We might think that the start date attribute is really a part of the relationship, but it is difficult to

图 15.2向图 15.1 添加开始日期属性

Figure 15.2 Adding a start date attribute to Figure 15.1 This

图示采用伦博格领口符号。

diagram uses Rumbaugh's collar notation.

与其说是咬文嚼字，不如说是吹毛求疵。更合理的反对意见是，除非有雇主，否则开始日期不应有值。这可以通过规则来解决，但这始终不是理想的解决方案，尤其是在大多数方法对这类规则的支持都不尽如人意的情况下。

justify as anything other than semantic nit-picking. A more reasonable objection is that the start date should not have a value unless there is an employer. This could be resolved by a rule, although this is always a less than ideal solution, in particular since most methods do not support these kinds of rules well.

如图 15.3 所示，当两个映射都是多值关系时，这种方法就不适用了。因为一个人对每项技能的能力都不同，所以不可能给这个人赋予一个数值。

This approach cannot be used on relationships where both mappings are multivalued as in Figure 15.3. Since a person has a different competency for each skill it is impossible to put the number on person.

对于不支持关联类型的方法，我们可以引入一个额外的类型，如图 15.4 所示（注意基数是如何从图 15.1 传递过来的）。这很好地解决了这个问题。新类型可能略显人为，但所有模型都包含一定程度的人为性，因为它们比自然语言更正式地表示了真实情况。这两个模型之间最显著的区别之一在于接口的含义。在图 15.2 中，person 有一个 getEmployer 操作，返回关联的公司。图 15.4 中的模型则具有不同的接口，返回雇佣关系。

In methods that do not support association types, we can introduce an additional type, as shown in Figure 15.4 (note how the cardinalities have been transferred from Figure 15.1). This handles the situation quite well. The new type may be somewhat artificial, but all models contain a certain amount of artificiality since they represent a real situation with a greater degree of formality than exists in natural language. One of the most significant differences between the two models lies in the interface implications. In Figure 15.2, person has a getEmployer operation that returns the associated company. The Figure 15.4 model has a different interface that returns the employment

图 15.3 两个映射均为多值的关系。

Figure 15.3 A relationship where both mappings are multivalued.

图 15.4 添加就业类型作为开始日期的持有者。

Figure 15.4 Adding an employment type as a holder for the start date.

然后，就业对象需要一条额外的消息来获取公司信息，因此我们需要将原始关联转换为派生关联，如图 15.5 所示。

object. The employment object then needs an additional message to get the company, so we need to make the original association a derived association, as shown in Figure 15.5.

雇主

employer

图 15.5 使用派生映射恢复雇主映射。

Figure 15.5 Restoring the employer mapping with a derived mapping.

我们可以通过图 15.3 中所示的多对多关联来探讨一个更微妙的问题。图 15.6 也采用了相同的引入新类型的方法。乍一看，仅仅添加能力类型似乎效果不错，因为它允许一个人拥有多种能力，从而拥有多种技能，每种能力都有一个能力值。问题在于，该模型过于宽松，因为它也允许同一项技能拥有多种能力。为了消除这种宽松性，我们需要为能力添加一条唯一性规则，表明每项能力都必须对应唯一的人员和技能组合。

We can consider a more subtle point by considering the many-many associations shown in Figure 15.3. Figure 15.6 uses the same introduction of a new type. Just adding the competency type works well on first inspection, because it allows a person to have many competencies, and thus multiple skills, each with a competency value. The problem is that that model is more permissive because it also allows multiple competencies for the same skill. To eliminate this we need the additional uniqueness rule for competency, indicating that each competency must have a unique combination of person and skill.

图 15.6 使用新类型处理图 15.3。

Figure 15.6 Using a new type to handle Figure 15.3.

使用关联类型表示法的建模者通常不会注意到这个问题。图 15.7 是这种表示法的另一个典型用法，其中关系包含这样的理解：一个人可以同时是多家公司的员工，并且其中一些工作可能已经结束，因此我们有

This issue is often not noted by modelers who do use the associative type notation. Figure 15.7 is another typical use of this notation in which the relationship holds an understanding that a person can be an employee of many companies, and some of these employments may have completed, so we have

图 15.7 就业关联类型。

Figure 15.7 Employment associative type.

就业经历。一个人完全有可能在同一家公司工作过两个时期。因此，我们不会添加如图 15.6 所示的约束。问题在于，通常情况下，我们无法确定关联类型是否具有该约束。

a history of employment. It is quite possible for a person to have two periods working for the same company. Hence we would not add a constraint of the style shown in Figure 15.6. The problem is that, in general, we do not know whether to interpret an associative type as having the constraint or not.

在实践中，建模者通常会同时使用关联类型表示法来表示两种不同的解释。这本身并非错误，但他们应该明确指出自己指的是哪一种。使用图 15.7 是合理的，但在这种情况下，必须为图 15.3 的情况制定一条类似于图 15.6 中规则的规则。如果建模者希望将图 15.3 的情况作为通常的解释，那么他们就不能使用图 15.7 形式的模型；他们必须改用一种新的类型。

In practice, modelers use the associative type notation with both interpretations. That is not in itself a fault, but they should make clear which they mean. It is reasonable to use Figure 15.7, but in that case a rule must be used for the Figure 15.3 case along the lines of the rule in Figure 15.6. If modelers wish to use the Figure 15.3 case as the usual interpretation, then they cannot use a model of the form of Figure 15.7; they must use a new type instead.

总的来说，我不太喜欢使用结合类型表示法。除非它们包含明确的规则，例如唯一性规则，否则我认为额外的表示法并没有太大的价值。唯一性规则虽然有用，但很少被正确使用，所以我宁愿使用一个额外的类型，然后添加唯一性规则来明确定义它。

On the whole I don't tend to use associative type notations. Unless they include a definite rule, such as that of uniqueness, then I don't think they add very much value for the extra notation. The uniqueness can be useful but is so rarely used properly that I would rather use an extra type and add the uniqueness rule to make it explicit.

15.2 键控映射

15.2 Keyed Mapping

键控映射是一种分析技术，它类似于使用字典（索引查找表，也称为映射[1]或关联数组）来实现关系的技术。图 15.8 和图 15.9 展示了其应用示例。我们的主要关注点是记录特定订单中包含的特定产品的数量。图 15.8 展示了经典的此类数据模型。图 15.9 中的模型使用了键控映射表示法，其重点在于查询订单中包含的产品数量并进行更改。图 15.8 则平衡了这一点，产品本身也能回答它被订购在哪些订单中以及每个订单中的数量。

Keyed mappings represent a technique that mirrors in analysis the technique of using dictionaries (indexed lookup tables, also called maps [1] or associative arrays) to implement relationships. Examples of its use are shown in Figures 15.8 and 15.9. Our main concern is to record how many of a particular product are on a particular order. The classic data model for this is shown in Figure 15.8. The model shown in Figure 15.9 uses keyed mapping notation, which concentrates on asking an order how many of a product it has and changing this. Figure 15.8 balances this with the product being able to answer which orders it is ordered in and how much on each order.

图 15.8 经典的订单、行项目模型。

Figure 15.8 A classic order, line item model.

图 15.9 使用字典对图 15.8 进行建模。

Figure 15.9 Using a dictionary to model Figure 15.8.

解读这些模型的一个重要方面是它们如何影响类型的接口。图 15.8 的模型暗示了订单和产品类型都存在 getLineItems 接口。图 15.9 的模型暗示了订单类型存在 getAmount-(product) 接口。产品类型则没有暗示任何接口。

An important part of the interpretation of these models is how they affect the interface of the types. The Figure 15.8 model implies an interface of getLineItems on order and product. The Figure 15.9 model implies an interface of getAmount-(product) on order. No interface is implied for product.

要查找某个产品在不同订单中的使用情况，需要询问所有订单实例中是否存在该产品的数量，这略显繁琐。另一个区别在于询问订单中包含哪些产品。对于图 15.8，这只需询问订单的行项目，然后询问每个行项目包含哪些产品即可。而对于图 15.9，则需要询问订单的金额字典，然后询问其键值；订单必须提供 `getAmounts` 操作才能访问其字典（或者更准确地说，是副本）。否则，我们需要逐个检查每个产品实例是否与订单匹配。

To find the use of a product in different orders would require asking all instances of order whether they have an amount for the product, which is somewhat more circuitous. Another difference lies in asking an order what products are present on it. For Figure 15.8 this merely requires asking an order for its line items and then each line item for its product. For Figure 15.9 this would require asking the order for the dictionary of amounts and then asking for its keys; order would have to provide a getAmounts operation to allow access to its dictionary (or more strictly a copy). Otherwise, we would need to test every instance of product against the order.

键控映射表示法可用于处理唯一性约束。图 15.8 模型通常会包含一条规则，规定一个订单中每个产品只能有一个订单项。我们不希望在同一个订单中出现包含 30 个小部件的订单项和包含 20 个小部件的订单项。更好的方案是为 50 个小部件创建一个订单项。这在图 15.8 中需要一条规则，但在图 15.9 中则非常明确，因为一个订单中每个产品只能有一个数量。

Keyed mapping notation can be used to handle uniqueness constraints. The Figure 15.8 model would usually come with a rule to say that only one line item can exist for a product within an order. We would not want a line item for 30 widgets and a separate line item for 20 widgets on the same order. A better proposal is to have a single line item for 50 widgets. This needs a rule for Figure 15.8 but is quite explicit in Figure 15.9, since an order can only have one quantity for a product.

我们需要考虑，当被问及订单中不存在的商品数量时，订单系统应该如何响应。在本例中，返回 0 似乎是合理的，这使得键值映射成为强制性的。在其他情况下，我们可能希望返回空值，从而使映射成为可选的。

We need to consider what response the order should make if it is asked for the amount of a product that is not on the order. In this example it seems reasonable to return 0, making the keyed mapping mandatory. In other cases we might wish to make a null return, which would make the mapping optional.

如果两种表示方法都有价值，那么我们完全可以同时使用它们。我们可以使用规则或推导标记来表示冗余，如图 15.10 所示。同时使用这两种表示方法表明，图 15.8 的方法在一般情况下更加灵活，而图 15.9 的方法则提供了一种非常有用的简写方式，并且明确地表达了唯一性。

If both representations are valuable, then there is no reason why we can't use both of them together. We can note the redundancy by using a rule or a derivation marker, as shown in Figure 15.10. Using both representations supports the fact that the Figure 15.8 approach is more flexible in general cases while the Figure 15.9 approach adds a very useful shorthand behavior, as well as making the uniqueness explicit.

图 15.10 使用两种表示方法，将其中一种标记为派生表示。

Figure 15.10 Using both representations, marking one as derived.

我发现键控映射表示法非常实用。是否使用它或添加额外的类型取决于具体情况以及我想强调的内容。虽然不用它也能正常工作，但我经常发现它很方便。不过，要注意不要过度使用它。通常，额外的类型对于提供附加信息和行为至关重要。在图 15.8 中，我们可以轻松地为行项目添加成本，而在图 15.9 中这样做就显得很别扭。当然，图 15.10 所示的“鱼与熊掌兼得”的方案也是一种常见的选择。

I find the keyed mapping notation a very useful construct. Whether I use it or an extra type depends on the situation and what I want to emphasize. Although I can certainly live without it, I often find it a handy construct. Beware not to overuse it, though. Often the extra type is important for additional information and behavior. In Figure 15.8 we could easily add a cost for the line item, which would be awkward using Figure 15.9. Naturally the "eat your cake and have it too" answer of Figure 15.10 is a frequent choice.

15.3 历史地图

15.3 Historic Mapping

物体不仅代表现实世界中存在的物体，它们也常常代表着人们对曾经存在但如今已消失的物体的记忆。用物体来代表记忆完全可以接受——对存在的记忆对人们来说往往与存在本身一样真实——但区分二者至关重要。以记录一个人的薪水为例。如图 15.11 所示，在任何特定时刻，一个人的薪水都是固定的。然而，随着时间的推移，薪水可能会发生变化。除非我们需要记住薪水的历史，否则这本身并不会使图 15.11 的模型失效。如果我们只想记住过去的薪水，那么图 15.12 就能满足需求，前提是我们在“薪水”这个修饰符中添加一个功能，允许我们将旧薪水添加到“旧薪水列表”中。通过使用列表，我们不仅可以记录之前的薪水，还可以保留它们适用的顺序。

Objects do not just represent objects that exist in the real world; they often represent the memories of objects that once existed but have since disappeared. Using objects to represent memories is perfectly acceptable —memory of existence is often as real to people as the existence itself—but it is important to be able to tell the difference. Consider the issue of recording a person's salary. At any single moment a person has a single salary, as shown in Figure 15.11. However, as time passes that salary may change. This in itself does not invalidate Figure 15.11 as a model, unless we need to remember the history of the salary. If all we want is to remember past salaries then Figure 15.12 will do the trick, provided that we add to the modifier of salary the ability to append the old salary to an old salaries list. By using a list we cannot only record previous salaries but also preserve the order in which they were applicable.

图 15.11 在任何时间点，一个人都只有一份工资。

Figure 15.11 At any point in time a person has one salary.

图 15.12 一个能够记住过去薪资的模型。

Figure 15.12 A model that remembers past salaries.

图 15.12 在许多情况下可能足够，但它无法帮助我们回答“约翰·史密斯 1997 年 1 月 2 日的薪水是多少？”这个问题。要回答这个问题，我们需要图 15.13 所示的更为复杂的方法。该模型使我们能够记录薪水及其完整的历史记录。然而，我们还需要一条额外的规则：同一人的薪水时间段不能重叠。这条规则通常被默认，但通常没有明确标明——因此很容易被遗忘。

Figure 15.12 may be adequate in many situations, but it doesn't help us answer the question "What was John Smith's salary on January 2, 1997?" To answer this question we need the rather more sophisticated approach suggested by Figure 15.13. This model gives us the ability to record both salaries and their full histories. We do need an additional rule, however: Salaries for a person must not have overlapping time periods. This rule is often implicitly assumed, but is usually not shown explicitly—and is thus forgotten.

图 15.13 所示的模型提供了我们所需的功能，但它相当笨拙。如果不查看底层规则，就会忽略一个重要事实：一名员工一次只能领取一份薪水。一个关联

The model shown in Figure 15.13 provides the power we need, but it is rather clumsy. The important point that an employee can have only one salary at a time is lost without looking at the underlying rules. One association

图 15.13 完整的薪资历史记录。

Figure 15.13 A full record of salary history.

两种类型之间现在存在四种类型和三种关联。这会显著增加图表的复杂性，尤其是在存在大量此类历史关系的情况下。为此建议的界面也相当笨拙。上一段问题的答案需要询问约翰·史密斯他所有的薪水，然后选择包含 1997 年 1 月 2 日的薪水。

between two types is now four types and three associations. This can add significantly to the complexity of a diagram, particularly if there are many such historical relationships. The interface suggested for this is also rather clumsy. The answer to the question in the previous paragraph involves asking John Smith for all his salaries and then selecting the one whose time period includes January 2, 1997.

我经常使用图 15.14 所示的模型，它结合了图 15.13 方法的灵活性和图 15.11 快照的图示简洁性。所有细节都隐藏在虽小但意义重大的关键字 [history] ​​之后。我引入了一种新的表示法，只要我正确定义它，这种表示法完全可以接受。我将省略数学定义，而是指出关键字定义的接口。图 15.11 暗示了一个访问器 getSalary()，用于返回薪资值，以及一个修改器 setSalary(Money)，用于更改薪资值。图 15.14 暗示了一个不同的接口：访问器 getSalary() 仍然存在，但这次返回薪资映射的当前值。这由 getSalary(Date) 提供支持，它返回指定日期的映射值。getSalary() 等价于 getSalary(Date::now)。

I often use the model shown in Figure 15.14, which combines the flexibility of the Figure 15.13 approach with the diagrammatic economy of the Figure 15.11 snapshot. All the details are hidden behind the small but significant [history] keyword. I have introduced a new notation, which is perfectly permissible so long as I define it properly. I'll forego a mathematical definition and instead indicate the interface defined by the keyword. Figure 15.11 implies an accessor getSalary() to return the value of the salary and a modifier setSalary(Money) to change it. Figure 15.14 implies a different interface: The accessor getSalary() still exists but this time returns the current value of the salary mapping. This is supported by getSalary(Date), which returns the value of the mapping at the supplied date. getSalary() is equivalent to getSalary (Date::now).

更新过程稍微复杂一些。我们可以使用 `setSalary(Money, Date)` 操作，从特定日期开始，将新的工资记录添加到历史记录中。这对于添加式更改来说是一个很好的接口，但如果旧工资记录存在问题，则这种方法就不够用了。

Updating is a little bit more complex. We can use a setSalary (Money, Date) operation to append a new salary, starting at a particular date, to the history. This is a good interface for additive changes but is not sufficient if the old

图 15.14 用更简单的符号表示图 15.13 的功率。

Figure 15.14 Representing the power of Figure 15.13 with a simpler notation.

记录需要修改。使用 `setSalaryHistory(Dictionary(key: TimePeriod, value: Money))` 操作，并配合 `getSalary-H1 storyQ` 操作，是最佳方案。这样，客户端就可以获取当前的薪资历史记录（以字典形式），使用标准的字典操作，然后一次性修改整条记录。这比逐条更新记录要好，因为规则规定员工在任何日期都必须有一个薪资记录。如果逐条修改记录，每次修改后都要确保规则仍然成立，会非常麻烦。而一次性提取整条记录，修改它（不进行规则检查），然后再替换回去，则更容易管理。

record needs alteration. A setSalaryHistory (Dictionary (key: TimePeriod, value:Money)) operation would be our best bet, together with a getSalary-H1 storyQ operation. Then the client can get the current salary history as a dictionary, use the standard dictionary operations, and then amend the whole record in one go. This is better than updating one record at a time because of the rule that an employee must have one salary at any one date. If alterations are made one record at a time, it is awkward to keep the rule true after every change. Taking the complete record out, changing it (without the rule checking), and replacing it all at once is much easier to manage.

显然，这里建议使用以时间段为键的字典实现。这样的实现可以轻松支持接口所需的所有行为，并且是该方法的一种简单应用。我们甚至可以更进一步，引入一个专门的类来处理历史数据集。

Clearly a dictionary implementation with time period keys is suggested here. Such an implementation easily supports all the behavior required by the interface and is a simple use of the approach. We can even go further and introduce a special class to handle historic collections.

据我所知，目前还没有任何方法论专家建议采用历史表示法。它非常有价值，因为它简化了一个既常见又棘手的问题。理想的解决方案是拥有一个具备完整“时间旅行”能力的对象系统。这样的系统并非完全遥不可及，它的出现将彻底消除对历史进行特殊处理的必要性。

The history notation is not currently suggested by any methodologist to my knowledge. It is very valuable because it simplifies a situation that is both common and sticky. The ideal solution is to have an object system with full "time travel" capability. Such a system is not completely farfetched, and its arrival will remove the need for any special handling of history.

本节内容也是一个特例，但也是一个普遍观点的体现。在建模过程中，你可能会遇到一些重复出现的情况，这些情况既常见又难以建模。不要害怕引入新的符号来简化这种情况，但你必须正确地定义它。需要考虑的关键权衡是：新构造带来的简化与需要记住额外符号之间的权衡。好的符号是一种折衷方案，既能保持简洁优雅，又不会过于冗长。这种权衡并非适用于所有项目，因此，在这些问题上，不要害怕做出自己的决定。

This section is also a particular case of a general point. In modeling you may come across a repetitive situation that is both common and awkward to model. Don't be afraid to introduce a new notation to simplify this, but you must define it properly. The key trade-off to consider is the simplification of a new construct versus having to remember the extra notation. A good notation is a compromise, allowing elegance but without a vast notation. The trade-off is not the same for all projects, so don't be afraid to make your own decisions in these matters.

建模原理
Modeling Principle
如果遇到难以建模的重复性情况，可以定义一种符号。但是，只有当定义符号带来的简化效果大于记忆额外符号的难度时，才应该定义符号。
If you come across a repetitive situation that is difficult to model, then define a notation. However, define a notation only if the resulting simplification outweighs the difficulty of remembering the extra notation.
15.3.1 电视维度历史

以上讨论主要集中在如何检索对象在过去某个时间点的某个属性值的问题上。许多系统还面临着另一个难题，那就是它们无法及时获取属性变化的信息。

The above discussion focuses on the problem of being able to retrieve the values of some attribute of an object at some point in the past. Many systems have a further complication that results from the fact that they do not receive knowledge of changes in a timely manner.

假设我们有一个工资系统，它知道某员工从1月1日起的日薪是100美元。2月25日，我们按照这个日薪进行了工资结算。3月15日，我们得知该员工的日薪从2月15日起变为110美元。当被问及2月25日的日薪是多少时，该员工应该如何回答？这个问题有两个答案：员工当时认为的日薪是多少，以及员工现在认为的日薪是多少。这两个日薪都很重要。如果我们需要回顾2月25日的工资结算数据来了解计算方法，我们需要看到之前的日薪。如果我们需要处理新的加班费，例如之前未申报的几个小时加班费，我们需要看到我们现在理解的日薪。

Imagine we have a payroll system that knows that an employee has a rate of $100/day starting on January 1. On February 25 we run the payroll with this rate. On March 15 we learn that, effective on February 15, the employee's rate changed to $110/day. What should the employee object answer when asked what its rate was for February 25? There are two answers to this question: what the employee thought the rate was at that time and what the employee thinks the rate is now. Both of these rates are important. If we need to look back at the February 25 payroll run to see how the numbers are calculated, we need to see the old figure. If we need to process a new entitlement, perhaps for a couple of hours overtime that were not reported previously, we need the rate as we understand it now.

世事难料，情况可能会变得更糟。假设我们已经做出了相应的调整，并支付了拖欠的加班费，所有这些都在3月26日的工资结算中处理完毕。4月4日，我们被告知该员工的工资标准再次更改，自2月21日起生效，为每小时112美元。现在，该员工对象可以给出三个关于其2月25日工资标准的答案！

Life being what it is, things can get worse. Assume we made corresponding adjustments and made the late overtime payment, all of which gets processed in a payroll run on March 26. On April 4 we are told that the employee's rate was changed again to $112 effective February 21. Now the employee object can give three answers to what its rate was on February 25!

要处理这类问题，我们需要一个二维历史数据。我们询问员工过去某个时间点的工资率，而这又基于我们对过去某个时间点工资率的了解。因此，我们需要两个日期：工资率适用的日期和我们据此推断工资率的日期，如表15.1所示。

To deal with this kind of problem in general, we need a two-dimensional history. We are asking the employee what its rate was at some point in the past, according to our knowledge at some other point in the past. Thus two dates are needed: the date at which the rate is applicable and the date on which we base our knowledge, as shown in Table 15.1.

表 15.1 示例的二维速率。
适用日期 知识日期 结果
2月25日 2月25日 每天100美元
2月25日 3月26日 每天110美元
2月25日 4月26日 每天112美元

单维示例实际上必须在以下两者之间做出选择：要么将适用日期和知识日期视为相同日期，要么始终将知识日期视为“现在”。

The single dimensional example effectively has to choose between treating the applicable and knowledge dates as the same, or always considering the knowledge date to be "now."

为历史记录添加完整的二维功能无疑会增加很多复杂性，而且并非总是值得的。重要的是要探究为什么需要这些不同的费率。在这个例子中，我们需要了解除当前已知历史信息之外的其他信息，可能仅仅是为了解释和发布对先前工资运行的调整。另一种处理方法是将所有关于工资计算方式的信息嵌入到工资计算结果中。如果这些信息仅供人工查看而不进行处理，则可以将其放在文本属性中。调整的计算可以参考计算结果——不一定需要使用具体的费率。即使需要费率，复制一份可能更安全。有了这些措施，只需要一维历史记录即可处理追溯性权益（例如迟报的两小时加班）。

Adding full two-dimensional capabilities to history certainly adds a lot of complication, and it is not always worthwhile. It is important to look at why these different rates might be needed. In this example the only reason we need to know anything other than our current knowledge of the past might be to explain and post adjustments to previous payroll runs. Another way of dealing with this would be to embed all the information about how a payroll calculation is made into the result of the payroll calculation. If this information will only be inspected by a human and not processed, this can be done in a textual attribute. Calculating adjustments can be done by reference to the results of the calculation—the rate that was used is not necessarily needed. Even if the rate is needed, making a copy may be considered safer. With all this in place, only a one-dimensional history is required so that retroactive entitlements (such as that late-reported two hours overtime) can be processed.

二维历史也会影响事件的时间点设置。除非我们确信总能第一时间获知事件发生，否则任何事件都需要两个时间点：事件发生的时间点和系统感知到该事件的时间点。（例如，第 6.1 节讨论的入口处的两个时间点，以及第 3.8 节讨论的双重时间记录。）

Two-dimensional history also affects timepoints that are placed on events. Unless we are confident that we always know as soon as an event occurs, we need two timepoints on any event: the timepoint when the event occurred and the timepoint when our system became aware of the event. (Examples of this include the two timepoints on entry discussed in Section 6.1, and the dual time records discussed in Section 3.8.)

第十六章 后记

Chapter 16. Afterword

你觉得这本书怎么样？你觉得书中的模式有用且有趣吗？我希望你这么认为，但我也希望你读完后意犹未尽——觉得还有更多内容值得探讨，更多知识值得理解。本节将探讨下一步该如何学习。

What do you think about this book? Have you found the patterns useful and interesting? While I hope that you have, I also hope you feel unsatisfied—that there is more to say and more to understand. This section is about where to go to next.

你可以尝试实践一下这些模式。阅读一本关于模式的书，实际上只能让你对现有的模式有个大致的了解。我读过“四人帮”[1]的书，它让我初步领略了他们的理念。然而，要真正理解这些模式的运作原理，我需要亲身实践。读完之后，我仍然对“四人帮”模式的许多方面不太理解，但我知道，通过练习和进一步阅读，我的理解会更加深入。

One thing you can do is try out some of these patterns. Reading a book of patterns really only gives you enough to get a sense of what patterns exist. When I read the "Gang of Four" [1] book, it gave me a taste of their ideas. To learn how the patterns worked, however, I needed to try them out. After reading, there are still many aspects of the "Gang of Four" patterns that I don't really appreciate and understand, but I know that practice and further readings will increase my understanding.

当您尝试使用这些方法时，请告诉我您的使用体验。这些模式中是否有解释不够清晰的部分？是否还有其他值得考虑的变体？请给我发邮件告知，以便我能进一步传播这些信息。（我的邮箱地址是 100031.3311 ® compuserve.com。）Addison-Wesley 出版社为本书提供了一个配套网站：http://www.awf.com/cseng/categories/oo.html，我计划在该网站上发布关于分析模式的补充信息，并提供关于我和其他人使用这些模式的经验和心得的补充说明和笔记。

When you try them out, please let me know about your work. Are there parts of the patterns that are poorly explained? Are there other variations that I should consider? Please send me e-mail and let me know so that I can further spread this information. (M y e-mail address is 100031.3311 ® compuserve.com.) Addison-Wesley is providing a Web site at http:// www.awf.com/cseng/categories/oo.html to go with this book on which I expect to publish supplemental information about analysis patterns and provide additional explanations and notes about what I, and others, have learned about using the patterns.

这本书最大的问题之一就是存在太多空白。我描述了几个领域的模式，但还有许多其他领域也存在模式需要理解。即使是我涵盖的领域，也还有更多模式等待发掘。而且我描述的模式并不完整；关于如何使用它们、有哪些变体、会出现哪些实现问题、如何测试它们以及如何获得最佳性能，还有很多东西需要学习。

One of the biggest problems with this book is that there are so many gaps. I have described patterns from a few domains, but there are many other domains out there with patterns to understand. Even the domains I have covered have more patterns to find. And the patterns I have described are incomplete; there is much to learn about how to use them, what variations exist, what implementation issues appear, how they can be tested, and how to get the best performance.

本书反映了我知识的不足。若想更深入地学习，需要关注模式社区不断涌现的成果。其他模式书籍正在出版，未来几年还将有更多书籍迅速问世。尽管目前关于分析模式（例如本书所探讨的模式）的书籍还不多，但我希望本书能够鼓励更多此类书籍的出现。从很多方面来看，本书最大的意义在于，它能够终结分析和设计类书籍的无休止的出版，开启模式书籍的新纪元。

This book reflects the incomplete state of my knowledge. To go further, you need to look at the growing body of work being generated by the patterns community. Other patterns books are being published, and even more will come out rapidly over the next few years. Although there isn't much yet on analysis patterns such as these, I hope this book will encourage more such books to appear. In many ways the greatest benefit of this book would be if it stops the endless succession of analysis and design books and starts a new succession of patterns books.

获取图案信息的最佳途径之一是互联网。拉尔夫·约翰逊的图案主页¹是图案信息的中心来源。沃德·坎宁安的波特兰图案库²也包含大量有价值的在线信息。

One of the best places to get information on patterns is the World Wide Web. Ralph Johnson's patterns home page1 is the central source of patterns information. Ward Cunningham's Portland Pattern Repository2 also contains much valuable on-line information.

现在许多会议都包含关于模式的演讲和研讨会。然而，最专注于模式的会议当属每年九月在伊利诺伊州阿勒顿公园举行的模式语言编程（PLoP）会议。该会议独具特色，最显著的特点是论文的展示方式。与正式的报告不同，每篇论文都会在写作工作坊中由其他作者进行点评。最终呈现的是一场精彩纷呈的讨论，作者们可以从中了解其他人如何看待自己的作品。

A number of conferences are now including talks and sessions on patterns. The most focused patterns conference, however, is Pattern Language o f Programming (PLoP) held each September at Allerton Park in Illinois. The conference is a unique event, most notably in the way papers are presented. Instead of a formal presentation, each paper is critiqued in a writers workshop by the other authors. The result is a fascinating discussion of each paper, in which authors learn a lot about how other people view their work.

下一步是编写你自己的模式。这并非难事。我发现模式社区乐于接受新想法，并热衷于鼓励更多人编写模式。PLoP 是一个提交模式的绝佳论坛，它提供了一个一流的平台，让你了解模式领域的整体发展。你也可以在网上发布模式——波特兰模式库（Portland Patterns Repository）正是为此而设计的。我还计划在本书的网站上发布其他人的分析模式。事实上，我希望本书的未来版本能够收录其他作者的模式，而我的角色也将从作者转变为编辑。

The next step is to write some patterns of your own. This is not that daunting an experience. I have discovered that the patterns community is open to new ideas and keen to encourage more people to write patterns. PLoP is an excellent forum to submit a pattern and provides a first class venue to see the whole area of patterns developments. You can also publish patterns on the Web—the Portland Patterns Repository is expressly designed for this purpose. I also intend to publish other people's analysis patterns on this book's Web site. Indeed I hope that future editions of this book will contain patterns from other authors, and that my role will become more of an editor than an author.

我写这本书是因为我刚入行时就渴望读到这样一本书。现在依然如此。我希望这本书以及后续的书籍能够让未来的软件项目不再从零开始。

I wrote this book because, when I started out, I wanted to read a book such as this. I still do. I hope that this book and those that follow it will mean that future generations of software projects will not start from blank sheets of paper.

第三部分 附录

Part 3. Appendix

附录 A. 技术和符号

Appendix A. Techniques and Notations

要写这样一本书，我需要用到一些建模技巧，但我不想花太多时间讨论它们。毕竟，这是一本关于模式的书，而不是一本关于建模技巧的书（这方面的书已经有很多了）。目前还没有统一的技巧标准，所以我只能选择我认为合适且不太陌生的技巧。我发现没有一种方法是万能的，我喜欢将不同方法的技巧结合起来使用。在本附录中，我将讨论我使用的技巧及其符号。

To write a book like this, I need to use some modeling techniques, but I don't want to spend too much time discussing them. After all, this is a book about patterns, not a book about modeling techniques (there are plenty of books on that subject). There are, as yet, no standards for techniques, so I am forced to choose something that I feel is appropriate and not too alien. I find that no method has everything and that I like to mix techniques from different methods. In this appendix I will discuss the techniques I use and the notation for them.

A.1 类型图

A.1 Type Diagrams

类型图展示了系统的结构视图。它着重描述系统中对象的类型以及它们之间存在的各种静态关系。其中最重要的两种关系是关联（例如，顾客租借了若干部影片）和子类型（例如，护士是一种人）。

The type diagram shows a structural view of a system. It concentrates on describing the types of objects in the system and various kinds of static relationships that exist among them. The two most important kinds of relationships are associations (a customer rents a number of videos) and subtypes (a nurse is a kind of person).

符号学方面最具争议的争论就在于此。每个人都选择自己独特的符号学体系。因此，本书有很多技巧可供选择，但它们大体上都大同小异。选择哪一种并不容易。

In this area lie the most contentious arguments about notation. Everybody chooses their own, very different, notations. There are thus many techniques to choose from for this book, all of which are broadly similar. Picking one is not easy.

Rational Software 的统一建模语言 (UML) [2] 是一个强有力的竞争者。但使用这种方法来编写本书存在两个问题。首先是时间问题。本书写于 1994 年至 1995 年，而统一建模语言是在本书初稿完成后才发布的。即使在我撰写本文时，该符号也仅以预发布版本提供，Rational 公司仍在讨论正式发布前的重大变更。第二个问题是，统一建模语言侧重于实现建模而非概念建模——而本书则侧重于概念模式。

One strong contender is Rational Software's Unified Modeling Language (UML) [2]. But there are two problems with using this method for the book. First there is the matter of timing. This book was written during 1994 and 1995, and the Unified Modeling Language was only published after the book was fully drafted. Even as I write this, the notation is only available in a prerelease form, and Rational is discussing significant changes before making a formal release available. The second problem is that the Unified Modeling Language concentrates on implementation modeling rather than conceptual modeling—and this book focuses on conceptual patterns.

我之所以选择 Odell [5] 的类型图表示法，主要是因为他的方法是主流面向对象方法中最具概念性的。不过，为了更好地满足我的需求，我在一些地方对其进行了调整。

I chose Odell's [5] notation for the type diagrams primarily because his approach is the most conceptual of the major OO methods. I have adapted it in a number of places, however, to better fit my needs.

大多数方法都包含某种形式的结构建模技术。关于该主题的教程，Odell [5] 最适合本书，因为他采用了一种非常概念化的方法。开发人员还应该阅读一些更注重实现的书籍，例如 Booch [1]，以了解实现方面的内容。Cook 和 Daniels [4] 对结构建模进行了最严谨的描述，值得一读。

Most methods have some form of structural modeling technique. For a tutorial on the subject, Odell [5] is the most suitable for this book as he uses a very conceptual approach. A developer should also read a more implementation-oriented book, such as Booch [1], to provide the implementation perspective. Cook and Daniels [4] provide the most rigorously defined description of structural modeling and are worth reading for that.

A.1.1 类型和类别

出发点是类型（type）的概念，用矩形表示。值得注意的是，我使用的是“类型”而不是“类”（class）。理解两者之间的区别至关重要。类型描述了类的接口。一个类型可以被多个类实现，一个类也可以实现多个类型。一个类型可以由许多使用不同语言、性能各异的类来实现。单个类也可以实现多个类型，尤其是在涉及子类型的情况下。类型和类之间的区别在许多基于委托的设计技术中都非常重要，正如“四人帮”（Gang of Four）的著作[3]中所讨论的那样。这两个术语经常被混淆，因为大多数编程语言没有明确区分它们。事实上，大多数分析和设计方法也没有明确区分它们。

The starting point is the notion of a type, represented by a rectangle. It is significant that I use the word type rather than class. It is very important to understand the difference between the two. A type describes the interface of a class. A type can be implemented by many classes, and a class can implement many types. A type can be implemented by many classes with different languages, performance trade-offs, and so forth. A single class can also implement many types, particularly where subtyping is involved. The distinction between type and class is very important in a number of design techniques based on delegation, as discussed in the "Gang of Four" book [3]. The two terms are often confused because most languages do not make an explicit distinction. Indeed most analysis and design methods do not make an explicit distinction.

我发现从概念、规范和实现这三个角度思考构建类型图1很有帮助[4]。概念模型模拟人们思考世界的方式。它们完全是心理图像，忽略任何技术问题。概念模型会根据其代表的是现实世界还是我们对世界的认知而有所不同。例如，一个人及其出生日期。在现实世界中，每个人都有出生日期，因此将出生日期建模为人的必要属性是合理的。然而，我们可以在不知道出生日期的情况下了解一个人。因此，对于许多领域而言，在反映我们对世界的认知的概念模型中，出生日期可以是可选的。这种区别对于历史信息可能非常重要。代表世界现状结构的模型通常最好绘制成某一时刻的快照。然而，如果它代表我们所知的，那么它通常也需要反映我们的记忆。本书中的模型采用了以下视角：

I find it useful to think about building type diagrams1 from three perspectives: conceptual, specification, and implementation [4]. Conceptual models model the way people think about the world. They are entirely mental pictures that ignore any technological issues. Conceptual models can vary, depending on whether they represent the real world or what we know about the world. An example of this is a person and a birth date. In the real world all people have birth dates, so it is reasonable to model birth date as a mandatory attribute of person. However, we can know about a person without knowing their birth date. Thus for many domains birth date can be optional in a conceptual model that reflects what we know of the world. This distinction can be very important for historical information. A model that represents the structure of the world as it is often can be best drawn as a snapshot of a moment in time. If it represents what we know, however, it often needs to reflect our memories, too. The models in this book take the perspective of

这种区别也适用于其他技术，但在结构模型中最为明显。

This distinction can also apply to other techniques, but it is most pronounced with structural models.

捕捉我们对世界的认知模型，因为这是信息系统中最有用的视角。

capturing a model of what we know about the world, since that is the per -spective most useful in information systems.

规范模型是用于定义系统中软件组件接口的模型。规范模型可以是隐式的，也可以是显式的。显式规范模型的一个例子是 C++ 头文件，它详细说明了存在哪些操作、它们的参数和返回类型。隐式规范模型需要结合一些约定，以说明它们如何解析为显式接口。例如，隐式规范模型中的 birthdate 属性在 Smalltalk 中解析为 `birthdate` 和 `birthdate: aDate` 操作，在 C++ 中解析为 `Date getBirthdate() const` 和 `void setBirthDate(Date)` 操作。

Specification models are models that can be used to define the interface of the software components in the system. Specification models can be implicit or explicit. An example of an explicit specification model is a C++ header file, which details exactly what operations exist, their parameters, and their return types. Implicit specification models need to be combined with some conventions that show how they resolve to an explicit interface. For example, an attribute of birthdate on an implicit specification model resolves to the operations bi rthdate and birthdate: aDate for Smalltalk, and the operations Date getBirthdate() const and void setBirthDate(Date) for C++.

隐式规范模型比显式模型更接近概念模型，并且能够承载比许多显式接口更多的信息。C++ 和 Smalltalk 接口缺少大量关于接口部分使用规则的信息。Eiffel 具有断言功能，因此可能更完整，但不如紧密遵循概念模型的隐式模型那样易于理解。

Implicit specification models can be closer to conceptual models than explicit models, and they can also carry more information than many explicit interfaces. C++ and Smalltalk interfaces miss a great deal of information about the rules for using parts of the interface. Eiffel, which has assertions, can be more complete, but less comprehensible than an implicit model, which closely follows the conceptual model.

实现模型清晰地展现了类的内部结构。它们可用作文档，也可供该类的设计者使用。除非用于说明整个项目中使用的通用实现原则，否则类的任何客户端都不应使用它们。

Implementation models lay bare the internals of a class.2 They are useful as documentation and for designers of that class. They should not be used by any of the class's clients, except when they illustrate general implementation principles used throughout the project.

概念模型和隐式规范模型几乎完全相同。因此，本书中的类型图既可以视为概念模型，也可以视为隐式规范模型。如果两者之间确实存在区别，我会在文中加以说明。本书中为数不多的实现模型都已明确标注，但我使用了相同的符号。

Conceptual models and implicit specification models are almost identical. Thus you can consider the type diagrams in this book to be both conceptual models and implicit specification models. If a distinction does surface between these two, I point it out in the text. The few implementation models in the book are clearly labeled as such, but I use the same notation.

第 14 章讨论了类型模型与实现模型之间的关系。如果实现某种模式引入的内容超出了第 14 章的范围，则会在讨论模式本身时一并讨论实现方式。

Chapter 14 discusses how type models relate to implementation models. On those occasions where implementing a pattern introduces something beyond the bounds of Chapter 14, the implementation is discussed with the pattern.

A.1.2 关联、属性和聚合

关联表示类型实例之间的关系（例如，一个人为一家公司工作，一家公司拥有多个办事处等等）。对关联的精确解释取决于它们是概念模型、规范模型还是实现模型的一部分。概念解释仅仅表明对象之间存在概念关系。就责任而言，它们有责任了解彼此。因此，订单和客户之间的关联被解释为订单了解其客户，反之亦然。

Associations represent relationships among instances of types (a person works for a company, a company has a number of offices, and so on). A precise interpretation of associations depends on whether they are part of a conceptual, specification, or implementation model. A conceptual interpretation merely states that there exists a conceptual relationship among the objects. In terms of responsibility, they have responsibilities for knowing about each other. Thus an association between an order and customer is interpreted as meaning that an order knows its customer and vice versa. In a

更准确的说法应该是类图，而不是实现模型。

An implementation model would be more correctly called a class diagram.

规范模型中存在用于访问和更新关系的运算；显式规范模型会在模型上显示这些运算及其名称。实现模型则将关联解释为指针或其他引用的存在。需要注意的是，在概念模型和规范模型中，关联并不指示数据结构。因此，封装性得以保持。

specification model, operations exist for accessing and updating the relationship; an explicit specification model shows the operations and their names on the model. An implementation model interprets an association as the existence of a pointer or other reference. It is important to note that in conceptual and specification models, associations do not indicate data structure. Encapsulation is thus preserved.

我喜欢区分关联和映射。映射（有时也称为角色）是从一种类型到另一种类型的有向链接。关联包含一个或两个映射。单向关联只有一个映射，可以看作是映射。双向关联包含两个映射，这两个映射互为逆映射。这里的“逆映射”与数学中的逆函数并不完全相同。本质上，这意味着如果您遍历一个映射及其逆映射，您将得到一个包含您最初所用对象的集合。因此，如果一个客户遍历其所有订单，则每个订单都指向该客户。术语“源”（或“域”）表示映射的源类型，“目标”（或“范围”）表示映射的目标类型。（例如，在从客户到订单的映射中，“客户”是源，“订单”是目标。）当名称与关联一起出现时，该名称是其中一个映射的名称。您可以通过名称在关联线中的位置来判断是哪种映射：目标在前，源在后，名称在左侧。

I like to make a distinction between an association and a mapping. A mapping (sometimes called role) is a directed link from one type to another. An association contains one or two mappings. A unidirectional association is just one mapping and can be seen as the same as a mapping. A bidirectional association contains two mappings, which are said to be inverses of each other. This inverse is not quite the same as that of inverse functions in mathematics. Essentially it means that if you navigate a mapping and its inverse, you will get a collection of objects that include the one you started from. Thus if a customer navigates through the set of orders it has made, each of those orders points back to that customer. The term source (or domain) indicates the type the mapping maps from, and the term target (or range) indicates the type the mapping maps to. (For example, in a mapping from customer to order, customer is the source and order is the target.) When a name appears with an association, the name is that of one of the mappings. You can tell which mapping it is by the position of the name to the association line: With the target at the front and the source at the back, the name is on the left.

关于双向关联的价值存在一些争议。从概念上讲，所有关系都是双向的。考虑一个人与其出生日期之间的关联。说日期与出生于该日期的人之间存在关联，这在概念上完全说得通。但在规范模型中，情况并非如此。如果给日期赋予一组操作，使其能够引用所有对象，那么出生日期的接口就会变得异常臃肿。双向关联的另一个问题是，它们会增加类型之间的耦合度。这会使重用变得更加困难。许多人使用单向关联来减少类型之间的依赖性。反驳的观点是，在信息系统中，很多工作都是在类型之间的链接之间导航。当这些链接主要是单向的时，就更难找到方向。这就像在城市里寻找自己的位置：即使你熟悉这座城市，单行道也会让整个过程变得更加困难。

There is some controversy about the value of bidirectional associations. Conceptually all relationships are bidirectional. Consider an association between a person and their birthdate. It makes perfect conceptual sense to say there is a relationship between a date and the people born on that date. In a specification model this is not true. To give date a set of operations to all the things that reference it would bloat the birth date's interface to an unreasonable degree. The other problem with bidirectional associations is that they increase the coupling among types. This can make reuse more difficult. Many people use unidirectional associations to reduce the dependencies among types. The counterargument is that in information systems much of the work is navigating through the links among types. When these links are mainly one-way, it is more difficult to find your way around. An analogy is that of trying to find yourself around a city: One-way streets make the whole thing much more difficult, even if you know the city.

本书中的模式表示双向关联。使用这些模式时，您可以选择使用双向关联或单向关联。您正在开发的应用程序应该会提示您应该使用哪种方向的关联以及应该舍弃哪种方向的关联。您的选择实际上并不影响模式本身。如果您使用双向关联，可以使用第 14.1 节中的模式来帮助您实现它们。

The patterns in this book indicate bidirectional associations. When you use the patterns you can choose to use either bidirectional associations or unidirectional associations. The application you are working on should suggest which direction to use and which to discard. Your choice does not really affect the pattern. If you use bidirectional associations you can use the patterns in Section 14.1 to help you implement them.

关联的一个关键方面是基数（有时也称为多重性）。它规定了诸如一个人可以为多少家公司工作，或者一位母亲可以生育多少个孩子之类的概念。基数是映射而非关联的特征：每个映射都有其自身的基数。基数有很多符号；图 A.1 展示了我使用的符号。

A key aspect of associations is cardinality (sometimes called multiplicity). This specifies such things as how many companies a person can work for and how many children a mother can have. Cardinality is a feature of the mapping rather than the association: Each mapping has its own cardinality. There are many symbols for cardinality; Figure A.1 shows the ones I use in

图 A.1 本书中使用的基数符号。

Figure A.1 Symbols for cardinality used in this book.

本书中，上界为 1 的映射称为单值映射，上界大于 1 的映射称为多值映射。除非另有说明（通过简短的语义说明），否则假定多值映射表示一个集合。

this book. Mappings with an upper bound of one are called single-valued, and those with an upper bound of more than one are called multivalued. Multivalued mappings are assumed to represent a set unless otherwise indicated (by a short semantic statement).

本书中，我将属性等同于单值映射。有时我会将属性显示在类型的矩形框内，有时会显示关联关系。区别仅仅在于符号表示的便利性。

In this book I consider an attribute to be the same as a single-valued mapping. Sometimes I show an attribute inside a type's rectangle, sometimes with an association. The difference is merely that of notational convenience.

有些方法会用到聚合关系，也就是部分/整体关系（例如，锤子由锤头和锤柄组成）。本书中我很少使用聚合。我觉得这个概念对领域模型来说用处不大，因为它的大部分语义都建立在任何关联之上。这样一来，它就变成了一种需要记忆和争论的符号，而且争论的结果通常也无关紧要。不过，我在应用层会用到它（参见13.6节）。

Some methods use aggregation relationships, which are part/whole relationships (for example, a hammer is made up of a head and a haft). I don't use aggregation very much in this book. I don't find the concept terribly useful for domain models, because most of its semantics are on any association. It thus becomes another piece of notation to remember and argue over, and the result of the argument is usually not very important either way. I do, however, use it in the application tier (see Section 13.6).

派生（或计算）关联描述了如何基于其他基础关联定义关联（例如，祖父关联是通过使用父关联和父级关联定义的关联）。概念模型上的派生映射表明映射基于模型中存在的其他映射。在规范模型上，它表明派生映射的访问器结果与使用底层映射组合的结果相同。这样，派生映射也可以被视为派生映射和基础映射之间的约束。除了此约束之外，将映射标记为派生映射对底层数据结构没有其他意义。实现者可以选择任何数据结构，只要该类型的用户能够理解派生映射是根据模型派生的即可。在实现模型上，派生映射表明存储的数据与对该数据进行操作的方法之间的区别。

Derived (or computed) associations describe how associations can be defined based on other base associations (thus grandfather is an association defined by using the parent association followed by the father association.) Derived mappings on a conceptual model indicate that a mapping is based on other mappings present on the model. On a specification model it indicates that the result of the accessor for a derived mapping is the same as using the combination of underlying mappings. In this way the derived mapping can also be seen as a constraint between the derived and the base mappings. Marking a mapping as derived has no significance for the underlying data structure other than this constraint. The implementor can choose any data structure as long as the user of the type is given the impression that the derived mapping is derived according to the model. On an implementation model derived mappings indicate the difference between stored data and a method over that data.

关联主题还有许多其他变体。我尽量保持简洁。第 15 章将讨论一些有用的变体，作为关联模式。

There are many other variations on the association theme. I try to keep things as simple as possible. Some useful variations are discussed in Chapter 15 as association patterns.

A.1.3 概括

我们以企业的个人客户和公司客户为例，来探讨概括的概念。这两类客户既有差异，也有许多相似之处。这些相似之处可以归纳为一个通用的客户类型，而个人客户和公司客户则是它们的子类型。

Let's consider personal and corporate customers of a business as a typical example of generalization. These two types of customers have differences but also many similarities. The similarities can be placed in a general customer type, with personal and corporate customer as subtypes.

同样，这种现象在不同的​​建模层次上有不同的解释。从概念上讲，如果所有企业客户的实例根据定义也都是客户的实例，那么我们可以说企业客户是客户的子类型。在规范模型中，企业客户的接口必须符合客户的接口。也就是说，企业客户的实例可以用于任何使用客户的场景，调用者无需意识到实际存在子类型（可替代性原则）。企业客户对某些命令的响应可能与其他客户不同（多态性），但调用者无需担心这种差异。

Again this phenomenon has different interpretations at the different levels of modeling. Conceptually we can say that corporate customer is a subtype of customer if all instances of corporate customer are also, by definition, instances of customer. In a specification model the interface of corporate customer must conform to the interface of customer. That is, an instance of corporate customer can be used in any situation where a customer is used, and the caller need not be aware that a subtype is actually present (the principle of substitutability). The corporate customer can respond to certain commands differently than another customer (polymorphism), but the caller need not worry about the difference.

在面向对象语言中，继承和子类化是一种实现方法，其中子类继承父类的数据和操作。它与子类型化有很多共同之处，但也存在一些重要的区别。子类化只是实现子类型的一种方法（参见第 14.2 节）。子类化也可以在不使用子类型化的情况下使用——但大多数作者都正确地不赞成这种做法。较新的语言和标准越来越强调接口继承（子类型化）和实现继承（子类化）之间的区别。

Inheritance and subclassing in OO languages is an implementation approach in which the subclass inherits the data and operations of the superclass. It has a lot in common with subtyping, but there are important differences. Subclassing is only one way of implementing subtyping (see Section 14.2). Subclassing can also be used without subtyping—but most authors rightly frown on this practice. Newer languages and standards increasingly try to emphasize the difference between interface-inheritance (subtyping) and implementation-inheritance (subclassing).

关于对象和类型之间的关系，存在两个问题。首先，对象是只有一个类型，可以从超类型继承（单分类），还是有多个类型（多分类）？多分类与多重继承不同。在多重继承中，一个类型可以有多个超类型，但每个实例都属于同一个类型，该类型可以有多个超类型。多分类允许一个对象拥有多个类型，而无需为此目的定义特定类型。例如，我们可以将“客户”的子类型设置为“个人客户”、“企业客户”和“重要客户”。一个客户可能既是个人客户又是重要客户。在多分类中，我们可以为一个对象赋予“个人客户”和“重要客户”两种类型（客户类型继承自它们）。如果没有多分类，我们就必须显式地定义“重要个人客户”类型。如果子类型过多，最终可能会出现大量的组合，难以管理。

Two questions arise concerning the relationship between an object and a type. First, does an object have a single type that can inherit from supertypes (single classification), or does it have several types (multiple classification)? Multiple classification is different than multiple inheritance. With multiple inheritance a type can have many supertypes, but each instance is of a single type that may have supertypes. Multiple classification allows multiple types for an object without defining a specific type for the purpose. We might have personal, corporate, and important customers as subtypes of customer. A customer might be both personal and important. With multiple classification we can give an object both the personal and important customer types (with customer inherited from them). Without multiple classification we must explicitly define an important personal customer type. If there are many subtypes, we can end up with a very large number of combinations, which is difficult to manage.

从概念上讲，多重分类是一种更自然的思维方式。然而，大多数面向对象语言，尤其是主流的 C++ 和 Smalltalk，都采用单一分类方法。许多方法也使用单一分类。权衡之处在于：一种概念上更自然但需要更多精力才能转化为代码的方法，与一种实现上更紧密但更容易转化的方法。我更倾向于概念上更自然的方法，因此本书采用多重分类。

Conceptually speaking, multiple classification is a more natural way of thinking. However, most OO languages, and certainly mainstream C++ and Smalltalk, use a single-classification approach. Many methods also use single classification. The trade-off is between a conceptually more natural approach that requires more effort in transforming to code, or a more implementation-bound approach that is easier to transform. I prefer the more conceptual approach and use multiple classification in this book.

使用多重分类时，我们必须通过将子类型分组到不同的分区中来展示哪些组合是合法的，如图 A.2 所示。同一分区内的类型互不相交；也就是说，任何对象都不能同时是同一分区内多个类型的实例。因此，超类型不可能同时是子类型 1 和子类型 2。不完全分区表示超类型的实例不一定是该分区内某个子类型的实例。完全分区表示超类型的每个实例都必须是该分区内某个子类型的实例。

When using multiple classification we must show which combinations are legal by grouping subtypes into partitions, as shown in Figure A.2. Types within the same partition are disjoint; that is, no object can be an instance of more than one type within a single partition. Thus it is impossi ble for the supertype to be both subtype-1 and subtype-2. An incomplete partition indicates that an instance of the supertype need not be an instance of a subtype within that partition. A complete partition indicates that every instance of the supertype must also be an instance of a subtype within the partition.

第二个问题是对象是否可以改变其类型。例如，当银行账户透支时，其行为会发生显著变化，多个操作（取款、关闭）会被重写。动态分类允许对象在子类型结构内改变类型，而静态分类则不允许。同样，主要的面向对象语言和大多数面向对象方法都是静态的，其权衡取舍与单分类/多分类相同。本书采用更偏重概念的动态分类方法。

The second question is whether an object can change its type. For example, when a bank account is overdrawn, it substantially changes its behavior, with several operations (withdraw, close) overridden. Dynamic classification allows objects to change type within the subtyping structure, while static classification does not. Again the principal OO languages, and most OO methods, are static, and the same trade-offs apply as for single/multiple classification. This book takes the more conceptual dynamic classification approach.

动态分类的一种理解方式是，它统一了状态和类型这两个概念。使用静态分类时，我们必须将状态相关的行为与子类型区分开来。而动态分类则将二者视为同一概念。

One way of looking at dynamic classification is that it unifies the notions of state and type. When using static classification we must pay attention to state-dependent behavior separately from subtyping. Dynamic classification treats them both the same.

不完全划分表明超类型的实例可以是子类型 4 的实例、子类型 5 的实例，或者两者都不是。

An incomplete partition indicates that instances of supertype can be instances ofsubtype-4, subtype-5, or neither.

完全分区表明 supertype 的所有实例必须是 subtype-1 或 subtype-2 的实例。

A complete partition indicates that all instances ofsupertype must be instances of either subtype-1 or subtype-2.

图 A.2 概括符号。

Figure A.2 Generalization notation.

超类型的一个实例可以是子类型 1 和子类型 4，但不能是子类型 1 和 子类型 2。

An instance of the supertype may be subtype-! and subtype-4, but not subtype-1 and subtype-2.

动态分类的使用揭示了概念模型和实现模型之间的一个微妙区别。在概念模型中，所有子类型都被视为动态的，除非被简短的语义语句[不可变]明确否定。这不仅反映了世界可能发生的变化，也反映了我们对这些变化的认知也在不断变化。对于某些企业而言，个人客户可能无法转变为企业客户。同样，我们之前认为的个人客户实际上可能是企业客户。在这里，我们对世界的认知意味着一种动态分类，即使世界本身是静态的。信息系统通常建立在我们对世界的认知之上，因此从概念上讲，子类型是动态的。

The use of dynamic classification brings to light a subtle difference between conceptual and implementation models. In a conceptual model all subtyping is considered dynamic, unless explicitly denied by the short semantic statement [immutable]. This reflects not only the changes that can occur in the world but also our changing knowledge of them. For some businesses it might be true that a personal customer cannot change into a corporate customer. It may also be true that a customer whom we thought was personal is actually corporate. Here our knowledge of the world implies a dynamic classification, even if the world itself is static. Information systems are usually built on our knowledge of the world, thus conceptually the subtyping is dynamic.

然而，处理动态分类的额外复杂性不容忽视。因此，在规范模型中，动态子类型在概念上通常被声明为静态的。这实际上意味着，尽管我们知道分类可能会发生变化，但这种情况发生的频率很低，我们不希望投入额外的精力（和成本）来支持它。如果真的发生了变化，用户将不得不通过复制和替换的方式来解决。在许多情况下，动态变化发生的频率足够低，因此这种方法是值得的。通过确保访问器接口在两种情况下保持一致（参见第 14.2.6 节），可以长期保持灵活性。

However, the extra complexity of handling dynamic classification cannot be ignored. Thus conceptually dynamic subtypes are often declared static in a specification model. This effectively says that although we know that the classification can change, it happens rarely enough that we don't wish to go to the extra effort (and cost) of supporting it. If it ever does happen, the users will have to sort it out by copy and replace. For many situations the dyna mism is sufficiently rare to make this approach worthwhile. Flexibility in the long term can be maintained by ensuring that the accessor interface is the same in either case (see Section 14.2.6).

最终，分区是静态的还是动态的取决于具体应用，因此我在模式中尽量避免做出任何通用判断。为了简单起见，我建议在使用静态分类语言时，尽可能使用静态分区。

In the end the decision to make a partition static or dynamic depends on the application, so I have tried not to make any general statements in the patterns. For simplicity I recommend using static partitions whenever you can when you are working in a statically classified language.

如果您使用的方法不使用多个动态分类，则需要使用第 14.2 节中开发的模式来转换模型。

If you are using a method that does not use multiple dynamic classification, then you will need to transform the models using the patterns developed in Section 14.2.

A.1.4 规则和语义语句

关联和子类型允许我们对类型进行很多描述，但并非全部。例如，我可能有一个人寿保险单对象，其中包含投保人和受益人的映射。我可以使用基数约束来捕获诸如“只有一个投保人，但可能有多个受益人”之类的语句；然而，这些约束不允许我们指定投保人不能是受益人。为此，我们需要一个更灵活的约束。约束是关于类型的逻辑表达式，它必须始终为真。尽管约束在 Eiffel 中（被称为不变量）早已存在，但在面向对象方法中却常常缺失。

Associations and subtypes allow us to say much about types, but not all. I may have a life insurance policy object with mappings for policyholder and beneficiaries. I can use the cardinality constraints to capture statements such as there is only one policyholder but there may be many beneficiaries; however, the constraints do not allow us to say the policyholder must not be a beneficiary. To do this we need a more flexible constraint. A constraint is a logical expression about a type that must always be true. Constraints are often missing from OO methods although they have been present in Eiffel (where they are called invariants) for a long time.

如图 A.3 所示，我使用语义语句来表达约束条件。简短的语义语句指的是可以用几个词概括的常见情况，并用方括号括起来。表 AI 列出了本书中使用的简短语义语句。

I express constraints using semantic statements, as shown in Figure A.3. Short semantic statements refer to common situations that can be summed up in a couple of words and are added in square brackets. Table A.I lists the short semantic statements used in this book.

应用于类型的简短语义语句。

A short semantic statement applied to a type.

应用于映射的简短语义语句。

A short semantic statement applied to a mapping.

应用于类型的长语义语句。

A long semantic statement applied to a type.

图 A.3 语义语句的符号。

Figure A.3 Notation for semantic statements.

[班级] 地图 映射关系源自类本身，而非实例。这相当于类变量或静态成员。

并非所有内容都能用简短的语义语句表达。当需要更多空间时，我会使用较长的语义语句，其中包含更多文本，这些文本以折角框的形式呈现。较长的语义语句带有标题，用于说明其描述的内容。这些标题列于表 A.2 中。

Not everything can be expressed as a short semantic statement. When more room is needed, I use a long semantic statement, which contains more text in a dog-eared box. A long semantic statement has a heading indicating what it describes. These headings are listed in Table A.2.

表 A.2 长语义陈述的标题。
标题 附于 意义
约束 类型 该语句必须对该类型的所有实例都成立。
推导 衍生映射 一种推导映射关系的方法。实现中可以选择其他等效方法。
实例 类型 该类型所有允许实例的列表。
方法 手术 指示操作方法。
笔记 任何事物 非正式评论。
超载 类型 表示该类型如何重载超类型的某些特征。

并非所有方法都能捕捉语义陈述中所包含的信息。然而，重要的是不要丢失这些信息。越来越多的方法提供某种类似于长语义陈述的视觉注释，可以用于此目的。

Not all methods provide a way of capturing the kind of information shown in semantic statements. It is important, however, that much of this information not be lost. Increasingly methods are providing some kind of visual note, similar to the long semantic statement, that can be used in this way.

A.1.5 基本类型

在传统的数据建模中，世界通常被划分为实体和属性。这种划分在某种程度上是人为的。实际上，属性通常指的是环境支持的基本数据类型——通常是整数、实数、字符串、日期，可能还有其他几种。

In traditional data modeling the world is often divided into entities and attributes. The division is somewhat arbitrary. In practice it often boils down to attributes being the fundamental data types supported by the environment—usually integer, real, string, date, and perhaps a couple of others.

借助面向对象系统，我们可以轻松定义具有与内置类型相同许多特性的新类型。Smalltalk 中的一个经典例子是分数。在 Smalltalk 中，分数就像任何其他数字一样工作；事实上，如果我们在 Smalltalk 中执行 V3，结果就是分数 V3，而不是某种伪无限循环小数。

With object systems we can easily define new types that have many of the same features as these built-in types. A classic example from Smalltalk is the fraction. In Smalltalk a fraction works just like any other number; indeed if we execute V3 in Smalltalk the answer is the fraction V3, not some pseudo-infinitely recurring decimal.

在开发系统时，我们必须使用这些类型。一个经典的例子是处理货币值。数据库中汽车的价值通常以数字形式存储，但说一辆车价值 10,000 是没有意义的。货币单位至关重要。利用对象，我们可以定义一个同时包含数字和货币单位的货币类型。它可以执行加法运算（检查货币单位是否匹配），并生成格式正确的输出。

When developing systems we must make use of these types. A classic example is handling monetary values. The value of a car in a database is typically held as a number, yet it is nonsense to say that a car costs 10,000. The currency is all important. With objects we can actually define a money type that knows both the number and the currency. It can perform addition (checking that the currencies match) and create a printout formatted the correct way.

表 A.3 列出了本书中使用的基本类型。关于基本类型的一个重要特点是，从基本类型到非基本类型的映射关系永远不会被实现。否则，基本类型的接口将会非常庞大​​，并且充斥着大量的访问器。

Table A. 3 lists the fundamental types used in this book. An important point about fundamental types is that mappings from a fundamental type to a nonfundamental type are never implemented. Otherwise, the fundamental type would get a huge interface crowded with accessors to

every type that used it. This would be both unwieldy and not reusable. A conceptual model can show that a mapping exists, since conceptually the mapping does exist, but a corresponding specification model cannot.

有些作者将这类类型称为字面量；然而，其他作者使用字面量一词来表示非对象类型（例如 C++ 中的 real 类型），这就是为什么我使用基本类型这个术语。

Some authors refer to these kinds of types as literals; however, other authors use the term literal to stand for nonobject types (such as the type real in C++), which is why I use the term fundamental type.

本书并未尝试对基本类型进行完整的规范。读者可将此作为练习（或留待未来版本）。Cook 和 Daniels [4] 的著作中给出了其中一些类型的规范。

I have not attempted to make a complete specification of fundamental types in this book. Consider this an exercise for the reader (or a future edition). Some of these types are given a specification in Cook and Daniels [4].

A.2 交互图

A.2 Interaction Diagrams

交互图展示了多个对象如何协作完成某项任务。交互图由若干垂直线组成，这些垂直线代表对象。线之间的箭头表示对象之间发送的消息，消息顺序通过沿纸向下延伸的方式表示，如图 A.4 所示。交互图应用广泛且易于理解。我常用的一个技巧是使用双向箭头来表示同一条消息发送给多个对象的情况，例如在循环或遍历集合时。我偶尔也会使用虚线来表示返回值；虽然我并非总是这样做，但在情况变得复杂时，虚线有时很有用。消息 1 开始交互。

Interaction diagrams show how several objects collaborate to get something done. An interaction diagram has a number of vertical lines that represent objects. Arrows between the lines represent messages sent between objects, with sequence indicated by progression down the paper, as shown in Figure A.4. Interaction diagrams are widely used and simple to follow. One unusual thing I do is use a double-headed arrow to show where the same message is sent to many objects, as occurs in a loop or iterating over a collection. I also occasionally use a dashed line to show a return value; this is not something I do all the time, but it is sometimes useful when things are getting hairy. Message-1 starts the interaction

类型 1 的实例向类型 2 的实例发送消息 2。

An instance of type-1 sends message-2 to an instance of type-2

类型 2 向类型 1 返回一个值。

A type-2 returns a value to a type-1

类型 1 向多个类型 2 发送消息 3（例如，使用类型 2 集合的迭代器）。

A type-1 sends message-3 tomanytype-2s(e.g., using an iterator over a collection of type-2s)

Message-4 创建了 type-3 的新实例。

Message-4 creates a new instance of type-3.

图 A.4 交互图中使用的符号 。

Figure A.4 Notation used for interaction diagrams.

本书中我大量使用交互图来展示行为。我经常将交互图与事件图（参见A.3节）结合使用，因为这两种方法相辅相成。事件图以一种鼓励并行性的方式定义行为，但它并不指明哪些对象执行哪些操作。交互图则展示了如何在对象之间分配这种行为，同时抑制并行性和具体的行为逻辑。

I use interactions quite a lot in this book to show behavior. Often I use them in conjunction with an event diagram (see Section A.3) because the two approaches complement each other well. Event diagrams define behavior in a manner that encourages parallelism, yet they do not indicate which objects do what. Interaction diagrams show how this behavior can be allocated between objects while suppressing the parallelism and the precise behavioral logic.

你可能更熟悉用方框之间编号消息来表示交互图的方式，这相当于页面上的线条。我个人更喜欢页面上的线条形式，因为我觉得它更容易看出消息的顺序。

You may be more familiar with seeing interaction diagrams expressed as numbered messages between boxes, which are equivalent to the lines down page. I prefer the lines-down-the-page-form because I think it makes it easier to see the sequence of messages.

由于交互图非常简单，即使您之前没有使用过，也不需要太多的教程。Booch [1] 的著作是了解更多细节的好参考资料。

Since interaction diagrams are so simple, you don't need much of a tutorial on them if you have not used them before. A good source for more details is Booch [1].

A.3 事件图

A.3 Event Diagrams

事件图是我使用的另一种行为模型。虽然它们比交互图更复杂，但它们允许对行为进行完全控制。此外，它们还能表达并行行为，这在业务建模中非常有用。

Event diagrams are another form of behavioral model that I use. Although they are more complex than interaction diagrams, they do allow complete control to be specified. They also are able to express parallel behavior, which is very useful in business modeling.

事件图中的方框代表通过发出事件信号而完成的操作。触发规则表示事件触发操作。当一个事件类型定义了多个触发规则时，就会出现并行性。因此，在图 A.5 中，表示操作 1 结束的事件类型会并行触发操作 2 和操作 3。这意味着操作 2 和操作 3 可以按任意顺序执行，也可以同时执行。并行性也可以通过多重触发来实现，这用双向箭头表示。这表示事件多次触发操作，例如在遍历集合时。箭头上的标签指示正在遍历哪个集合。

The boxes on an event diagram represent operations that complete by sig-nalling an event. A trigger rule indicates that an event triggers an operation. Parallelism appears when an event type has more than one trigger rule defined on it. Hence in Figure A.5 the event type signaling the end of opera-tion-1 triggers both operation-2 and operation-3 in parallel. This means that operation-2 and operation-3 can occur in any order or simultaneously. Parallelism can also occur with a multiple trigger, which is shown by a double-headed arrow. This indicates that the event triggers the operation many times, such as when iterating over a collection. A label on the line indicates what collection is being iterated over.

如果触发规则通过控制条件引导操作，则只有当控制条件（布尔表达式）的计算结果为真时，才会执行该操作。控制条件通常用于同步并行线程。每个线程都会触发该条件，该条件被设计为仅在适当的同步点为真。

If a trigger rule leads into an operation via a control condition, the operation is only invoked if the control condition (a Boolean expression) evaluates to true. The control condition is often used to synchronize parallel threads. Each thread triggers the condition, which is designed to be true only at the appropriate synchronization point.

两种常见的控制条件是“与”条件和“z”条件。“与”条件仅在所有传入的触发规则都已触发一次时为真，在菱形中用“&”表示。“z”条件在图表上没有任何操作被触发运行时为真，也就是说，当图表处于空闲状态时，它在菱形中用“az”（如“zzzzzz”）表示。“z”条件通常用于图表的末尾，以同步图表的结尾。

Two common control conditions are the and condition and the z condition. The and condition is true only when all incoming trigger rules have fired once. It is shown by a & in the diamond. The z condition is true whenever there are no operations on the diagram that are triggered to run, that is, when all is quiet and the diagram has gone to sleep. It is shown by a z in the diamond (as in zzzzzz). A z condition is often used at the end of the diagram to synchronize the end of the diagram.

另一个条件逻辑是分区逻辑，与操作 3 中的相同。事件会根据操作结果进行子类型划分。可以在超类型事件上放置触发规则，以指示无论结果如何都会触发的触发器。分区的工作方式与结构化模型中的相同。一个事件可以定义多个分区，一个分区可以包含任意数量的事件，并且分区可以彼此叠加到所需的任意深度。任何事件都只会是每个分区中一种事件类型的实例。

The other conditional logic is that of the partition, as on operation-3. The event is subtyped depending on the outcome of the operation. A trigger rule can be placed on the supertype event to indicate a trigger that is fired whatever the outcome. The partition works the same way as in structural models. An event can have many partitions defined on it, a partition can have any number of events within it, and partitions can be defined on top of each other to any desired depth. Any event will be an instance of only one event type from each partition.

多重触发。表示操作 6 将是

A multiple trigger. Indicates that operation-6 will be

触发规则。当事件发生时（即操作 1 完成时），则调用操作 2 的结束流程。

A trigger rule. When the event occurs (i.e., on completion of operation-1) then The end of the operation-2 is invoked. process.

表示流程开始。

Indicates the start of the process.

操作可以通过子事件图和/或前置条件和后置条件来描述。

An operation can be described by a subsidiary event diagram and/or by pre-and postconditions.

因同一触发事件而被多次调用。通常涉及遍历集合。

invoked many times for one triggering event. Typically involves iterating over a collection.

特殊控制条件。如果所有计划操作均已执行，则为真。分区，与类型图中的分区完全相同。指示事件类型可以细分为不同的触发子类型。操作将生成分区中的一种事件类型。通用触发器显示在超类型上。

A special control condition. True if all scheduled operations have been executed. A partition, exactly the same as for type diagrams. Indicates that event types may be subtyped for different triggering. The operation will result in one of the event types in the partition. Common triggers are shown on the supertype.

控制条件。任何布尔表达式，只有当其为真时，操作 3 才能被调用。如果为假，则不执行任何操作。

A control condition. Any Boolean expression that must be true for operation-3 to be invoked. If false nothing happens.

时钟事件。按一定时间间隔触发（例如，每天早上）。

A clock event. Fires according to some time interval (e.g., each morning).

简单且受控的条件。如果所有传入的触发器都已触发，则为真。

Simple and control condition. True if all incoming triggers have fired.

图 A.5 事件图的符号表示。

Figure A.5 Notation for event diagrams.

事件图是概念性的，因为它们只描述某个过程是如何运作的，而不描述哪些对象执行该过程。因此，它们与交互图能够很好地互补。有关事件图的教程，请参阅 Odell [5]。

Event diagrams are conceptual in that they only say how some process works, not which objects carry out the process. Thus they complement interaction diagrams very well. For a tutorial on them see Odell [5].

A.4 状态图

A.4 State Diagrams

状态图通过描述对象可以进入的各种状态以及对象如何改变状态来定义单个对象的行为。面向对象方法中最常用的状态图是哈雷尔状态图。本书中使用的是这种状态图的一个子集。状态图针对单个类型绘制，并表示该类型每个实例的行为。

State diagrams define the behavior of a single object by describing the various states the object can get into and how the object changes state. The most widely used form of state diagram in OO methods is that of the Harel state chart. I use a subset of this form in this book. A state diagram is drawn for a single type and represents the behavior of each instance of that type.

如图 A.6 所示，每个状态都用一个方框表示。这些方框通过状态转换连接，状态转换展示了对象如何从一个状态移动到另一个状态。状态转换会标记触发该转换的事件。如果状态转换带有条件判断，则只有当条件判断为真时，状态转换才会发生。条件判断是一个布尔表达式。如果状态转换带有动作判断，则在转换到新状态期间执行该动作。状态可以泛化为超状态。超状态可以用来定义状态转换，这些转换随后会应用于所有子状态。

Each state is shown by a box, as shown in Figure A. 6. The boxes are linked by transitions that show how an object can move from one state to another. The transition is labeled with the event that causes the transition. If a transition has a guard, then the transition only occurs when the event occurs, and the guard evaluates to true. The guard is a Boolean expression. If a transition has an action, then this action is executed during the transition to the new state. States can be generalized into superstates. A superstate can be used to define transitions that then apply to all substates.

从该符号开始的转换表示对象的初始状态。

Transitions from this symbol indicate the initial state of an object.

转换是由事件引起的。如果存在守卫条件，则该条件必须为真。如果存在动作，则

A transition is caused by an event. The guard, if present, must be true. The action, if present,

图 A.6 本书中的状态图符号。

Figure A.6 Notation for state diagrams in this book.

关于 Harel 状态图的简单教程，请参阅 Booch [1]。更全面的讲解，最佳参考资料是 Cook 和 Daniels [4]。本书中我并不经常使用状态图，当然也不会使用像 Harel 状态图那样强大的状态图，但它们偶尔也会出现。

For a simple tutorial on Harel state charts, see Booch [1]. For a more com-prehensive treatment, the best source is Cook and Daniels [4]. In this book I do not use state diagrams that much, and certainly none with the power of Harel state charts, but they do pop up occasionally.

A.5 封装图

A.5 Package Diagrams

对于大型模型，我们需要一种方法来组织类型图中出现的大量类型。单个大型类型图对于人类来说过于复杂，难以理解，对于软件来说也难以管理。大型类型图可以拆分成多个页面供人阅读，但随意选择页面对软件的控制作用不大。如图 A.7 所示，包图提供了一种更易于控制的机制。

On large models we need a way to organize the mass of types that appear on the type diagram. A single large type diagram is both too complex for humans to comprehend and too difficult for software to manage. A large diagram can be broken down into pages for a human, but an arbitrary choice of pages does little to control the software. Package diagrams, as shown in Figure A.7, provide a more controlled mechanism.

图 A.7 包描述符号。

Figure A.7 Notation for describing packages.

此图取自图7 7.3。我使用 Rational Software 的统一建模 语言表示法 [2] 来表示包，因为我发现它比 Booch 的原始表示法更清晰。

This diagram is taken from Figure 7 7.3. I'm using the Rational Software's Unified Modeling Language notation [2] for packages, as I find it clearer than Booch's original notation.

包（也称为类别域、集群或子系统）是一组类型（或类）。一个类型只能属于一个包。通常，类型会被分配到不同的包中，以便将经常协作的类型放在同一个包里。包中的任何类型都可以访问同一包中任何其他类型的任何特性。

A package (also called category domain, cluster, or subsystem) is a group of types (or classes). A type can belong to only one package. Usually types are assigned to packages so that types that collaborate often are put in the same package. Any type in the package can access any feature of any other type in the same package.

包之间通过可见性关系关联。如果一个客户端类型想要使用另一个包中的服务器类型，则客户端类型和服务器类型之间必须存在可见性关系。任何服务都需要这种可见性关系，例如调用操作、在属性中保存数据或作为参数传递数据。

Packages are linked by visibility relationships. If a client type wishes to make use of a server type in another package, a visibility relationship must exist between the client type and the server type. This is required for any service: calling an operation, holding in an attribute, or passing as a parameter.

可见性与先决条件不同。先决条件意味着一个包需要另一个包的存在才能运行。先决条件具有传递性：如果包 C 是包 B 的先决条件，而包 B 又是包 A 的先决条件，那么包 C 也是包 A 的先决条件。可见性不具备这种传递性。包 A 可能对包 C 不可见；实际上，包 B 的设计目的可能就是为了对包 A 隐藏包 C——这正是分层架构的本质。先决条件和可见性经常被混淆，因为编程语言通常将两者合并在一起。C++ 头文件和 Envy 的先决条件定义了先决条件，并允许所有先决条件可见，这使得一个包无法隐藏另一个包。所有可见性都必须在包中显式声明。因此，在图 A.7 中，风险管理应用程序包必须显式地对投资组合包可见才能使用其服务。如果缺乏这种透明度，投资组合方案（通过估值方案）仍然是必要条件，但透明度却荡然无存。透明度意味着必要条件，反之则不然。

Visibility is different from a prerequisite. A prerequisite implies that one package needs the presence of another package to function. Prerequisites are transitive: If package C is a prerequisite of package B, and package B is a prerequisite of package A, then package C is a prerequisite of package A. This transitivity is not true for visibilities. Package A may not have visibility to package C; indeed package B may be specifically designed to hide package C from package A—this is the essence of a layered architecture. Prerequisites and visibilities are often confused because programming languages often merge the two together. C++ header files and Envy prerequisites define prerequisites and allow visibility to all prerequisites, which defeats the use of one package to hide another. All visibilities must be explicitly declared in a package. Hence in Figure A.7 the risk management application package must have an explicit visibility to the portfolio package to be able to use its services. If that visibility were not present, the portfolio package would still be a prerequisite (via the valuation package), but there would be no visibil ity. Visibilities imply prerequisites but not the reverse.

在同一个包内，类型可以是公共的，也可以是私有的。公共类型可以被所有具有可见性的包访问；私有类型只能由同一包内的类型使用。包可以设置为全局类型，在这种情况下，所有其他包都可以访问该包。这对于整数、字符串和集合等通用组件来说是必要的。

Within a package, types can be public or private. Public types are seen by packages that have visibility; private types can only be used by types within the same package. Packages can be made global, in which case all other packages have visibility to them. This is necessary for general components such as integers, strings, and collections.

在开发大型系统时，我们会尽量减少软件包之间的可见性，从而减少系统依赖关系，使其更易于管理。本书第 11 章和第 12 章主要讨论软件包问题。

When developing a large system, we try to minimize the visibilities between packages so that the system has less dependencies and is thus easier to manage. In this book I discuss packages primarily in Chapters 11 and 12.

尽管这类模型对于大型系统至关重要，但在方法论中却鲜有讨论。Booch [1] 提出了我在此使用的基本思想，但他的描述非常简略，主要是因为如果没有实质性的例子，很难深入探讨这个主题。Robert Martin 弥补了这一不足，他给出了许多使用包模型的例子 [6]。

Although this kind of model is essential for larger systems, it is not much discussed in methods. Booch [1] introduced the basic ideas that I use here, but his description is very brief, largely because it is difficult to discuss this subject without a substantial example. This lack has been rectified by Robert Martin, who gives a number of examples of the use of package models [6].
