Appendix B. Table of Patterns

文本部分姓名 问题解决方案
2.1

派对

Party

个人和组织单位承担着类似的责任。

People and organizational units have similar responsibilities.

创建“政党”这一类型，作为人和组织的超类型。

Create a type party as a supertype of person and organization.
2.2

组织层级

Organization Hierarchies

表示一种层级式组织结构。

Representing a hierarchical organization structure.

基于组织创建递归关联。

Create a recursive association on organization.
2.3

组织结构

Organization Structure

组织结构具有层级结构或更复杂的联系。

An organization structure has hierarchies or more complex links.

出现了新的链接类型。保留了结构变更的历史记录。

New kinds of links appearing. Keeping a history of changes to the structure.

创建组织结构，使其成为双方之间的有向关系。为其指定组织结构类型，以表示这种关系类型。

Create organization structure as a directed relationship between two parties. Give it an organization structure type to represent the kind of relationship.
2.4

问责制

Accountability

代表组织结构、雇佣、管理、专业注册和合同等类似结构。

Representing organization structures, employment, management, professional registration, and contracts with a similar structure.

将问责制建立为双方之间的一种定向关系。赋予问责制一种类型来代表这种关系。

Create accountability as a directed relationship between two parties. Give it an accountability type to represent the kind of relationship.
2.5

问责知识水平

Accountability Knowledge Level

记录下如何以易于更改的方式建立问责制的规则。

Recording the rules that describe how accountabilities can be formed in a way that is easy to change.

通过建立问责类型与当事人类型之间的关联，构建问责知识层级。该知识层级制约着问责和当事人的操作层面。

Create a knowledge level for accountability by associations between accountability type and party type. This knowledge level constrains the operational level of accountability and party.
2.6

政党类型概括

Party Type Generalizations

模型中有很多政党类型，其中大多数都与其他一些政党类型相似。

Of many party types in a model, most are similar to some other party type.

允许政党类型进行子类型划分，以便它们继承问责类型。

Allow party types to be subtyped so they inherit accountability types.
2.7

层级问责制

Hierarchic Accountability

将某些问责类型限制在层级结构中。

Constraining some accountability types into a hierarchy.

定义一个包含层级约束的问责类型子类型。层级列表允许您为层级中的每个层级命名。

Define a subtype of accountability type that includes the hierarchy constraint. A list of levels allows you to name each level in the hierarchy.
2.8

操作范围

Operating Scope

描述问责制所隐含的责任。

Describing what responsibilities are implied by an accountability.

在问责制中增加若干操作范围。操作范围的类型取决于问责制的类型。

Add a number of operating scopes to the accountability. The type of operating scope depends on the type of accountability.
2.9

邮政

Post

责任在于工作本身，而不是从事这项工作的人。

Accountabilities are due to the job rather than the person doing it.

创建“职位”这一政党子类型。任命某人担任该职位并赋予其相应的职责。职位持有者在其任期内承担该职位的所有责任。

Create a post as another subtype of party. Appoint a person to a post with an accountability. The holder of the post then gets the responsibilities of the post while they hold it.
3.1

数量

Quantity

代表诸如 6 英尺或 5 美元之类的数值。

Representing a value such as 6 feet or $5.

使用包含数量和单位的数量类型。货币也是一种单位。

Use a quantity type that includes both the amount and the unit. Currencies are a kind of unit.
3.2

转化率

Conversion Ratio

不同单位之间的数量转换。

Converting between quantities in different units.

记录单位之间的换算比率。

Record conversion ratios between units.
3.3

复合单元

Compound Units

表示单位，例如 kg/m2。

Representing units such as kg/m2.

使用由其他单位组合而成的单位。

Use a unit that is a combination of other units.
3.4

测量

Measurement

一个对象具有大量的数量属性。

An object has a large number of quantity attributes.

记录有关某项属性的单次测量信息。

Recording information about an individual measurement of an attribute.

跟踪属性值随时间的变化。

Tracking changes in a value to an attribute over time.

创建一个对象来表示单个测量值。该对象与被测量的对象以及描述所进行测量类型的现象类型相关联。

Create an object to represent the individual measurement. This is linked to the object being measured and to a phenomenon type that describes the kind of measurement being made.
3.5

观察

Observation

属性是定性的，因此不能用数字来衡量。

Attributes are qualitative and thus cannot be measured with numbers.

创建一种观测类型，将对象与某种现象关联起来。每种现象都是某种现象类型的一个值。

Create an observation type that links the object to a phenomenon. Each phenomenon is a value for some phenomenon type.
3.6

子类型观察概念

Subtyping Observation Concepts

现象是另一种现象的特殊情况。

Phenomena are special cases of another phenomenon.

允许在知识层面上对现象进行关联性细分。

Allow phenomena to be subtyped with an association in the knowledge level.
3.7

协议

Protocol

处理类似现象时，由于观察方法不同，有时会导致不同的解释。记录测量的准确度和灵敏度。

Dealing with similar phenomena when the method of observing can occasionally cause different interpretation. Recording the accuracy and sensitivity of a measurement.

记录用于确定观察结果的方案。

Record the protocol used for determining the observation.
3.8

双时记录

Dual Time Record

观察结果为真与你注意到观察结果的时间之间，以及事件发生与你注意到事件的时间之间，都会产生差异。

Differences arise between when an observation is true and when you noticed it, and between when an event occurs and when you noticed it.

将所有此类物品的两种时间分别记录下来。

Record both times separately for all such objects.
3.9

被拒绝的观察

Rejected Observation

观察结果有误，但无法抹去。

Observations were made in error but cannot be erased.

保留它们，标记为已拒绝，并记录拒绝它们的观察结果。

Keep them, mark them as rejected, and record what observation rejected them.
3.10

主动观察、假设和预测

Active Observation, Hypothesis, and Projection

观察结果的确定性。当需要根据这种可能性制定治疗方案时，表示你认为可能会发生的观察结果。

Certainty in observations. Representing observations that you think may come to pass when you have to base treatment on that possibility.

将观察结果细分为主动观察（我将对此进行处理）、假设（我将进一步调查）和预测（我认为这可能会发生）。

Subtype observations into active observations (I'm going to treat this), hypothesis (I'm going to investigate further), and projection (I think this may happen).
3.11

相关观察

Associated Observation

记录诊断依据。

Recording the evidence for a diagnosis.

将诊断视为一种观察结果，并将其与用作证据的观察结果联系起来。

Treat the diagnosis as an observation with an association to the observations used as evidence.
3.12

观察过程

Process of Observation

确定观察和诊断过程。

Determining the process of observation and diagnosis.

每一次观察都可能引出进一步观察和干预的建议，并促使人们重新评估相互矛盾的观察结果。随着这些步骤产生更多观察结果，这就形成了一个持续的观察过程。

Each observation may lead to suggestions for further observations and interventions to be proposed, and to re-evaluation of contradictory observations. As these steps produce further observations, this leads to a continuous process of observation.
4.1

企业部门

Enterprise Segment

使用不同的标准和不同程度的粒度，将大型企业分解成若干部分。

Breaking down a large enterprise into pieces using different criteria and varying degrees of granularity.

将每个分解标准定义为一个维度，并将其表示为元素层级结构。将企业细分定义为每个维度中一个元素的组合。

Define each criteria for breakdown as a dimension, and represent it as a hierarchy of elements. Define an enterprise segment as the combination of one element from each dimension.
4.2

测量方案

Measurement Protocol

表示测量值是通过计算或从数据库中读取的。

Indicating that measurements are calculated or read from a database.

记录计算公式。

Recording the formulas for calculations.

同一种现象类型，根据上下文的不同，可以用不同的方式来确定。

The same phenomenon type can be determined in different ways depending on context.

定义测量规程，描述如何针对某种现象类型创建测量方法。测量规程可以从现有数据中获取，也可以通过计算得出；计算方法可以是因果关系分析、比较分析或维度组合分析。

Define a measurement protocol that describes how to create a measurement for a phenomenon type. Measurement protocols can be sourced or calculated, calculations can be causal, comparative, or dimension combination.
4.3

范围

Range

描述两个值之间的范围。

Describing a range between two values.

定义一个具有上限和下限以及合适运算的范围类型。

Define a range type with upper and lower bounds and suitable operations.
4.4

具有范围的现象

Phenomenon with Range

描述一种现象，该现象被定义为某种现象类型的一个范围。

Describing a phenomenon defined as a range on a phenomenon type.

给该现象赋予一个范围属性。创建一个范围函数，在其他现象描述的条件下，将该范围与该现象关联起来。

Give the phenomenon an attribute of range. Create a range function that links the range to the phenomenon under conditions described by other phenomena.
5.1

姓名

Name

指代某个对象。

Refering to an object.

给对象赋予一个字符串名称。

Give the object a string as its name.
5.2

识别方案

Identification Scheme

确保标识仅指代一个对象，但不同的参与方可以对该对象有不同的称呼。

Ensuring an identification refers to only one object but different parties can refer to the object differently.

创建包含标识符的识别方案，其中每个标识符仅指代一个单元。任何一方均可使用任何识别方案。

Create identification schemes that contain identifiers, where each identifier refers to only one unit. A party can use any identification scheme.
5.3

对象合并

Object Merge

这两个物体实际上是同一个。

Two objects are in fact the same.

将一个对象的属性复制到另一个对象，将所有引用从第一个对象切换到另一个对象，然后删除第一个对象。

Copy the attributes of one over to the other, switch all references from the first to the other, and delete the first.

将其中一个标记为已取代，并添加指向另一个的链接。

Mark one as superseded and give it a link to the other.

将这两个物体的外观与某种本质联系起来，表明它们是相同的。

Link the two object appearances with an essence that indicates they are the same.
5.4

对象等价性

Object Equivalence

有些人认为两个物体相同，而另一些人则认为它们不同。

Some people think two objects are the same, but others think they are different.

为这些对象建立等价关系。

Create an equivalence for the objects.
6.1

帐户

Account

记录某个量的变化历史。

Recording a history of changes to some quantity.

创建账户。每次变更都会记录为账户中的一笔分录。账户余额即为账户的当前价值。

Create an account. Each change is recorded as an entry against the account. The balance of the account gives its current value.
6.2

交易

Transaction

确保账户中没有任何数据丢失。

Ensuring that nothing gets lost from an account.

使用交易功能在账户之间转移物品。

Use transactions to transfer items between accounts.
6.3

汇总账户

Summary Account

将一组账户视为一个账户来看待。

Looking at a group of accounts as if they were a single account.

创建一个汇总账户，并将其他账户作为其子账户。

Create a summary account with the other account as children.
6.4

备忘录账户

Memo Account

在不进行交易的情况下，将部分金额记入附属账户。

Noting some quantity in a side account without using a transaction.

创建一个不影响实际交易且不持有实际物品的备忘录账户。

Create a memo account that does not affect real transactions and does not hold real items.
6.5

发帖规则

Posting Rules

账户间自动转账。

Automating transfers between accounts.

定义账户之间的过账规则。

Define a posting rule between the accounts.
6.6

个体实例法

Individual Instance Method

为每种类型的实例赋予其自身的操作方法。

Giving each instance of a type its own method for some operation.

为每个方法定义一个单例子类。

Define a singleton subclass for each method.

运用策略模式。

Use the strategy pattern.

创建一个隐藏在对象内部的 case 语句。

Create a case statement hidden inside the object.

将不同的行为拆分成参数。构建一个简单的解释器。

Separate the different behaviors into parameters. Build a simple interpreter.
6.7

发布规则执行

Posting Rule Execution

确保所有发布规则都在正确的时间执行。

Ensuring that the posting rules are all executed at the right time.

当账户中插入条目时，触发所有出站规则。

Fire all outbound rules when a entry is put into an account.

明确要求触发发帖规则。

Explicitly ask a posting rule to fire.

请某个账户解除其出站发帖规则。

Ask an account to fire its outbound posting rules.

当查询帐户时，反向链接发布规则。

Backward chain the posting rules when an account is queried.
6.8

许多账户的发帖规则

Posting Rules for Many Accounts

为多个账户定义相同的发帖规则。

Defining the same posting rules for many accounts.

定义账户类型的规则。

Define the rules on an account type.

定义汇总账户的规则。

Define the rules on a summary account.
6.9

选择参赛作品

Choosing Entries

请求账户提供其部分条目。

Asking an account for a subset of its entries.

向某个对象请求其某个收藏集中的部分物品。

Asking an object for a selection of objects in one of its collections.

该账户返回所有条目，调用者从中选择所需的条目。该账户为每个可能的子集提供相应的操作。

The account returns all entries, and the caller selects the ones it wants. The account provides an operation for each possible subset.

调用者向帐户传递一个过滤器对象。

The caller passes a filter object to the account.
6.10

会计实务

Accounting Practice

将多个发帖规则作为一个组进行分配。

Assigning several posting rules as a group.

建立一套会计制度将它们归类在一起。

Create an accounting practice to group them together.
6.11

入口来源

Sources of an Entry

查看交易是如何计算的。

Seeing how a transaction was calculated.

将创建过账规则及其在计算中使用的条目记录到新交易中。

Record the creating posting rule, and the entries that it used in the calculation, with the new transaction.
6.12

资产负债表和损益表

Balance Sheet and Income Statement

编制资产负债表和损益表。

Representing balance sheet and income statements.

创建账户子类型。

Create subtypes of account.
6.13

对应账户

Corresponding Account

调和双方对同一事件的不同看法。

Reconciling two parties' views of the same account.

将每个观点视为彼此对应的独立账户。

Treat each view as separate accounts that correspond to each other.
6.14

专业账户模式

Specialized Account Model

在具体案例中运用一般会计准则。

Using the general accounting patterns in a specific case.

根据特殊需求，对模式类型进行子类型划分。

Subtype the pattern's types to support the specialized needs.
6.15

记账分录账户

Booking Entries Accounts

将同一条目记入多个账户。

Putting an entry in more than one account.

将其中一个账户作为真实账户，另一个账户使用备注账户。

Treat one account as the real account and use a memo account for the other.

将其中一个账户作为真实账户，另一个账户使用派生账户。

Treat one account as the real account and use a derived account for the other.
8.1

拟议和已实施的行动

Proposed and Implemented Action

既体现了你的意图，也体现了你的实际行动。

Representing both what you intended to do and what you did.

建议的操作和已实施的操作应使用不同的对象。

Use separate objects for the proposed and implemented actions.
8.2

已完成和已放弃的行动

Completed and Abandoned Actions

说明某个动作是如何结束的。

Indicating how an action ended.

如果一项行动按预期完成，则该行动即告完成；否则，该行动即告放弃。

An action is completed if it was carried out as intended, abandoned if not.
8.3

暂停

Suspension

暂时中止某项行动。

Putting an action on a temporary hold.

暂停该动作。使用时间范围来表示动作持续时间。

Put a suspension on the action. Use a time range to show how long it lasts.
8.4

计划

Plan

记录一组您打算同时执行的行动。

Recording a group of proposed actions that you intend to perform together.

表示动作之间的依赖关系。

Representing the dependencies among actions.

允许不同的人协调彼此的计划。

Allowing different people to coordinate each other's plans.

计划是一系列由相互依赖关系联系在一起的拟议行动的集合。多个参与方可以制定不同的计划，但这些计划都指向同一个拟议行动。

A plan is a collection of proposed actions linked by dependencies. Several parties can have different plans that refer to the same proposed action.
8.5

协议

Protocol

多次以相同方式执行标准程序。

Performing standard procedures many times the same way.

操作可以按照协议执行。协议可以分解为通过依赖关系连接的子协议。

An action can be done according to a protocol. A protocol can be divided into subprotocols linked by dependencies.
8.6

资源分配

Resource Allocation

将资源分配给计划、方案和行动。

Allocating resources to plans, protocols, and actions.

一般资源分配分配一定数量的某种类型资源。特定资源分配分配特定的资源。

General resource allocations allocate a quantity of a resource type. Specific resource allocations allocate specific resources.
8.7

结果和开始功能

Outcome and Start Functions

了解何时执行某项规程，以及执行该规程的结果和任何后续行动将会是什么。

Knowing when to carry out a protocol and what the outcome of the protocol, and any actions, will be.

启动函数和结果函数将协议与触发该协议的观察概念联系起来，并且可能是该协议的结果。

Start functions and outcome functions link a protocol to the observation concepts that trigger it and may be the result of it.
9.1

合同

Contract

从买卖双方的角度记录交易。

Recording deals from the perspective of both the buyer and the seller.

使用同时服务于买卖双方的承包商。

Use a contractor with both buying and selling parties.
9.2

文件夹

Portfolio

根据不同目的动态选择合约。

Dynamically selecting contracts for different purposes.

动态选择对象。

Dynamically selecting objects.

将投资组合定义为合约的集合。合约的选择由筛选器决定——筛选器是一个布尔表达式，用于确定哪些合约符合投资组合的要求。

Define a portfolio as a collection of contracts. The contracts are selected by a filter — a Boolean expression used to determine which contracts fit the portfolio.
9.3

引用

Quote

买入价和卖出价是分开标示的。

Separate prices are given for buying and selling.

将两个价格合并成一个报价。

Combine both prices into a single quote.
9.4

设想

Scenario

乐器的价格会随着时间而变化。

Prices of instruments change over time.

考虑各种假设的价格组合。

Considering hypothetical combinations of prices.

一种乐器的价格会影响另一种乐器的价格。

Prices of one instrument can affect prices of another.

创建情景来捕捉市场的真实或假设状态。情景会给出该状态下任何金融工具的价格，并包含推导假设市场状态价格的规则。

Create a scenario to capture the real or hypothetical state of the market. A scenario gives the price of any instrument in that state and includes rules to derive prices for hypothetical market states.
10.1

远期合约

Forward Contracts

合约可能会在未来以今天的价格交付。

A contract may be delivered in the future at today's prices.

使用交易日期和交货日期分开的合同。

Use a contract with separate trade and delivery dates.
10.2

选项

Options

一方可能会在未来的某个时间点选择以预定价格买卖某物。

A party may choose to buy or sell something at a set price at some point in the future.

期权是合约的一种子类型，它具有额外的行为。期权是一个独立的对象，合约是其属性之一。

An option is a subtype of contract with the additional behavior. An option is a separate object with a contract as an attribute.
10.3

产品

Product

销售人员将组合选项视为一个整体，但经销商则将其视为一系列更简单的合同。

A combination option is seen as one item by the salesperson but as a collection of simpler contracts by the dealers.

销售人员看到一个包裹，但内部只能看到包裹里的物品。

A salesperson sees one package, but only the items in the package are seen internally.

将销售人员销售的产品视为产品，将内部估值的产品视为合同。

Treat what the salesperson sells as a product and what is internally valued as a contract.
10.4

子类型状态机

Subtype State Machines

屏障期权与普通期权的行为有所不同，但看起来像是期权的子类型。本文将探讨子类型和状态机的处理。

A barrier option has different behavior to an option, but seems like a subtype. Dealing with subtypes and state machines.

确保子类型对象和超类型对象都响应相同的事件。

Ensure both sub- and supertype objects respond to the same events.
10.5

并行应用程序和领域层次结构

Parallel Application and Domain Hierarchies

您正在用户界面中显示对象列表。这些对象是各种子类型，需要显示某些子类型的属性。您的用户界面对象不应因向不合适的对象发送消息而导致失败。

You are displaying a list of objects in a user interface. These objects are various subtypes, and some subtype properties need to be displayed. Your user interface objects must not fail by sending a message to an inappropriate object.

应用程序对象会检查域对象的类型，以确保它能够理解消息。为超类型提供一个包含所有子类型行为的接口。

The application object checks the type of the domain object to ensure it will understand the message. Give the supertype an interface that encompasses all subtype behaviors.

将这些属性视为运行时属性。使用由域对象加载的中间对象。

Treat the properties as a run time attribute. Use an intermediate object loaded by the domain object.

使用异常处理包。

Use exception handling package.
11.1

对软件包的多个访问级别

Multiple Access Levels to a Package

同一套餐的不同客户需要的行为量也不同。

Different clients of a package need different amounts of behavior.

将软件包拆分成多个独立的软件包，每个软件包对应一个访问级别。允许软件包拥有多个接口。

Split the package into separate packages for each level of access. Allow packages to have more than one interface.
11.2

相互可见性

Mutual Visibility

两个软件包中的类型需要相互识别。

Types in two packages need to see each other.

将两个包裹合并。

Combine the two packages.

有两个相互可见的包裹。

Have two mutually visible packages.

决定其中一种类型不能看到另一种类型。

Decide that one type cannot see the other.
11.3

子类型包

Subtyping Packages

在包中使用子类型。

Using subtypes with packages.

子类型可以放在单独的包中。包对子类型可见，但反之则不然。

The subtype can be put in a separate package. Visibility to the package is with the supertype, but not vice versa.
12.1

双层架构

Two-Tier Architecture

客户端/服务器系统上的分区软件。

Partitioning software on a client/server system.

将用户界面放在客户端，数据库放在服务器端。用户界面类直接访问数据库。

Put the user interface on the client and the database on the server. The user interface classes access the database directly.
12.2

三层架构

Three-Tier Architecture

这种两层架构将用户界面与数据库设计耦合得太紧密了。

The two-tier architecture couples the user interface too tightly to the database design.

数据库接口不支持丰富的领域模型。

The database interface cannot support a rich model of the domain.

具有三个逻辑层级：应用层、域层和数据库层。

Have three logical tiers: application, domain, and database.
12.3

表示层和应用层逻辑

Presentation and Application Logic

应用软件既负责解释领域模型，也负责驱动用户界面。

Application software handles both interpretation of the domain model and driving the user interface.

将应用层拆分为表示层（用户界面）和应用逻辑层（处理领域模型）。将应用逻辑层构建为一组用于表示层的门面（facade）。

Separate the application tier into presentation (user interface) and application logic (dealing with the domain model). Structure the application logic as a set of facades for the presentation.
12.4

数据库交互

Database Interaction

使用数据库。

Working with a database.

让领域类负责将自身保存到数据库中。创建一个单独的层来处理数据库和领域对象之间的交互。

Let the domain classes be responsible for saving themselves in the database. Create a separate layer to handle the interactions between database and domain objects.
14.1

实施协会

Implementing Associations

建立概念关联。

Implementing a conceptual association.

选择一个方向来实现，并使用一个操作和一个指针。

Choose one direction to implement, and use an operation and a pointer.

双向放置操作和指针。

Put operations and pointers in both directions.

两个方向都允许操作，但只有一个方向需要指针。另一个方向使用查找。

Put operations in both directions but a pointer only in one. Use lookup for the other direction.

将操作放在两个方向上，并使用表格和查找功能来查找指针。

Put operations in both directions, and use a table and lookup for the pointers.
14.2

实现泛化

Implementing Generalizations

实现泛化，尤其是在涉及多重和动态分类的情况下。

Implementing generalization, especially if multiple and dynamic classification is involved.

使用继承。

Use inheritance.

对于支持多重继承的每种子类型组合，都应使用类。使用内部标志。委托给隐藏类（状态模式）。

Use classes for each combination of subtypes with multiple inheritance. Use an internal flag. Delegate to a hidden class (state pattern).

复制并替换。

Copy and replace.
14.3

对象创建

Object Creation

创建对象。

Creating an object.

对于所有必需且不可变的映射，请使用带参数的创建方法。

Use a creation method with arguments for all mandatory and immutable mappings.
14.4

物体销毁

Object Destruction

销毁物体。

Destroying an object.

设定一个具体的销毁方法。定义删除操作的级联范围。

Have a specific destruction method. Define how much the delete should cascade.
14.5

入口点

Entry Point

开始寻找物品。

Starting to look for objects.

让类负责存储和查找其实例。

Let the class be responsible for storing and finding its instances.

让注册员查找并存储对象。

Have a registrar find and store objects.
14.6

实施约束

Implementing Constraints

实施约束。

Implementing constraints.

给每个对象添加一个用于检查其约束的操作。调试时，在修饰符的末尾调用该操作。

Give each object an operation to check its constraint. Call it at the end of modifiers when debugging.
15.1

关联类型

Associative Type

为关联添加功能。

Adding features to an association.

为关联创建一个类型。使用特殊符号。

Create a type for the association. Use a special notation.
15.2

键控映射

Keyed Mapping

表示映射中以另一种类型为键的值。

Representing values in a mapping that are keyed off another type.

使用键控映射。

Use a keyed mapping.
15.3

历史地图

Historic Mapping

记录映射的先前值。

Recording previous values of a mapping.

使用历史地图。

Use a historic mapping.
